article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Divinópolis alerta para vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis City Hall warns about measles vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil, enhances measles vaccination amid importation risk from the United States and other Americas. Despite high local coverage, the city’s Semusa warns of rising outbreaks abroad and mobilizes health posts, the Saúde na Hora program, and the Vacimóvel to ensure immunization. First-dose MMR coverage is 109.94% and second-dose 96.98% (percentages reflect population estimates). Free vaccination is available at municipal posts, ten Saúde na Hora units, and the Vacimóvel; residents—children, adults up to 59 years, and health workers—should verify and update their immunization records. The MMR vaccine protects against measles, mumps, and rubella; the schedule provides the first dose at 12 months and the second at 15 months. People up to 29 years need two documented doses, while adults 30–59 require at least one dose; health workers must have two up-to-date doses. The Immunization Central’s coordinator is Tércio Leão.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリス市役所、麻疹ワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 実際の麻疹アウトブレイクではなく、輸入リスクに備えた予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ディヴィノーポリス市における予防接種啓発キャンペーンに関する内容で、現地での麻疹発生自体は報告されていない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、実際の感染症発生ではなく予防的措置の記事であるため、イベントとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемиолог допустил завоз Эболы в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An epidemiologist allowed the importation of Ebola into Russia.
article.articleSummary: Epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko, academician of the Russian Academy of Sciences, says Ebola importation into Russia from the Democratic Republic of Congo is possible but would not spread domestically. In a TASS interview, he argued that while Ebola could be brought in, rapid detection would prevent transmission, and it is not transmitted via airborne droplets as SARS-CoV-2. Ebola spreads through close contact with the secretions of infected people. He noted the current outbreak is less active than the 2016 surge. August reports suggested the DRC outbreak could become the largest on record, and in October MSF warned that spread in North Kivu province in eastern DRC had gotten out of control. The article frames Russia as facing imported risk rather than ongoing domestic transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学者、ロシアへのエボラ熱の持ち込みの可能性を指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行がMSFにより「制御不能」と警告され、過去最大規模になる可能性も報じられており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアへの輸入リスクに関する専門家コメントが主題だが、実際のアウトブレイクはDRC北キブ州で発生しており、MSFが拡大制御不能と警告、史上最大規模化の懸念も報じられている。ロシアは発生国ではなく輸入リスクの議論対象に過ぎないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。続報でDRCの疫学状況（症例数・致死率・対応状況）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes pastikan belum ditemukan kasus super flu di Situbondo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office confirms that no super flu cases have been found in Situbondo.
article.articleSummary: Situbondo, East Java, reports no cases of influenza type A ('super flu') based on the local government laboratory, with only influenza-like illness (ILI) and pneumonia detected. In week 39 (Sept. 27–Oct. 3, 2026), ILI rose by 38 cases to 251 across 15 facilities (puskesmas and district hospitals), the largest increase at Puskesmas Asembagus (76.2%). Public health actions include distributing influenza information and cough etiquette guidance; authorities encourage high-risk groups to receive influenza vaccination voluntarily. High-risk individuals are under-5 children, adults over 60 with comorbidities, and pregnant women. Officials also promote hygiene and healthy living, advising regular handwashing, balanced nutrition, and exercise, via posyandu, community programs, and schools to prevent spread of respiratory illness.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、シトゥボンドでスーパーフル（インフルエンザA型）の症例は確認されていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事はむしろ「スーパーフル」症例が確認されていないことを伝える内容であり、ILI増加も通常の季節性範囲内の対応として報告されているため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主旨は『スーパーフル（インフルエンザA型）の症例は確認されていない』という否定的内容であり、ILI増加も通常の監視対応の範囲内。地域的にはインドネシア・シトゥボンドの話だが、対象国リストに含まれるインドネシアであっても、イベントの実態は『疑い例なし』の報告であるため、シグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Quase 9 mil crianças estão sem aulas em Lagoa Santa (MG) por causa de surto de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Almost 9,000 children are out of school in Lagoa Santa (MG) due to a human scabies outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 9,000 children in Lagoa Santa, part of the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area in Minas Gerais, are out of school due to a human scabies outbreak. As of Oct 9, 2026, 178 infections have been recorded in the city, with 12 new cases confirmed in the last 24 hours. To curb transmission, all 25 municipal schools will close for a comprehensive hygiene and sanitization campaign. With the scheduled school recess next week, classes are expected to resume on Oct 19. The outbreak is driving widespread disruption to education in Lagoa Santa and highlights the need for prompt public health and sanitation measures to control the spread of human scabies in community settings.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴアサンタ（ミナスジェライス州）で疥癬（ヒゼンダニ症）の集団発生、約9000人の子供が休校に
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国内の限定地域における学校関連の集団発生であり重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、約9000人規模に影響し行政対応（学校閉鎖）が取られているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症度が低く、通常は国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しないが、学校閉鎖による社会的影響が大きいため注視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia Trung Quốc đánh giá về nguy cơ dịch hạch lây lan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Chinese expert assesses the risk of bubonic plague transmission.
article.articleSummary: Low risk of bubonic plague spreading to China, says Li Tongzeng, physician at Beijing You’an Hospital, Capital Medical University. Plague is not highly transmissible and typically presents with noticeable symptoms, aiding border detection. Ebola-like pathogens can spread from asymptomatic individuals, making such diseases more dangerous. Russia reports no health threats after the Irkutsk case: Darya Shipilova, 28, an employee at the Plague Research Institute in Irkutsk, fell ill during work and died on Oct 2, 2026 in Shelekhov. Russian authorities, per Rospotrebnadzor, say the worker was diagnosed with pneumonia of unknown origin; media claims of pneumonic plague due to a broken vial are unconfirmed. Governor Kobzev notes contact tracing found no related cases; about 5,000 tests were conducted. Russia urges public calm and continues cooperation on infectious diseases with China.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の専門家、ペスト流行拡大のリスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し肺ペストの疑いが報じられたが、ロシア当局は未確認とし接触者追跡で関連症例なしと発表。中国への拡大リスクは専門家により低いと評価されており、確定情報が不足するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 事例の発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国は専門家によるリスク評価の発言主体として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations は空とした。ペストか肺炎かの診断も未確定であり続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza pada Anak, Kenali Tanda Bahaya yang Tak Boleh Diabaikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Children: Recognize the Warning Signs That Should Not Be Ignored.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases are rising in Indonesia, particularly among children. In Jakarta, Liputan6 reported remarks from Dr. Imyadelna Ibna Nila Utama of RSAB Harapan Kita: urgent medical evaluation is needed when fever lasts more than three days, or children have severe cough and runny nose, nausea, or lethargy; rapid breathing or chest retractions, blue lips, chest pain, seizures, or difficulty waking require care. Dehydration and temporary improvement followed by worsening are warning signs. Typical influenza begins with sudden fever, cough, sore throat, muscle aches, headache, and fatigue, and while most recover, risks are higher for children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities, with pneumonia as a potential complication. For mild illness, fever/pain relief (paracetamol) may be used with medical advice; severe symptoms demand clinical assessment. Prevent by handwashing, cough etiquette, masking when ill or in crowds, limiting close contact, and annual vaccination per Kemenkes.

triage.headline_ja: 子供のインフルエンザ:見逃してはいけない危険な兆候を知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は医師による一般的な注意喚起であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例数急増を示すデータはない。

article.articleHeadline: 上山砍毛竹突然被"刺"，处置不当可能诱发致命感染！医生提醒→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Going up the mountain to cut Moso bamboo, a sudden thorn prick could lead to a deadly infection if not treated properly—doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: 69-year-old man in Zhejiang Province, China, sustained a left-forearm deep, narrow puncture wound from a bamboo splinter while cutting Moso bamboo. Although the wound initially appeared to heal, within three days he developed toothache, trismus, and jaw stiffness, followed by back tightness, muscle spasms, and later generalized convulsions. He was admitted in respiratory failure and diagnosed with tetanus at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine. After targeted supportive care, he recovered from the life-threatening phase. Tetanus is caused by Clostridium tetani, which thrives in anaerobic wounds and releases a potent toxin; without intervention, death can approach 100%. Early signs include jaw locking and neck/back stiffness. Deep, narrow puncture wounds, contaminated wounds, dirt exposure, or animal bites increase risk. Vaccination remains the core preventive measure. Wound cleaning and, if indicated, tetanus immune globulin or antitoxin should be promptly used, and suspicious symptoms warrant urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: 山に登ってモウソウチクを切っていたところ突然とげが刺さり、適切な処置をしないと致命的な感染症を引き起こす可能性がある！医師が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 個別の破傷風症例報告であり、人-人感染性や公衆衛生上の広範な影響はなく、単発事例として注意喚起を目的とした記事であるため。
triage.notes: 破傷風は非感染性（ヒト-ヒト感染なし）の個別外傷症例であり、公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクではないため対象国リストへの計上も不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو ترتفع إلى 8728 والوفيات تتجاوز 4200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Congo rise to 8,728, with deaths exceeding 4,200.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,728 cases and 4,205 deaths, per the National Institute of Public Health's daily update. In the latest 24-hour period, 63 new cases and 27 deaths were recorded, with 10 patients recovering. The outbreak remains active and widespread across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with ongoing transmission reported by health authorities. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kasia warned that the virus could cross borders into neighboring countries as the epidemic persists in the region, highlighting cross-border risk and the need for sustained public health response. The figures reflect reported cases and fatalities up to the present update.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が8,728人に上昇、死者数は4,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率が高く国境を越える拡大リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDC長官が近隣国への越境リスクを警告している点は、感染症の国際的拡大の懸念を示す重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉突破国境！肯尼亚爆首例死亡　患者竟闯过机场筛检
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Breaks Borders! Kenya Reports Its First Death; The Patient Even Bypassed Airport Screening.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (EVD) death, signaling cross-border spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda to Nairobi. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in DRC for seven years, fell ill about a month earlier, traveled by land from Uganda on Oct 2, and arrived at Nairobi’s Jomo Kenyatta International Airport on Oct 3. On arrival he underwent routine public-health screening and was placed in a dedicated isolation facility after developing fever, chills, sore throat, swallowing difficulty, and subcutaneous bleeding—typical hemorrhagic symptoms. Lab confirmation by the Kenya National Virology Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute confirmed EVD. He died on Oct 5 despite supportive care. Officials acknowledge screening gaps possibly masked by medication, with 652,584 travelers screened and 267 tests conducted; 28 contacts identified, including 23 fellow passengers and 4 crew. Since May, DRC has reported over 8,000 cases and 4,000 deaths; no approved vaccines or therapies for this strain, four vaccines in development (one in human trials). Kenya is the fourth country to report cases after Uganda and France.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が国境を越える！ケニアで初の死亡例を報告　患者は空港検疫をすり抜けていた
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でケニアへ国境を越えて拡大し、空港検疫をすり抜けた患者が死亡。IHR基準を複数満たす重大な国際公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC発のエボラ流行が国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニア・フランスへ拡大したこと。ケニア・ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行の起点として本文で詳細に言及（5月以降8000例以上、4000人以上死亡）されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 惠州疾控："两热"输入风险较高，返惠须开展14天健康监测
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Huizhou CDC: The importation risk of “Two Fevers” is high; those returning to Huizhou must undergo 14 days of health monitoring.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Huizhou Center for Disease Control warns that importation risk of dengue fever and chikungunya fever (the 'Two Fevers') is high. With the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays ending, many residents return to Huizhou, particularly from overseas or Southeast Asia, raising importation risk. Returning individuals from areas with dengue and chikungunya activity should undertake 14 days of self-health monitoring. Key symptoms to watch for include sudden high fever up to 39–40°C, rash (red maculopapular) on body, back, limbs, or palms/soles, and joint pains in wrists, ankles, and knees. If any symptoms occur, do not ignore or self-medicate; seek hospital or community health service, and inform clinicians about travel history to enable testing for 'Two Fevers'. Maintain vector control at home and while out: drain standing water, wear long sleeves, and use effective repellents to reduce transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 恵州疾病予防管理センター：「二熱（デング熱・チクングニア熱）」の輸入リスクが高く、帰郷者は14日間の健康観察が必要
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や流行拡大の報告はなく、休暇後の帰省者向けの定例的な予防啓発情報であり、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の症例報告ではなく、国慶節・中秋節連休後の帰省者に対する輸入リスク注意喚起および予防行動の呼びかけである。具体的な感染者数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 上山砍毛竹被"刺" 7天后呼吸衰竭 警惕破伤风感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pricked by a bamboo thorn while cutting Moso bamboo on a hillside; seven days later he developed respiratory failure; beware tetanus infection.
article.articleSummary: 69-year-old man in Zhejiang, China developed tetanus after a bamboo thorn puncture on his left forearm while cutting Moso bamboo on a hillside. The initial wound was red and pus-filled but appeared to heal; three days later he experienced jaw pain and trismus, then chewing difficulty, followed by neck/back stiffness, generalized muscle spasms, and respiratory failure. He was transferred to Zhejiang University First Affiliated Hospital, diagnosed with tetanus, and survived after symptomatic treatment. Tetanus is caused by Clostridium tetani spores entering through wounds in anaerobic conditions, releasing a potent toxin; the lethal dose is under 1 microgram and mortality approaches 100% without treatment. Early symptoms include trismus, a sardonic smile, neck/back stiffness, and widespread spasms; prognosis worsens when the wound is closer to the CNS. The report highlights that any deep, contaminated puncture—not just rusty nails—can harbor spores, underscoring the need for proper wound care after outdoor injuries.

triage.headline_ja: 竹の棘が刺さり7日後に呼吸不全、破傷風感染に注意
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の拡大リスクはなく、破傷風は一般的に知られた非伝染性疾患であるため国際的な懸念に該当しない。
triage.notes: 破傷風は土壌中のクロストリジウム菌芽胞による創傷感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染しないため公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。単一症例の医療啓発記事。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو ترتفع إلى 8728 والوفيات تتجاوز 4200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 8,728, and deaths exceed 4,200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 8,728 cases with 4,205 deaths, according to the National Institute for Public Health's daily tally issued from Kinshasa on 9 October 2026. In the last 24 hours, 63 new infections and 27 deaths were recorded, while 10 patients recovered. John Kasia, Director-General of Africa CDC, warned that the outbreak risks crossing into neighboring countries as transmission continues throughout the DRC. The update underscores a persistent outbreak within the nation and the ongoing need for enhanced surveillance, infection prevention, case management, community engagement, and cross-border coordination to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者8,728人に増加、死者4,200人超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模に継続拡大しており、致死率約48%・越境リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが近隣国への越境拡大リスクを警告しており、国際的な支援・監視強化が継続的に必要とされる状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Weekly Situation Update on Ongoing Health Emergency Events in South Sudan - Week #40, Date: 28 Sep - 4 Oct 2026 - South Sudan
article.articleSummary: Week 40 (28 Sep–4 Oct 2026) South Sudan update: Sustain BVD preparedness across 15 priority counties as DRC records 8,375 cases and Kenya reports its first imported case; PoE screening totals 72,183 (1–3 Oct) with continued readiness along the western corridor. Cholera response continues in Mayom and Renk, with a cumulative 112,186 cases and 15 new cases plus 1 death in Fangak; aim for 100% rapid diagnostic testing and an earliest end-of-outbreak declaration by 26 Oct. Poliovirus outbreak response accelerates with five new cVDPV1 and one new cVDPV2 case; cVDPV2 now extends to Awerial, Lakes; finalize R1 National Immunization Day readiness and address active measles outbreaks in Tonj North and Aweil South. Guinea Worm surveillance shows 0 human and animal cases in 2026, with 3 wild-cat detections in Week 40; continuing health education, water treatment, and pipe-filter distribution in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO南スーダンにおける継続中の健康緊急事態に関する週次状況報告 - 第40週（2026年9月28日～10月4日）
triage.triage_reason: コレラ・ポリオ（cVDPV1/cVDPV2）・麻疹など複数の疾患が南スーダンで継続流行し、ポリオウイルスは新たな地域（Awerial, Lakes）に拡大、国境を越えた予防体制強化（DRCでの8,375例、ケニアでの輸入症例）が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南スーダンの複数疾患（コレラ、ポリオ、麻疹、ギニア虫症）の状況報告だが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCについてはBVD（恐らくエムポックス等）関連で具体的な症例数（8,375例）が明示されているため、実発生国として included。ケニア・チャドは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Fatty Liver Cells Turn On a Caspase-2 Death Pathway That Damps Hepatitis B
article.articleSummary: HBV infection intersects with MASLD; in vitro study from China uses HepG2.2.15 HBV-producing hepatocytes from Central South University’s Second Xiangya Hospital. Free fatty acids (oleate:palmitate 2:1) induce steatosis, confirmed by triglyceride content and Oil Red O staining. Lipotoxicity triggers a modest apoptosis and activates a TNF-α/TNFR1/Caspase-8/Caspase-2 axis. All HBV replication markers decline concurrently: intracellular HBV DNA, pregenomic RNA, HBsAg, and HBeAg. TNF-α neutralization partially restores viral markers and reduces pathway activation, providing causal evidence that this inflammatory signaling suppresses HBV under lipotoxic stress. The study further uses a Caspase-2 inhibitor to probe its role, implying Caspase-2 contributes to reduced HBV replication in steatotic cells.

triage.headline_ja: 脂肪肝細胞がカスパーゼ2死滅経路を活性化し、B型肝炎の複製を抑制
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（in vitro細胞実験）であり、公衆衛生上の発生事例や流行報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 中国の研究機関による基礎医学研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生事象ではないため地域検証の対象外（verified_locationsは空配列）。

article.articleHeadline: Josh Teams launched across J&K to strengthen TB elimination efforts
article.articleSummary: TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan's Josh Teams rolled out in the Kashmir Division, Jammu and Kashmir, with a national launch by Union Health Minister J P Nadda from New Delhi. In Kashmir, state-level dignitaries included Akriti Sagar IAS, Dr Nighat Yasmeen, Dr Basra Mir, WHO consultant Dr Ishfaq Nazir, NCC and MyBharat representatives, NHM programme managers, and NTEP staff. Following the state-level launch, events were held across all districts with Chief Medical Officers, District Officers, and frontline workers in attendance. Each block-level Josh Team comprises five NCC cadets and five MyBharat volunteers, tasked with community mobilisation, grassroots awareness and strengthening anti-TB campaigns. 2,061 Panchayats in Kashmir Division were felicitated for attaining certified TB-Free Status; Nikshay Mitras and frontline workers were honoured. The initiative seeks youth involvement to promote timely testing and treatment toward a TB-free Kashmir, in line with TB Mukt Bharat.

triage.headline_ja: JK州でTB撲滅の取り組み強化のため「Joshチーム」が発足
triage.triage_reason: 結核撲滅に向けた政府の啓発・対策プログラムの発足報道であり、新規発生や異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のTB対策プログラム（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan）の拡大実施に関する行政・啓発活動の報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Cara Mencegah Penularan Influenza Tipe A dan Mengenali Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to Prevent the Transmission of Influenza A and Recognize Its Symptoms
article.articleSummary: Influenza A transmission risk highlighted by Jakarta-based clinician Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, Sp.MK. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets during coughing, sneezing, or speaking at close range, with symptoms typically more severe than common flu appearing 1–4 days after exposure. Preventive measures emphasize mask use in crowded or enclosed spaces, and annual vaccination due to ongoing antigenic drift and waning antibodies. Additional precautions include proper cough and sneeze etiquette (avoid covering the mouth with hands; use disposable tissues or the inner elbow) and rigorous hand hygiene to block surface-to-face spread. For detection, rapid antigen testing with nasal or nasopharyngeal swabs is available; however, for severe cases or high-risk groups, PCR or other molecular methods are recommended for higher sensitivity. The guidance originates from Jakarta as of 9 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型の感染予防法と症状の見分け方
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団感染やアウトブレイクではなく、臨床医による一般的な予防啓発情報であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的なアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、インフルエンザA型全般に関する予防啓発・教育的内容であるため、特定の発生国として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: 秋冬常见疾病防控要点来了 防蚊虫 防过敏 防感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Key points for the prevention and control of common autumn and winter diseases are here: prevent mosquitoes and other insects; prevent allergies; prevent infections.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and Chikungunya fever are flagged as risks in Guangxi, China, linked to the Aedes albopictus mosquito. Early symptoms for both diseases include high fever, headache, and muscle–joint pains, sometimes with rash, easily mistaken for a common flu. People are advised to seek prompt medical care if fever of unknown origin or joint pain arises, and to inform clinicians about travel and mosquito exposure. Prevention centers on mosquito control: wear long sleeves and pants outdoors in parks, along rivers, and in forests; reapply approved repellents every 2–4 hours; ensure hotel screens and nets are intact; eliminate standing water around homes to curb breeding. Autumn allergies (dust mites, mold) can aggravate rhinitis and asthma; outdoors, wear masks and avoid allergen-heavy areas, then wash face, nasal passages, and clothing after exposure. Maintain hand hygiene, avoid gatherings when ill, and practice mask use and early medical care during travel or in crowded indoor spaces.

triage.headline_ja: 秋冬の一般的な疾病予防対策のポイント：蚊虫対策、アレルギー対策、感染予防
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な疾病予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告がなく、異常性や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 本記事は広西チワン族自治区における季節性疾病（デング熱、チクングニア熱、アレルギー等）の一般的な予防啓発内容であり、具体的な発生状況や患者数の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 屏縣再添本土登革熱病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pingtung County reports another locally transmitted dengue fever case.
article.articleSummary: On October 8, 2026, Taiwan’s CDC announced a new locally transmitted dengue fever case in Pingtung County. The patient is a woman in her 40s residing in Pingtung City who developed fever, headache, muscle pain, and diarrhea in early October. She tested positive for dengue virus type 4 and is hospitalized; cohabiting contacts are asymptomatic. Exposure likely near home; no overseas travel history. Virus sequencing will be performed to clarify the infection source. Nationally, 188 confirmed dengue cases to date, including 13 locally acquired: Kaohsiung City (10), Changhua County (2), and Pingtung County (1); 175 imported, with Vietnam contributing 48 cases—the largest single-country source. Monitoring and vector control ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 屏東県で新たな国内感染型デング熱症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内の季節性デング熱の個別症例報告であり、既存の監視体制下での通常の症例追加に過ぎず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみでイベント発生地ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna humana leva à suspensão de aulas em Lagoa Santa; cidade registra 253 notificações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of human scabies leads to suspension of classes in Lagoa Santa; the city records 253 notifications.
article.articleSummary: Lagoa Santa, part of the Belo Horizonte metropolitan region in Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports a human scabies outbreak with 253 notified cases as of Oct 8, including 178 confirmed and 75 under investigation. In the previous 24 hours, 12 new cases were recorded. The municipality suspended municipal-school activities on Oct 7 to enable cleaning and transmission-control efforts; the first case was identified on Sept 18. Regional distribution shows Norte with 91 cases (~36%), followed by Leste (19%), Sul (11.9%), Nordeste (6.3%), Centro-Oeste (5.1%), and 55 cases (21.7%) with unknown origin. The Municipal Mércia Margarida Lacerda School had previously suspended after 21 cases among students and one teacher. Scabies is caused by a mite and spreads via close contact and sharing of clothes, towels, or bed linens. All cases were referred for evaluation and treatment; contacts may require concurrent treatment. Other Minas Gerais outbreaks include Andradas, Itapecerica, Lavras, Joaquim Felício, Coronel Xavier Chaves, and Alfenas.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタで疥癬の集団発生、授業休止に;市内で253件の届出
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性が低く国際的拡大リスクも低いが、学校休止など地域的影響があり、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疥癬はダニによる接触感染症で、重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、学校での集団発生が継続しており地域の公衆衛生対応として注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa libera testes em humanos para vacina inédita contra malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa clears human trials for an unprecedented malaria vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa cleared on Oct 7, 2026, phase 1 human trials for Vivaxin, Brazil’s malaria vaccine targeting Plasmodium vivax. The study, conducted by UFMG, USP, and Cristália, will enroll 48 healthy adults (18–59) with no malaria history at Hospital das Clínicas da UFMG in Belo Horizonte. It will assess three dosing regimens versus placebo, given in three injections 28 days apart, with about one year of follow-up. Primary goals are safety, tolerability, and immunogenicity; efficacy cannot be determined in this initial phase. There is no licensed vaccine against P. vivax, though WHO-recommended vaccines target P. falciparum. Malaria parasites transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, with P. vivax prevalent in Latin America and Asia, accounting for 63.1% of estimated Americas cases in 2024. Authorization does not imply commercialization or population access; further trials are required.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、マラリア新規ワクチンのヒト試験を承認
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチンの第1相臨床試験承認に関する科学・医療ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるP. vivaxワクチン候補Vivaxinの第1相試験承認に関する報道であり、アウトブレイクや感染症の発生報告ではない。発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが、イベントとしては疾患発生でなくワクチン開発ニュースのため、感染症イベントとしての地域検証は該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kaltim ingatkan warga tingkatkan waspada ISPA dan DBD saat kemarau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Kalimantan Health Office reminds residents to heighten vigilance for ARI and dengue fever during the dry season.
article.articleSummary: East Kalimantan’s Health Office warns of rising risks of Acute Respiratory Infection (ISPA/ARI), diarrhea, and dengue fever (DBD) during the dry season in Samarinda and across ten districts of Kalimantan Timur. Limited access to clean water and dusty conditions may fuel ARI and diarrhea outbreaks, while drought-driven water storage can boost Aedes aegypti breeding, elevating dengue risk. Authorities urge continued 3M Plus measures—drain, cover water storage, and regular larvicidal powder application—alongside hand hygiene and boiling drinking water. Hot, dry weather, dust, and potential haze from land fires could worsen respiratory cases; citizens should wear masks outdoors, limit strenuous activity, and ensure adequate water intake. Health facilities in all ten districts should strengthen medicine logistics and conduct weekly case monitoring, and residents are advised not to delay medical checks, seeking care at puskesmas or local clinics if fever or breathing difficulties occur.

triage.headline_ja: 東カリマンタン州保健局、乾季におけるARI（急性呼吸器感染症）とDBD（デング熱）への警戒強化を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 乾季の季節的な注意喚起であり、デング熱・ARIともに通常の予防啓発レベルの内容で、異常な増加や重篤な事例報告はない。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局による季節性注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な増加のデータは記載されていない。デング熱は毎年乾季・雨季の変わり目に地域で流行する風土病的性質が強く、新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 多人婚宴吃席后腹泻呕吐，佛山通报：初步判定为食源性疾病聚集事件__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people develop diarrhea and vomiting after attending wedding banquets; Foshan reports: preliminary determination that this is a cluster of foodborne illness.
article.articleSummary: Diarrhea and vomiting occurred among attendees of wedding banquets in Foshan, Guangdong, linked to Foshan Huakai Palace Banquet Catering Management Co., in Chancheng District. About 200 guests at one wedding banquet were affected; 3–4 diners at neighboring tables also fell ill, with roughly 100 patients later admitted to Foshan Second People’s Hospital. On Oct 9, the Chancheng Market Supervision Administration announced a preliminary foodborne illness cluster, citing unsafe food processing practices at the catering company. Authorities conducted on-site inspections, collected samples of ingredients, leftover foods, and environmental specimens, and health/CDC teams performed epidemiological and contact tracing. Some collected samples tested positive for pathogenic bacteria. Based on site investigations, epidemiology, and lab results, the incident is being treated as a foodborne disease cluster with the company under investigation. The firm has paused banquet receptions since Oct 7 to implement full rectification.

triage.headline_ja: 多数が結婚披露宴後に下痢・嘔吐、佛山市当局：食品由来疾患の集団発生と初步判定
triage.triage_reason: 広東省佛山市の結婚披露宴で約100人が入院する食中毒クラスターが発生したが、原因は特定の飲食店の食品衛生問題によるものであり、人-人感染や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。地域当局が調査・対応中であり、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本事例は単一の飲食店に起因する食中毒（細菌性）クラスターであり、感染症の国際的拡大リスクは低い。病原体の種類や患者の重症度詳細は不明であり、今後の検査結果・当局発表を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya ramps up Ebola measures after 1st case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case, with 57 contacts identified and 10 under quarantine as authorities intensify tracing. The patient, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, fell ill there, was treated at several hospitals, then traveled by road to Kampala and flew to Nairobi, where he was admitted and isolated at Nairobi Hospital and died Monday night. Health Secretary Aden Duale described the case as imported, not an outbreak, and said contacts—family, health workers, immigration officials—are being traced, with numbers expected to rise. The Ministry of Health activated national surveillance; travelers arriving from 10 countries face enhanced screening. At Malaba border, officials shifted to active response. DR Congo’s outbreak totals exceed 8,660 cases and 4,170 deaths, with new hotspots and 70% of new cases outside known contacts; 60% of deaths occur outside treatment centers. South Sudan has stepped up preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ症例確認後、対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラ流行（8,660例以上、死者4,170人）を背景に、ケニアで初の輸入症例が確認され国境を越えた拡大リスクが顕在化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例であるが、ケニア・ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。実際にエボラ流行が継続しているDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。

article.articleHeadline: 佛山多人婚宴吃席后腹泻呕吐，官方已立案调查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people in Foshan experience diarrhea and vomiting after attending a wedding banquet; authorities have opened a case and launched an investigation.
article.articleSummary: In Foshan, Guangdong, attendees of a wedding banquet hosted by Foshan Huakai Palace Banquet Catering Management Co., Ltd. in Chan Cheng District experienced diarrhea and vomiting after the event, prompting an investigation as a suspected foodborne illness cluster. On October 9, 2026, the Chan Cheng District Market Supervision Administration announced findings of nonstandard food processing at the implicated venue, ordering immediate remediation. Combined with on-site inspections, epidemiological tracing, and sampling, authorities preliminarily classified the incident as a foodborne disease cluster and filed a case against the unit. The company stated it had paused banquet receptions since October 7 to undertake full rectification. Laboratory tests detected pathogenic bacteria in some samples from attendees. Health authorities, including the health and disease control departments, will continue investigations and risk assessments to strengthen food safety and protect the public.”} ,

triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での食中毒クラスターであり、病原体は食品由来と特定されつつあるため国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の重大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 食品衛生当局による調査・摘発が行われており、原因施設は特定・是正済み。感染症としての拡大リスクは低いローカルな食中毒事例。

article.articleHeadline: India struggles to curb leprosy transmission
article.articleSummary: India reported 91,783 new leprosy cases in 2025-26, 41.2% above the projected 65,000, with child cases 91.6% above projection. Grade 2 Disability (G2D) among new cases was 1.34 per million, above the target of 1 per million. National prevalence stood at 0.56 per 10,000 at end-March 2026, below the elimination threshold of <1 per 10,000, but transmission remains geographically concentrated: states with highest prevalence were Chhattisgarh (1.66), Jharkhand (1.51), Chandigarh (1.49), Odisha (1.25), and Maharashtra (1.14) per 10,000. District-level burden: 14.8% of districts (>1/10,000) in 2025-26, down from 18.6% in 2013-14; 114 districts above elimination target, while only 148 districts achieved interruption of transmission (vs 300 projected). G2D cases (1,945 total) clustered in Chandigarh, Delhi, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha (42.5%). Chandigarh 13.54, Delhi 11.53, Chhattisgarh 7.87 per million. SDR PEP coverage reached 91.2% of 16.94 lakh eligible contacts in 2025-26 (up from 71.4% of 6.48 lakh in 2019-20). Source: National Leprosy Eradication Programme (2025-26).

triage.headline_ja: インドがハンセン病感染抑制に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: 慢性疾患であるハンセン病の統計報告であり急性の公衆衛生危機ではないが、新規症例数が予測を大幅に上回り地域的な伝播継続が示唆されるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ハンセン病は慢性感染症で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、国家プログラムのデータとして予測を上回る新規症例数・小児症例増加・特定州への集中が報告されており、公衆衛生プログラムの進捗として注視価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: 'หมอยง' เคลียร์ชัด! 'กาฬโรค' จะกลับระบาดใหญ่จริงหรือ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Yong Sets the Record Straight! Will the Plague Return as a Major Outbreak?
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Thai infectious-disease expert Dr. Yong Poovorawan states there is no confirmed plague case. A female scientist who died from pneumonia remains under investigation; she worked in a laboratory dealing with plague, fueling speculation but lacking confirmation. Plague has three forms—bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic—with pneumonic plague capable of human-to-human transmission via droplets but with relatively low spread (R0 ≈ 1.3). In Russia, a pneumonia case prompted quarantine of about 200 contacts; none tested positive for plague, and 90% of quarantines have been released, with no secondary cases detected. The deceased’s pneumonia is of unknown origin. If plague occurs, antibiotics exist and post-exposure prophylaxis is available. Overall, Thailand’s outbreak risk is considered low; no outbreak or secondary clustering is evident, but calls for transparent, rapid investigations if the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: 「ヨン医師」が明確に否定！『ペスト』は本当に大流行するのか？
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内でのペスト確定例はなく、ロシアでの肺炎症例も検査陰性で二次感染も確認されていない。専門家が流行の可能性を否定する内容であり、現時点でシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアでの肺炎症例（ペスト研究者）に関する調査結果とタイ国内への影響に関する専門家コメントであり、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、タイでは確定例がないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 佛山通报多人就餐后身体不适：初判为食源性疾病聚集事件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foshan reports multiple people ill after dining together: preliminary assessment indicates a cluster of foodborne illnesses.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-09, Foshan, Guangdong Province, China, Chancheng District Market Supervision Administration reported a cluster of foodborne illnesses linked to dining at Foshan Huakai Palace Banquet Catering Management Co., Ltd. Authorities, in coordination with health and disease control departments, conducted on-site investigations and containment measures. Investigations found nonstandard food processing practices and ordered immediate corrective actions. To identify the cause, the district delegated professional food-testing agencies to sample ingredients and leftover foods, while the disease control department tested affected individuals and environmental samples. Some collected samples tested positive for pathogenic bacteria, supporting a preliminary diagnosis of a foodborne disease cluster. A case has been filed against the catering company. Next steps include lawful disposition and strengthened food-safety risk surveillance to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: 佛山、多人数が会食後に体調不良を報告：初期判断は食源性疾患の集団発生事件
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での食中毒クラスターであり、病原細菌が検出され原因特定・対応が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、通常の食品衛生事案として処理されている。
triage.notes: 単一の飲食店に関連した食中毒クラスター事案であり、感染症の国際的脅威としての要件は満たさない。地方当局により既に調査・是正措置が実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: 俄鼠疫疑雲驚變！死者母親：試管根本摔不破 | 肺鼠疫 | 俄羅斯 | 世衛
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian plague rumors take a dramatic turn! The mother of the deceased: the test tube simply can't be broken | Pneumonic plague | Russia | WHO
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a suspected pneumonic plague case at Irkutsk’s plague research institute after a death on Oct 2, with about 200 contacts quarantined. The World Health Organization seeks more information on tests performed, public health measures, and contact health status; Russia says no second case as of Oct 8 and has tested roughly 5,000 samples with no dangerous pathogen found. The deceased, Darya Shipilova, was vaccinated and no lab accident is identified. Her mother, Svetlana Shipilova, a medical professional, publicly disputes the claim that infection came from breaking a test tube. The New York Post highlights expert skepticism about lab leaks or bioweapons research and notes pathogen modification as a possibility; former CDC director Redfield discusses antibiotic treatment implications. Trump plans to discuss with Putin for more data. Mongolia tightens border monitoring; northeast China (Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning) reports panic and hoarding of PPE and meds, with rumors of lockdowns.)

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑惑が急展開！死亡者の母親：試験管は壊れるはずがない｜肺ペスト｜ロシア｜WHO
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストの疑い死亡例をめぐりWHOが情報提供を要請し、国境管理強化や周辺国でのパニック的買い占めが発生するなど、IHR基準の複数（異常性、渡航・貿易制限リスク、重篤性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国東北部（黒竜江・吉林・遼寧）は実際の感染発生ではなくパニック・買い占めの反応のみが報告されているため、記事の主題発生国とは認定せずverified_locationsから除外した。モンゴル・米国も対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: 秋季海产集中上市 谨防食源性疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autumn seafood marketed in bulk; beware of foodborne diseases.
article.articleSummary: Autumn seafood markets in Nanchang reopen after the summer fishing moratorium, with abundant fish, shrimp, crabs, and shellfish. The Nanchang Center for Disease Control issues a health alert warning that seafood can trigger gastroenteritis, allergic reactions, and gout if misused. Key recommendations: verify freshness (fish eyes bright, gills red, flesh firm; crabs lively with intact shells; prawns translucent; shellfish that close and spit sand); avoid raw or undercooked seafood to prevent parasites and Vibrio parahaemolyticus. Prefer quick cooking methods (steaming or brief boiling) to preserve flavor; store seafood promptly in refrigeration or freezing; do not keep at room temperature. Moderate consumption and consideration of personal health are advised; those with cold-prone stomachs or diarrhea risk should limit high-purine items like crabs and shellfish, and avoid pairing with icy drinks or raw fruit. Buy from reputable supermarkets or farmers markets to ensure safety.

triage.headline_ja: 秋の海産物が大量に市場に出回る、食源性疾患に注意
triage.triage_reason: 南昌市の疾病予防センターによる季節的な食品安全に関する一般的な注意喚起であり、具体的な感染事例や集団発生の報告はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防啓発の一般広報であり、実際の感染事例報告ではないため、対象国としての発生事例には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Nationwide Survey of Cambodian Bats Reveals Hidden Diversity of Malaria
article.articleSummary: Cambodia-wide bat survey uncovers 13% carriage of haemosporidian parasites across 1,180 individuals from 34 species (CamBatRat, 2016–2020). Two genera dominate: Polychromophilus (bat-restricted) and Hepatocystis (related to Plasmodium). Infections were confirmed by multilocus sequencing (cytb, cox1, clpC, ef2, pat) from 152 bats across four families: Emballonuridae, Hipposideridae, Pteropodidae and Vespertilionidae. Notable prevalences include Scotophilus kuhlii at 54% and S. heathii at 4%; Cynopterus brachyotis at 42%; Hipposideros cf. grandis at 23%; Taphozous melanopogon (emballonurid) at 18%. Infections newly recorded in Megaerops niphanae and Eonycteris spelaea; no infections detected in Molossidae, Megadermatidae or Rhinolophidae (sampling limits). Phylogenetics show Polychromophilus as a conserved Cambodian–Thai–Madagascar lineage, while Hepatocystis exhibits deep divergence with possible historical bat–rodent host shifts in Asia, revealing extensive, underrecognized malaria parasite diversity in Southeast Asia.

triage.headline_ja: カンボジア全土のコウモリ調査でマラリア原虫の隠れた多様性が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおけるマラリア原虫（Polychromophilus、Hepatocystis）の学術的多様性調査であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の懸念を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はコウモリを宿主とする原虫（ヒトマラリア原虫Plasmodiumとは異なる近縁属）の生態・系統学的研究であり、ヒト感染症の発生報告ではないため対象国の該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ca sốt xuất huyết nội tại, Nghệ An tăng cường giám sát dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Detection of a locally transmitted dengue fever case; Nghệ An strengthens disease surveillance.
article.articleSummary: One locally transmitted dengue fever case detected in Nghệ An, Vietnam, in Vinh City’s Trường Vinh Ward (Ben Thủy 1 area). An eighth-grade student developed fatigue and fever on 2 October; dengue virus confirmed on 6 October. The patient had not traveled to dengue-affected regions, indicating community-based transmission. Health authorities, led by the Vinh City Center for Disease Control and Prevention, implemented rapid response measures: environmental cleanup, removal of water-holding containers, larval/pupal control, and insecticide spraying within a 200-meter radius of the home. Ongoing surveillance aims to identify new cases early; the patient remains stable at Vinh City General Hospital. This follows a September 2026 dengue outbreak in Quỳnh Anh commune (59 cases), after which containment efforts were intensified. Residents are advised to cover water storage, eliminate standing water and larvae, sleep under mosquito nets, and seek medical care for fever.

triage.headline_ja: 域内感染のデング熱症例を発見、ゲアン省が疾病監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 単発の地域内感染例であり既存の流行地域（Quỳnh Anh）での再燃だが、重篤な拡大や国際的影響の証拠はなく、現時点では経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、地方当局による迅速な対応が取られている。9月のQuỳnh Anhでの59例の流行に続く案件であり、継続的な監視が必要だが現時点で重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯鼠疫 实验室事故引发全球关注
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's Plague Laboratory Accident Draws Global Attention.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old female researcher in Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, Russia handling live Yersinia pestis (plague bacillus) broke a tube, later developing severe pneumonia and dying. About 200 close contacts were quarantined; 197 people remained under observation, and a hospital halted new admissions while a chief sanitary physician led the investigation and authorities opened a criminal probe. Official statements denied a pathogenic-microbe incident and labeled the death as pneumonia of unknown etiology, yet responses tracked a Class A infectious-disease approach. WHO and the U.S. State Department urged Russia for more information. Neighbouring nations—Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Mongolia—tightened border controls to curb potential risk. Pneumonic plague is more lethal than COVID-19 but not pandemic-prone; it spreads from symptomatic respiratory disease and is treatable with antibiotics, making rapid contact tracing and isolation crucial. The episode underscores gaps in laboratory biosafety and calls for stronger, routine biosafety oversight, including in China.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト菌研究所事故、世界的な注目を集める
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究施設でのペスト菌曝露による研究者死亡事例であり、WHO・米国務省が情報提供を求め、周辺国が国境管理を強化するなど国際的な関心と対応が見られるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 事案発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。中国への言及はバイオセーフティ強化を呼びかける文脈のみで、発生国ではないため除外。ロシア当局は病原体事故を否定し『原因不明の肺炎』と発表しているが、対応は一類感染症相当であり、情報の透明性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương khoanh vùng, xử lý các ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently contain and manage dengue fever outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of dengue fever in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, with 9 cases in Vinh Loc hamlet, Cam Trung commune. The first patient, L.T.V.A. (born 2009), developed fever on 28 September; a rapid test was positive on 3 October. Eight additional cases followed, many in nearby households, indicating tight clustering. In Nhan Hoa hamlet, Thien Cam commune, N.T.T. developed fever on 27 September; his two children were ill and the family self-medicated before hospital admission on 29 September; he was discharged after treatment on 6 October. Other hotspots include Cam Trung, Thien Cam, and Ky Xuan. Ky Hoa commune has 96 dengue cases since August 2026, with 3 new cases on 7 October and 14 still under treatment. From January 2026 to date, Ha Tinh has 380 cases; authorities report ongoing community transmission in densely populated areas, stress environmental cleanup, early detection, and avoiding self-medication; promote bed nets and vector control.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱発生地域を緊急に封じ込め・対応へ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省で季節性デング熱の局地的クラスター発生が報告されているが、通常の地域流行の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や重症例の詳細情報は不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ハティン省で年初から380例、Ky Hoa地区で96例と局地的なクラスター発生。地方当局が対応中であり、デング熱はベトナムで季節性・地方流行性疾患であるため、現時点では通常の国内対応範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز 4200 حالة والإصابات ترتفع إلى 8728
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo exceed 4,200, with cases rising to 8,728.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 8,728 cases, including 4,205 deaths. In the latest daily update, 63 new cases and 27 deaths were recorded in the previous 24 hours, with 10 patients recovering. The outbreak continues to spread across the country, prompting ongoing public health concerns. Jean Kasia, Director-General of Africa CDC, warned that the virus could cross borders into neighboring nations as transmission persists in various regions of the DRC. No details on laboratory confirmation methods, transmission sources, or imported/exported cases are provided in the brief. The data underscore a high fatality toll and persistent transmission, necessitating continued surveillance, cross-border cooperation, and strengthened outbreak response in the DRC and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が4,200人を超え、感染者数は8,728人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、致死率が高く、国境を越えた拡大リスクがAfrica CDCにより警告されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Africa CDC幹部が近隣諸国への越境リスクを警告しているが、具体的な越境感染の確認例は記事に記載なし。致死率は約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia levanta medidas preventivas tras sospecha de brote de neumonía en Siberia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia lifts preventive measures after a suspected pneumonia outbreak in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Russia’s consumer safety agency, Rospotrebnadzor, lifted preventive measures in Irkutsk region after a suspected pneumonic plague episode. The death of researcher Daria Shipílova (28) prompted investigations; over 5,500 clinical analyses found no dangerous pathogens, and about 200 contacts were monitored. Investigations employed bacteriological, biological, molecular-genetic, and mass-spectrometry methods across five organizations. Authorities said there was no second pneumonic plague case; the fatality was attributed to pneumonia of unknown etiology. Shipílova was vaccinated and believed to have strong immunity. Early reports linked Yersinia pestis or travel to Thailand, but neither was confirmed; Thai authorities did not confirm travel and remain in contact with the WHO. The WHO asked for more transparency and data on preventive measures and quarantines. The US, China, Mongolia and others followed the case; Trump said he would discuss with Putin and later denied a bioweapon link. Irkutsk near Lake Baikal remains under control.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、シベリアでの肺炎流行疑いを受けた予防措置を解除
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペスト疑い事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、CEPR対象国リストに該当する国（中国・タイ等）での発生ではなく、言及のみに留まる。また二次感染なし・予防措置解除済みで事態は収束方向にあるため、現時点でのピックアップは不要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイ・中国・モンゴル・米国は事例への関心表明や渡航歴疑惑の文脈で言及されたのみで、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。最終的に死因は原因不明の肺炎とされ、ペスト菌は確認されず、二次感染もなく、予防措置は解除済み。

article.articleHeadline: 國內今年首例本土傷寒！30多歲女4度就醫才確診　感染來源待查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first domestically acquired typhoid fever in the country! A woman in her 30s visited the hospital four times before being diagnosed; the source of infection is under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports this year’s first domestically acquired typhoid fever case: a woman in her 30s from central Taiwan who developed fever, vomiting, and diarrhea in late August and was hospitalized in mid-September after blood culture confirmed Salmonella Typhi. She received antibiotics and recovered, discharged about a week later; the infection source remains under investigation. She had eaten raw seafood (raw fish and raw oysters) during the incubation period in another county, but a definitive source has not been established. Five close contacts have been traced with no symptoms. Typhoid incubation is usually 8–14 days but can range 3–60 days; risks include undercooked seafood, contaminated produce, and untreated water. Public health advises boiled or bottled water, fully cooked foods, avoidance of cross-contamination, and thorough handwashing. As of 9 Oct 2026, six typhoid cases have been confirmed in Taiwan: one locally acquired and five imported (Indonesia: four; Philippines: one).

triage.headline_ja: 国内今年初の本土感染腸チフス症例！30代女性が4回受診してようやく確診、感染源は調査中
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における今年初の本土感染腸チフス症例だが、単発例で濃厚接触者に症状なく、感染源も特定されていないため情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入症例の感染源として言及されているのみで、当該国内での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 國內今年首例本土傷寒！30多歲女4度就醫才確診　感染來源待查 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally acquired typhoid fever in the country! A woman in her thirties was diagnosed only after four medical visits; source of infection under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports the year's first locally acquired typhoid fever case: a woman in her thirties from central Taiwan developed fever, vomiting and diarrhea in late August, sought medical care four times, and was hospitalized in mid-September where blood culture confirmed Salmonella Typhi infection. The infection source remains under investigation. Health officials note the typhoid incubation can range from 3 to 60 days and emphasize risks from raw seafood such as sashimi and oysters, contaminated produce, and untreated water. Common symptoms include persistent high fever, headache, abdominal pain and diarrhea; 2–5% may become chronic carriers. Five contacts have been traced and remain asymptomatic. The patient recovered after about a week of antibiotic treatment. This year Taiwan has six confirmed cases (one locally acquired, five imported; imported from Indonesia in four cases and the Philippines in one).

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で今年初の国内感染腸チフス症例、30代女性が4回受診後に確診 - 感染源は調査中

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: 21,655 cases, 10 deaths in TN since January; surge coming down, says Minister Arunraj
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, Tamil Nadu reports 21,655 dengue cases and 10 deaths since January 1. In Chennai, high-fever-area incidence fell from 500 to 300 in two weeks amid intensified preventive measures ahead of the northeast monsoon. Public cooperation is urged: avoid standing water around homes; mosquito-control workers will inspect premises. Fines for water stagnation are Rs 10,000 for first violations for companies/construction sites, with Greater Chennai Corporation having collected Rs 7.5 lakh in two months. About 1,000 fever camps are run daily across Tamil Nadu; one special camp is held for every two Chennai wards. At a Kodambakkam camp, 50 people were screened with one fever case identified; further dengue tests will follow if confirmed. Approximately 3,700 mosquito-control workers are deployed in Chennai; 301 dengue patients statewide are hospitalized. Chennai SWD construction is slated to finish by month-end.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱:タミル・ナードゥ州で1月以降21,655件、死亡10人;大臣は流行が減少傾向にあると発表
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節性・地域流行のデング熱に関する定例報告であり、感染者数は減少傾向にあると当局が発表。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存の対策が機能している通常の公衆衛生活動である。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの該当地域で毎年季節的に発生する風土病であり、本記事は当局による対策状況と症例数の減少傾向を報告する定例ニュースである。

article.articleHeadline: CUK launches 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan
article.articleSummary: Ganderbal, Jammu and Kashmir, Oct 8: Central University of Kashmir (CUKashmir) launched a 100-Day TB Awareness & Elimination Campaign under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2026 to bolster India’s TB elimination effort. The initiative, organized by the Health Centre with the Directorate of Students’ Welfare (DSW), NSS and NCC, is led by Dr. Abid Ahmad Sofi, Medical Officer and Nodal Officer for TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2026. The programme emphasizes a TB-Free India 2026 through sustained awareness, early detection and collective action among students, faculty and staff. Registrar Dr. Nisar Ahmad Mir underscored the need for widespread awareness; Dean Prof. C. Naseema praised ongoing health-awareness and screening efforts. Technical sessions featured Dr. Naveed Nazir (Chest Disease Hospital) on TB clinical aspects, diagnosis and management, and Dr. Mir Shahnawaz on awareness, prevention and elimination. The event concluded with the TB-Free India 2026 Public Pledge.

triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策啓発キャンペーンに関する通常の広報記事であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 21,000 dengue cases, 10 deaths in Tamil Nadu in 2026
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Tamil Nadu, India, shows 21,655 cases and 10 deaths as of Oct 7, 2026. In Chennai, dengue cases have declined and stabilized, but vigilance remains as the monsoon season approaches. Across Tamil Nadu, 301 patients are hospitalized for dengue. Health authorities report active fever camps averaging about 1,000 per day, with disease hotspots reduced from about 500 to 300 over two weeks. Officials urge removal of water stagnation and rainwater-collecting items to curb breeding sites. The Chennai corporation has levied fines totaling 7.50 lakh over the last two months on defaulters for creating dengue breeding grounds, affecting both households and companies. The information emphasizes ongoing surveillance, source reduction, and public cooperation ahead of the upcoming monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州で2026年にデング熱21,000例、10人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのタミル・ナードゥ州で例年のデング熱流行が報告されているが、既に鎮静化傾向にあり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAには至らないが地域の季節的流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年流行する地方風土病的疾患であり、今回の報告は季節性の経過報告に近い。チェンナイでは症例が減少傾向にあり、地元当局による対策（防除・罰金）も機能している。

article.articleHeadline: PAHO Regional Situation Report No.13: Measles in the Region of the Americas (8 October 2026) - Guatemala
article.articleSummary: Measles in the Region of the Americas, as of 3 Oct 2026 (published 9 Oct 2026), 55,792 confirmed cases across 17 countries/territories (EW1–EW39 2026), a 4.8-fold rise vs 2025. Guatemala leads with 34,355 cases, followed by Mexico 13,595; United States 3,887; Peru 2,553; Canada 1,121, accounting for 99.5% of cases. Deaths total 77: Guatemala 50; Mexico 23; United States 2; Peru 1; Bolivia 1; the US and Peru deaths are the first for 2026 in those countries. EW37–38 saw 687 new confirmed cases in seven countries, down 35% from EW35–36 (1,059). Of these, US 293; Guatemala 200; Peru 155; Mexico 34; Bolivia 3; Canada and Brazil 1 each. Rt estimates remain below 1 in some countries, but persistent low-level transmission through sporadic chains may continue >12 months, risking re-establishment of endemic transmission and jeopardizing measles-free status.

article.articleHeadline: UKHSA monitors major Ebola-strain outbreak and suspected plague death
article.articleSummary: UKHSA monitors a major Ebola-like Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, reporting 8,603 confirmed cases and 4,148 deaths as of 4 October 2026; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Separately, a death of a 28-year-old laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Russia, on 2 October 2026 is a suspected pneumonic plague, with UKHSA assessing very low public health risk to the UK. Ongoing cholera and dengue fever outbreaks may affect travellers: Nigeria’s Borno State has 68,152 suspected cholera cases and 394 deaths since May 2026; Bangladesh reports 94,151 dengue cases and 294 deaths as of 8 October 2026 (via DGHS dengue dashboard). No UK travel restrictions; standard international travel health advice remains in place.

article.articleHeadline: Nadda launches JOSH teams to accelerate youth-led TB elimination efforts
article.articleSummary: India launches JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan to accelerate youth-led TB elimination, announced at a national event in Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. The initiative mobilizes young people to promote TB prevention, early diagnosis, timely treatment and stigma reduction, aiming to transform India’s TB response into a people’s movement rooted in Jan Bhagidari and community ownership. Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda underscored collaboration with the Ministries of Youth Affairs & Sports and Defence, and urged volunteers to foster trust, address concerns, and encourage symptomatic individuals to seek testing, supporting the full care continuum from diagnosis to treatment completion. India reports a 21% decline in TB incidence (global: 12%); treatment coverage stands at 92% (global: 78%). Tech-enabled screening—portable AI-assisted X-ray and rapid molecular diagnostics—facilitates early detection and drug-resistance identification, guiding appropriate treatment and expanding community outreach to identify vulnerable populations.

article.articleHeadline: 鼠疫的危害是什么？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the dangers posed by the plague?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, plague remains one of China’s two Class A infectious diseases. Bubonic plague is the most common form, transmitted by flea bites, with an untreated fatality rate of about 30–60%. Pneumonic plague can spread between people via droplets; incubation may be as short as 24 hours, and illness presents with high fever, chest pain, and coughing up blood-tinged sputum. Without treatment, pneumonic plague is nearly 100% fatal, usually within 2–3 days. Septicemic plague occurs when bacteria enter the bloodstream, causing widespread bleeding and tissue necrosis; the skin may blacken, giving rise to the name “Black Death.” Timely medical care is critical, as septicemic plague can kill within 1–3 days if not treated. The article emphasizes the extreme lethality and rapid progression of these forms.

triage.headline_ja: 鼠疫（ペスト）の危険性とは何か？

article.articleHeadline: China extends 2 mln USD grant to Kenya for Ebola preparedness, drought relief
article.articleSummary: Kenya received a $2 million grant from China on Oct 8, 2026, to bolster Ebola preparedness and drought relief. One million dollars funds Ebola response infrastructure in counties identified as very-high- to high-risk; the remaining $1 million supports drought relief. The handover in Nairobi included Chinese Ambassador Guo Haiyan, National Treasury PS Chris Kiptoo, and Public Health PS Mary Muthoni. Kenya recently reported its first imported Ebola case, on Oct 6, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years and died while being treated in Nairobi. Authorities will intensify surveillance at ports of entry to mitigate transmission risk. The move aligns with China–Kenya cooperation under the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC) and the Global Development Initiative (GDI). Kenya also faces climate shocks and anticipated El Niño floods from Oct to early next year.
