article.articleHeadline: 物価の優等生・卵が過去最高値、冬場に鳥インフル流行すればさらに高騰か...「買う頻度減らした」の声
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eggs, the price standout, hit a record high; if avian influenza spreads this winter, prices could rise even further... "People have cut back on how often they buy."
article.articleSummary: Eggs remain expensive in Japan as production costs rise from higher feed prices driven by Middle East tensions. If highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) spreads this winter, shortages and further price hikes are likely. In Tokyo’s Nerima, a 10-egg pack was 268 yen (289 yen with tax). A September 7–9 nationwide survey found 10-egg packs averaging 309 yen. JA Zen-Noh plans to raise feed prices for Oct–Dec by about 3,200 yen per ton, the fourth consecutive quarterly increase. Since 2020 Japan has endured six avian-influenza seasons; the 2022 peak saw about 17.71 million birds culled, triggering an “egg shock.” Industry groups push supply stabilization, including frozen-egg storage and shared storage costs, with recommendations due by FY2026. Kewpie diversifies sourcing, including Brazilian eggs since 2023, while Ifuji Industries aims to lift liquid-egg sales to 80,000 tons by 2030. Vaccination against HPAI is under government review.

triage.headline_ja: 物価の優等生・卵が過去最高値、冬場に鳥インフル流行すればさらに高騰か...「買う頻度減らした」の声
triage.triage_reason: 記事は日本における鶏卵価格高騰と今後の鳥インフルエンザ流行への懸念を経済的観点から報じたものであり、対象国（日本は対象外、ブラジルは卵調達先として言及のみ）での実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は日本の卵価格高騰と鳥インフルエンザ流行リスクに関する経済ニュースであり、感染症の実発生報告ではない。ブラジルは卵の調達先として言及されているのみで、ブラジル国内での鳥インフルエンザ発生を報じるものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Peste: a doença medieval que nunca desapareceu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague: The Medieval Disease That Never Disappeared.
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains endemic in parts of the world and can be fatal without rapid diagnosis and treatment. It manifests as bubonic (flea bite, swollen lymph nodes), septicemic, or pneumonic (airborne, with human-to-human transmission possible). Worldwide, up to 3,000 cases are reported annually; current hotspots include the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and Madagascar, which last major outbreak occurred in 2017 and averages 250–500 annual infections there. Occasional cases arise in western United States; in Oregon, a patient contracted plague after misdiagnosis, underscoring diagnostic delays. The medieval pandemic (1347–1353) killed about 25 million people, roughly 60% of Europe’s population. Genomic evidence links Y. pestis to ancient origins, with the ymt gene enabling flea transmission arising in the Bronze Age. The disease largely disappeared from Europe after 1945. Robert Koch Institute researchers work to accelerate lab confirmation, a critical need to prevent imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：決して消えなかった中世の病
triage.triage_reason: 歴史的・一般解説記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの歴史・疫学的背景を解説する教育的内容で、DRC・ウガンダ・マダガスカルは既知の流行地として言及されているのみ。ウガンダ・マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。新規イベントとしての緊急性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 加纳4个月内报告450例黄热病疑似病例 3例确诊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghana reports 450 suspected yellow fever cases in four months; 3 cases confirmed.
article.articleSummary: From June to September 2026, Ghana reports at least 450 suspected yellow fever cases, with 3 laboratory-confirmed infections. Health Minister Kwabena Akando said the Ministry intensified surveillance and deployed a National Rapid Response Team to the Upper West Region where suspected cases are concentrated. Public calm urged as monitoring continues. Yellow fever is caused by the yellow fever virus and spread mainly by Aedes mosquitoes in Africa and Latin America; symptoms include high fever, headache, jaundice and bleeding, and severe cases can be fatal. There is no specific antiviral treatment; vaccination offers effective prevention. By contrast, Ghana’s 2021 outbreak affected four regions with about 200 suspected cases, 70 confirmed, and 35 deaths between mid-October and late November. Authorities will provide updates as laboratory confirmation progresses.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナで4ヶ月間に黄熱病疑い例450件、確定例3件を報告
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病はワクチン予防可能だが重症化・致死性のある国際的に懸念される疾患であり、4ヶ月間で450例の疑い例という規模はIHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2021年の同国アウトブレイク（200疑い例、70確定、35死亡）と比較されており、今回は確定例が少ないものの疑い例数が多く監視強化中。致死例・重症例の有無については本記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola contact nightmare: Why tracing Patient Zero can become national disaster
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a single confirmed case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease linked to travel from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda to Nairobi. As of 2026-10-09, authorities identified 66 contacts and quarantined 10; others under monitoring, with estimates suggesting more than 100 primary contacts could exist, including staff at airports, airlines, hospitals, and even cleaners and passport officers. A second concerning case—a 20-year-old man traveling from DRC through Uganda by road to Wajir—presented with cough, headache, and severe anaemia after a 2,000 km journey; he was hospitalized in a private facility, raising fears of wider transmission. Health officials stress rapid tracing, isolation, testing, and management of contacts; while some experts urge caution and warn that additional cases could appear in coming days or weeks. The risk persists due to ongoing cross-border movement from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ接触者追跡の悪夢：患者ゼロの追跡がなぜ国家的災厄になり得るか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)症例がケニアに越境し、多数の接触者（空港職員等含む100人超の可能性）が発生しており、国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクが高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 症例自体はケニア（ナイロビ、ワジル）で確認されたが、感染源はDRCでの渡航歴に基づくため、DRCを流行背景国として記載。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。続報で接触者追跡の結果や二次感染の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: 唠"科"话丨流感季将至，流感疫苗如何打？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Science Chat: The Flu Season Is Coming—How Do You Get the Flu Vaccine?
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination season in China: Beijing authorities say October is the “golden vaccination period” ahead of the winter–spring flu season, with protective antibodies forming 2–4 weeks after vaccination. The flu peak usually occurs December–January and can last into February–March; vaccination during the season remains protective. For 2026–2027, vaccines include trivalent and quadrivalent formulations; trivalent covers two influenza A strains and one B lineage, while quadrivalent adds a second B lineage. The Chinese CDC notes available vaccines include trivalent inactivated (for 6 months and up) and trivalent live attenuated (for 3–17 years). High-risk groups (≥60 years; children 6 months–5 years; those with chronic diseases or immunocompromise) and staff in healthcare, elderly care facilities, and schools should vaccinate if no contraindications. Antibody levels peak after 2–4 weeks and last about 6–8 months; strains drift yearly, so annual vaccination is recommended. Hygiene, ventilation, masking in crowds, and avoiding unnecessary gatherings help reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サイエンスチャット：インフルエンザシーズン到来—ワクチンはどう接種する？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種に関する一般的な公衆衛生広報記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種に関する啓発・広報記事であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではないため対象国を特定する発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: J-K: Health authorities launch JOSH teams and TB-free awareness programme for NCC cadets & students in Poonch
article.articleSummary: TB-free India awareness and training programme in Poonch, Jammu and Kashmir on JOSH Day marks the launch of the Joint Squad for Health (JOSH) teams dedicated to a tuberculosis-free mission. Health authorities convened NCC cadets, students, MY Bharat volunteers, and medical staff to educate communities about tuberculosis and mobilize a nationwide TB-free effort. The programme, organized under the Government of India, follows a preparatory meeting at the Chief Medical Officer's Office in Poonch last month, where block-level teams of NCC cadets and MY Bharat volunteers were formed to actively participate in the JOSH Squad. NCC Cadet Sania Hafiz of Government Degree College, Poonch (5 J&K Battalion) stated the objective is to make India tuberculosis-free through collective effort; Mehbooba Khan, a student, highlighted the goal of widespread awareness.

triage.headline_ja: J&K州：保健当局がプーンチでNCC士官候補生・学生向けにJOSHチームとTBフリー啓発プログラムを開始
triage.triage_reason: 結核の啓発・教育プログラムに関する内容であり、新規の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 政府主導の結核撲滅啓発キャンペーンに関する報道であり、疾病発生そのものの報告ではないため、地域検証の対象外（verified_locationsは空）とした。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza Tipe A: Gejala, Risiko, dan Cara Mencegah Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Type A: Symptoms, Risks, and How to Prevent Transmission.
article.articleSummary: Influenza Type A, a respiratory infection, raises concerns in Purwasuka, with transmission increasing in crowded or enclosed settings. Mask use is promoted to reduce spread of respiratory droplets from the sick and to provide protection for others, according to Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, Sp.MK, a clinical microbiology specialist educated at Diponegoro University. In Jakarta, on 8 October 2026, he stressed that masking complements other preventive measures. Transmission occurs when people inhale respiratory droplets expelled by an infected person during coughing, sneezing, talking, or breathing at close range. Symptoms typically emerge 1–4 days after exposure and can include high fever, chills, headache, sore throat, myalgia, and fatigue; some patients may also experience cough and runny nose. Clinical presentation varies, and symptoms alone cannot reliably distinguish influenza from other respiratory infections. The article does not provide case counts, lab confirmation details, or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型:症状、リスク、感染予防の方法
triage.triage_reason: 一般的なインフルエンザの啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数・流行状況・異常性を示す情報がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は一般的な医学教育・啓発コンテンツであり、特定の発生イベントやアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。症例数、検査確認情報、感染拡大の状況は一切記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria da Agricultura dá por encerrado um foco de gripe aviária no Norte gaúcho - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Agriculture declares an avian influenza outbreak in northern Rio Grande do Sul closed - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (influenza aviar) outbreak in northern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, centered in Selbach (Alto Jacuí region). After 10-km perimeter inspections of 70 properties, including a commercial farm with no birds, authorities pronounced the latest focus extinguished, citing no suspicions and clinical checks confirming healthy stock. Rapid field response: in under 24 hours, all properties within a 3-km radius were surveyed and community outreach continues. A new case was laboratory-confirmed by LFDA-SP on Oct 5, four days after initial field response; the publication date is Oct 9, 2026. OMSA notes that cases detected only in subsistence poultry do not alter Brazil’s status as avian influenza‑free for commercial production, so exports remain protected unless the virus reaches commercial farms. Previous July high-path outbreak occurred in Coqueiros do Sul (northwest RS) among subsistence birds; a suspected zoo case in Sapucaia do Sul was ruled botulism. Public advised to report signs and contact authorities via WhatsApp (51) 98445-2033.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、ガウーショ北部での鳥インフルエンザ発生終息を宣言 - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家禽（非商業的飼育）における鳥インフルエンザ発生は既に終息が宣言されており、商業生産への影響もなく、ヒトへの感染報告もない。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（鳥）における動物衛生イベントであり、ヒト感染の報告はない。地方当局により既に発生終息が確認され、OMSAもブラジルの商業的養鶏における清浄国ステータスに影響しないとしている。

article.articleHeadline: DOH sees very low plague risk in PH
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague risk in the Philippines remains very low after Russian authorities investigate the death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk; DOH stated the worker died of pneumonia and that causation is not yet confirmed as plague. The World Health Organization’s initial risk assessment indicated low risk for Russia overall and very low risk for the WHO European Region. In the Philippines, the Bureau of Quarantine has begun health screening at airports; the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine can test for plague if needed, and designated hospitals can isolate and treat suspected cases. No special precautions are required at this time, with guidance to maintain frequent handwashing and proper coughing/sneezing etiquette. The DOH will continue monitoring the situation and provide verified updates as they become available.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン保健省、国内のペスト感染リスクは非常に低いとの見解
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの検査技師死亡例が肺ペストの疑いとして調査中だが原因は未確定であり、WHOおよびフィリピンDOHはリスクを低いと評価している。フィリピン国内に実際の症例はなく、情報が確定するまで経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の疑い症例はロシア・イルクーツクで発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンでは症例確認はなく、空港での健康スクリーニング等の予防的対応のみが報じられている。ペストであることも未確定のため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Wajir County Confirms Negative Ebola Test for Suspected Patient
article.articleSummary: Wajir County, Kenya, reports a suspected Ebola case that tested negative. A 20-year-old man evaluated at Habaswein Sub-County Hospital, who arrived in Kenya from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda, underwent Ebola testing under public-health protocols. Samples were sent to the National Public Health Virology Laboratory in Nairobi; preliminary results returned negative for Ebola virus disease, described as reassuring. The patient remains under observation with ongoing monitoring, in a coordinated response involving the hospital, the County Department of Medical Services, the Department of Public Health and Sanitation, and national health authorities. Officials emphasized the travel history from a DRC-linked outbreak region and urged residents to rely on official updates and seek prompt care for unusual symptoms. No confirmed cases or deaths have been reported at this time; surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: ワジル郡、疑い患者のエボラ検査陰性を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCの流行地域からの渡航歴を持つ疑い患者がケニアで検査されたが結果は陰性であり、現時点で確定症例はない。ただしDRCでの流行継続と越境移動によるリスクは注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事の直接の対象事象（ケニア・ワジル郡での疑い例）は検査陰性であり確定症例ではない。記事はDRCの流行地域からの渡航歴を背景として言及しているため、DRCを関連国として記録するが、ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: इंदौर की सेंट्रल जेल में डेंगू, 50 से ज्यादा बीमार, 3 की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव, बुखार से एक कैदी की हो चुकी है मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Indore Central Jail: More than 50 inmates ill, 3 test positive, one prisoner has died of fever.
article.articleSummary: Indore Central Jail in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, reports a dengue-linked health cluster with fever cases as of 2026-10-09. More than 50 inmates are ill; three inmates have tested positive for dengue, and one prisoner has died of fever. Most inmates are reportedly diagnosed with typhoid. About 20 patients have recovered; others remain under treatment. A Malaria Department team found dengue larvae in thousands of water containers inside the jail—roughly 3,000 to 4,000 containers—and destroyed them with treatment. Inmates store water for bathing and toilet in pots and buckets, creating mosquito breeding sites. No imported or exported cases are mentioned. Ongoing vector control and medical management are underway to address the outbreak. Keywords: dengue, typhoid, fever, Indore jail, vector control, water storage, outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: インドール中央刑務所でデング熱発生、50人以上が体調不良、3人が陽性、発熱により囚人1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所という閉鎖的環境で50人以上の罹患・1名死亡という集団感染が発生し、蚊の大量繁殖源（3,000〜4,000容器）も確認されており、WPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行しやすさに該当し社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 施設内（刑務所）限定のクラスターであり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。デング熱・腸チフス・発熱症例が混在しており、マラリア局による防除活動（幼虫駆除）が進行中。続報で感染拡大の有無・死亡者数の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Warga Kaltim Diminta Waspada Sakit ISPA dan Demam Berdarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Kalimantan Residents Urged to Be Vigilant Against Acute Respiratory Infections and Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: East Kalimantan's Health Department warns residents to stay vigilant against Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs), diarrhea, and Dengue Fever during the dry season. Health facilities in ten regencies and cities across East Kalimantan are urged to boost preparedness, including weekly case monitoring and medical logistics. Limited access to clean water and dusty conditions are identified as drivers of ill health. Mapping shows water storage during drought fosters Aedes aegypti breeding, the dengue vector. Citizens are urged to practice the 3M Plus campaign: drain and clean water containers, cover storage, and regularly apply larvicidal powder. To combat diarrhea, ensure hygienic drinking water—boil before drinking—and handwashing with soap. Hot, dry weather, dust, and possible haze from forest fires may raise ARI cases. People should wear masks outdoors, limit strenuous activity, and seek care at a puskesmas if fever or breathing difficulties occur.

triage.headline_ja: 東カリマンタン州住民、急性呼吸器感染症とデング熱に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・ARIに関する注意喚起であり、異常な増加や重症例の報告はないが、乾季における媒介蚊対策・衛生対策の継続的な呼びかけがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による季節性注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito da dengue mantém quase metade dos municípios brasileiros em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue-carrying mosquito keeps almost half of Brazilian municipalities on alert.
article.articleSummary: Brazil remains on alert for Aedes aegypti, with 49.2% of municipalities in either alert or risk according to the 2nd cycle of the LIRAa index (May–Aug 2026, 3,732 cities). Dengue cases remain the focus despite a sharp fall: probable dengue totals reached 470,500 by September 26, 2026, about 70% below the 1.5 million in the same period of 2025; chikungunya declined to 67,900 and Zika to 2,141 (Jan–Sep 2026). Prevention efforts ahead of summer include training over 300,000 Community Health Agents, ongoing vector-control by ACE (Agentes de Combate às Endemias), ovitraps in about 2,000 municipalities, Residual Intradomiciliary Spraying (BRI-Aedes), Larvicidal Dissemination Stations (EDL), and Fiocruz Wolbachia program to reduce transmission. Infestation sources vary: tires and trash in the North, water-storage reservoirs in the Northeast, and domestic containers elsewhere. With El Niño-driven rainfall, household inspections and vector-control remain critical through the coming summer.

triage.headline_ja: デングを媒介する蚊、ブラジルの自治体の約半数で警戒レベル継続
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比約70%減少しており、季節性の蚊媒介対策活動の一環としての定例報告であり、異常な増加や新規事象は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル保健当局による季節前の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱）対策の定例報告であり、全疾患で症例数が前年より大幅減少している。新規の異常事態ではなくルーティンサーベイランス情報のためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : 13 patients guéris d'Ebola sortent du centre de traitement en deux jours, dont un bébé de 29 jours à Beni - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: 13 Ebola patients cured, discharged from the treatment center in two days, including a 29-day-old baby in Beni - Le Potentiel
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo — Between Oct 7–8, 2026, 13 Ebola virus disease patients were cured and discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center at the General Reference Hospital of Beni. Eight were released on Oct 7, and five on Oct 8, including Dr Alex, a physician who contracted Ebola while treating patients. Hospital director Dr Jérémie Muhindo stated the clinician fought Ebola from the outset and recovered after care. Two nurses and a pastor were also among the discharged. Among the earlier release was a 29-day-old infant whose mother died of Ebola; the pediatric supervisor noted the baby’s odds of survival were initially low, but the child survived with multidisciplinary care. The director urged survivors to share their experiences to strengthen community trust and called on residents to support outbreak-response interventions to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ治癒患者13人が2日間でベニの治療センターから退院、29日齢の乳児も含む－Le Potentiel
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱患者が引き続き発生・治療されており、致死率が高く国際的拡大のリスクもあるIHR通報対象疾患であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は治癒・退院という前向きな内容だが、背景にエボラの継続的な流行（北キブ州ベニ）があることを示しており、アウトブレイク継続中であるためモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo reach 8,728, deaths exceed 4,200
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) total 8,728 with 4,205 deaths, according to the National Institute of Public Health. In the latest daily report, 63 new cases and 27 deaths were recorded over the past 24 hours, with 10 recoveries. The outbreak continues to spread within the DRC, prompting concerns about cross-border transmission to neighboring countries. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the virus remains a risk to neighboring nations as transmission persists. The figures illustrate the ongoing scale and severity of the outbreak, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance, case management, and public health measures to limit further transmission and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱の症例数が8,728人に、死者数が4,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模に継続拡大し、死者数が4,200人を超え、周辺国への越境感染リスクも指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが周辺国への感染拡大リスクを警告しているが、具体的な越境症例の報告は本サマリーには含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alert
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola incident this week, a Nairobi death of a national who had returned from the DRC. Ill for about a month, he travelled from the DRC to Uganda, then to Nairobi, and died in hospital after isolation. The DRC outbreak has killed over 4,000 people and logged about 8,300 cases. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and bleeding. Kenya is the fourth country to record a case in the current eastern Congo outbreak; Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths but was Ebola-free in August. A doctor returning to France from Congo tested positive, with no further spread. Kenya quarantined eight family members, 21 health workers, and tracked passengers and crew on the same flight; entry screening is under review. Nigeria is urged to boost vigilance; NCDC flags high risk from international travel. Bundibugyo strain; no vaccine. Prevention: avoid body fluids, wash hands, avoid bush meat, report symptoms promptly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ流行がケニア・ウガンダ・フランスへ越境拡大しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際的公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（東部コンゴ、Bundibugyo株、4000人超死亡・約8300症例）が発生源であり、ケニア・ウガンダ・フランス・ナイジェリアは越境例や警戒対象として言及されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当する。ワクチンなしで致死性が高く、国際的な渡航関連リスクが顕在化している。

article.articleHeadline: Wajir Patient Tests Negative for Ebola, Positive for Malaria, Duale Says
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Wajir County health authorities say a patient evaluated for Ebola tested negative for Ebola and malaria positive; antimalarial treatment began after Thursday night test results confirmed malaria. This follows Kenya's first imported Ebola case, a Bundibugyo EBOV patient who died Oct 6 in Nairobi after arriving Oct 3 from the DRC via Uganda and boarding Jambojet JM8523. Laboratory confirmation at Nairobi's National Public Health Virology Laboratory confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease. Health authorities are conducting contact tracing and enhanced surveillance, with screening at points of entry and strengthened facility readiness. The Wajir result occurs amidst ongoing efforts to identify suspected cases in a context of elevated vigilance. Public urged to rely on official sources; toll-free line 719 for information.

triage.headline_ja: ワジル郡の患者、エボラ検査は陰性もマラリア陽性—デュアレ氏が発表
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで発生した輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ株、DRC由来）による死亡例を背景に、国境を越えた移動と接触者追跡が進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクが示唆されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は輸入エボラ症例の発生地ケニア（ワジル、ナイロビ）だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源・出発地としてDRCが言及されており、ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの由来国として含めた。Wajirの疑い例自体はエボラ陰性・マラリア陽性と判明したが、既に発生した輸入死亡例とその後の監視強化が主要な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya: China Gives Kenya $2 Million for Drought Relief, Ebola Preparedness
article.articleSummary: China grants Kenya US$2 million to bolster drought relief and Ebola preparedness, with US$1 million for drought mitigation and US$1 million for preparedness and response to potential Ebola outbreaks. The handover, by Chinese Ambassador Guo Haiyan at the National Treasury in Nairobi, signals ongoing Kenya–China cooperation in infrastructure, health, and development. National Treasury Principal Secretary Dr. Chris Kiptoo said the funds enhance emergency response capacity amid climate-related risks and infectious disease threats. The Ebola component comes after Kenya confirmed its first imported Bundibugyo Ebola case, underscoring the need to detect, isolate, and respond to high-risk infections. The drought portion aims to safeguard livelihoods and food security in vulnerable areas, while the Ebola allocation targets surveillance, rapid isolation, and case management if further cases emerge. Public Health and Professional Standards Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni accompanied Kiptoo at the ceremony, reflecting broader bilateral cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：中国がケニアに干ばつ対策とエボラ対策準備のため200万ドルを供与
triage.triage_reason: 記事は中国からケニアへの資金援助に関する内容であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での新規感染拡大情報ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア（対象国リスト外）における中国からの資金援助であり、中国国内でのエボラ発生事例ではないため、中国もverified_locationsには含めない。ケニアでのBundibugyoエボラ輸入症例については別途情報収集が必要な可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Innovation. A novel green light-activated tech to fight bacterial infections
article.articleSummary: Os(II) metallophotoantibiotics Os1–Os3, activated by green light, inhibit bacterial growth and disrupt biofilms, addressing antimicrobial resistance and infected wound healing. IIT (BHU) Varanasi researchers Banerjee and Mukherjee tested against Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus and Bacillus subtilis, with Os1 showing the strongest antibacterial activity. Green-light activation generates reactive oxygen species that damage bacterial cells and interfere with essential processes, enabling substantial biofilm suppression. In rat infection models, Os1 achieved approximately 85% inhibition of biofilm formation in E. coli and Bacillus subtilis. The study, published in Communications Chemistry (Nature Portfolio), underscores IIT (BHU)’s interdisciplinary collaboration across chemistry, biomedical engineering, and pharmaceutical engineering and points to potential therapeutic development for device-associated infections.

triage.headline_ja: イノベーション。細菌感染症と闘う新しい緑色光活性化技術
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、抗菌技術に関する研究開発の報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりを示す要素がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はIIT(BHU)による抗菌・抗バイオフィルム技術の研究成果報告であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため対象国の疾病発生とはみなさない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt 2 tuần, phát hiện bệnh từ vết loét nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever for two weeks, diagnosis made from a small ulcer.
article.articleSummary: A 54-year-old Cambodian woman presented with two weeks of fever, headache, malaise, cough, abdominal pain, and vomiting, developing dyspnea and chills before admission to Xuyên Á Tay Ninh General Hospital in Tay Ninh, Vietnam. Lab tests showed rising liver enzymes consistent with acute liver injury. Initial workup ruled out viral hepatitis, biliary infection, liver abscess, dengue, malaria, and sepsis. The turning point was a small, dry, crusted eschar on the abdominal skin, with gardening exposure and prolonged fever prompting consideration of scrub typhus; real-time PCR of blood confirmed Orientia tsutsugamushi. She was treated with doxycycline, fever resolved within a day, and health improved over two weeks. Clinicians note scrub typhus has diverse, often misleading presentations and that painless, hidden eschars can be missed. There is currently no vaccine available for scrub typhus.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱2週間、小さな潰瘍から診断された病気
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例のつつが虫病（Orientia tsutsugamushi）の臨床症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム・タイニン省の病院における単一のつつが虫病症例の臨床報告であり、集団発生やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクを示唆する内容は含まれていない。患者はカンボジア人女性だが発症・受診地はベトナムであり、Cambodiaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Peste pneumônica pode virar pandemia? Entenda o risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague could become a pandemic? Understand the risk.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague remains a public health concern, caused by Yersinia pestis and circulating in animal reservoirs. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, human cases persist; in the United States, plague is rare, with pneumonic form the only one that can spread via person-to-person contact. In Russia’s Irkutsk region, a 28-year-old lab technician, Darya Shipilova, died after pneumonia whose cause was not yet confirmed; about 200 potential contacts are under observation. The WHO assessed risk for Irkutsk as moderate-to-low, low for Russia, and very low for the WHO European region. Pneumonic plague can cause rapid symptoms—fever, shortness of breath, chest pain, cough (sometimes bloody)—and transmits through respiratory droplets. Early diagnosis, isolation, contact monitoring, and antibiotics can halt transmission; a global pandemic is deemed unlikely due to effective treatments and swift recognition.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストはパンデミックになり得るか？そのリスクを理解する
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアでの原因未確定肺炎による死亡例を中心に肺ペストのパンデミックリスクを解説する総論記事であり、対象国であるDRCへの言及は既知の流行継続についての背景情報に留まり新規性は低い。情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる話題はロシア・イルクーツク州での研究技師の原因未確定肺炎死亡例だが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCおよびマダガスカルでの人間症例持続は背景情報として言及されているが、DRCのみ対象国リストに該当するため記載。WHOはリスクを低〜非常に低いと評価しており、現時点で国際的拡大の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 廣東知名酒店婚宴後多人腹瀉嘔吐 疑食物中毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people develop diarrhea and vomiting after a wedding banquet at a well-known Guangdong hotel; suspected food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: A foodborne illness cluster is linked to a high-profile wedding banquet at Foshan, Guangdong’s Flower Opening Day Wedding Arts Center, operated by Foshan Huakai Gongyan Banquet Catering Management Co. During the National Day period, attendees experienced diarrhea and vomiting; about 100 patients were treated in hospitals, with reports of 200 guests at one banquet and multiple tables affected. Authorities described it as a clustered foodborne disease, with pathogenic bacteria detected in samples from some staff. Investigations are ongoing; the company paused banquet receptions from Oct 7 to conduct corrective measures, and no specific pathogen or contamination point has been disclosed. The event underscores ongoing food safety concerns in Foshan (Chancheng District) and broader Guangdong.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省の有名ホテルでの結婚披露宴後、多数が下痢・嘔吐の症状を訴える、食中毒の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単一の結婚披露宴に起因する局所的な食中毒クラスターであり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは認められないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 原因病原体や汚染源は未特定だが、単一の披露宴会場に限定された食中毒事例であり、感染症としての拡大リスクは低い。地元当局により調査・是正措置が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Premier mort d'Ebola au Kenya: Madagascar passe en alerte renforcée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola death in Kenya: Madagascar goes on high alert.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 9, 2026, Kenya reports its first Ebola death, confirmed October 6, 2026, in a case imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, which is experiencing a surge in cases. Madagascar has no confirmed cases on the island, but authorities have raised alert and strengthened measures. The Malagasy health ministry, with WHO and partners, has intensified entry screening at airports and prepared facilities to detect, isolate, sample, transport specimens, manage cases, and prevent infections. Travelers from the DRC or who transited through it face 21-day surveillance; entrants authorized to enter must undergo a 21-day quarantine with health follow-up. Those arriving from Kenya receive enhanced entry screening and 21-day health monitoring, subject to evolution of the outbreak. Suspected symptoms after travel or contact should call 115 before seeking care. Authorities urge vigilance, not panic, and good hand hygiene; situation under ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、マダガスカルが厳戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染拡大中のエボラがケニアへ国際的に拡大し死亡例が発生、周辺国が渡航制限・検疫措置を強化しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。発生源であるDRCでの感染急増が主因であり、DRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: 肺鼠疫引恐慌！APEC傳緊急改線上會議 WHO要求俄國揭真相
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague sparks panic! APEC reportedly switches to an online meeting in an emergency. WHO calls on Russia to reveal the truth.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk, Siberia, Russia, an employee at the Irkutsk Plague Research Institute died Oct 2 after falling ill Sept 29; the 28-year-old woman, Darya Shipilova, died of pneumonia of unknown cause. WHO says no confirmed plague and requests information on the death, exposures, and test results for contacts. About 200 individuals are under quarantine or health monitoring. The agency notes media reports of a possible laboratory incident but cannot confirm. Russian authorities on Oct 8 said nearly 5,000 samples from contacts tested, with no dangerous pathogens found and no evidence of plague infection; they emphasize the death remains unclear and deny an ongoing plague outbreak. Social-media rumors of widespread plague and cross-border spread remain unsubstantiated. Reports of direct flights from Irkutsk to Chinese cities are unverified, and do not prove transmission risk. Separately, China is hosting the November APEC summit, with online ministerial meetings possible and leaders’ talks possibly canceled.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストが恐慌を誘発！APECが緊急でオンライン会議に切替か　WHOがロシアに真相開示を要求
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡し、WHOが情報提供を要求するなど国際的関心が高まっている。確定診断はされていないが、異常性と社会的注目度からフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツク州での原因不明死亡例であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国はAPEC開催国として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOはペスト確定を否定しており、ロシア当局も5000検体陰性と発表しているが、SNS上の噂やAPEC対応変更など社会的関心が高いため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ex-Senator Poghisio warns Kenya over relaxed Ebola protocols after first confirmed death
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola death from a Bundibugyo strain, tied to a single imported case involving a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and travelled through Uganda before arriving in Nairobi. He arrived at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport on 3 October 2026 and was later hospitalized at Nairobi Hospital; he fell ill about a month earlier and tested positive on 6 October at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI, dying subsequently. Symptoms included fever, chills, fatigue, muscle pain and bleeding under the skin. Authorities intensified surveillance and contact tracing, identifying 57 contacts by 7 October, with 10 under quarantine; designated facilities were set up to isolate suspected or confirmed cases. The World Health Organization confirmed the imported case on 8 October, stating no wider outbreak, while Senator Poghisio urged Kenya not to relax existing protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 元上院議員ポギシオ氏、ケニアで初のエボラ死亡確認後、緩和された防疫対策について警告
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）死亡例が確認され、輸入症例として国際的な移動歴を伴う事例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本症例はケニアでの輸入エボラ死亡例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは患者の居住歴として言及されているが、実際の発生国としての明示的記述はないため除外。WHOは広範なアウトブレイクではないとしているが、国内外での続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Чума в России и крысиная лихорадка в Таиланде: стоит ли опасаться казахстанцам
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Russia and murine typhus in Thailand: should people in Kazakhstan be afraid?
article.articleSummary: Kazakhstan’s Ministry of Health says the epidemiological situation is stable and border checkpoints maintain sanitary-quarantine control, with no travelers displaying fever or signs of highly dangerous infections. In Russia, reports of a plague outbreak are not confirmed: a 28-year-old Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute employee died of pneumonia of unknown origin; Rosptroponadzor reports no cases among contacts; initial surveillance included about 200 people, with roughly 90% finished, and around 5,000 laboratory tests found no dangerous pathogens. The World Health Organization has requested additional data for independent assessment. In Thailand, leptospirosis (rat fever) is rising during the rainy season but is not a new pandemic or unknown strain; from Jan 1 to Sep 23, 2026, there were 3,303 cases and 46 deaths (case fatality ~1.39%). The article notes no confirmed imported cases and emphasizes continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペストとタイのネズミ熱（レプトスピラ症）：カザフスタン国民は恐れるべきか
triage.triage_reason: タイのレプトスピラ症は雨季による季節性の増加であり新規病原体や新規流行ではないとされるが、2026年の累計症例3,303件・死亡46件という一定規模のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアのペスト疑い事例（未確認、ロシアは対象国外）とタイのレプトスピラ症（季節性、雨季に伴う既知の増加）。カザフスタン保健省は国境管理の状況が安定していると説明。タイの事例は新規パンデミックや新規株ではないと明記されており、輸入例も確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: With dengue surging, experts push for QDENGA vaccine access, private
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh faces a worsening dengue surge with 90,356 hospitalisations and 294 deaths this year, alongside 1,935 new admissions. Health experts urge government approval of WHO-prequalified QDENGA (TAK-003) dengue vaccine to reduce severe cases, hospitalisations and fatalities, arguing private imports could extend access while national rollout is being decided. QDENGA is a two-dose vaccine given three months apart, and WHO recommends it for children aged 6–16 in high-transmission settings; it provides protection against all four dengue serotypes. In Bangladesh, officials stress that vaccine evaluation should be evidence-based and not rushed, since immediate impact is unlikely. Globally, QDENGA has WHO prequalification (May 2024), SAGE endorsement (Sept 2023), and has been approved in 43 countries; India approved on 20 July 2026, planning commercial launch in early 2027 with price Rs 6,000–12,000. Safety notes prohibit vaccination for pregnant women, under-six children, and some immunocompromised individuals. Private import could ease access and hospital burden.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱急増を受け、専門家がQDENGAワクチンへのアクセス拡大・民間輸入を推進
triage.triage_reason: 主な発生国はバングラデシュ（対象国外）であり、インドについてはワクチン承認・商業展開に関する言及のみで、実際の発生事例ではないため対象国における感染症イベントとは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はバングラデシュのデング熱流行とQDENGAワクチン導入に関する議論。インドへの言及はワクチン承認・価格設定等の規制情報のみであり、インド国内でのデング熱発生事例を報告するものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Govt Issues Ebola Update After Suspected Case of Another Kenyan From DRC
article.articleSummary: Laboratory tests in Wajir County for a 20-year-old Kenyan truck worker with travel history from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) via Uganda to Kenya returned negative for Ebola virus disease. The patient, reported at Habaswein Sub-County Hospital, developed illness in DRC (Sept 2) and arrived home Sept 20; he will continue to be monitored under public health protocols after preliminary results showed no Ebola infection. This update follows Kenya’s first Ebola Bundibugyo virus death confirmed on Oct 6: a 40-year-old Kenyan who traveled from the DRC through Uganda to Nairobi, arriving Oct 3, was isolated at Nairobi Hospital after fever, fatigue, and bleeding under the skin and died Oct 5 around 11:30 p.m., triggering intensified contact tracing. Authorities urged calm and reliance on official communications; health workers at Habaswein and the Ministry of Health were commended for swift response.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、別のケニア人のDRC由来疑いエボラ症例についてアップデートを発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行に関連し、ケニアで渡航関連の死亡例が確認されたこと、国際的な人の移動を伴う越境感染リスクがあることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例（疑い例は陰性、確定例は死亡）だが、感染はDRCで発生したものであり、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためDRCのみを検証対象地域とした。DRCでのエボラ流行の越境拡大事例として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tod im Russen-Labor: Werden Pest-Erreger für Biowaffen genutzt?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death in the Russian lab: Are plague agents being used for bioweapons?
article.articleSummary: Death of a laboratory technician in Russia coincides with US-led accusations that Russia and other states produce internationally banned biological weapons. The Irkutsk Institute for Plague Research has long housed highly virulent strains of plague, anthrax, and other pathogens, officially for public health defense; a US study cited by the New York Post alleges ties to Soviet bioweapons programs. Biowarfare expert Dr. Mirko Himmel (University of Hamburg) differentiates defensive bio-defense research from prohibited offensive biowarfare, noting such defensive work is widespread in the US, UK, Russia, China, and EU states, while concrete details on offensive programs remain undisclosed, though suspicions exist toward the US, China, Russia, North Korea, and Iran. He warns plague bacteria could theoretically be dispersed as bioaerosols to cause pneumonic plague via inhalation. BWÜ lacks a verification mechanism, leaving civil society uncertain about compliance as of 9 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア研究所での死亡事故：ペスト菌が生物兵器に利用されているのか？
triage.triage_reason: ペスト、炭疽病の病原体が絡む重大な懸念があるが、記事は主に米国による疑惑の報道であり、実際の確認された発生や大規模な流行の証拠に乏しい。生物兵器疑惑に関する社会的関心は高いが、PICKUP基準を明確に満たさない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した位置情報には、ロシア、ドイツ、米国、イラン、北朝鮮、英国が含まれるが、対象国リストではロシア（id=2017370）は含まれていない。対象国の中からは、記事本文で言及されているChinaのみ verified_locations に含める。ハンブルク大学の専門家見解は学術的コメントであり、確定的な事例ではない。実際の感染症流行の証拠、確認症例、死亡数等が明確でないため、情報不足判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: 廣東佛山通報多人就餐後身體不適：初判為食源性疾病聚集事件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foshan, Guangdong reports multiple people ill after dining: initially assessed as a cluster of foodborne diseases.
article.articleSummary: Foshan, Guangdong—Chancheng District Market Supervision Administration reported a cluster of foodborne illness after dining at Huakai Palace Banquet Catering Co., Ltd. Diners in Foshan experienced illness; authorities joined health and disease-control teams to inspect. Investigations found non-standard food processing practices; officials ordered immediate remediation. The bureau commissioned professional food-testing laboratories to sample ingredients and leftover foods, while health authorities conducted tests on exposed individuals and the surrounding environment. Pathogenic bacteria were detected in samples from some cases. Based on site inspection, epidemiological investigation, and laboratory results, the incident is preliminarily classified as a foodborne disease cluster, and the company is under formal investigation. Next steps include continued regulatory actions, strengthened food-safety risk screening, and measures to safeguard public health in Foshan.

triage.headline_ja: 広東省仏山市、多数が食事後に体調不良を訴えたと通報：初期判断は食品由来疾患の集団事例
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでの食中毒クラスターであり、病原細菌は検出されたが国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクはなく、通常の食品安全事案として対応されている。
triage.notes: 単一施設での食中毒事例であり、感染症（ヒト-ヒト感染）のイベントではないため対象国リストへの計上は見送り。地元行政（市場監督管理局・衛生当局）が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: 佛山市民飲宴後不適　官方通報食源性疾病聚集事件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foshan residents fall ill after a banquet; authorities report a cluster of foodborne illnesses.
article.articleSummary: Foshan City, Chancheng District, Guangdong Province, China reports a cluster of foodborne illness linked to multiple wedding banquets at a hotel during Golden Week. The incident began after a banquet on Oct 3 at Foshan Huakai Palace Banquet Catering Co., Ltd., with attendees experiencing diarrhea and vomiting; one attendee reported 7–8 stools the next day. The hotel hosted five weddings; a single reception drew over 200 guests, while other tables reported affected relatives. By Oct 9, the Chancheng District Market Supervision Administration, with health and CDC authorities, classified it as a foodborne illness cluster. Investigations found non-compliant food processing operations, and officials ordered immediate rectification. Laboratories were commissioned to test ingredients and leftover foods, while environmental and worker sampling was conducted. Pathogenic bacteria were detected in some collected samples.

triage.headline_ja: 佛山市民、宴会後に体調不良　当局が食品由来疾患の集団発生を公表

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Anggap Sepele Influenza A, Kenali Gejala dan Komplikasinya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Underestimate Influenza A: Recognize Its Symptoms and Complications.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A, including subtypes H1N1 and H3N2, is a highly transmissible respiratory virus circulating in Jakarta, Indonesia. Symptoms typically appear abruptly and include fever, cough, nasal congestion or runny nose, sore throat, headache, muscle or body aches, fatigue, and sometimes vomiting or diarrhea. While some recover with rest and fluids, influenza A can lead to serious complications such as pneumonia, asthma attacks, or heart problems, especially in infants, toddlers, and the elderly. Diagnosis is commonly done with a rapid nasal or throat swab; positive results prompt antiviral treatment with Oseltamivir (Tamiflu), Zanamivir (Relenza), or Peramivir (Rapivab). Baloxavir Marboxil (Xofluza) is also available in some settings. Annual flu vaccination remains the most effective prevention. Transmission can occur from one day before symptoms to about five days after onset, with longer contagious periods in severe cases.

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ca sốt xuất huyết nội tại, ngành y tế khẩn trương giám sát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Detection of a locally transmitted dengue fever case, the health sector is stepping up surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever detected in Nghệ An Province, Vietnam, with a locally transmitted case in Vinh City’s Ben Thuy 1 area. An eighth-grade student began fatigue and fever on Oct 2; dengue infection confirmed on Oct 6. The patient, who had not traveled to dengue-affected regions, is in stable condition and receiving care at Vinh City General Hospital. Health authorities, led by the Vinh City Health Center, have intensified surveillance and implemented vector control within a 200-meter radius of the patient’s home, including insecticide spraying. Local authorities found mosquitoes, larvae and water-holding containers at the residence; residents are urged to eliminate breeding sites and practice anti-mosquito measures, especially around the case area. Citizens should seek medical testing for sudden high fever, headaches and body pains. Previously, in September 2026 Nghệ An reported a cluster in Quỳnh Anh commune, with 59 cases as of Sept 4.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の国内感染例を発見、保健当局が監視を強化

article.articleHeadline: افزایش عفونت‌های تنفسی همزمان با فصل سرما
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in respiratory infections during the cold season.
article.articleSummary: An Iranian pediatric pulmonologist notes a rise in respiratory infections as cold weather begins, with influenza and rhinoviruses among the most common pathogens. Most children’s respiratory infections are mild and self-limited; parents should not assume every cold or cough signals severe pneumonia. Antibiotic misuse is discouraged, since not all infections require antibiotics. Indoor crowding in winter facilitates transmission, so greater vigilance is needed for infants—especially under three months or those with lung disease or other serious underlying conditions. Red flags include abnormal breathing, chest retractions, lip cyanosis, or a deteriorating general condition (sleepiness or reduced feeding). Influenza vaccines are in limited supply; Russian and Chinese vaccines are distributed, with physician discretion. Prevention: handwashing, ventilation, and keeping ill children at home 1–2 days. Data up to Mehr 3 show 17.4% COVID-19 positivity and outpatient respiratory visits rising from 6% to 8%, but no influenza wave yet; a tough season is anticipated.

triage.headline_ja: 寒冷シーズンに伴う呼吸器感染症の増加

article.articleHeadline: 肺鼠疫可飞沫传播 肺鼠疫症状是什么
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic plague is droplet-transmitted; what are the symptoms of pneumonic plague?
article.articleSummary: Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis, an animal-origin bacterium commonly found in small mammals and their fleas. Humans become infected via flea bites, contact with infectious fluids or contaminated materials, or inhalation of respiratory droplets from patients with pneumonic plague. The disease can manifest as septicemic plague or pneumonic plague; mortality, if untreated, ranges from 30% to 100%. Pneumonic plague is especially deadly and traditionally fatal without early treatment. It is highly transmissible between people through airborne droplets, capable of sparking severe outbreaks. The article emphasizes the zoonotic reservoir and multiple transmission routes, underscoring the need for prompt diagnosis and treatment to reduce mortality and prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストは飛沫感染する 肺ペストの症状とは

triage.notes: 記事は疾患の一般的解説であり、中国または他の対象国での実際の発生事例を報じていないため、発生地域の検証対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-穿山甲源耐药菌传播风险研究获新进展
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet: New progress in research on the transmission risk of pangolin-origin antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
article.articleSummary: 5 of 22 fecal isolates from pangolins rescued in 2018 (Malayan pangolins, Manis javanica) carried multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli, spanning sequence types ST354, ST206, and ST48. Core resistances include beta-lactams, chloramphenicol, fluoroquinolones, and sulfonamides, with resistance genes co-located on IncX1 plasmids. Plasmids harbor abundant mobile elements—class 1 integrons, IS26, and transposon Tn1721—that promote horizontal gene transfer. Conjugation experiments demonstrated efficient transfer of resistance plasmids to recipient E. coli, enabling rapid acquisition of multidrug resistance. Phylogenomic and comparative genomics show these MDR E. coli are closely related to human and animal isolates from East Asia and Southeast Asia, with some resistance plasmids highly homologous to globally reported plasmids, suggesting pangolins could facilitate cross-ecological spread of resistance. While virulence of the isolates was overall low, dissemination of resistance genes poses public health risks. Wildlife trade contributes to cross-border AMR spread; supports enhanced wildlife quarantine and One Health antimicrobial resistance controls. Published in Integrative Zoology (doi:10.1111/1749-4877.70161) on 2026-10-09.

triage.headline_ja: 科学网:センザンコウ由来の薬剤耐性菌の伝播リスクに関する研究が新たな進展
triage.triage_reason: 2018年に救助されたセンザンコウの糞便由来株を用いた学術研究報告であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の発生事例ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2018年に救助されたセンザンコウの検体を用いた学術論文（Integrative Zoology誌掲載）の紹介であり、ヒトへの感染事例や急性のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。薬剤耐性菌の野生動物由来伝播に関する基礎研究として、One Health的観点からの継続的モニタリング対象ではあるが、トリアージとしては即時対応不要。

article.articleHeadline: Gia tăng ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết, Hà Tĩnh tăng cường kiểm soát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increasing dengue fever outbreaks, Ha Tinh strengthens control measures.
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, is contending with a complex dengue fever outbreak in 2026, reporting 380 cases to date. New clusters have emerged in densely populated areas, raising community transmission risk. In Vinh Loc village, Cam Trung commune, nine cases have been recorded; the first, L.T.V.A. (born 2009), developed fever and fatigue on 28 September and tested positive by rapid dengue assay on 3 October. Eight further cases followed, with many residents living nearby or in the same family. Other affected areas include Thiên Cầm and Kỳ Xuân; in Nhân Hòa, Thiên Cầm, awareness and early hospital presentation are emphasized. Kỳ Hoa commune has seen 96 cases since August 2026, with three new infections on 7 October and 14 patients under care. Response centers on intensified epidemiological surveillance, vector control, removal of standing water, environmental sanitation, and routine indoor/outdoor insecticide spraying by Hà Tĩnh CDC and local authorities.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行拡大、ハティン省が対策を強化

article.articleHeadline: Angka Influenza Melonjak sampai 56 Persen, Ini Gejala yang Sering Tak Disadari dan Cara Mencegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases have surged by as much as 56 percent; here are symptoms that are often overlooked and how to prevent them.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Indonesia remains moderate and under control, despite a rise in positivity. Ministry of Health data shows influenza positivity at 56% in week 38 (end of September 2026) – the proportion of positive specimens among those tested in surveillance, not the share of the population infected. Symptoms can appear abruptly and include fever or chills, cough, runny nose, sore throat, headache, muscle pain, and fatigue. High-risk groups—children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities—should seek earlier medical consultation if symptoms worsen. Emphasis is placed on early recognition and preventive practices to reduce transmission, amid ongoing outbreaks in Indonesia, with reports from Jakarta. Do not panic; guidance is to remain vigilant as weather changes affect health.

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯的"鼠疫"，开始蔓延
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's 'plague' begins to spread.
article.articleSummary: In Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, Sept 25 a laboratory worker broke a vial containing Yersinia pestis. Two days later the 28-year-old researcher deteriorated; doctors initially suspected COVID-19. Despite emergency intubation, she died Oct 2. About 200 people were quarantined; the hospital was sealed for three weeks, and an aluminum plant required masks; streets showed personnel in protective gear. Russian authorities later said the deceased was diagnosed with pneumonia of unknown cause; nearly 5,000 tests found no dangerous pathogen, and no outbreak risk. WHO asked for clarification but said public risk remained low. In China, Oct 8 trading surged in anti-epidemic concepts: DaAn Gene, North China Pharmaceutical, RunDu Co., BluBlue Biotech up to 10% daily limit; Zhenbaodao, Botuo Biotech, Lukang Medicine also higher. The piece notes this is speculative. Plague is now treatable with cheap antibiotics; China has had no plague cases since 1953, with under five annually and a surveillance system.

triage.notes: 事件はロシア（対象国リスト外）で発生した研究室内曝露事故。中国での反応は『防疫関連銘柄』への投機的な株価上昇のみであり、中国国内での感染症発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ロシア当局とWHOは危険な病原体は検出されずアウトブレイクリスクは低いと発表している。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Cara Mencegah Penularan Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 Ways to Prevent the Transmission of Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A transmission in Indonesia can be reduced through five preventive steps outlined by Dr. Andrew Adhytia Lieputra, Sp.MK, a clinical microbiology specialist from Diponegoro University. Vulnerable groups face risks of serious complications such as pneumonia requiring further medical assessment. Five measures: 1) strengthen immunity via a healthy lifestyle—balanced nutrition, regular exercise, adequate sleep and overall health maintenance; 2) annual influenza vaccination, advised especially for those at risk, with vaccine composition updated to match circulating strains and antibody protection waning over time; 3) wear masks in high-risk settings, particularly crowded or enclosed spaces; 4) practice proper cough and sneeze etiquette—avoid covering the mouth/nose with hands; use disposable tissues or the inside of the elbow if tissues are unavailable; 5) frequent handwashing with soap to prevent hand-mediated transmission. Reported by Antara on 9 October 2026 (as cited by SuaraSumut.id).

article.articleHeadline: Shorter High-Dose Antibiotic Course for Buruli Ulcer Shows Promise but
article.articleSummary: Buruli ulcer in Ghana was studied in the SHARP randomized trial, testing whether four weeks of high-dose rifampicin (20 mg/kg) plus clarithromycin (15 mg/kg) could match eight weeks of standard-dose therapy (rifampicin 10 mg/kg with clarithromycin). All PCR-confirmed cases received wound dressings coated with dialkylcarbamoyl chloride. Primary endpoint: time until no viable Mycobacterium ulcerans detected by quantitative PCR targeting 16S rRNA, followed through week 20. From Nov 2021 to Jul 2024, 42 participants were randomized (23 high-dose, 19 standard). Mean clearance times were 4.9 vs 7.0 weeks; adjusted difference 0.5 weeks in favor of the short course, p=0.835, with CI crossing null. Paradoxical reactions: 0/21 in high-dose vs 5/15 in standard; OR 0.19, p=0.102. No recurrences in either arm; safety was similar. Conclusion: no clear microbiological advantage for the four-week regimen; larger trials are needed.

triage.headline_ja: ブルーリ潰瘍に対する短期高用量抗生物質療法、有望性示すも目標には届かず(ガーナ試験)

article.articleHeadline: Что произошло в Забайкалье из-за угрозы ящура
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What happened in Transbaikalia due to the threat of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, Transbaikalia (Zabaykalsky Krai) Governor Alexander Osipov declared a heightened readiness regime due to a perceived risk of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), citing a 'critical risk' of spread linked to outbreaks in Mongolia and China. The decree calls for intensified monitoring and preparedness across the region. The move follows a related alert in Buryatia after reports of nodular dermatitis outbreaks in Irkutsk Oblast; in Irkutsk District, livestock culling has begun, according to Baikal People. A veterinary epidemiologist suggested the nodular dermatitis event could be connected to FMD. The article emphasizes cross-border risk and regional responses, with enhanced surveillance and animal depopulation as immediate control measures.

article.articleHeadline: Эбола добралась до Кении: что будут делать эстонские туроператоры?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has reached Kenya: What will Estonian tour operators do?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has reached Kenya as of 2026-10-09, after a deadly spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo where the strain has killed more than 4,000 people and infected about 8,500. Uganda experienced transmission earlier but was declared free of the disease in August. In the week before 2026-10-09, the rare Bundibugyo strain reached Kenya; a Kenyan man who died on Monday contracted the virus in the DRC, marking the country’s first Ebola death. The outbreak remains centered in the DRC with cross-border risk to East Africa’s tourism-dependent region. The infection source in the Kenya case is imported from the DRC; no other clinical or laboratory details are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがケニアに到達：エストニアの旅行会社はどう対応するか？

article.articleHeadline: जम्मू-कश्मीर मेंं डेंगू मरीजों की संख्या 1000 के पार, एक दिन में ही 59 मामले दर्ज; जम्मू में सबसे ज्यादा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases in Jammu and Kashmir cross 1,000; 59 cases reported in a single day; Jammu records the highest.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Jammu and Kashmir exceed 1,000 with 59 new infections in the last 24 hours. Of 297 people tested, 59 were positive, led by Jammu district (29). Cumulative totals: Jammu 560; Doda 143; Samba 134 (one death); Udhampur 26; Kathua 35; Rajouri 23; Ramban 17; Poonch 10; Reasi 13; Kishtwar 8; Kashmir region 6; 20 cases from other states; one imported case in the last 24 hours. Overall, 1,004 dengue patients confirmed in the state. Samba reports a death. Last year (2025) saw 1,483 confirmed cases from 16,831 tested; this year, 17,736 tested so far with 1,004 positives. Authorities are conducting awareness campaigns and urging sanitation to prevent stagnant water and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンムー・カシミールでデング熱患者数が1000人を突破、1日で59例を記録；ジャンムーで最多

article.articleHeadline: Health alert: Yellow fever outbreak in Upper West: * 3 cases confirmed, 74 suspected * Rapid response team deployed
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreak reported in Ghana's Upper West Region. As of Tuesday, Oct 7, 2026, three cases have been confirmed and 74 suspected in the Upper West, with about 450 suspected nationwide from June–September 2026. A National Rapid Response Team has been deployed to strengthen surveillance and response; affected facilities are demarcated and isolation measures in place. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh urged reliance on official sources and cautioned against panic. The response includes enhanced entry-point surveillance, laboratory capacity, and isolation facilities to promptly detect and manage suspected cases. Separately, Ghana monitors Ebola developments in the African region, with no cases in the country; no outbreak domestically, but measures are in place to contain one.

triage.headline_ja: 健康警報：アッパー・ウェスト州で黄熱病アウトブレイク：確定3例、疑い74例、緊急対応チーム展開
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の確定例・疑い例が急増（全国で疑い約450例）しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な規模の拡大が認められるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たしフルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナ国内の黄熱病アウトブレイクが主題。エボラについては地域内の動向を監視しているのみで、ガーナ国内での発生はないため、エボラに関する評価はこのイベントには適用していない。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内に明記がなく不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о 8,7 тыс. подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported 8,700 confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports 8,728 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 4,205 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo since May 2026, giving a case-fatality rate around 48.2%. In the interval since Sept 25, 775 new confirmed cases were recorded, including 379 deaths. The outbreak has spread to Alimbongo district in North Kivu and now covers 64 districts across seven eastern provinces, with Ituri the hardest hit. Transmission remains intense at the national level but uneven: some areas show slowing transmission while others continue rising. The persistently high mortality and many deaths outside health facilities indicate delays in detection and access to care. The outbreak began May 15 in DR Congo and Uganda; Uganda has declared the outbreak over (confirmed by WHO on Aug 25). On Oct 6, Kenya reported a first Ebola case in a Kenyan who visited DR Congo and died in hospital.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱確定症例8,700件を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例8,728件・死者4,205名（致死率約48.2%）に達し、7州64地区に拡大、ケニアへの国際的な感染拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは終息宣言済み（WHOが8月25日確認）、ケニアでDRC渡航歴のある症例が死亡したが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Po pranešimų apie marą Rusijoje - sujudimas: specialistai ragina nedaryti klaidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After reports of the plague in Russia, a stir: experts urge not to make mistakes.
article.articleSummary: Reports that a woman at a plague research institute in Russia’s Irkutsk region died from plague have not been confirmed by Moscow; the Irkutsk governor says contact-traced individuals show no health issues. Despite this, North American online communities have surged in interest around plague treatments, with videos推广 a $300 “preparedness” kit and discount codes, tied to The Wellness Company and promoter Rogan O’Handley. The kit allegedly contains doxycycline and ivermectin. Public health experts caution against self-manding antibiotics or antiparasitics: doxycycline should not be taken without infection risk; it can disrupt gut microbiota and drive antibiotic resistance, and not all exposures warrant treatment. FDA-approved use of ivermectin is limited to parasitic infections. Misinformation persists, with past examples during hantavirus cruise-ship cases and the 2026 Ebola outbreak in the DRC promoting unproven remedies. Experts Isaac Bogoch, Paul Keim, and Timothy Caulfield warn against scams exploiting fear, stressing that a non-confirmed case does not signal a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト報告後、騒動が発生：専門家らは誤った対応をしないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州での研究所関係者のペスト死亡報告はモスクワ当局により未確認であり、記事の主眼は未確認情報に便乗した誤情報・便乗商法への警鐘である。対象国における実際の感染症発生は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（対象国リスト外）での未確認ペスト報告とそれに伴うオンライン上の誤情報・便乗商法への警鐘。DRCの2026年エボラ流行は過去の誤情報事例として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ILI di Situbondo Naik 17,8 Persen, Dinkes Pastikan Belum Ada Super Flu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ILI cases in Situbondo rise by 17.8 percent, Health Department confirms there is no Super Flu yet.
article.articleSummary: Situbondo Regency, East Java, Indonesia reports no Super Flu (influenza type A) cases to date, but influenza-like illness (ILI) and pneumonia have risen. Local Health Department (Dinkes Situbondo) director Dwi Herman Susilo said regional lab tests show no Super Flu; detected illnesses are ILI and pneumonia. ILI is defined as acute respiratory infection with flu-like symptoms and fever up to 38°C. For week 39 (Sept 27–Oct 3, 2026), ILI cases reached 251, up 38 from the prior week, a 17.8% rise. Data come from 15 public health facilities (puskesmas and district hospitals). The largest increase occurred in the Asembagus health area, at 76.2%. Preventive measures include influenza awareness and cough etiquette campaigns via leaflets and outreach at posyandu, religious gatherings, and schools.

triage.headline_ja: シトゥボンドのILI症例が17.8%増加、保健局はスーパーフルはまだ確認されていないと説明
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性ILI/肺炎の増加であり、スーパーフル（新型インフルエンザ）は検査で否定されている。地域的かつ軽度な増加であり、国際的拡大や重篤性の懸念も確認されない。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局が通常の監視活動として報告した事例であり、スーパーフル（H5N1等）は否定されている。国内の一地域における季節性変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng tăng cao, cảnh báo biến chứng đe dọa tính mạng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and hand, foot, and mouth disease on the rise, warning of life-threatening complications.
article.articleSummary: Week 40 (Sept 28–Oct 4, 2026) in Ho Chi Minh City recorded 1,505 dengue cases, down 2.3% from the four-week average, total 37,369 dengue cases year-to-date. Dengue remains high with hotspots in Con Dao, Ngai Giao and Minh Thanh, requiring intensified surveillance and vector control. Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) rose to 1,673 cases that week, up 47.8%; year-to-date HFMD total is 38,463. Hotspots include Con Dao, Bình Khánh, and Hiệp Phước. Together the two diseases added 3,178 cases in one week. Dengue can progress to plasma leakage, shock, hemorrhage, and multi-organ failure, especially days 3–7. HFMD is usually mild but EV71-related cases can cause severe neurological, cardiac, and respiratory complications; watch for persistent high fever, tremors, or abnormal breathing. Vaccination and hygiene are emphasized; Dengue vaccine Qdenga is available for 4+ years with two doses; EV71 HFMD vaccine is being prepared for deployment.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、手足口病が増加、生命を脅かす合併症に警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市における毎週のデング熱・HFMDサーベイランス報告で、HFMDが前週比47.8%増加し合併症への警告があるが、両疾患とも同国の季節性風土病であり異常事態とは言い難く、社会的関心の高まりも不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はホーチミン市当局による定例の週次感染症サーベイランス報告であり、デング熱・HFMDは同国の既知の季節性流行疾患。HFMDの症例増加率は高いが、年次を通じた風土病の範囲内と考えられる。続報でHFMD（特にEV71関連重症例）の急増が継続するか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Смерть в российской лаборатории: возбудитель чумы как биологическое оружие?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death in a Russian Laboratory: The Plague Agent as a Biological Weapon?
article.articleSummary: US officials accuse Russia and several states of developing prohibited biological weapons, following a deadly incident at a plague laboratory in Irkutsk. The Irkutsk Plague Institute has long housed high-virulence strains of plague, anthrax, and other pathogens; officially its work protects public health, but a New York Post report cites results suggesting collaboration with Soviet-era bioweapons programs. Euronews interviewed Dr. Mirko Himmel, who differentiates defensive biosecurity research from covert offensive programs and notes that defensive plague research occurs in many nations (US, UK, Russia, China, EU members like Germany and France, etc.), potentially masking offensive aims. He warns that plague could be weaponized as a bioaerosol, producing pneumonic plague upon inhalation, although no publicly known arsenals exist and the Biological Weapons Convention lacks a verification mechanism, leaving uncertainty about state programs and their scope.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア研究所での死亡事件：ペスト病原体は生物兵器か？
triage.triage_reason: ペスト、炭疽菌などの高リスク病原体の施設事故と生物兵器開発疑惑に関する国際的な政治的関心の高いイベント。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイルクーツクのペスト研究所での事故をきっかけに、米国による生物兵器開発疑惑の国際的議論を報じている。発生地域リストに多数の国が含まれるが、サマリー上で実際に事件が発生している確認箇所はロシア（イルクーツク）である。ロシアは対象国リストに該当しないため、言及されている対象国はChina（防御的ペスト研究実施国として言及）のみ。高リスク病原体の取扱、施設事故、生物兵器規制の検証メカニズム欠如といった要素から、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В религиозном тексте 1000-летней давности нашлись следы древней болезни
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In a thousand-year-old religious text, traces of an ancient disease were found.
article.articleSummary: Researchers from University College Dublin report finding traces of sheep pox in the York Gospels, a 1000-year-old manuscript. Published in Science Advances, the study traces the evolution of the sheep pox virus using ancient DNA preserved in manuscripts and animal remains. Sheep pox is highly contagious among sheep and can devastate flocks, with high mortality in young animals; humans are not generally affected. DNA of the virus was detected on parchment made from calf and goat skins, suggesting interspecies infection or contamination during parchment production. Comparison with Bronze Age sheep teeth DNA shows sheep pox has affected domestic stock for more than 3700 years across Eurasia. The York Gospels were written in Canterbury in the late 10th century and later housed at York Minster. The findings imply parchment archives worldwide may harbor historical pathogen DNA, aiding understanding of viral evolution and informing eradication efforts, including Greece's current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 1000年前の宗教文書に古代病の痕跡が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は歴史的研究(羊痘ウイルスの古代DNA解析)に関する内容であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や対象国における実際の発生事例を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は考古学・歴史研究(ダブリン大学による古代写本中の羊痘ウイルスDNA解析)に関するものであり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。言及されているギリシャの現行アウトブレイクは対象国リストに含まれない。Bluedot APIが付与したタイやアイルランドなどの地域情報は、記事の主題（歴史研究）とは無関係で誤付与と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ricercatrice morta di peste: nuovi dubbi sul laboratorio dopo i finanziamenti Usa e i test con la Cina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Female researcher dies of plague: new doubts about the laboratory after US funding and tests with China.
article.articleSummary: Plague-related concerns surround the Irkutsk laboratory in Siberia after the death of researcher Darya Shipilova. While the article’s title attributes the death to plague, Russian authorities later attributed it to pneumonia, drawing Western calls for transparency about the incident and the lab’s safety. The piece notes that U.S. funding from Robert Kennedy Jr. and joint plague tests with China are at the center of the controversy. Irkutsk regional governor Kobzev announced that medical monitoring of all contacts has concluded, with no infectious disease cases or hazardous microorganisms found. However, as is common in reporting on Russia, officials’ statements are viewed with caution and many observers demand independent verification before declaring the case closed. The article highlights ongoing scrutiny of the laboratory’s operations and international collaborations related to plague research.

triage.headline_ja: ペストで死亡した女性研究者：米国からの資金提供と中国との共同試験を巡り、研究所への新たな疑惑
triage.triage_reason: 単一の研究者死亡事例であり、ロシア当局は感染症ではなく肺炎と説明、接触者監視も終了し感染拡大の証拠はないが、死因や施設の安全性を巡る情報が交錯しており続報を要する。
triage.notes: 事件発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、本評価の対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しない。中国は共同試験の相手国として言及されているのみで、事件発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Morte em laboratório russo: Peste pode ser usada como arma biológica?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death in a Russian laboratory: Could plague be used as a biological weapon?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, following the death of a laboratory technician at Russia’s plague research facility in Irkutsk, the United States and others allege Russia and colleagues are pursuing prohibited biological weapons. The Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research has long been described as a repository for virulent Yersinia pestis strains and other pathogens; officially, these labs are for public health, but a US study cited by the New York Post alleges collaboration with Soviet bioweapons programs. Euronews interview with Mirko Himmel (University of Hamburg) clarifies the distinction between biodefense research (permitted) and offensive BW programs (prohibited), noting many countries conduct biodefense while public details of offensive efforts remain scarce. The US suspects China, Russia, North Korea, and Iran of potential ongoing programs. Theoretically, plague could be weaponized as pneumonic plague via inhaled bioaerosols dispersed by aircraft or explosive devices, but no verifiable arsenals exist under the 1975 Biological Weapons Convention, leaving uncertainty about state activity.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所で死亡事故:ペストは生物兵器として使用され得るか?
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアの研究所での技術者死亡を契機とした生物兵器疑惑に関する政治的・推測的議論であり、対象国における実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国・北朝鮮・イラン・ロシアを生物兵器疑惑の対象国として言及しているが、実際の感染症流行や症例報告ではなく、地政学的・政治的議論に留まる。対象国リストのChinaも疑惑の文脈での言及のみで実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El primer enfermo de ébola en Kenia importado de Congo viajó durante semanas por carretera y avión por tres países sin ser detectado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first Ebola patient in Kenya, imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, traveled for weeks by road and by air through three countries without being detected.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola patient detected in Kenya imported from DRC died in Nairobi on Oct 5, 2026. The patient traveled for nearly a month by road and air across Congo, Uganda, and Kenya (Bondo and Kisangani in DRC; Kampala in Uganda; final flight to Nairobi) after visiting Buta, Likati, and Aketi in northeastern DRC. He presented with high fever and rash in Congo but was misdiagnosed with Rift Valley fever; Ebola testing was not performed until hospital transfer. Kenya identified 57 contacts, with 10 in quarantine; border control failures allowed travel through three countries. Africa CDC mapped the itinerary and urged vigilance. The DRC outbreak has 8,700+ confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths (48% mortality), caused by Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine; Uganda had declared zero cases on July 28 after 42 days. Kenya is boosting isolation capacity (five centers, 241 beds).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国から輸入されたケニア初のエボラ患者、3カ国を陸路・空路で数週間移動も検知されず
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ患者がウガンダ・ケニアへ未検知のまま国際移動し死亡、ケニアで57名の接触者を特定するなど国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認されるため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの大規模流行（8,700例以上、致死率48%）が主要な背景であり、国境管理の不備による国際伝播が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow fever response too slow - SEND Ghana tells gov't - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Ghana faces a suspected yellow fever outbreak with about 450 suspected cases reported across the country between June and September 2026, including 74 in the Upper West Region; three of the suspected cases have been laboratory-confirmed as yellow fever. Seven deaths in the Sissala East District are linked to the suspected outbreak, though officials have yet to confirm yellow fever as the cause. The government has sent samples to Senegal for confirmatory testing and cannot declare an outbreak until results arrive. SEND Ghana's Harriet Nuamah Agyemang criticized the four-month delay in responses, urging streamlined emergency funding and faster action during emergencies, calling for an emergency button. The government has announced measures such as deploying a National Rapid Response Team and strengthening laboratory testing, and cites the 7-1-7 outbreak response framework to bolster preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病への対応が遅すぎる - SEND Ghanaが政府に指摘
triage.triage_reason: ガーナで黄熱病疑い例約450件・確定3件・死亡7人が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: セネガルは確認検査のための検体送付先として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。確定診断待ちのため今後の続報で重症度・拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Students fall ill at a hostel in Pebbair of Wanaparthy
article.articleSummary: About 25 students at the Women's Polytechnic College hostel on the outskirts of Pebbair, Wanaparthy district, fell ill Wednesday night with suspected food poisoning. ANI reports observed vomiting, fever and weakness among those affected; several were taken to Pebbair Primary Health Centre for examination, with seriously ill individuals treated and the overall condition described as stable. While allegations point to chicken curry as a possible source, the exact cause is under investigation. A formal probe is underway to identify the infection source. Local officials, including Pebbair Municipal Chairman Srinivas Goud and Congress town president Dayakar Reddy, visited the college to check on the students. No laboratory-confirmed cause has been reported yet, and the incident is being assessed by health authorities. Keywords: outbreak, food poisoning, investigation, Pebbair, Wanaparthy.

triage.headline_ja: ワナパルティのペッバイルの寮で学生が体調不良に
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での集団食中毒疑いで、感染症としての国際的拡大や異常性は認められず、症状も安定しているため見送り。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いであり感染症イベントとしての該当性は低い。原因食品（鶏カレー）の調査中で、ラボ確認結果は未報告。対象国リストの疾患としては該当しないため地域は空欄とした。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Pekalongan giatkan gerakan PSN untuk mencegah peningkatan kasus DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pekalongan City Government steps up the PSN campaign to prevent an increase in dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Pekalongan, Central Java, Indonesia — The Pekalongan City Government intensified the Mosquito Nest Eradication (PSN) campaign to curb dengue fever (DBD). Health Department head Puji Winarni cautioned that changing weather can boost Aedes aegypti breeding, urging residents to disrupt breeding sites as well as target adult mosquitoes. The 3M approach—Drain, Bury, and Recycle—should be practiced, with inorganic waste recycled rather than dumped where mosquitoes breed. Residents are advised to use protective measures such as anti-mosquito repellents and nets, particularly around homes. Fogging is conducted as focused fogging based on confirmed DBD cases and epidemiological investigations by nearby community health centers, not as blanket spraying. In 2026, Pekalongan reports 50 dengue cases, down from about 80 in the previous year.

triage.headline_ja: プカロンガン市政府、デング熱（DBD）患者増加防止のためPSN（蚊の巣撲滅）運動を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は地域風土病であり、症例数も前年比で減少傾向にあるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年の約80件から今年は50件に減少しており、通常の季節的対策として実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : en moins de 24 heures, 13 patients dont un médecin et deux infirmières déclarés guéris ont quitté le CTE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: in less than 24 hours, 13 patients including one doctor and two nurses declared cured have left the Ebola Treatment Center.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo's North Kivu province, 13 Ebola virus disease patients were discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center at Beni General Reference Hospital within 24 hours. Eight left on October 7, and five more on October 8. Among the five on October 8 was a physician who had contracted Ebola while treating patients, along with two nurses and a pastor. Dr. Jérémie Muhindo, medical director of the hospital, confirmed the infected doctor recovered after medical care. Among the eight discharged on October 7 were a one-month-old infant and a school-aged child; the infant, orphaned by the death of the mother from Ebola, survived thanks to rapid treatment. This reflects ongoing recoveries amid the local Ebola outbreak centered in Beni.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：24時間足らずで医師1名と看護師2名を含む13名の患者が治癒宣言を受けエボラ治療センターを退院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、医療従事者を含む院内感染が確認されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は回復者の退院を報じるポジティブな内容だが、医師・看護師を含む院内感染が発生している点から継続的なヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあり、進行中のアウトブレイク状況の確認が必要。
