article.articleHeadline: Ρωσία: Θάνατος εργαζομένης σε ινστιτούτο πανώλης - Τα ερωτήματα για τα βιολογικά όπλα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia: Death of a female worker at a plague institute - Questions about biological weapons.
article.articleSummary: Death of a female laboratory assistant in Irkutsk remains unexplained; Russian authorities attribute it to pneumonia of unknown etiology, with no confirmed pneumonic plague cases, while the WHO has requested more information. The Irkutsk Plague Research Institute has long housed strains of plague, anthrax, and other pathogens. Officially, the labs serve public health protection, but a US study cited by the New York Post alleges plague facilities linked to Soviet-era bioweapons programs. Bio-weapons expert Mirko Himmel notes the need to distinguish defensive bio-research from prohibited offensive weapons research. He says bio-defense work—often studying plague as a potential agent—occurs in multiple countries, including the US, UK, Russia, China, and EU states such as Germany and France, though detailed state disclosures are lacking. He cautions that even if plague-based weapons exist, the BWÜ lacks verification mechanisms, and public evidence remains uncertain. Aerosolized dissemination via bioaerosols is discussed, but no confirmed programs exist.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア:ペスト研究所の女性職員死亡—生物兵器をめぐる疑問
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員の死因が未確定で肺ペストの確定例はないが、WHOが追加情報を要請しており続報を注視する必要がある。対象国（中国を含む）は記事の主題ではなく生物防衛研究の一般的言及に留まる。
triage.notes: 死因は肺炎として未確定で肺ペスト確定例はない。中国・米国・英国・ドイツ・フランスは生物防衛研究が存在する国として一般的に言及されているのみで、イベントの発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。実際の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）だが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Las autoridades de Kenia descartan un caso de ébola en un paciente que viajó a RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan authorities rule out an Ebola case in a patient who traveled to DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Kenya ruled out Ebola virus disease in a 20-year-old Kenyan who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda. In Wajir County, he was evaluated after Ebola-like symptoms; samples were sent to Nairobi’s National Virology Laboratory, with preliminary results negative for Ebola. Authorities will continue monitoring and care per public health protocols. The case follows a previously reported imported case: a 40-year-old Kenyan resident in the DRC who traveled by road to Uganda and flew to Nairobi, then died; authorities classified that case as imported. Kenya is the fourth country to report an Ebola-linked case from the DRC outbreak, alongside Uganda, France, and the Netherlands. The DRC’s seventeenth Ebola outbreak began May 15, with 8,728 cases and 4,205 deaths; Uganda declared the outbreak ended on Aug 26 after 20 cases (15 imported from the DRC) and two deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; two vaccines are in human trials. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア当局、コンゴ民主共和国に渡航した患者のエボラ感染を否定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで continuing する第17次エボラ流行（8,728症例・4,205死亡）がケニア・ウガンダ・フランス・オランダへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事自体はケニアでの疑い例が陰性と判明した続報だが、背景にあるDRCの第17次エボラ流行は継続中で複数国への越境例が発生しており、全体としてリスク評価の対象とすべき。ケニア・ウガンダ・フランス・オランダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Canada issues Ebola warning for travellers to Kenya
article.articleSummary: Canada reports confirmed Ebola case in Nairobi, Kenya linked to a traveller from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Travellers should monitor for Ebola symptoms for 21 days after leaving Kenya, follow local health instructions, and isolate and seek care if symptoms emerge. Kenya identifies 57 contacts, with 10 in quarantine; JKIA elevated screening for arrivals from 10 countries relevant to the Ebola response. The case is not described as a wider outbreak, and Kenya remains open to tourists while authorities intensify surveillance and contact tracing. The guidance aligns with international advisories while Kenya prioritizes containment. In addition to Ebola precautions, Canada warns travelers about terrorism risks and crime, noting restricted areas (Mandera, Wajir, Garissa, parts of Lamu, Turkana, Marsabit) and discouraging non-essential travel to Kibera.}

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、ケニア渡航者向けにエボラ警報を発出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例がケニア（ナイロビ）でDRC由来の渡航者に関連して報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 症例確認地はケニア（ナイロビ）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。DRCは感染者の出身国として言及されているが、DRC国内での発生事例ではないため除外。カナダは渡航警告の発出国であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: China grants Kenya $2 million for Ebola preparedness, drought response
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case in an imported patient who had traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo through Uganda, dying at Nairobi Hospital after testing positive for the Bundibugyo strain and triggering intensified surveillance and contact tracing. China granted Kenya $2 million to strengthen Ebola preparedness and drought response: $1 million to improve preparedness infrastructure in high-risk counties for prevention, detection, and rapid response; $1 million to drought relief in arid and semi-arid regions addressing water scarcity, livestock, and food insecurity. The handover in Nairobi was led by Chinese Ambassador Guo Haiyan and Kenya’s National Treasury Principal Secretary Chris Kiptoo. The funding underscores ongoing China–Kenya cooperation on health, agriculture, and humanitarian aid, amid Kenya’s cross-border disease vulnerability and continued drought pressures.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ケニアにエボラ対策・干ばつ対応のため200万ドルを供与
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）輸入症例が確認され死亡、越境感染拡大のリスクを示す重大事例であり、国際的な資金支援も動いているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラ輸入症例（DRCからウガンダ経由で渡航）だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは患者の出身地として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生拡大についての具体的記述はないため除外。中国は資金援助国であり発生国ではないため除外。続報でDRC・ウガンダでのアウトブレイク状況を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: China grants Kenya $2 million for Ebola preparedness, drought response
article.articleSummary: Kenya received a $2 million grant from China to bolster Ebola preparedness and drought response. Of the total, $1 million will boost Ebola preparedness infrastructure in high-risk counties, strengthening Kenya's ability to prevent, detect, and respond to outbreaks amid cross-border threats. The timing follows Kenya confirming its first Ebola case and death of a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda; he died at Nairobi Hospital on Monday after testing positive for the Bundibugyo strain, prompting intensified surveillance and contact tracing. The remaining $1 million will support drought response in arid and semi-arid regions, addressing water shortages, livestock, and agricultural impacts that raise food insecurity. The grant was signed in Nairobi by Chinese Ambassador Guo Haiyan and Kenya's National Treasury Principal Secretary Chris Kiptoo, with Public Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni witnessing. The aid underscores China-Kenya cooperation in health, agriculture, and humanitarian support.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ケニアにエボラ対策と干ばつ対応のため200万ドルを供与
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダ経由で入国した男性がエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）陽性となり死亡、ケニア初の症例として越境伝播と国際支援（中国からの資金援助）が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアで確認された初のエボラ症例（感染源はDRC、ウガンダ経由で渡航）だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。DRCは感染源として言及されているが、DRC国内での発生拡大を示す記述はないため、位置付けは参考情報として記載。続報でDRC国内のアウトブレイク状況や越境感染の広がりを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: गाय-भैंस में दिखें लंपी रोग के लक्षण, तुरंत करें ये काम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of Lumpy Skin Disease in cows and buffaloes, take these steps immediately.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) is spreading again among dairy cattle, especially cows and buffaloes, across several Indian states as of October 9, 2026. The infection causes fever, and round, painful nodules appearing on the neck, muzzle, back and legs; excessive watery or thick saliva from mouth and nose; marked lethargy; sudden drop in milk yield; and in some cases difficulty standing due to leg swelling. Immediate actions include isolating symptomatic animals from healthy herd, housing them in ventilated shelters, using separate drinking troughs, and sanitizing handlers and clothing. Transmission is mainly vector-borne via flies, mosquitoes, ticks and wasps, with water stagnation around sheds facilitating spread. Control measures include eliminating stagnant water, fumigating with camphor or dried neem leaves, and targeted disinfectant spraying. There is no cure; treatment is symptomatic. Do not use heavy antibiotics; consult government veterinary hospital. Vaccination with goatpox or LSD-ProVac vaccines is advised to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 牛・水牛にランピースキン病の症状、直ちに対処を
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛・水牛に発生する非人獣共通感染症であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはなく、インド国内で季節的に繰り返される既知の家畜疾患であるため。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病はヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、本件は家畜・農業分野の情報であって人の公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。畜産経済への影響はあるが、IHR(2005)の対象となる人の健康リスクとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Morador vê capivaras tomarem o gramado do condomínio à beira do lago, e o síndico recebe alerta sobre o carrapato-estrela e a febre maculosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A resident sees capybaras take over the condo's lakeside lawn, and the building manager receives an alert about the star tick and Brazilian spotted fever.
article.articleSummary: At a lakeside condominium, capybaras occupying the common lawn triggered concerns about the star tick, Amblyomma sculptum, a vector linked to Brazilian spotted fever (Rickettsia rickettsii). The animals’ presence does not confirm transmission; authorities must assess whether infected ticks are present and evaluate local epidemiology to determine risk. Until evaluated, residents should avoid contact with the capybaras, limit movement in tall vegetation near the lake and grassy areas, and keep children and pets away. Building management should inform residents and engage environmental and health agencies; removal of the capybaras is not advised without proper study. Prevention focuses on avoiding tick attachment and rapid removal if attached. Symptoms of Brazilian spotted fever typically begin 2 to 14 days after exposure and include fever, severe headache, muscle pains, malaise, nausea, vomiting, and sometimes red spots on hands and feet. Seek prompt medical care and report exposure to capybaras.

triage.headline_ja: 湖畔のコンドミニアムでカピバラが芝生を占拠、管理組合にスター・ダニとブラジル紅斑熱に関する注意喚起が届く
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染事例の報告ではなく、カピバラの出現を受けた予防的注意喚起の記事であり、公衆衛生上の実害や異常性は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症発生事例ではなく、カピバラの出現に伴うダニ媒介性疾患（ブラジル紅斑熱）への予防的注意喚起であり、実際の感染確認情報は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương khống chế dịch bệnh viêm da nổi cục trên trâu, bò
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently Contain the Lumpy Skin Disease Outbreak in Buffalo and Cattle.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease outbreak affecting buffalo and cattle in Tuyen Quang province, Vietnam, prompts intensified vaccination and control measures as of Oct 9, 2026. Nearly 55,000 vaccine doses have been administered in the province; about 17,000 in outbreak-affected communes and 38,000 in non-outbreak areas. Authorities also procure lime powder and chemicals for distribution, reinforce surveillance, rapid sampling, sanitation, and disinfection, and tighten controls on movement, sale, and slaughter of animals to prevent spread. The provincial government has issued directives to raise Autumn-Winter 2026 vaccination coverage to at least 80% of the herd and to conduct mass vaccination in September-October 2026, with commune leaders held accountable. The campaign follows low Spring-Summer vaccination rates and ongoing threats from African swine fever, avian influenza A/H5N1, and other diseases; gaps in immunization risk wider spread, especially under favorable conditions for vectors.

triage.headline_ja: 水牛・牛のランピースキン病の流行を緊急に抑制
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛・水牛のみに感染するウイルス性疾患でヒトへの感染性はなく、公衆衛生上の直接的脅威は低い。H5N1やASFへの言及はあるが本記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は人獣共通感染症ではなく家畜間でのみ伝播する疾患。地方政府によるワクチン接種率向上の取り組みが報告されているが、ヒト公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては優先度が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Rare Black Yeast Fungus Linked to Lung Inflammation in Landmark Case Report
article.articleSummary: China-based case from Hangzhou (Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine) reports a 45-year-old man with three weeks of chest tightness and exertional dyspnea. CT revealed diffuse bilateral pulmonary nodules. BAL with targeted next-generation sequencing initially detected Streptococcus pneumoniae, but antibiotics failed and disease progressed. Transbronchial lung cryobiopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with negative fungal/mycobacterial staining. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing on BAL identified Exophiala oligosperma, a melanized black yeast, with 88 reads and an RPTM of 34 per 10 million, confirming pulmonary phaeohyphomycosis. Exophiala oligosperma is rare in lungs but commonly originates from wet environments (shower drains, sink traps), making exposure plausible. Open-access report in BMC Infectious Diseases highlights the diagnostic value of mNGS in atypical granulomatous lung disease, underscoring the need to distinguish true pathogens from bystander colonization.

triage.headline_ja: まれな黒色酵母様真菌が肺炎症と関連、画期的な症例報告
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や感染拡大リスクは認められず、稀な日和見感染症例の学術報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 単一患者の症例報告であり、環境由来の非伝染性真菌感染症（Exophiala oligosperma）であるため、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kiedyś zabijała miliony, dziś można ją skutecznie leczyć. Tak można się zarazić dżumą
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague used to kill millions; today it can be treated effectively. This is how you can contract the plague.
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) is a zoonotic infection persisting in animals, especially small mammals, and fleas. Despite historical associations, plague remains present worldwide, with WHO data (2019–2025) reporting 3,847 suspected cases and 423 deaths across several countries. It occurs in three forms: bubonic (most common), with sudden, very painful enlarged lymph nodes called buboes; septicemic; and pneumonic, the form most capable of human-to-human transmission, though large outbreaks are unlikely with effective antibiotics. Transmission mainly occurs via flea bites from infected rodents, or direct contact with infected animals or their tissues; pneumonic plague can spread via respiratory droplets during close, prolonged contact. No confirmed current outbreak in Poland; Europe has no recent autochthonous cases. Endemic foci exist in Africa, Asia, and the Americas, notably the Democratic Republic of Congo, Madagascar, and Peru; the United States reports about five cases annually in rural western states.

triage.headline_ja: かつては何百万人もの命を奪ったが、今日では効果的に治療できる。ペストはこうして感染する
triage.triage_reason: 特定の現行アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ペストに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、ポーランド国内や欧州での新規症例確認もないため。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの歴史的背景・感染経路・流行地（DRC、マダガスカル、ペルーなど）に関する一般知識を解説するものであり、特定の新規発生事例の報告ではない。ポーランド・欧州での現行アウトブレイクは確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria que ameaça criação de tilápias avança para novas regiões do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacterium that threatens tilapia farming advances into new regions of Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus agalactiae serotype III is expanding from Brazil's Northeast tilapia farming to other production hubs. In April–June 2026, 154 analyses for serotype III yielded 17 positives (11%). Overall S. agalactiae was detected in 39 of 309 analyses (13%), while serotype Ib had 28 positives in 156 analyses (17.9%). Co-circulation of serotypes underscores sanitation strategies must consider farm history and regional epidemiology. Clinical signs include anorexia, lethargy, erratic swimming, exophthalmia, corneal opacity, neurological changes, systemic inflammation, and mortality. Vaccination is a principal preventive tool; commercial vaccines offer defined antigen content and dosing when properly used, but effectiveness depends on administration, water quality, animal condition, and timing relative to exposure. Vaccination should be integrated with biosafety: PCR diagnostics, serotyping, origin, stocking density, water quality, equipment hygiene, and stress reduction. In areas with serotype III presence or risk of introduction due to fish movement, preemptive vaccination is more robust than waiting for outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ティラピア養殖を脅かす細菌がブラジルの新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 魚類（ティラピア）における細菌性疾患であり、ヒトの公衆衛生に直接影響する感染症ではないため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは水産養殖業における動物疾患（魚病）であり、人獣共通感染症としての報告もないため、ヒト感染症のEBSトリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: 4名员工午休时被飞入办公室蝙蝠咬伤 秋季蝙蝠活跃需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four employees were bitten by bats that flew into the office during their lunch break; autumn bat activity warrants vigilance.
article.articleSummary: Four female employees at a company in Dongxihu District, Wuhan, Hubei Province, China, were bitten on the head and face by a bat that flew into the office during late September, highlighting autumn bat activity. At Wuhan Jinyintan Hospital, these patients received rabies exposure prophylaxis, including passive immunoglobulin and rabies vaccine. In the past two months, the hospital’s Animal Injury Treatment Center has treated 13 bat-bite cases, illustrating the high rabies risk from bats. Bites are often tiny, painless, and easy to miss, yet any direct bat contact qualifies as Category III rabies exposure, the highest risk, requiring full post-exposure management. WHO regards bats as high-risk natural hosts for rabies. Preventive guidance includes closing doors/windows during rest, washing exposed areas with soap for at least 15 minutes, thorough iodine disinfection, and prompt medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 昼休み中にオフィスに飛び込んだコウモリに社員4人が噛まれる 秋はコウモリの活動期で注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 個別の動物咬傷事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、既存の暴露後予防対応で管理されている。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染せず、個別の動物咬傷事例として医療機関が適切に暴露後予防を実施済み。公衆衛生上の注意喚起記事であり、アウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Outubro Verde' busca alertar sobre perigos da Sífilis, IST com mais de 16 mil casos em 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Green October' aims to raise awareness about the dangers of syphilis, STIs, with more than 16,000 cases in 2025.
article.articleSummary: Green October campaign in Bahia raises awareness about syphilis and congenital syphilis. In 2025, 16,207 cases of this sexually transmitted infection were recorded. The National Day to Combat Syphilis and Congenital Syphilis is observed on third Saturday of October, established by Law 13.430/2017; Outubro Verde began the year before. Objectives include warning the public, especially pregnant women, about infection risks, prenatal care, early diagnosis, and immediate treatment to curb spread. Syphilis is caused by Treponema pallidum and is transmitted through sexual contact with lesions. Primary stage features a painless chancre, rash, and fever; without treatment, progression to serious skin/bone lesions and cardiovascular or neurological involvement (neurosyphilis) may occur. Congenital syphilis results from maternal transmission during pregnancy or at birth, risking miscarriage, preterm birth, and infant problems; Bahia reported 115 infant deaths 2015–2024. Treatment uses benzathine penicillin, provided free by SUS; prevention remains key. Testing at 162 Salvador units, no appointment.

triage.headline_ja: 「グリーン・オクトーバー」、2025年に1万6千件超の症例を記録した梅毒・性感染症の危険性について啓発を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイーア州における梅毒啓発キャンペーンの定期報道であり、新規の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は啓発キャンペーン（国民啓発週間）に関する内容であり、突発的なアウトブレイクではない。エルサルバドルは記事本文に言及なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : plus de 800 cas suspects de choléra, dont 12 décès, enregistrés en une semaine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: more than 800 suspected cholera cases, including 12 deaths, recorded in one week.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in South Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. In week 40 (early October 2026), 811 suspected cholera cases were recorded with 12 deaths confirmed across the province, deaths reported in Fizi, Ruzizi, Nundu, Ibanda, Kitutu and Mulungu health zones. The Division provinciale de la santé notes a strong outbreak, following 972 cases in week 39. Some health zones—Kabare, Kitutu, Kamituga, Nyantende, Nyangezi—show a decline in notified cases, while shortages of medical inputs hinder patient care. Overall, 27 of 34 health zones in South Kivu have reported cholera cases. Since the start of 2026, more than 14,800 cholera cases and 258 deaths have been notified in the province, underscoring ongoing transmission and the need for continued response and resource support.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州:1週間で800人以上のコレラ疑い症例、12人死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC南キブ州で大規模なコレラ流行が継続しており、1週間で800人超の疑い症例・12人死亡、年初来14,800人超の症例・258人死亡と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、医療資材不足で対応が困難なため管理可能性にも懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC南キブ州のコレラ流行に特化。発生地域リストに含まれるRwanda, Burundi, Brazil, Fijiは記事サマリー上では言及されておらず、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。医療資材不足により患者対応に支障が出ている点が管理可能性の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: PH risk from suspected pneumonic plague in Russia 'almost zero' -- expert
article.articleSummary: Suspected pneumonic plague in Russia poses almost zero international risk to the Philippines as of Oct 9, 2026. A 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died after severe pneumonia; Russia has told WHO that no plague case has been reported in the Irkutsk region, though about 200 contacts are quarantined as a precaution. WHO, as of Oct 7, seeks additional laboratory results to clarify the incident and has not completed a risk assessment. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, a bacterium typically linked to infected rodents and fleas, affects the lungs and spreads via respiratory droplets; transmission generally requires close, prolonged contact with a symptomatic person, and there is no evidence of sustained transmission linked to this incident. DOH in the Philippines monitors WHO guidance; no confirmed pneumonic plague case or outbreak, and no Philippine cases. Surveillance on travelers and cargo continues.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの疑い肺ペストによるフィリピンへのリスクは『ほぼゼロ』 ― 専門家
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員が重症肺炎で死亡し肺ペストが疑われ、約200人が隔離されるなど異常性と重篤性が認められるため、IHR基準を2つ満たしフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断する。
triage.notes: 実際の発生（疑い）事例はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは自国へのリスク評価を報じているのみで、確定症例は報告されていないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア側はWHOに対し地域内でペスト症例の報告はないとしており、WHOも追加の検査結果を待っている段階で情報は流動的。

article.articleHeadline: Canada Issues Updated Travel Advisory for Kenya Over Ebola Risk
article.articleSummary: Ebola case confirmed in Nairobi linked to the Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts Canada to update its travel advisory for Kenya. Guidance urges travelers to avoid healthcare facilities in affected zones unless urgent, follow local health directives, and practice good hygiene. Visitors should monitor health while in Kenya and for 21 days after departure, seeking immediate medical attention and self-isolating if Ebola symptoms appear. Canadian officials say the overall risk to most travelers remains low with precautions, but avoid contact with suspected patients, contaminated items, and bodies of those who have died from Ebola or unexplained illnesses. Kenya reports 57 contacts traced and 10 individuals quarantined; authorities say the country remains open to visitors. Enhanced surveillance at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for arrivals from ten designated countries. A single imported case does not indicate a wider outbreak; response is guided by verified health information.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラリスクを理由にケニアへの渡航勧告を更新
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の流行に関連し、ケニアへの輸入症例が確認され、カナダが渡航勧告を更新するなど国際的な懸念が高まっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行に関連するケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、流行発生源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: Studi Ungkap 12 Persen Kasus Kanker Dipicu oleh Infeksi yang Bisa Dicegah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study reveals that 12 percent of cancer cases are triggered by preventable infections.
article.articleSummary: As of 2024, a global analysis published in The Lancet Oncology by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) finds that about 2.3 million new cancer cases—roughly 1 in 8 worldwide—are directly linked to infection. Of 37 infection–cancer pairs studied, two pathogens dominate: Helicobacter pylori, a stomach bacterium, associated with about 760,000 gastric cancer cases; and Human Papillomavirus (HPV), responsible for about 750,000 cancers, including nearly all cervical cancers (~600,000) and additional oropharyngeal, anal, and penile cancers. Other infectious drivers include hepatitis B and C (liver cancer), Epstein–Barr virus, and HIV. The heaviest burden appears in East Asia and in low- to middle-income countries. Prevention potential is substantial: HPV and hepatitis B vaccines; routine screening (Pap smear, HPV testing, hepatitis B/C testing); and early eradication of H. pylori with antibiotics. Healthcare interventions could substantially reduce future cancer incidence.

triage.headline_ja: 研究、がん症例の12%は予防可能な感染症が引き金と判明
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国での感染症アウトブレイクではなく、世界的ながんと感染症の関連性に関する研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はIARC/Lancet Oncologyによるグローバルながん疫学研究の紹介であり、特定国での感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。発生地域としてShanghai/Chinaが付与されているが、記事本文に中国特有の事象としての言及はなく誤付与と判断。

article.articleHeadline: DBD di Jogja Tercatat 83 Kasus, Warga Diminta Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever in Yogyakarta Recorded 83 Cases, Residents Urged to Be Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Yogyakarta City, Indonesia: As of early October 2026, 83 dengue cases have been recorded since January, staying below 100 as the rainy season approaches. Yogyakarta is described as an endemic area, necessitating year‑round prevention beyond outbreak spikes. Authorities emphasize persistent vector control and environmental cleaning, promoting the 3M Plus approach: drain water containers, seal storage sites, and recycle or repurpose items that can collect water. Environmental inspections should include overlooked sites such as roof gutters, pet water bowls, and water storage in dispensers and refrigerators. Fogging is kept minimal given the current low case count. Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes are monitored, with about 87% of sampled Aedes aegypti carrying Wolbachia as part of a broader transmission-reduction strategy. Puskesmas Mantrijeron reports 22 cases; residents are urged to seek medical care for sudden high fever, especially days 4–5, to enable early management before the rainy season intensifies.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタでデング熱83例を記録、住民に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ジョグジャカルタは既知のデング熱流行地域であり、症例数も100件未満と低く、通常の季節的な予防啓発活動の範疇で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱流行地における通常の年間を通じた予防活動・環境対策の報道であり、Wolbachia媒介蚊によるコントロール戦略も進行中。症例数は低く抑えられている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число заболевших лихорадкой Эбола превысило 8,7 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of people infected with Ebola virus disease has surpassed 8,700.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continue. As of 6 October 2026, the World Health Organization reports 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 confirmed deaths, CFR 48.2%. Since 25 September, 775 new confirmed cases have been recorded, including 379 deaths. The outbreak has spread to Alimbongo district in North Kivu Province, expanding geographic reach to 64 districts across seven eastern provinces, with Ituri Province heavily affected. Surveillance indicates ongoing laboratory-confirmed cases. The article does not provide infection sources or details on imported/exported cases. The data reflect an ongoing, high-mortality Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern DRC, underscoring continued public health response needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス病の感染者数が8,700人を突破

triage.notes: WHO報告に基づく継続的なアウトブレイク。地理的拡大（北キブ州アリンボンゴ地区へ）と高致死率が懸念材料。感染源や越境事例についての情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: JOSH teams launched in 7 Rajasthan districts to promote TB awareness
article.articleSummary: JOSH teams are launched on a pilot basis in seven Rajasthan districts—Alwar, Baran, Banswara, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur and Rajsamand—to raise TB awareness, promote timely testing, and encourage patients to complete treatment. The first phase of JOSH deployments covers 55 districts across 11 states. Each block-level team will comprise five MY Bharat volunteers and five National Cadet Corps cadets, led by a Class-I officer, and will conduct awareness activities aimed at expanding public participation in TB prevention, testing, and treatment. The national launch at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, was led by Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda, who emphasized youth involvement in a TB-free India and addressing stigma. In Rajasthan, the state program was aired virtually from Swasthya Bhawan, Jaipur, chaired by Gayatri Rathore. Certificates of appreciation were awarded to volunteers by Rathore and Ravi Prakash Sharma, with NHM officials in attendance.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州7地区でTB啓発促進のためJOSHチームが発足
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核啓発キャンペーン（JOSHチーム発足）に関する行政広報であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病であり本記事は啓発活動の発足報道。新規感染拡大や異常事態の兆候はないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Tanjungpinang intensifkan tracing TB melalui Cek Kesehatan Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tanjungpinang City Government intensifies TB tracing through free health checks.
article.articleSummary: TB tracing is intensified in Tanjungpinang, Indonesia, through the free health-check program (CKG). The City Health Office reports 3,600 residents screened, 1,601 sputum samples referred, and eight active TB cases identified. All diagnosed patients are on six months of standard anti-TB therapy; contacts receive preventive therapy weekly for three months. Integrated tracing aims to locate and treat TB, interrupt transmission, and push toward elimination by 2030. The effort spans 36 sites in 18 neighborhoods, launched by Mayor Lis Darmansyah on 9 September 2026 and running through 27 November 2026. A total of 87 locations will be used. Participation is high, with some sites exceeding 100 participants. Screenings include TB education, general health checks, anthropometry, blood pressure, and glucose; suspected TB cases get sputum testing, and some sites offer chest X-rays. Of X-ray results, 111 indicated TB and are under pulmonologist review.

triage.headline_ja: タンジュンピナン市、無料健康診断を通じて結核トレーシングを強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムの一環であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存の公衆衛生活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核対策プログラム（CKGプログラム）の実施報告であり、通常業務の一環。新規異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 食環署公布十月份首批白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FEHD releases October's first batch of Aedes albopictus mosquito trap indices.
article.articleSummary: On 9 October 2026, Hong Kong’s Food and Environmental Hygiene Department released the first batch of October 2026 Aedes albopictus ovitrap indices, warning of dengue fever risk and urging residents to intensify personal protection against mosquitoes. FEHD will continue cross-department collaboration, risk assessment, and public education to reduce transmission. In high-risk areas, intensified control includes inspections, elimination of breeding sites, larviciding, fogging, and installing traps. Public outreach exhibitions and distribution of leaflets accompany notices to housing estates via the rapid alert system to boost vigilance among property managers and residents. Since August 2025, district results are issued after each two-week monitoring cycle, with weekly trap collection across 62 monitoring districts. After week one, sticky boards are checked for adult Aedes to compute trap index (Phase 1) and density index (Phase 1); after week two, district index is calculated. Data available on FEHD website.

triage.headline_ja: 食環署が10月分初回の白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指数を公表

triage.notes: 本記事は蚊媒介指数の定例モニタリング結果の公表であり、実際のデング熱症例の報告ではない。対象国リストには含まれるが、デング熱発生そのものの情報ではないため見送り判定。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情依然严峻 跨境传播风险上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains severe; cross-border transmission risk is rising.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe with rising cross-border transmission risk. As of October 8, Africa CDC reported Ebola confirmed cases in Ituri and North Kivu provinces declined by 24% and 19% over the prior three weeks, yet 47 of 64 affected health zones still show active transmission. About 60–70% of reported Ebola deaths occurred outside medical facilities, indicating large numbers of undetected infections and limited contact tracing. Cross-border transmission risk is evident as Kenya reported its first Ebola death imported from the DRC via Uganda; Kenya, Uganda, and the DRC have launched joint contact-tracing efforts. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted slowed transmission in some areas but the situation remains dire, with cases near the South Sudan border. Authorities urge intensified screening, early detection, and contact tracing, and caution against blanket travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は依然として深刻、国境を越えた伝播リスクが上昇

article.articleHeadline: How did Ebola pass Kenya's screening systems despite months of preparedness?
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s first confirmed imported Ebola case concerns a Kenyan who fell ill in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo virus), traveled via Uganda to Nairobi (arriving Oct 3, 2026) and died Oct 5. The World Health Organization confirms the case as lab-positive. By Oct 6, Kenya had screened over 652,000 travellers, tested 267 suspected samples, and trained about 5,000 health workers on Ebola prevention and management. The infection source is the DRC; screening questions remain whether border screening would detect high-risk travelers, as medications the patient took may have masked symptoms during airport checks at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport. A separate suspected case in Wajir tested negative. WHO advises against travel restrictions, urging evidence-based screening, rapid diagnosis, cross-border cooperation, and transparent contact tracing while protecting privacy. The investigation must identify weaknesses and show preparedness beyond training lists.

triage.headline_ja: 入念な準備にもかかわらず、エボラ出血熱はどのようにケニアの検疫システムをすり抜けたのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)由来のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）感染者がウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後に死亡し、国境検疫をすり抜けた国際的な感染拡大事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 感染者はDRCでウイルスに感染し、ウガンダを経由してケニア(ナイロビ)に到着後に発症・死亡。ケニアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。WHOは渡航制限に反対し、証拠に基づく検疫強化と越境協力を推奨している。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Dugaan Wabah Pes di Rusia Berpotensi Jadi Pandemi Kecil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case of Suspected Bubonic Plague Outbreak in Russia Could Become a Minor Pandemic
article.articleSummary: Suspected bubonic plague case in Russia could become a minor pandemic, says Prof. Iwan Ariawan of the University of Indonesia’s Public Health Faculty. The expert notes the pathogen is not new, antibiotics are effective, incubation is 1–3 days, and the disease can be severe, aiding rapid detection; transmission requires close contact, and existing lab containment steps appear to limit spread to the laboratory setting. Indonesia’s Health Ministry has upped vigilance for potential spread of the pneumonia‑like illness of unknown origin linked to the event. Enhanced surveillance is being implemented at international entry points, including Bali, with measures such as the Digital Health Declaration (All Indonesia – SSHP) to monitor travel and health, Risk Based Assessment for inbound transport, direct symptom observation (fever, cough, shortness of breath), and vector surveillance for rats and fleas at entry points to curb zoonotic transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの疑いペスト症例、小規模なパンデミックになる可能性
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでのペスト疑い例について専門家が小規模流行の可能性を指摘し、インドネシア政府が国際空港での検疫・監視を強化するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はロシアとされ、対象国リストには含まれない。インドネシアは渡航者監視強化を行っているのみで国内発生ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。続報でロシア国内の詳細や拡大状況を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Maxaa ka jira in Wajeer laga helay Ebola? - BBC News Somali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What’s the deal with Ebola being found in Wajir?
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, preliminary laboratory results from a Wajir, Kenya sample were negative for Ebola, easing local fears. Kenya has confirmed its first Ebola-related case after a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo died in Nairobi following travel through Uganda. The 20-year-old patient had been ill for about a month and treated in Congo before flying to Nairobi, where he died on Monday night at 23:30 local time. Samples were sent to a Nairobi lab for confirmation. The Congo outbreak has recorded over 8,000 cases with more than 4,000 deaths this year; Uganda reported cases earlier, but WHO declared it Ebola-free in August. In Kenya, at least 28 close contacts have been identified, including 23 passengers and 4 flight crew, with authorities tightening border surveillance and urging health workers to remain vigilant and calm.

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Uganda'da Bundibugyo Ebola aşı denemelerinin başladığını açıkladı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC announced that Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine trials have begun in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC announced the Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine candidate developed by Oxford University has entered a new phase of clinical trials in Uganda, which began on October 6, 2026. To date, over 7,700 health workers and frontline personnel have been vaccinated. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), an Ebola outbreak persists, centered in Ituri province, with outbreak declared May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant currently has no approved treatment or vaccine. Initial trials of Oxford and Moderna candidates occurred in the United Kingdom and Canada, and Moderna’s vaccine candidate has received ethical approval to advance to a new Ugandan phase. Africa CDC characterized the Uganda trial as part of broader efforts to address Ebola in Africa.

article.articleHeadline: Τι είναι η πανώλη και ποιοι κινδυνεύουν
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the plague and who is at risk?
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) is an acute, potentially fatal bacterial zoonosis primarily maintained in wild small mammals and fleas. A Siberia lab‑worker death has heightened global vigilance. WHO’s September 2026 report (2019–2025) cites about 3,860 suspected cases worldwide, with six countries reporting confirmed infections; the Congo and Madagascar carry the highest annual burden. In the EU, no cases have been recorded for a decade (ECDC). In the US, CDC reports roughly five human cases per year, including a fatal case in 2025 linked to exposure to ill cats. Three clinical forms: bubonic (most common; painful lymphadenopathy, fever), septicemic, and pneumonic (rapid pneumonia, dyspnea, possible hemoptysis). Transmission from animals to humans occurs via infected fleas and contact with contaminated tissues; pneumonic plague enables human‑to‑human spread via respiratory droplets, necessitating isolation and contact tracing. At‑risk groups include hunters, veterinarians, laboratory workers, and healthcare workers; prompt treatment improves prognosis.

triage.headline_ja: ペストとは何か、誰が危険にさらされているのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストの一般的な解説記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。コンゴやマダガスカルへの言及はWHOの過去統計（2019-2025年）に基づく背景情報にすぎず、新たな異常事態は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの疫学・臨床像に関する解説記事で、具体的な新規症例やアウトブレイクの報告はない。コンゴは過去統計上の高負担地域として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の新規イベントではないため新たなシグナルとはみなさない。シベリアの検査技師の死亡例が記事の主な契機だが、対象国リストに該当せず評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Russia declares 'state of emergency' as disease spreads in two other nations
article.articleSummary: Russia declared a state of emergency in Siberia on 9 Oct 2026 due to fears of a foot-and-mouth outbreak linked to China and Mongolia, with border-area vaccination and strict grazing controls implemented by Trans-Baikal governor Alexander Osipov amid cross-border spread concerns. This follows a Black Death plague alert in the Irkutsk region, where two suspected cases prompted officials to say no infectious diseases were detected. Past actions include cows seized and burned in Irkutsk over nodular dermatitis symptoms matching foot-and-mouth disease, and roughly 4,500 cattle slaughtered across Siberia’s Novosibirsk region earlier this year for pasteurellosis and rabies, amid farmer suspicions of FMD and cover-ups. Concurrent controversy surrounds the death of Daria Shipilova, a 28-year-old Irkutsk scientist, with officials reporting unknown pneumonia and withholding details, fueling demands for plague-testing results (Yersinia pestis) and funerary information.

triage.triage_reason: ロシア・シベリアで口蹄疫・ペスト疑い・原因不明肺炎死亡などが重なり非常事態宣言が出され、中国・モンゴルとの越境拡大懸念や検疫措置があるためIHR基準を複数満たすが、対象国での実発生は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz reforça cuidados após aumento de vírus respiratórios; Roraima está em nível de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz reinforces precautions after an increase in respiratory viruses; Roraima is at an alert level.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe weekly bulletin documents a national uptick in severe acute respiratory illness (SARI) linked to rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, and SARS-CoV-2, while COVID-19–related SARI remains low. Vaccination guidance emphasizes keeping COVID-19 vaccines current; pregnant women should receive RSV vaccination. SARI due to RSV and influenza B is falling; influenza A hospitalizations stay low and stable. Roraima is among states at alert/high risk for SARI in the past two weeks, with a six-week upward trend among children and adolescents; Alagoas and Sergipe show growth tied to metapneumovirus. In Roraima, viral source is not yet identified. Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina also report alert/risk levels without clear long-term growth. Capitals Aracaju, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, São Luís, and Vitória report elevated SARI activity. Most affected are children under 2; preventive measures include vaccination, avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, and timely medical care.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、呼吸器系ウイルス増加を受けて対策を強化；ロライマ州は警戒レベルに
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器ウイルス（RSV、メタニューモウイルス、ライノウイルス等）による重症急性呼吸器疾患（SARI）の増加がブラジル複数州で報告されているが、これは季節性の国内サーベイランス情報であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、新興・異常な病原体の出現も確認されていない。
triage.notes: 複数の季節性呼吸器病原体（RSV、ヒトメタニューモウイルス、ライノウイルス、COVID-19、インフルエンザA/B）による国内サーベイランスの通常の季節変動報告であり、新興感染症としての緊急性は低い。2歳未満の乳幼児に影響が集中している点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: What is Bundibugyo virus disease and why is it lethal?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BEVD) outbreak, first reported May 2026 in Ituri, DR Congo, is the largest Bundibugyo outbreak, with 8,700 confirmed cases and 4,200 deaths. Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Oct 5: a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the DRC for seven years, traveled via Uganda, and flew to Nairobi on Oct 3; infected about a month earlier and died at Nairobi Hospital. WHO describes Bundibugyo as a severe, often fatal Ebola strain; fruit bats are suspected natural reservoirs. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of symptomatic persons; it is not airborne. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms resemble flu, progressing to organ failure and bleeding. Lab confirmation requires PCR or antibody tests. Control relies on isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials; no licensed vaccine or virus-specific treatment exists. As of Oct 9, 57 contacts linked to the deceased have been identified and managed.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルス病とは何か、なぜ致死性が高いのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョウ株)流行（8,700症例・4,200死亡）に加え、ケニアへの国際的な感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアはBluedot対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC（イツリ州）が流行の主体地域。ケニアでの輸入症例・接触者57名の管理状況は続報要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 本港錄得新增外地傳入登革熱及基孔肯雅熱個案｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records new imported dengue fever and chikungunya fever cases.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports two imported mosquito-borne cases for Oct 2–8, 2026: dengue fever in a traveler who had been to Vietnam, and chikungunya fever in a 73-year-old man who had travelled to Mainland China. The dengue total in Hong Kong this year is 33 (31 imported, 2 local); last year 2025 had 59 (all imported); 2024 had 161 (156 imported, 5 local). The chikungunya total this year is 5 (4 imported, 1 local); last year 2025 had 82 (11 local). Globally, dengue incidence remains high: last year >90 countries reported >5 million cases and >4,000 deaths; Jan–Aug 2026 ~2.2 million cases and >1,000 deaths. Nearby, Sri Lanka and Vietnam exceed 100,000 cases this year; Bangladesh and Cambodia >80,000; Indonesia and Malaysia >70,000; Singapore >2,600; Guangdong Province, China, by Aug 31 reported 431 dengue cases (August 496). For chikungunya, globally last year 502,264 cases and 186 deaths; Guangdong by Aug 31 reported 739 chikungunya infections (August 496). Public health advice: use mosquito repellents (DEET or equivalent), eliminate standing water, change vase water weekly, keep drains clear, report mosquito problems at 1823.

triage.headline_ja: 本港、新たに外地からの輸入デング熱および基孔肯雅熱（チクングニア熱）症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入デング熱・チクングニア熱症例の定期報告であり、アジア地域での既知の季節性流行の文脈内。WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に一部該当するが、社会的関心の高まりなど情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は香港政府衛生当局による輸入症例の定期的なサーベイランス報告。デング熱患者はベトナム渡航歴、チクングニア熱患者は中国本土渡航歴あり。広東省・ベトナム・インドネシア等アジア各国の流行状況が引用されているが、いずれも既知の季節性エンデミック疾患の年次推移report。スリランカ、バングラデシュ、カンボジア、マレーシア、シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: उज्जैन में डेंगू से राहत...पिछले साल आए थे 22 मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue relief in Ujjain... 22 patients were reported last year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue relief in Ujjain district, Madhya Pradesh, India for 2026: dengue incurs 4 laboratory-confirmed cases and malaria 5, with chikungunya remaining zero through September 30, 2026. Compared with the same period last year, when dengue totaled 22, this year shows a substantial drop. From January to September 2026, over 100,000 samples were tested with all results negative (likely general screening). Public health efforts include intensified vector surveillance, focusing on the Anopheles mosquito (female Anopheles lays eggs in clean, stagnant water even below 20 ml), village-level screening camps, street plays, pamphlets, and ongoing fogging and anti-larva spraying. The combined awareness campaigns and surveillance appear to have curbed dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases, contrasting with earlier years where malaria and dengue had varied incidence (notably 2020–2021 higher, 2022–2023 near-zero, 2024 dengue 22).

triage.headline_ja: ウッジャインでデング熱が減少…昨年は22人の患者が報告されていた
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインド・マディヤプラデーシュ州ウッジャイン県でデング熱症例が前年より大幅に減少したことを報じており、むしろ公衆衛生対策の成功例であり、シグナルとしての懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向であり、ベクター監視や啓発活動が奏功している旨の肯定的な報告。緊急性なし。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯现"不明原因肺炎"死亡病例，囤多西环素可"防鼠疫"？医生紧急提醒：普通人若无高危暴露，感染风险极低，健康人乱吃是严重错误
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Reports Deaths from Pneumonia of Unknown Etiology; Hoarding Doxycycline Could 'Prevent Plague'? Doctors Urgently Warn: For ordinary people without high-risk exposure, infection risk is extremely low; healthy people taking it indiscriminately is a serious mistake.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-09, in Irkutsk Oblast, Russia, a staff member at a plague-prevention institute died of pneumonia of unknown etiology; authorities and the WHO report no Yersinia pestis detected. Social media urged stockpiling doxycycline for plague prevention. An infectious diseases expert from Ba Zhong Hospital explains plague is caused by Yersinia pestis; transmission is mainly via fleas from rodents or contact with infected wildlife, and human-to-human spread is limited to pneumonic plague. For ordinary people without high-risk exposure, infection risk is extremely low. Post-exposure prophylaxis with doxycycline or ciprofloxacin is reserved for specific exposures and must be supervised by a clinician for seven days; they are not routine preventive drugs. Doxycycline can cause esophageal irritation; take with water and remain upright after dosing. Do not hoard antibiotics; seek medical care if high fever with swollen nodes and exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで原因不明肺炎による死亡例、ドキシサイクリン買いだめで『ペスト予防』？医師が緊急注意喚起：高リスク曝露がない一般人の感染リスクは極めて低く、健康な人が乱用するのは重大な誤り
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツク州のペスト予防研究所職員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡したが、当局とWHOはペスト菌（Yersinia pestis）は検出されていないとしており、単発症例かつ人為的拡散の証拠はない。SNSでの抗生剤買いだめ等社会的関心はあるが、医学的実態としては専門家が過度な心配を否定する内容であり、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: イベント発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国(四川省巴中)は医師のコメント発信地であり、イベント発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ペスト菌は未検出で、原因不明肺炎の単独死亡例として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Gejala Penyakit Pes, Penyebab, dan Cara Penanganannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding the Symptoms of the Plague, Its Causes, and How It Is Treated.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, plague (Yersinia pestis) remains present beyond history, including Indonesia, where rodent and flea populations are high. Transmission occurs mainly via infected flea bites to humans, through contact with infected animal tissue, or via droplets from a pneumonic case. Three forms are described: Bubonic plague, characterized by painful lymph node swelling (bubo) and sudden fever; Septicemic plague, with fever, marked weakness, abdominal symptoms, bleeding under the skin, and possible tissue necrosis; and Pneumonic plague, the most dangerous and the only form transmissible person-to-person through air, causing rapid onset of severe cough with possible hemoptysis, chest pain, high fever, and respiratory failure if untreated within 24 hours. Diagnosis relies on blood, sputum, or lymph node fluid testing. Treatment requires strong antibiotics (streptomycin, gentamicin, or doxycycline) under medical supervision. Prevention emphasizes rodent control and environmental hygiene; seek medical care for high fever and lymph node pain.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト(疫病)の症状、原因、および治療法について理解する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、インドネシアでの具体的な症例発生や流行を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発目的の一般解説であり、具体的な発生事例・患者数・地域名の言及がないため、インドネシアでの実際の発生事例としては確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta de la elevada mortalidad del brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the high mortality of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths as of 6 October 2026 (case fatality 48.2%). Since 25 September, 775 new cases and 379 more deaths were reported; Alimbongo in North Kivu has four cases and two deaths. Transmission spans 64 health zones in Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud-Ubangi and Tshopo; Ituri is the epicenter (6,480/2,989) and North Kivu (1,755/1,013; CFR 57.7%). In the last 24 hours, 62 new cases (33 Ituri, 30 North Kivu). Weekly cases rose 2.5% (475→487); weekly deaths were stable (224→222). Notably, 264 community deaths and 108 in facilities. Contact tracing covered 80.4% (23,741/29,535). An imported case in Kenya died in Nairobi; a Dutch health worker was evacuated and not counted as local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの高い致死率を警告
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例8,728例・死亡4,205例（致死率48.2%）、国際的な波及（ケニアでの輸入症例死亡、オランダ人医療従事者の退避）があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ケニア（輸入症例による死亡）およびオランダ（医療従事者の退避）での関連事案が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率が非常に高く（全体48.2%、北キブ州57.7%）、地域拡大・コミュニティでの死亡率の高さ（264例）が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Brotes de sarampión en América: más de 55.000 casos, 77 muertes y riesgo de que vuelva a ser endémico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreaks in the Americas: more than 55,000 cases, 77 deaths, and the risk of it becoming endemic again.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in the Americas total 55,792 confirmed cases and 77 deaths across 17 countries/territories in 2026, per OPS data up to Oct 3. Guatemala, Mexico, the United States, Peru, and Canada account for 99.5% of infections. In weeks 37–38, 687 new cases and 9 deaths were reported; US 293, Guatemala 200, Peru 155; Mexico 34; Canada and Brazil 1 each. New York declared a disaster emergency to contain the outbreak. US transmission appears rising, with an estimated 1.4 secondary cases per case; models project about 2,480 new cases in the next four weeks (range 2,172–2,812). Guatemala has 34,355 cases and 50 deaths; Mexico 13,595/23; US 3,887/2; Peru 2,553/1; Canada 1,121/0; Bolivia 120/1. Guatemala reports transmission in 22 departments; higher incidence in Izabal, Guatemala Central, Sololá; 63% of cases are 15–39 years, and 67.6% are unvaccinated, with under-1s at highest risk. Emphasizes vaccination, case investigation, surveillance, lab confirmation, and genomic sequencing to prevent endemic transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ大陸における麻疹の流行：5万5千例以上、77人死亡、再び風土病化するリスク
triage.triage_reason: アメリカ大陸17か国・地域で55,792例・77人死亡という大規模な麻疹流行が継続しており、国際的拡大と風土病化のリスクが指摘されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主流行地はグアテマラ・メキシコ・米国・ペルー・カナダで、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ（週37-38で1例確認）。ブラジルは流行の主要発生国ではないが実際に症例が報告されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Phuket prepares for suspected plague threat
article.articleSummary: Phuket, Thailand, is preparing for potential pneumonic plague after a suspected Siberian case. A Phuket Public Health Office notice (Oct 7; published Oct 9) calls for enhanced surveillance, isolation readiness, PPE, and rapid laboratory testing (BSL-3) with results in one day. Hospitals will screen fever and severe pneumonia, prioritizing patients with international travel or high-risk exposure; suspected cases may be isolated and treated with antibiotics while epidemiological investigations proceed. Public risk communications are intensified, and travel medicine clinics will monitor travellers and advise accordingly. The Siberian case concerns a 28-year-old woman at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute who died on Sept 29 from pneumonia of unknown origin; 197 contacts are under monitoring, with no illnesses reported. No laboratory evidence confirms plague, no transmission seen, and the likelihood of introduction to Thailand remains very low. WHO and Russia have not confirmed an outbreak; Thai authorities are monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: プーケット、ペスト疑いの脅威に備える
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストは稀で異常性が高く、タイ公衆衛生当局が監視体制強化を発表するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。ただし確定診断はなくロシアの疑い例に基づく予防的対応段階。
triage.notes: 実際の疑いペスト症例はロシア・イルクーツク州の研究所関係者（死亡1例、接触者197人監視中、発症なし、検査未確定）で発生。タイ・プーケットでは症例なく、予防的な監視体制強化のみ実施。対象国リストにロシアが含まれないため、発生国としてのverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat: Minister visits personnel with dengue, 50 of 87 recovered
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Gujarat involved 87 security personnel (BSF, CRPF, ITBP) who arrived from Odisha, Jharkhand, Delhi, West Bengal and Chhattisgarh for a parade and were shifted to Gandhinagar Civil Hospital after reporting fever. Over the past 10 days, 50 have recovered and been discharged, while 37 remain under treatment; all are stable and improving, with none in critical condition. One personnel died, after sudden severe chest pain; ECG and ICU care were provided; despite intensive treatment, the death occurred; final post-mortem results are awaited; doctors preliminarily noted strenuous exercise during fever as a possible contributor. Health Minister Praful Pansheriya visited the hospital, directing doctors to ensure adequate water, nutritious meals (breakfast, fresh fruits, fruit juice, salads) and to maintain sufficient blood and platelet stocks. The incident underscores dengue management among imported security personnel in Gujarat.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州:保安要員のデング熱入院者を大臣が訪問、87人中50人が回復
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州で保安要員87人のデング熱クラスターが発生し1名死亡したが、デング熱はインドで流行病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの流行病であり、本件は他州から集結した保安要員87人の局所的クラスター。死亡例（1名）はパレード参加中の発熱時の激しい運動が一因と疑われており、既に州保健当局が病院で対応中。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言い難いが、死亡例の詳細（剖検結果）や感染拡大の有無について続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Niño venezolano 'predijo' peste; qué se sabe de la muerte en Irkutsk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuelan boy 'predicted' the plague; what is known about the death in Irkutsk.
article.articleSummary: A 28-year-old laboratory technician, Daria Shipilova, died on October 2 in Irkutsk, Siberia, after exposure linked to Yersinia pestis—the bacterium that causes pneumonic plague, though Russian authorities deny a plague outbreak, citing pneumonia of undetermined etiology and no high-risk pathogens in contacts. The World Health Organization has requested complete risk information, and the U.S. embassy has warned citizens to leave Russia, elevating travel advisory to level 4. Independent Russian media speculate infection from a broken test tube in a laboratory at the Irkutsk Pest Research Institute or during a trip to Thailand. The case has amplified social-media interest in a Venezuelan boy, Jesús López, aka “El Servidor,” whose September 29 prophecy about pestilence and death sparked comparisons to Shipilova’s death. Experts emphasize no scientific basis for these predictions, attributing viral spread to algorithmic amplification rather than facts.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラの少年が『予言』したペスト；イルクーツクでの死亡について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの検査技師の原因不明肺炎死亡がYersinia pestis曝露と関連し、WHOがリスク情報を要求、米国が渡航警告をレベル4に引き上げるなど国際的懸念が急速に高まっているため。
triage.notes: 事件の実際の発生地はロシア・イルクーツクであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。タイへの渡航歴は感染源として臆測されているに過ぎず、確定情報ではないため含めていない。ロシア当局はペスト流行を否定しているが、WHOの情報要請や米国の渡航警告レベル引き上げなど国際的な緊張が生じており、続報の精査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sanitarios del Área Norte de Málaga participan en el Congo en una actuación frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers from Málaga's Northern Area participate in the Congo in an operation against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Healthcare workers from Málaga's Norte Area of the Andalusian Health Service, in collaboration with Médicos del Mundo, operate in Miti-Muherca and Katana health zones in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, to bolster Ebola response and other outbreaks. The mission strengthens infection prevention/control and triage in 14 health centers to detect and isolate suspected Ebola cases, amid shortages of PPE and staff. It includes training for triage personnel and a ten-point infection-control Decalogue, plus an Ebola fever-detection algorithm that also accounts for malaria as a major fever cause. The operation also addresses Katana cholera, supporting treatment centers and improving access to drinking water through 20 chlorination points; Lugendo center water shortages prompted emergency delivery and plans to expand storage and harvest rainwater. A measles vaccination campaign has reduced weekly incidence. Coordinated with local health authorities, NGOs, and reference hospital, the mission signals Málaga Norte's commitment and knowledge sharing.

triage.headline_ja: マラガ北部地域の医療従事者がコンゴでエボラ対策活動に参加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国南キブ州でエボラ・コレラ・麻疹・マラリアが同時に発生しており、国際的な医療支援チームが派遣されている状況であり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・マラガの医療従事者によるコンゴでの支援活動を伝えるものだが、背景としてエボラ・コレラ・麻疹・マラリアが同時流行している南キブ州の状況が示されている。新規症例数や発生規模などの詳細情報は記事中に記載がなく、不明な点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: quase metade dos municípios brasileiros está em alerta - Diário News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: Nearly half of Brazilian municipalities are on alert - Daily News
article.articleSummary: Nearly half of Brazilian municipalities assessed are in alert or risk for Aedes aegypti, the dengue, chikungunya and Zika vector, per the second cycle of the Rapid Index Survey for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) released October 7, 2026. Of 3,732 reporting municipalities, 49.2% require attention and intensified prevention. May–Aug 2026 breeding sites: 42.3% in plant pots and dishes, 26.1% in water reservoirs, 23% in tires and solid waste. Regional patterns: North—tires/solid waste; Northeast—water storage; Southeast/South/Central-West—domestic containers. Dengue remains the most monitored with about 470,500 probable cases by 26 September 2026, down from 1.5 million in the same period 2025 (~70%). Chikungunya: 67,902 in 2026 vs 118,885 in 2025 (~43%); Zika: 2,141 in 2026 vs 3,724 in 2025 (~35%). Public actions include ovitraps, residual spraying, larviciding, Wolbachia, and expanding over 300,000 community health agents by end-2026; households are urged to cover water tanks, clean gutters, store bottles inverted, and eliminate standing water and debris year-round.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ：ブラジル市町村のほぼ半数が警戒レベルに
triage.triage_reason: デング熱等の媒介蚊リスクは高いが、症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低い。定期的なサーベイランス情報として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 症例数は2025年比で大幅減少傾向にあり、政府による予防対策（オビトラップ、ワクバキア、残留噴霧等）が既に実施されている。深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、季節的な蚊媒介感染症サーベイランスとして継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 海鱼携带"食肉菌"，深圳男子被刺后手掌溃烂高烧不退险丧命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sea fish carry "flesh-eating bacteria"; Shenzhen man nearly died after being stabbed as his palm rotted and fever persisted.
article.articleSummary: On 9 October 2026, a Shenzhen seafood seller sustained a right-palmar puncture from a fish spine, then developed sepsis from Vibrio vulnificus (ocean wound pathogen) after neglecting wound care. Within hours he had fever (39°C), swelling, chills, and body aches. Laboratory tests showed leukocytosis, neutrophilia, and elevated procalcitonin; blood cultures confirmed Vibrio vulnificus infection. He underwent antimicrobial therapy and local wound care during a 7-day hospital stay, then transferred to Shenzhen Third People's Hospital due to persistent infection. MRI found a 2 cm forearm abscess; with precise antimicrobial therapy and wound management, swelling and pain subsided and infection markers normalized. He was discharged with outpatient follow-up. Vibrio vulnificus is a high-mortality flesh-eating bacterium in warm coastal waters and seafood; untreated mortality 50-70%, approaching 100% within 72 hours. Prevention: wear gloves when handling seafood; wash and disinfect wounds; ensure seafood is cooked; avoid seawater contact with wounds.

triage.headline_ja: 海魚が「人食いバクテリア」を保有、深圳の男性が刺された後に手のひらが化膿し高熱が続き一時危篤に
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別感染事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: Vibrio vulnificusは創傷感染による散発例で、海産物取扱者の個人衛生・安全教育に関する注意喚起記事。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada DBD di Musim Pancaroba Dinkes Kota Yogyakarta Tekan Kasus di Bawah 100
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be Alert for Dengue Fever During the Transitional Season as Yogyakarta City Health Office Reduces Cases to Under 100.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever alert as Yogyakarta city enters the rainy-season transition. As of Oct 9, 83 dengue cases have been recorded in Yogyakarta since January, with total cases staying below 100. Fogging continues to be used, and progress is noted in a Wolbachia-based vector-control program, with about 87% of monitored Aedes aegypti mosquitoes carrying Wolbachia to reduce transmission. Public health emphasis remains on PHBS (Clean and Healthy Living) and intensified PSN (mosquito nest eradication). Residents should eliminate standing water at home, including in water dispensers, refrigerators, and pet-water bowls. The 3M Plus campaign—drain, cover, and reuse or dispose of waste—plus careful maintenance of gutters and leaf debris is advised ahead of heavier rains. In Mantrijeron district, 22 dengue cases have been reported. Early symptoms include sudden high fever; monitor days 4–5 of fever. Officials aim to keep total cases below 100 by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目のデング熱に警戒を、ジョグジャカルタ市保健局は症例数100未満を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 年間83例と例年通りの季節性デング熱で、当局は既存の媒介制御プログラム（ウォルバキア活用）で対応しており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクともに認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による季節性の注意喚起記事であり、症例数も低く抑制されている。ウォルバキア媒介制御プログラムは順調に進展中。

article.articleHeadline: ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ ಭೀತಿ: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದ ಮುನ್ನ ಸೊಳ್ಳೆಗಳ ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ತಡೆಯಲು 20 ನಿಮಿಷದ ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue scare: Do this 20-minute task to prevent mosquitoes from breeding before the monsoon season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Tamil Nadu remains severe, with 21,655 cases on October 7; Chennai hotspots fell from 500 to 300 due to preventive measures. Karnataka also faces rising dengue threat this week. With the Northeast Monsoon expected to bring rain between October 15 and 21, households should remove breeding sites now. Aedes mosquitoes breed in tiny standing water around homes; eggs hatch in 7–10 days, and adults bite. Breeding hotspots include balconies, plant pots, flower trays, gutters, and water tanks. A 20-minute weekly cleaning routine is advised: empty and scrub water containers, fill plant-pot plates with sand, clear colanders/AC trays, close drains, install window screens, and seal sumps. If fever with abdominal pain, vomiting, or bleeding occurs, seek urgent medical care; call 104 helplines (Tamil Nadu/Karnataka) or Bengaluru BBMP 1533. IMD forecasts a narrow window before rain; proactive cleaning can reduce weekend mosquito nuisance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の恐怖:モンスーン前に蚊の繁殖を防ぐための20分の作業を行いましょう
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱症例が多数報告され流行が継続しているが、本記事は主に予防啓発（家庭内対策）を目的とした一般向け情報であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: タミル・ナードゥ州で21,655例の報告があり流行が継続中、カルナータカ州でも増加傾向。記事は予防啓発が主目的であり、死亡者数や入院率など重症度に関する具体的データは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in DRC exceed 8,700 -- WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 confirmed deaths as of October 6, 2026, a case fatality rate of about 48.2%. Since September 25, the outbreak added 775 confirmed cases and 379 deaths. Transmission remains intense at the national level with an uneven burden: some areas show slowing transmission, others continue to intensify; the high death toll outside health facilities signals delays in detection and care. The outbreak began May 15 in the DRC and Uganda and has expanded to 64 health zones across seven eastern provinces, with Ituri province particularly hard hit and the Alimbongo health zone in North Kivu now affected. Uganda’s outbreak is noted as ended (July 28; WHO confirmation August 25). On October 6, Kenya reported its first Ebola case—an individual who had visited the DRC and died in hospital—indicating cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ確定症例が8,700人を超える -- WHO
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ケニアへの越境感染も確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息宣言済み。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、ケニアでの初症例は本文に記載したがverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Indore Central Jail Dengue, Dengue Cases in Jail, Dengue Mosquito Larvae, Typhoid Cases in Indore | जेल में कैसे फैला डेंगू? 3 कैदी पॉजिटिव, 1 की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indore Central Jail Dengue Fever, Dengue Fever Cases in Jail, Dengue Mosquito Larvae, Typhoid Fever Cases in Indore | How Did Dengue Fever Spread in Jail? 3 Inmates Tested Positive, 1 Dead
article.articleSummary: Three inmates at Indore Central Jail in Madhya Pradesh have dengue fever confirmed, among over 50 inmates who have developed fever; the majority have typhoid. Three dengue cases were lab-confirmed; patients were shifted to MY Hospital. In the past 15 days, 32 inmates were hospitalized, with 18 still under treatment. One inmate died on October 2; death attributed to Sickle Cell Anemia, not dengue. Health teams found dengue mosquito larvae in about 3,000–4,000 containers across the jail, mainly water-storage vessels used for bathing and toilets. A vector-control campaign ran October 4–8 to destroy larvae and spray pesticides. Dengue spreads via Aedes mosquitoes, not direct person-to-person contact, raising risk in large closed facilities with standing water. Authorities urge regular cleaning/monitoring of water containers and protective measures (long-sleeve clothing, repellents, nets).

triage.headline_ja: インドール中央刑務所でデング熱発生、デング熱ケース発生 ジェル内でどのようにデング熱が広がったのか？3人の受刑者が陽性、1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所という閉鎖施設内でのデング熱・腸チフスの集団発生だが、死亡は鎌状赤血球貧血によるものでデング熱との直接関連はなく、国際的拡大の可能性も低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 閉鎖施設（刑務所）内でのデング熱・腸チフスの集団発生事例。既にベクターコントロール対策（10月4-8日）が実施済みで、現地当局により管理されている。ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく蚊媒介性のため、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。続報があれば規模拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sanitarios malagueños del Área Norte luchan contra el ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Málaga healthcare workers from the Northern Area fight Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Published 9 October 2026: Málaga’s Área Sanitaria Norte sent professionals to the Congo’s South Kivu to strengthen capacity amid an Ebola outbreak and other epidemics. In Miti-Muherca and Katana health zones, the mission focused on infection prevention and control and upgrading triage protocols across 14 centers to detect and isolate suspected Ebola cases, hampered by PPE shortages and staff gaps. Trainers delivered a fever-detection triage algorithm that accounts for malaria, a major fever cause in the region, and produced a ten-action triage decalog emphasizing PPE use and professional conduct. In Katana, cholera response was supported with 20 chlorination points to improve potable water; Lugendo center faced water shortages for rehydration salts, triggering emergency water transfers and plans for expanded storage and rainwater harvesting. Measles vaccination campaigns reduced weekly incidence. The mission coordinates with local authorities, other NGOs, and the hospital network to strengthen emergency readiness in South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: マラガ県北部地域の医療従事者、コンゴでエボラ対策に従事
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国南キブ州で継続中のエボラ・コレラ・麻疹・マラリアの複合流行に対し国際支援が行われており、重症度・流行継続・管理可能性の観点から懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・マラガの医療支援チームによるコンゴ南キブ州での活動報告であり、新規の疫学的データは乏しいが、エボラ・コレラ・麻疹・マラリアが同時に発生している複合的な公衆衛生危機を示している。既知の継続中アウトブレイクである可能性が高く、新規性については不明。

article.articleHeadline: What Is Bundibugyo? The Ebola Strain Behind Kenya's First Confirmed Case
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo EVD) has been confirmed in Kenya as an imported case from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where by Oct 6, 2026 the outbreak had 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths—the largest Bundibugyo outbreak to date, beginning in Ituri Province in May 2026. A Kenyan citizen who lived in the DRC for seven years tested positive and died in Nairobi. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccine or specific antiviral; care is supportive. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; the virus is not airborne, and animal reservoirs (fruit bats) are suspected. Symptoms typically appear 2–21 days after exposure, including fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, hemorrhage and organ failure; laboratory confirmation is required. Kenya traced 57 contacts by Oct 7, with monitoring and regional coordination to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョとは何か？ケニア初の確認症例の背後にあるエボラ株
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,728例・4,205死亡という過去最大規模のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が発生し、隣国ケニアへの越境輸入症例（死亡例）も確認されており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ただし越境輸入症例の発生は国際拡大リスクの根拠として評価に反映した。致死率約48%と非常に高く、ワクチン・特異的抗ウイルス薬が存在しない稀な株である点も重大性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Nach Pest-Verdacht in Russland: Wie verbreitet ist die Krankheit und wo kommt sie vor?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Plague in Russia: How Widespread Is the Disease and Where Is It Found?
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Russia reports a suspected pneumonic plague death in a 28-year-old laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Siberia. Authorities say the death is due to pneumonia of unknown origin, while the WHO seeks more information on the infection source. Unconfirmed reports mention a second lab employee with pneumonia and possible additional deaths. The case involves a plague research center in Irkutsk; Russia denies a lab accident, though bioweapons speculation persists. About 200 potential contacts in Irkutsk and Schelechow are in quarantine. Globally, plague persists in Africa, Asia, and the Americas, with Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of Congo, China, Mongolia, and parts of the USA reporting recurring cases; Europe and Australia have no endemic foci per the RKI. The disease presents in three forms—bubonic, pneumonic, septicemic—with incubation 1–7 days; pneumonic can spread between people in close contact, bubonic via flea bites; initial symptoms are flu-like. Yersinia pestis is the causative bacterium.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペスト感染疑い：病気はどの程度広がっており、どこで発生しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究施設関連で肺ペストによる死亡例が発生し、約200人が隔離対象となっている。WHOが感染源の情報を求めており、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある肺ペストという重篤かつ異常な事案であるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 事案の主たる発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。記事中のアフリカ・中国・モンゴル等の記述は世界的なペスト流行地域に関する一般的背景情報であり、本事案の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Plaušu mēris Krievijā: ekstrasensa pareģojums par pandēmiju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonic Plague in Russia: A Psychic Prophecy About the Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: On 9 October 2026, media report a British clairvoyant’s warning of a possible new bacterial pandemic tied to pneumonic plague in Russia. Briton Kreigs Hamiltons-Pārkers claimed that on 24 September two Tibetan monks visited his home and spoke of a forthcoming outbreak distinct from prior ones. A 28-year-old Darja Shipilova, who worked at Irkutsk’s institute, died in Siberia; provisional data suggest she may have contracted pneumonic plague, a severe lung infection capable of rapid progression. There is no proven link between the clairvoyant’s statements and Shipilova’s death. Hamiltons-Pārkers has previously attracted attention for predicting COVID-19, and now asserts monks knew medicines for the upcoming disease, with AI potentially aiding treatment development. The article notes no scientific validation for his forecasts and remains cautious about implied causes or outbreak scope.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの肺ペスト:超能力者によるパンデミックの予言
triage.triage_reason: 内容は超能力者の予言に関するもので、科学的根拠のない憶測記事であり、実際の感染症発生を裏付ける情報が乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（イルクーツク、シベリア）における単一の死亡例を扱っており、対象国リストに含まれない。中国（チベット）は僧侶の逸話的言及のみで実際の発生地ではないため除外。内容の大半は超能力者の予言という非科学的な話題であり、信頼性の低い情報源。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola bir ülkeye daha sıçradı! İlk ölüm yaşandı, temaslılar tek tek aranıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has spread to another country! The first death has occurred, and the contacts are being traced one by one.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola death reported in Kenya; no outbreak, only confirmed case traced to a traveler from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Contact tracing identified 57 possibly exposed individuals; 10 have been quarantined in Nairobi and are under daily symptom monitoring. Authorities say about 17 additional contacts have been identified. Nationwide measures include screening more than 652,000 travelers for Ebola symptoms, with 267 samples of suspected cases sent to laboratories. Approximately 5,000 health workers have received training on prevention, case finding, and patient management. Officials continue monitoring contacts and pursuing any new cases to prevent further transmission. The situation remains under close surveillance by Kenya's Health Ministry. As of 9 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがもう一つの国に拡大！最初の死亡例が発生、接触者を一人ずつ追跡中
triage.triage_reason: DRCを感染源とするエボラの越境事例がケニアで初めて確認され死亡者も発生しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ケニア(Kenya)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし感染源国として明示されたDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため計上。続報でDRC国内の流行状況や渡航制限措置の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Куга је убила милионе људи, а и данас може да буде смртоносна
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The plague has killed millions of people, and even today it can be deadly.
article.articleSummary: A broken test tube in Siberia rekindles attention to plague, caused by Yersinia pestis. In Irkutsk, Russia, 28-year-old Darya Shipilova, a staff member at the Institute for Plague Research, died; officials have not confirmed plague or a lab incident, with reports suggesting death from pneumonia of unknown origin and the WHO seeking more information. Plague persists in nature, with natural reservoirs among wild rodents; humans mainly contract it via bites from infected fleas, though direct contact with animals or their tissues can also transmit. Global data (2019–2025) show ongoing human cases, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar. Three forms exist: bubonic (most common; fever, lymph node swelling), pneumonic (respiratory, high fever, chest pain, cough, dyspnea; potentially fatal), and septicemic (blood infection). Incubation is 1–7 days (1–3 days for pneumonic); diagnosis requires symptoms, exposure history, and laboratory testing. Antibiotics are effective when started early; treatment depends on the form.

triage.headline_ja: ペストはかつて数百万人を殺した。今日でも命に関わる可能性がある。
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員の死亡がペスト関連か未確認であり、WHOも情報収集中。対象国（DRC・マダガスカル）への言及は統計的背景情報に過ぎず、現在進行中の発生報告ではないため情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・イルクーツクの研究所職員の死亡事例（ペストかラボ感染かは未確認）であり、DRC・マダガスカルは2019-2025年の世界的統計データの紹介として言及されているに過ぎず、現時点での発生国として特定できないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bangka Tengah sasar 29 lokus intensifkan penelusuran TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Bangka Regency Health Office targets 29 sites to intensify TB tracing
article.articleSummary: TB tracing intensified in Central Bangka Regency, Kepulauan Bangka Belitung Islands Province, Indonesia, with 29 designated sites for tuberculosis contact tracing. The Bangka Tengah Health Office aims to broaden screening and boost early TB detection to curb transmission in districts and villages with relatively high TB incidence. Officials, led by Zaitun, say the 29 sites will guide targeted examinations to identify cases and prevent spread, focusing on those with close contact to TB patients. Screening and contact tracing are expected to yield more case detections, reflecting outreach to previously unidentified cases. The Health Office intends to accelerate patient management and reduce transmission within families and communities, while encouraging residents with TB symptoms or exposure history to seek care at health facilities. As of 2026-10-09.
