triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行疾患(結核)に対するルーチンの接触者追跡・スクリーニング強化活動であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域の風土病であり、本記事は保健当局による通常の公衆衛生対応(接触者追跡・早期発見)を報じるもの。緊急的なアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ящура нет, ограничения есть: Ветслужба Забайкалья объяснила путаницу с инфекциями
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no foot-and-mouth disease, there are restrictions: the Zabaykalsky Veterinary Service explained the confusion about infections.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 9, 2026, officials in Russia's Zabaykalsky Krai stated there is no active foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in the region after repeated inquiries by Babr Mash. A heightened readiness regime has been established due to the risk of introducing FMD from neighboring Mongolia and China. A Telegram channel had reported outbreaks in settlements, but regional veterinary authorities attributed that to possible confusion and said the person giving the comment was not a veterinarian and might have mistaken information. While restrictions were imposed in two settlements, officials clarified these were connected to bovine leukemia in cows, not FMD. Earlier, Governor Alexander Osipov announced enhanced readiness and ordered additional vaccination of animals against FMD in 12 border districts, and required grazing restrictions within a 10-km belt along the state border.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫はない、しかし規制はある：ザバイカル地方の獣医局が感染症に関する混乱を説明
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・ザバイカル地方当局が口蹄疫の発生を否定し、実際の規制措置は牛白血病によるものと説明している。対象国（中国・モンゴル）は隣接国としてリスク要因に言及されているのみで、実際の発生事実は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内でのFMD発生を否定する内容であり、実際の発生事実は確認されていない。中国・モンゴルは国境地帯のリスク要因として言及されているのみで、対象国での実際の発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kualitas Udara Sulsel tidak Sehat, Pemprov Terbitkan Edaran Kewaspadaan Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unhealthy Air Quality in South Sulawesi, Provincial Government Issues Influenza Alert Circular
article.articleSummary: Unhealthy PM2.5 air pollution in South Sulawesi triggers influenza alert. BMKG data dated Oct 5, 2026 show PM2.5 rising at Sulawesi Selatan weather/climate stations, changing air quality from Moderate to Unhealthy, raising risk of influenza and Acute Respiratory Infections (ARI). In response, the Sulawesi Selatan Provincial Government issued Circular No. 100.3/4/13819/DINKES on Vigilance Against Influenza. The circular, signed by Acting Secretary of the Regional Government A. Winarno Eka Putra for Governor Andi Sudirman Sulaiman, urges Bupati and Wali Kota to immediately implement prevention and mitigation actions to protect respiratory health. The measure calls for government-community collaboration; no case counts, lab confirmations, or infection sources are reported. It emphasizes preparedness and public awareness to curb morbidity linked to poor air quality.

triage.headline_ja: 南スラウェシの大気質が不健康に、州政府がインフルエンザ警戒の通達を発出
triage.triage_reason: 大気汚染によるインフルエンザ・ARIリスク上昇への予防的注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や感染拡大の報告はなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は大気汚染(PM2.5)による呼吸器疾患リスクへの行政的予防通達であり、インフルエンザの流行や症例報告ではない。公衆衛生上の実質的事案ではなく環境問題が主因。

article.articleHeadline: Relief as Wajir man tests negative for Ebola, diagnosed with malaria
article.articleSummary: A 20-year-old man from Wajir with Ebola-like symptoms tested negative for Ebola; malaria confirmed by the National Public Health Virology Laboratory in Nairobi. He traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo through Uganda to Kenya, prompting isolation and Ebola testing. He was started on antimalarials. As of 09 Oct 2026, about 66 contacts are in isolation at the National Police Service Isolation Centre. Investigations continue for others who were on the same flight as the deceased man. Kenya reports 263 alerts from 17 counties; 4,971 health workers trained and over 652,000 travellers screened at 15 entry points. Five laboratories (including mobile units) are testing samples with a 6–12 hour turnaround; more than 268 samples tested, one positive result. Isolation/treatment facilities total 241 beds across Kenyatta National Hospital, Moi Teaching and Referral Hospital, National Police Service Hospital, Port Reitz, and The Nairobi Hospital, with more beds planned in Busia County. WHO and India donations, plus US/IGAD/Africa CDC support, bolster PPE and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: ワジル出身の男性、エボラ検査陰性でマラリアと診断され安堵
triage.triage_reason: 本人はエボラ検査陰性でマラリア確定であり、個別症例としての深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威は否定された。対象国リストに該当する国でのエボラ発生は記事から確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア（Wajir/Nairobi）での個別エボラ疑い例がマラリアと判明した事例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCやインドは渡航歴・支援国として言及されているのみで、それらの国でのエボラ発生が記事の主題ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumonic plague risk to PH 'very low' amid death in Russia
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, the Philippines Department of Health says the risk of pneumonic plague in the country remains very low. This follows the death of a laboratory worker in Irkutsk, Russia, where authorities have not confirmed the cause; officials say the patient died of pneumonia and a plague link has not been established. The World Health Organization assigns a low risk in Russia and a very low risk in Europe. Infectious-disease expert Dr. Rontgene Solante says the likelihood of spread to other countries is low, noting quarantine and extensive testing. Pneumonic plague is a severe lung-focused form transmitted via respiratory droplets in close contact, but is treatable with antibiotics when detected early. The DOH notes readiness: the Research Institute for Tropical Medicine can test for plague; designated hospitals can isolate and treat suspect cases; no special precautions needed, but general hygiene is advised.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでの研究員死亡を受け、フィリピンでの肺ペスト感染リスクは『非常に低い』
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの研究員が肺ペストの疑いで死亡し、WHOも注視している異常事態であり、ペストは重篤な感染症かつヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、社会的関心（保健当局の公式声明）も伴いフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 実際の発症・死亡事例はロシア・イルクーツク州で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは自国へのリスク評価を発表しているのみで、同国内での発生は確認されていないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mudança climática reduz ciclo de vida do Aedes aegypti e acelera contágio - Aqui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change shortens the Aedes aegypti life cycle and accelerates transmission - Here
article.articleSummary: Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector, shows a accelerated life cycle and transmission potential in Minas Gerais, Brazil, due to rising temperatures. Prolonged heat shortens the egg-to-adult development from seven to ten days under mild conditions, and to about seven days under extreme heat, boosting the adult population capable of spreading dengue. Dengue virus incubates faster in the mosquito at temperatures above 30 °C, enabling quicker transmission after bites. Females become infectious sooner and remain capable of spreading for much of their adult life. Mosquito eggs can survive dry periods for over a year; when rainwater fills sun-warmed containers, larvae hatch rapidly, increasing domestic breeding in areas with sanitation gaps. About 80% of foci are indoors. The Minas Gerais Health Secretariat advises weekly inspections of plant pots, rainwater-collecting containers, gutters, and water tanks to eliminate standing water and disrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がネッタイシマカのライフサイクルを短縮し、感染拡大を加速させる
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な発生やアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、気候変動とデング熱媒介蚊の生態に関する一般的な啓発記事であるため。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数や死亡者数、アウトブレイクの発生報告は含まれておらず、気候変動によるデング熱リスク上昇に関する一般的な科学解説記事である。

article.articleHeadline: TGHRC Takes Suo Motu Cognizance of Food Poisoning at Wanaparthy Girls' Hostel
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, the Telangana Human Rights Commission (TGHRC) took suo motu cognizance of reports alleging food poisoning among several female students at the Government Women’s Polytechnic College hostel in Pebbair, Wanaparthy district, after a chicken dinner on 7 October. The commission noted claims that the hostel warden and her husband attempted to conceal the incident by attributing illness to viral fever. TGHRC has directed the Wanaparthy District Collector to submit a detailed report on the circumstances, the health status of the affected students, and the medical treatment provided, with the report due by 6 November 2026. The case raises concerns over food safety and student health and prompts scrutiny of hostel management and response measures.

triage.headline_ja: テランガーナ州人権委員会、ワナパルティの女子寮での食中毒疑惑について自発的に審理開始
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での食中毒疑惑事案であり、感染症の国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。人権委員会の調査という行政・社会的側面が主体。
triage.notes: 食中毒（非感染性の疑い）であり感染症イベントとしての性質が薄い。対象国リストにインドは含まれるが、本事案は単発の食品安全・人権問題であり、感染症サーベイランスの観点からは見送り対象。

article.articleHeadline: পুজোতেও চলবে অভিযান, বন্ধ স্কুল-কলেজে মশার লার্ভা খুঁজবে স্বাস্থ্য দপ্তর
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campaign will continue during Puja; the health department will search for mosquito larvae in closed schools and colleges.
article.articleSummary: During Puja, the state’s health department will intensify dengue prevention: no holidays for health surveillance. With schools, colleges, and government offices closed, dedicated dengue teams will inspect closed premises for standing water and larval sources; larvicidal drives will be conducted if needed. Dengue patients resting at home will receive daily phone check-ins, and there will be no dial-in for hospital admissions; action will be taken if a hospital or nursing home refuses admission. A district-level dengue meeting will precede Puja, and a specialized control team will coordinate. At each Puja pandal, inspections will occur on Saptami and Asthami; rapid-response teams will monitor large pandals and adjacent fairs. Fever patients undergoing dengue testing during Puja must have their reports collected daily from private hospitals and nursing homes. Dengue outbreaks persist in the state, with cases in North Kolkata, suburbs, and Kolkata-adjacent districts.

triage.headline_ja: プジョー期間中も活動継続、休校中の学校・大学で保健局が蚊の幼虫を捜索
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州でデング熱の流行が継続し行政が対策強化中だが、感染規模・重症度等の詳細情報が不足しており経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州（コルカタ及び近郊）で季節性流行が継続中。地元保健当局による予防対策強化の記事であり、新規異常事態ではなく例年の対応強化と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Valencia City pursues tests for suspected Hepa A cases
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A cases surge in Valencia City, Bukidnon, Philippines, with 73 suspected infections across Barangay Lurugan, where most patients are students aged 10–19. Confirmed infections in Lurugan rose from six to 14, with two additional cases in neighboring Barangay San Carlos. City health officials are rushing to secure diagnostic confirmatory testing via a memorandum of agreement with hospitals, following an emergency CDRRMC meeting on Oct 8. Patients previously hospitalized have been discharged and are recovering at home; remaining suspected cases are monitored at their residences. Transmission is typically via contaminated food or water in areas with poor sanitation; the exact source is under investigation. As a precaution, Lurugan barangay banned ambulant vendors from selling cooked or ready-to-eat foods within the village pending probe.

triage.headline_ja: バレンシア市、A型肝炎疑い症例の確定検査を推進
triage.triage_reason: WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・継続曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、地元当局・住民の関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 73人の疑い例のうち確定14例、感染経路（汚染食品・水）は調査中。地方自治体レベルでの対応（CDRRMC緊急会議、屋台禁止措置等）が行われており、現時点では局地的な発生に留まる。重症例・死亡例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova início dos estudos em humanos da vacina brasileira contra malária vivax
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves the start of human trials of the Brazilian vaccine against Plasmodium vivax malaria.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa authorized the start of phase 1 human trials for Vivaxin, Brazil's first vaccine targeting Plasmodium vivax malaria. Developed by CTVacinas (UFMG) with USP and Cristália, Vivaxin uses recombinant surface antigens from P. vivax. Phase 1 will enroll 48 healthy volunteers aged 18–59 with no malaria history, testing three dose levels in a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled design. Participants will receive three injections at 28-day intervals, with about a one-year follow-up to assess safety and antibody responses. Trials take place at the Clinical Research Center, Hospital das Clínicas da UFMG in Belo Horizonte. If safe, progression to Phase 2/3 will evaluate efficacy in a larger population. In 2025 Brazil reported 118,000 malaria cases (85% vivax; 99% in the Amazon) and 39 deaths; transmission is via female Anopheles mosquitoes. The country aims to interrupt local transmission by 2035.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、ブラジル製三日熱マラリアワクチンのヒト臨床試験開始を承認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発の臨床試験承認に関する報道であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態や流行拡大の兆候を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアワクチン開発の進展に関するもので、既存の流行状況（2025年118,000症例、39死亡）は背景情報として言及されているのみであり、新たなアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lagoa Santa chega a 178 casos confirmados de sarna humana e mantém aulas suspensas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoa Santa reaches 178 confirmed cases of human scabies and keeps classes suspended.
article.articleSummary: Lagoa Santa, a municipality in Greater Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 178 confirmed human scabies cases, with 75 more under investigation and 253 total notifications; 12 new cases in the last 24 hours. On Oct 9, the city suspended municipal schools as a precaution, though officials note school closures are not a routine control measure and depend on family adherence to preventive practices at home. Symptoms include intense itching and skin lesions; suspected cases should seek evaluation at a health unit. Transmission occurs mainly through prolonged direct contact and sharing contaminated clothing, towels, or bedding. Seven scabies outbreaks have been identified in Minas Gerais in 2026, in Andradas, Lagoa Santa, Itapecerica, Lavras, Joaquim Felício, Coronel Xavier Chaves, and Alfenas. The SES-MG states scabies is not on national/state notifiable lists; when two or more linked cases are found, municipalities must report to SES-MG via CIEVS-Minas. Lagoa Santa previously closed Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Maria on Oct 1–2 after 21 cases.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタ、疥癬確定症例178件に増加、休校措置を継続
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域内で複数の集団発生が確認されており、学校閉鎖など社会的影響が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症で致死性が低く、国家・州の届出義務疾患ではないが、ミナスジェライス州内で7件の集団発生が報告されており、地域保健当局（SES-MG）への報告体制が強化されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、地域の学校閉鎖など社会的影響があるため続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية إصابة هولندى بفيروس إيبولا والكونغو تسجل 8728 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Dutchman infected with Ebola virus, Congo records 8,728 cases.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain (BVD), was detected in Kenya on 5 October 2026, imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The patient traveled from DRC to Kenya via Uganda, received care in Kenya, and died on 5 October. Public health authorities in Kenya and Uganda initiated contact tracing and other responses since the previous outbreak report on 25 September 2026. The DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has expanded to a new health zone, Alimbongo Health Zone in North Kivu, widening the eastern outbreak. Separately, the Netherlands reported evacuating a healthcare worker after laboratory confirmation of Ebola infection, who was transported to the Netherlands for treatment. As of 6 October 2026, updates were being issued by WHO and national authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:オランダ人がエボラウイルスに感染、コンゴは8,728例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが新たな保健区域に拡大し、ケニアへの輸入例（死亡）、オランダへの医療従事者の後送例が確認されており、国際的拡大と重篤性が明確なためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・オランダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内での北キブ州Alimbongo保健区域への拡大が主たる発生地。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana declares yellow fever outbreak in Upper West Region
article.articleSummary: Ghana has declared a yellow fever outbreak in the Upper West Region after three laboratory-confirmed cases, all fatalities, reported from Sissala West and Wa West since 9 September 2026. Samples tested locally were sent to a WHO-accredited laboratory in Dakar, Senegal, which confirmed yellow fever. The declaration follows International Health Regulations (2005) and Ghana's National Public Health Act. National and Regional Public Health Emergency Operations Centres are activated, with Rapid Response Teams deployed for case finding, surveillance and risk communication. A targeted emergency vaccination campaign is planned for October 2026 in Wa West, Sissala West and Sissala East. Measures include strengthened case management, enhanced surveillance, and promotion of insect repellents and day-time use of insecticide-treated bed nets. Citizens should report fever, headache, muscle pain, jaundice or unusual bleeding; eliminate stagnant water, use repellents, and avoid self-medication, while awaiting official updates and with leaders and media supporting containment.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、アッパーウェスト州で黄熱病の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病はIHR常時通報対象疾患であり、3例全てが死亡(致死率100%)という重篤な事例が確認され、ガーナ政府が公式に流行を宣言し緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを計画していることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 黄熱病はIHR(2005)付属書2において常時通報対象とされる疾患。検査確認はセネガル・ダカールのWHO認定ラボで実施されたが、発生自体はガーナ国内（アッパーウェスト州）に限定されるため、セネガルはverified_locationsに含めない。致死率100%（3例中3例死亡）は特に注視すべき点。

article.articleHeadline: هولندا تسجل أول إصابة بفيروس إيبولا وكونغو 8728 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Netherlands records its first case of the Ebola virus, and the Congo reports 8,728 cases.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports a lab-confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) case in Kenya, a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo who reached Kenya via Uganda; the patient died the same day, prompting public health responses in Kenya and Uganda, including contact tracing. The Congo outbreak continues with ongoing transmission; the Netherlands evacuated a healthcare worker confirmed to have BDBV in the DRC and transported to the Netherlands for treatment. As of 6 October 2026, the DRC has 8,728 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,205 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.2%. Cases are reported across 64 health zones in 7 provinces: Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud-Ubangi, and Tshopo. New weekly cases rose 2.5% over three weeks (475 to 487); weekly deaths were about 224. Many deaths occur outside treatment centers, indicating delays in diagnosis and care. On 1 October, PCR-confirmed infection led to NL evacuation of a healthcare worker.

triage.headline_ja: オランダが初のエボラウイルス感染例を記録、コンゴは8,728例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（8,728例・致死率48.2%）が継続し、ケニアおよびオランダへの国際的な波及が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの症例はDRCからの渡航者、オランダへの搬送は医療従事者の国際後送であり、いずれも流行発生国はDRCのため対象国としてはDRCのみを計上。ケニア・ウガンダ・オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Kenya case travelled through DRC, Uganda before death - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola case in Kenya traced to travel from the DRC into Uganda before death in Nairobi. The patient crossed from DRC into Uganda on Oct 1 via Kasindi, went to Kampala and Entebbe, and left Entebbe Airport on Oct 3, arriving at Jomo Kenyatta Airport, Nairobi. Symptoms included fever, sore throat, muscle pains and injection-site bleeding, with jaw bleeding reported; a sample tested positive at KEMRI on Oct 5, and the patient died at 11:30 p.m. Oct 5; burial followed on Oct 6. Africa CDC described the case as imported, not an outbreak, urging cross-border surveillance. DRC’s outbreak has grown to 8,700 cases, >4,200 confirmed, and >4,200 deaths, with 266 healthcare workers infected, expanding to 64 health zones in seven provinces. Vaccines/therapeutics: Ervebo doses to DRC; monoclonal antibody trial (654 volunteers); obelisvir PEP (437); ChAdOx/Moderna trials in Uganda. Kenya activated its PHO and response, with $2.9B pledged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアの症例はDRC・ウガンダを経由して死亡 - アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,700症例・4,200人超死亡という大規模アウトブレイクが継続中であり、越境してケニアへの輸入症例が発生したことでIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの大規模アウトブレイク（8,700症例、4,200人超死亡、266名の医療従事者感染、64保健区域に拡大）が主題であり、ケニアへの越境輸入症例は国際的拡大の懸念を示す重要な情報として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: من شبح الموت الأسود إلى مخاوف التسرب البيولوجي.. وفاة غامضة داخل مختبر روسي للطاعون تعيد هواجس الأوبئة القاتلة وتضع شفافية موسكو تحت المجهر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From the specter of the Black Death to fears of a biological leak: A mysterious death inside a Russian plague laboratory rekindles concerns about deadly epidemics and puts Moscow's transparency under the microscope.
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Russian lab worker Daria Shipilova died within 48 hours after a test tube containing Yersinia pestis broke at the Institute of Plague Research in Siberia and the Far East, prompting surveillance of about 200 contacts. Officially, death is attributed to pneumonia of unknown origin; some reports suggest pneumonic plague. The US is monitoring and there are concerns about Russia's transparency; the International Health Regulations (2005) require notifying WHO within 24 hours for events that may trigger a health emergency. Irkutsk officials said tests did not detect plague bacteria. The WHO notes plague can be bubonic, septicemic, or pneumonic; pneumonic form spreads via respiratory droplets and is highly deadly if untreated. Plague remains endemic in several countries, with most 2019–2025 cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar. An Arizona pneumonic plague case was reported in July 2025. The situation fuels calls for rapid data sharing and transparency.

triage.headline_ja: 黒死病の亡霊から生物学的漏洩への懸念へ…ロシアのペスト研究所内での謎の死が致死的な感染症への恐怖を再燃させ、モスクワの透明性が疑問視される
triage.triage_reason: ロシアのペスト研究所で検体破損後に研究員が死亡し、肺ペストの疑いがあることから深刻性・異常性の両方でIHR基準に該当し、国際的な監視（米国含む）と透明性への懸念も生じているため。
triage.notes: 事象の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）および米国（過去事例の言及）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・マダガスカルは過去の流行地として一般的文脈で言及されているのみで、本事象の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシアの検査では当初ペスト菌は検出されなかったとの公式発表があり、情報は流動的。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: إصابة هولندى بفيروس إيبولا والكونغو تسجل 8728 حالة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Dutch national infected with the Ebola virus, and Congo reports 8,728 cases - Youm7
article.articleSummary: WHO reported on Oct 5, 2026 a laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) case in Kenya, imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The patient travelled from DRC to Kenya via Uganda, received treatment in Kenya, and died on Oct 5; Kenya and Uganda initiated contact tracing and other public-health responses after the Sept 25 outbreak report. The DRC outbreak has expanded to the Alimbongo health zone in North Kivu, with ongoing spread in the eastern region. The Netherlands evacuated a healthcare worker after confirmed Ebola infection, with transfer to the Netherlands for treatment. As of Oct 6, 2026, DRC reports 8,728 lab-confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths (CFR 48.2%), across 64 health zones in 7 provinces: Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud-Ubangi, and Chobo. Transmission remains intense nationwide; weekly cases rose 2.5% (475→487) while weekly deaths stayed around 224. Deaths outside treatment centers suggest delays in diagnosis and care.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:オランダ人がエボラウイルスに感染、コンゴは8,728例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（8,728症例、CFR48.2%）がケニア・オランダへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準4項目全て該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: DRCの7州64保健ゾーンで感染拡大中。ケニアへの輸入例（死亡）、オランダへの医療従事者避難例があり、既に国際的拡大が現実化している。週次症例数は増加傾向（475→487）、死亡率高止まり。対象国リストにはケニア・ウガンダ・オランダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 压降蚊媒密度，阳春市多举措抓实登革热、基孔肯雅热防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reduce mosquito-vector density; Yangchun City takes multiple measures to strengthen dengue fever and chikungunya prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and chikungunya are at peak season in Yangchun City as Aedes aegypti activity increases. To curb transmission, the city has rolled out comprehensive vector-control measures: since August, full-area source-reduction in high-risk zones—urban villages, old neighborhoods, peri-urban interfaces, markets, construction sites, and idle land—plus weekly environmental cleanup on Patriotic Health Campaign days. In high-density areas, city CDC and public-health authorities coordinate with emergency, street, and third-party teams to conduct standardized, large-scale spraying with science-based dosing to rapidly reduce mosquito density and transmission risk. Household inspections use red-green labeling; green indicates completed inspection and disinfection, red indicates pending. Public education is delivered door-to-door, with posters and material distribution; campuses (HeXi Street Central Primary, ChunCheng Street YunLing Primary, Experimental Primary) receive health talks via campus livestreams. Preparedness includes 48 isolation wards and 116 beds; frontline points and emergency spraying teams are trained. Yangchun will continue vector-season controls to sustain public-health safety.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介密度を抑制、陽春市がデング熱・チクングニア熱の予防対策を多角的に強化
triage.triage_reason: 中国陽春市でデング熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊対策が報告されているが、具体的な患者数・重症度の記載がなく、季節性の通常対応の範囲内と見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の蚊媒介感染症対策に関する行政報道であり、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・流行規模の記載がないため、フルリスク評価の緊急性は低いと判断。隔離病棟・病床確保の記載から一定の警戒はあるが、異常事態とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Μια καθηγήτρια Επιδημιολογίας απαντά: Τι είναι η πανώλη και ποιοι κινδυνεύουν από αυτήν
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An epidemiology professor answers: What is the plague and who is at risk from it.
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains a zoonosis with reservoirs in wild rodents and fleas; modern antibiotic therapy improves prognosis, though delayed diagnosis drives mortality. A WHO report published September 2026 (covering 2019–2025) notes 3,860 suspected cases, with six countries reporting confirmed cases; Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar continue to have the highest counts. Disease forms include bubonic plague (painful buboes in the groin, axilla, or neck; fever, rigors, and fatigue), septicemic plague (shock, hemorrhages, multi-organ failure), and pneumonic plague (rapid pneumonia, dyspnea, cough, sometimes hemoptysis). Transmission: animal-to-human via infected fleas or handling infected animals; cats can be sources, especially when pneumonic. Human-to-human spread occurs mainly in pneumonic plague through respiratory droplets in close, prolonged contact. At-risk groups comprise residents and visitors to endemic areas, hunters, handlers of dead animals, veterinarians, laboratory staff, and healthcare workers; poor working conditions and limited access to care worsen outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学の教授が答える：ペストとは何か、誰が危険にさらされているのか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストに関する一般的な解説・Q&A記事であり、新規の発生事例や急性の公衆衛生イベントを報じるものではない。2026年9月公表のWHO報告書（2019〜2025年のデータ）を引用した背景説明にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はギリシャの新聞による一般向け解説記事で、ペストの病態・感染経路・リスク集団について説明している。WHO報告書（2019〜2025年）でDRCとマダガスカルが症例数最多と言及されているが、マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。新規の発生イベントではなく背景情報としての位置づけ。

article.articleHeadline: China hands Kenya Sh259 million to boost Ebola preparedness - Nairobi Law Monthly
article.articleSummary: China provided Kenya with a $2 million cash grant to bolster Ebola preparedness and drought relief, handed on Oct 8 at the National Treasury by Chinese Ambassador Guo Haiyan to Treasury PS Chris Kiptoo, with Public Health PS Mary Muthoni present. Half funds Ebola readiness—PPE, lab capacity upgrades at the National Public Health Laboratory, and rapid-response teams—in high-risk counties; the other half supports drought relief. Kenya confirmed its first imported Ebola case two days earlier; as of 2026-10-09 there is no outbreak, with 4,971 healthcare workers trained, response teams in 24 counties, and screening at 15 entry points. Contacts in quarantine total 66; a suspected Wajir case tested negative. US (~Sh21B) and World Bank (~Sh51.8B) aid, plus domestic Sh2.6B, aim for over Sh70B for Ebola preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ対応強化のためケニアに2億5900万シリング（約2億円）を供与
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ症例が確認され、国際的な支援（中国・米国・世界銀行）が動いていることから、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例への対応支援であり、中国は資金提供国として登場するのみでエボラ発生国ではない。発生国ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Aedes aegypti: quase metade das cidades está em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti: nearly half of the cities are on alert.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Aedes aegypti remains a public-health concern in 2026. In the Health Ministry’s second LIRAa cycle (May–Aug), 49.2% of the 3,732 municipalities that reported data are in alert or risk for the dengue-transmitting mosquito, which also spreads chikungunya and Zika. Dengue probable cases total 470,500 through Sept 26, 2026, down about 70% from 1.5 million in the same period of 2025. Chikungunya falls ~43% to 67,900; Zika declines ~35% to 2,141 in the same period. Breeding sites remain largely indoors: 42.3% are plant pots and small containers; 26.1% water-storage facilities; and 23% tires and solid waste. Regional differences show tires/waste prevalent in the North, water tanks in the Northeast, and domestic containers in the Southeast, South, and Central-West. Authorities plan expanded prevention, including >300,000 community health agents by end-2026 and ovitraps in ~2,000 municipalities, plus BRI-Aedes, EDL, and Wolbachia interventions, ahead of El Niño-driven conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカ:ほぼ半数の都市が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱は前年比で大幅減少しているが、約半数の自治体で蚊の警戒レベルが継続しており、エルニーニョの影響も懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年比で大幅減少傾向にあり、これは季節的サーベイランス報告の一環。ブラジル保健省が予防策を強化しており、現時点で国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Border surveillance gaps raise concerns in the Central African Republic
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak concerns persist in the Central African Republic as of 2026-10-09. In Zemio, southeast CAR near the Democratic Republic of Congo border, officials fear cross-border transmission could occur. Border screening is hampered by repeated absences of health workers at checkpoints, while residents continue to cross via unofficial crossing points, complicating surveillance. The on-the-ground reporting by FRANCE 24 highlights how gaps in screening and staffing undermine early detection and response. The article does not provide specific case counts or laboratory-confirmed details. Ongoing surveillance challenges—staff shortages, difficult screening conditions, and unregulated cross-border movement—underscore the vulnerability of the region to Ebola spread and the need for strengthened border health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：中央アフリカ共和国で国境監視の不備が懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症の国境を越えた伝播リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地は中央アフリカ共和国（Zemio、Haut-Mbomou州）であり、対象国リストには含まれない。DRCは国境を接する国として越境伝播への懸念が言及されているのみで、DRC国内での症例確認の記述はないため verified_locations には含めなかった。症例数や検査確定情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Red Cross supports response to country's first Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola case and first fatality, in Nairobi, involving a Kenyan national who had lived in Congo before returning home. The rapidly evolving outbreak underscores importation risk from Congo. The Kenya Red Cross is supporting the government's efforts to prevent a public health crisis, with Paul Olala, the NGO's head of health security and emergencies, coordinating the response. FRANCE 24's Bastien Renouil reported on the situation after meeting Olala, highlighting the humanitarian response mobilized to address the case. The development marks a new phase in Kenya's encounter with Ebola and tests the capacity of national response to a border-crossing health threat.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア赤十字社、同国初のエボラ症例への対応を支援
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで同国初のエボラ出血熱症例・死亡例が確認され、コンゴ（DRC）からの越境感染が疑われる重大かつ異例の公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアで確認された初のエボラ症例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。DRCは患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での新規発生事例として明示されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Πανώλη και "Μαύρος Θάνατος": Η ασθένεια που εξακολουθεί να εμφανίζεται - Όλα όσα πρέπει να γνωρίζουμε
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague and the 'Black Death': The disease that continues to appear — Everything you need to know.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains an ongoing global concern after the death of a laboratory worker in Siberia, underscoring persisting risk despite effective antibiotics when diagnosed promptly. Caused by Yersinia pestis, it presents in three forms: bubonic (painful lymphadenopathy, usually from flea bites), septicemic, and pneumonic (rapid respiratory symptoms; can spread via droplets). A September 2026 WHO report covering 2019–2025 records 3,860 globally suspected cases, with six countries reporting confirmed cases; the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar are among those with the highest numbers. The EU has had no cases for decades; the US reports about five human cases per year, with the last fatality in 2025. Transmission is primarily zoonotic via fleas; cats can be infected and transmit to humans, as highlighted by a CDC-linked Arizona incident tied to exposure to ill cats. For pneumonic plague, immediate isolation, treatment, and contact tracing are critical; high-risk groups include people in endemic areas, hunters, veterinarians, and health/lab workers.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト菌と「黒死病」：今も発生し続ける疾患——知っておくべきすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ペストに関する一般的な解説・既存WHO報告（2019-2025年集計）の紹介記事であり、対象国における新規・異常な公衆衛生事象は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はシベリアでの研究者死亡事例を契機とした一般的なペスト解説記事。WHO報告（2019-2025年）でDRCが確認症例の多い国の一つとして言及されているが、具体的な新規発生情報ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: La peste neumónica vuelve a encender las alarmas: qué ocurre en Rusia y qué riesgo existe para España
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The pneumonic plague is flaring up again: what's happening in Russia and what risk does it pose to Spain.
article.articleSummary: Following the death of Daria Shipilova, a 28-year-old researcher at Siberia’s Anti-Plague Institute, a suspected pneumonic plague case has sparked international scrutiny. On Oct. 2, authorities quarantined hospitals and about 200 contacts; Russia maintains the death was due to an 'unknown pneumonia.' The WHO has asked for fuller information and transparency. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, transmits via respiratory droplets and can present with fever, chills, difficulty breathing, and chest pain within 1–7 days; without timely antibiotics it can be fatal, though it responds to treatment when diagnosed. The plague persists worldwide, with activity in Madagascar, the DRC, Central Asia, Mongolia, and Russia; cases in the United States and Peru. The WHO says Europe’s risk is very low, and Spain faces no immediate threat, though strict isolation protocols exist for potential cases. Factors fueling outbreaks include antimicrobial resistance, new strains, climate change, globalization, and information access.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストが再び警鐘を鳴らす：ロシアで何が起きているのか、スペインにとってのリスクとは
triage.triage_reason: ロシアで研究者が原因不明の肺炎（疑い肺ペスト）で死亡し、約200人の接触者が隔離されるなど異常性・重篤性が高く、WHOが情報開示を求めるなど国際的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる事象はロシア・シベリアでの研究者死亡例（疑い肺ペスト）であり、対象国リストには含まれないが、記事内でDRCにおける現行のペスト活動が言及されているため含めた。ロシア政府は死因を『原因不明の肺炎』としており、確定診断情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana declares outbreak of dangerous disease after recent deaths, lists symptoms to look out for
article.articleSummary: Yellow Fever outbreak declared in Ghana's Upper West Region after laboratory tests confirmed three fatal cases in Wa West and Sissala West; suspected cases first reported Sept 9, 2026. Samples were tested locally and at the WHO-accredited Dakar laboratory, confirming Yellow Fever. All three patients died despite treatment. Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh declared the outbreak under International Health Regulations (2005) and Public Health Act, 2012. The Ghana Health Service activated the National and Regional Public Health Emergency Operations Centres and dispatched Rapid Response Teams for case finding, surveillance, and risk communication. An emergency vaccination campaign is planned for Wa West, Sissala West, and Sissala East in October, with heightened surveillance across the Upper West Region. Preventive measures include insect repellents, use of insecticide-treated nets during daytime when Aedes is active, and seeking care for fever, jaundice, or bleeding; households should clear stagnant water and follow official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、最近の死亡例を受け危険な感染症の流行を宣言、注意すべき症状を列挙
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ保健省がIHR(2005)に基づき黄熱病アウトブレイクを正式宣言し、死亡例3名確認、緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンも計画されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: サンプルはWHO認定のダカール研究所で確認されたが、発生地はガーナのUpper West Regionのみ。Senegal/Dakarは検査実施地であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : plus de 8.700 cas en RDC, un premier mort au Kenya, et l'Afrique s'embrase de Kinshasa à Durban - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 8,700 cases in the DRC, first death in Kenya, and Africa is ablaze from Kinshasa to Durban
article.articleSummary: 8,728 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,205 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of Oct 6, 2026 (case fatality ~48%). The outbreak spans 64 districts across seven eastern provinces, with Ituri and Nord-Kivu heavily affected; MSF warns transmission is “out of control,” noting 75% of deaths occur outside treatment facilities. Since Sept 25, 775 new cases and 379 deaths were recorded. The epidemic began May 15 in DRC and Uganda; Kampala’s outbreak was declared over on July 28. Kenya reports its first Ebola death on Oct 6—a Kenyan national who returned from DRC and died in Nairobi; 57 contacts identified, with 10 located and quarantined. The World Food Programme seeks $30 million to feed Congolese refugees in Burundi (Busuma camp ~33,000 people). Separately, Ethiopian drones struck Eritrean units in Tigray near Adigrat on Oct 7–8; Addis Ababa asks the UN Security Council; Eritrea denies invasion.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で8,700人超の症例、ケニアで初の死亡例、アフリカはキンシャサからダーバンまで緊張
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8,700件超の症例・4,200人超の死亡（致死率約48%）という深刻な公衆衛生被害があり、MSFが「制御不能」と警告。さらにケニアへの国境を越えた感染拡大（初の死亡例）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ブルンジ・エチオピア・UAEも発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニアでの死亡例は感染拡大の重要な兆候として本文に記載されているが、ケニアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry declares Yellow Fever outbreak in Upper West Region
article.articleSummary: Yellow Fever outbreak declared in Upper West Region, Ghana, after lab confirmation of three cases, all of which died. Suspected cases with fever, jaundice, and bleeding were reported from 09 September 2026 in Sissala West and Wa West. Samples tested locally; confirmation came from the WHO-accredited lab in Dakar, Senegal. The Minister declared the outbreak in Wa West, Sissala West, and Sissala East districts. The Ghana Health Service activated National Public Health Emergency Operations Centres and deployed Rapid Response Teams for case finding and surveillance. A targeted vaccination campaign is planned for October in affected and at-risk districts. Measures include insecticide repellents, bed nets, strengthened case management, and intensified risk communication. Public advised to seek care for fever, jaundice, or bleeding; eliminate stagnant water and rely on official updates.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アッパーウェスト州で黄熱病の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ラボ確認された3例全例が死亡という高致死率の黄熱病流行が宣言され、公衆衛生緊急事態センターが稼働するなど、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : la vaccination contre l'épidémie lancée par le gouverneur à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Upper Uele: vaccination against the outbreak launched by the governor in Isiro - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 9 October 2026 in Isiro, Haut-Uele province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, a preventive Ebola virus disease (EVD) vaccination campaign was launched for frontline health workers as part of the national Ebola preparedness and response strategy led by the Ministry of Health. Implemented through the Expanded Immunization Program with support from partners including WHO, UNICEF, Africa CDC, and PAM, the first dose was administered to the provincial health minister, the provincial assembly rapporteur, a religious leader, a WHO partner, the provincial medical inspector, and other prelisted health professionals to encourage uptake. The vaccination aims to bolster frontline protection and complements existing infection prevention and control measures, PPE, and hand hygiene. The ceremony took place at Mayogo Hall in Isiro, with attendance from the vice-governor, assembly representative, national response coordinators, and representatives from international agencies and civil society.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州のエボラ：知事がイジロでワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤かつ国際的拡大リスクの高い疾患であり、現地で予防接種キャンペーンが開始されるなど継続的な流行対応が行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当項目が複数あり監視継続が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始を報じるもので、新規症例数や流行規模についての具体的データは含まれていない。既存のエボラ流行に対する対応強化策として評価。

article.articleHeadline: China extends $2 million grant to Kenya for Ebola preparedness, drought relief
article.articleSummary: China extends a $2 million grant to Kenya for Ebola preparedness and drought relief. Of the total, $1 million funds Ebola virus disease preparedness infrastructure in counties identified as very high- and high-risk; the other $1 million supports drought response. Kenya reports its first imported Ebola case, a Kenyan citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for seven years and died of Ebola while under treatment at a Nairobi hospital. East Africa’s largest economy faces climate shocks, with prolonged droughts in semi-arid counties and forecasts of El Niño rains bringing floods from October to early next year. The grant follows a Kenyan government request and aims to bolster surveillance, outbreak preparedness, and drought relief efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ対策と干ばつ対策のためケニアに200万ドルの助成金を供与
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで輸入エボラ症例（DRC在住歴のある人物が死亡）が初めて報告され、国際支援（中国からの資金援助）が実施されている点で、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lagoa Santa confirma 178 casos de sarna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoa Santa Confirms 178 Cases of Scabies
article.articleSummary: Lagoa Santa, in Greater Belo Horizonte, Brazil, reports 178 confirmed scabies cases and 75 under investigation (253 total notifications) as of Oct 8–9, 2026, with 12 new cases in the last 24 hours. In response, all municipal schools have suspended classes on Oct 9 as a precaution; authorities stress that school closures are not a routine control measure and success depends on families’ actions at home. The outbreak follows a prior period when one municipal school logged 20 confirmed cases and another case outside the institution. Scabies is a skin disease caused by a mite; transmission occurs mainly through prolonged direct skin contact, less often via shared clothing or bedding, and is not linked to hygiene or respiratory spread. All notified cases are treated within the municipal health network; contact treatment is done only when advised. Home measures include washing bedding and clothing at hot temperatures, sealing non-washables for seven days, avoiding sharing items, and keeping nails short.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタ市、疥癬178例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低い疾患だが、学校休校など地域での対応拡大が見られるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 疥癬は致死性・重症度が低く、通常は公衆衛生上の緊急事態とはならないが、学校集団発生と休校措置という地域的対応が報告されているため、感染拡大状況の推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue em BH: PBH pede denúncias de focos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Belo Horizonte: PBH requests reports of hotspots.
article.articleSummary: BH authorities urge residents to report Aedes aegypti hotspots as rains approach and Minas Gerais prepares for a potential dengue epidemic in 2027. Reports can be submitted anonymously via 156, the BHSIM app, or the PBH Services Portal. From January to September this year, about 1,200 requests were logged; 2025 saw over 1,700 inspection requests. When hotspots are identified, vector-control agents inspect and advise owners on eliminating breeding sites, focusing on abandoned properties, unfinished construction, and poorly maintained pools; a roughly 10-minute home visit can identify key risks. State Health Secretary Fábio Baccheretti warned of a possible sharp rise in dengue in 2027, given transmission cycles and forecasted weather. Minas Gerais’ 2024 outbreak was the largest in state history: ~1,651,722 probable, 1,409,866 confirmed, 1,324 deaths; 2025: 160,882 probable, 121,012 confirmed, 161 deaths; by Sept 25, 2026: 63,647 probable, 47,502 confirmed, 49 deaths. Vaccination and Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes are among strategies.

triage.headline_ja: ベロ・オリゾンテのデング熱：市当局が発生源の通報を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州での通常のデング熱対策・予防啓発記事であり、過去の大規模流行歴と2027年の再流行懸念はあるが、現時点で急性の異常事態ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2024年にミナスジェライス州史上最大のデング熱流行（死者1,324人）があり、2027年に再度大規模流行の可能性が州保健当局から警告されている。季節性の予防啓発記事だが、過去の流行規模と将来予測は注視に値する。

article.articleHeadline: One human protein helps malaria and kala-azar thrive. JNU scientists took it out
article.articleSummary: JNU researchers in Delhi report that removing a human protein, p38-MAPK, undermines both malaria parasites (Plasmodium) and kala-azar (visceral leishmaniasis) in lab systems. The study, published June 11 in Communications Biology, used PROTAC NR-7h to selectively degrade p38-MAPK in human macrophages and red blood cells, leaving ERK1/2 intact. In infected cells, NR-7h reduced kala-azar parasite levels up to ~16-fold and malaria parasite burden similarly, without harming host cells; parasites grown alone were unaffected. Removing the protein disrupted immune signaling, with TNF-alpha and IL-12 responses altered. Timing matters: p38-MAPK activity rose around six hours post-infection and declined by twelve hours, suggesting early defense but later parasite support. Malaria caused ~610,000 deaths and 282 million cases in 2024 worldwide; kala-azar affects India (Bihar, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand) with 50,000–90,000 new cases annually; drug resistance reported in eight African countries. No animal or human trials yet; host-directed therapy.

triage.headline_ja: ヒトのあるタンパク質がマラリアとカラアザールの増殖を助けている。JNUの科学者がそれを除去した
triage.triage_reason: 研究室レベルの基礎研究（創薬標的研究）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントではなく、動物・ヒト試験も未実施のため公衆衛生上の脅威情報ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は基礎科学研究（分子生物学的なタンパク質機能解析）であり、疾患の発生・流行状況を報告するものではない。マラリア・カラアザールの既存の疫学的背景情報として数値が引用されているのみで、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ対象外（DISMISS）と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Tiruchi Corporation penalises eight property owners for failing to check mosquito breeding
article.articleSummary: Eight residential property owners in Tiruchi, Tamil Nadu, were fined a total of ₹24,000 for failing to eliminate mosquito breeding sources linked to Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector. Tiruchi Corporation has deployed 400 domestic breeding checkers who inspect streets and homes, identify breeding sources, apply larvicide Abate, and conduct fogging to curb dengue transmission. Commissioner N. Ponmani led door-to-door inspections in Wards 35 and 49 (Zones II and III), finding breeding sites at eight properties and imposing penalties under the Public Health Act. Residents were instructed to prevent water stagnation in tanks, plastic containers, and other receptacles. The authority warned of further fines and legal action for non-compliance.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue hit security personnel as 87 hospitalised in Gujarat ahead of Statue of Unity parade
article.articleSummary: Dengue and related fevers affected security personnel arriving from Odisha, Jharkhand, Delhi, West Bengal and Chhattisgarh for the Statue of Unity parade in Kevadia, Gujarat. In total, 87 personnel were admitted to Gandhinagar Civil Hospital over 10 days; 50 have recovered and been discharged, 37 remain under treatment. One jawan died during treatment after severe chest pain; suspected cardiac arrest under investigation; final cause to be determined after post-mortem. The affected forces include BSF, CRPF, and ITBP. Health Minister Praful Pansheriya visited the hospital, ordered uninterrupted treatment, hydration, and a balanced diet, and reviewed blood/platelet stocks. Preventive measures at accommodation sites include fogging and insecticide spraying twice daily. Specialist doctors are stationed at the hospital. 37 patients stable; death circumstances awaiting post-mortem findings.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でデング熱が治安部隊員を襲う、スタチュー・オブ・ユニティ・パレードを前に87人が入院

triage.notes: インド国内の複数州から集まった治安部隊員の集団感染で、デング熱は同国で季節的に流行している疾患。死亡例1件は心臓発作の疑いで剖検待ち、デング熱との直接因果関係は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: "Nicht entweder Pandemie oder unwichtig - eine Menge Krankheitserreger können sehr viel Schaden anrichten"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not either a pandemic or unimportant - a lot of pathogens can cause a great deal of damage
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Yersinia pestis (plague) remains circulating in animals with human cases in the United States, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Madagascar, driven by rodent reservoirs and flea transmission. In Russia, a young laboratory worker reportedly died of plague; hundreds of people have been quarantined as a precaution, though official confirmation of a plague case is pending. The WHO is seeking details. Causes include potential laboratory safety gaps and symptom reporting; historical Chicago 2009 case showed unusual virulence but still controlled by antibiotics and isolation. Experts caution that a plague outbreak is unlikely to become a pandemic, unlike coronaviruses; local outbreaks can occur, as seen with the Congo’s Ebola outbreak. The article emphasizes balanced, non-panic discussion of dangerous pathogens and the ongoing need for vigilance and rapid antibiotic treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Чума в Росії, удари по Україні та Гаага: Влад Росс приголомшив новим прогнозом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague in Russia, strikes on Ukraine and The Hague: Vlad Ross stunned by a new forecast.
article.articleSummary: Astrologer Vlad Ross foresees a pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia, centered in Siberia near the Mongolian border (Tuva region and near China). He linked the plague to Russia’s war against Ukraine, claiming Europe could be decimated by plague as in medieval accounts. For Ukraine, Ross predicts intensified Russian strikes on infrastructure through late October and early November, aiming to cut water, sewage, and heating to press Kyiv into capitulation. He says Ukraine will continue hitting Russian oil depots but avoid attacks on civilian targets. He also forecasts that after the conflict, a tribunal will be held in The Hague to investigate war crimes, with all crimes addressed. The article notes this forecaster’s prior ominous predictions.

article.articleHeadline: Чума в России, удары по Украине и Гаага: Влад Росс ошарашил новым прогнозом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague in Russia, Strikes on Ukraine and The Hague: Vlad Ross Stunned Everyone with a New Forecast.
article.articleSummary: Vlad Ross, an astrologer, forecast a plague outbreak in Russia, specifically in Siberia near the Mongolian border, including the Tuva region near China, predicting pneumonic plague as a consequence of an unjust war and suggesting Europe could face historic mortality. Regarding Ukraine, Ross warned that by late October and early November Russia would escalate strikes on infrastructure to deprive civilians of water, sewage, and heating, aiming to force Kyiv to capitulate. He said Ukraine would continue hitting Russian oil depots but would refrain from targeting civilian objects, noting that war crimes would be investigated and that perpetrators would face a tribunal in The Hague. The piece also recalls his prior forecast of a catastrophic end to the war in Ukraine. Published October 9, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: AI-Powered X-Ray Screening Proves Feasible for TB Detection in
article.articleSummary: TB remains the deadliest infectious disease; in 2024 the Philippines accounted for 6.8% of the global TB caseload, underscoring transmission in crowded urban settings. A qualitative study in PLOS Global Public Health evaluates AI-powered CAD (computer-aided detection) applied to digital chest X-ray during a Médecins Sans Frontières community active case finding campaign in Tondo, Manila. From January to April 2023, in-depth interviews and observations with MSF staff, local clinicians, program personnel, and residents explored perceptions beyond diagnostic accuracy. Four themes emerged: (1) operational efficiency—CAD increased screening capacity and streamlined workloads; (2) human resources and role adaptation—reallocating tasks required ongoing training and support; (3) technical feasibility and system design—calibrating probability thresholds depends on local prevalence and health-system capacity; (4) community acceptability and ethics—trust grows when technology is embedded in accessible, not parachuted, care.

article.articleHeadline: जिले में 48 तक पहुंचा डेंगू मरीजों का आंकड़ा, चिकनगुनिया के 4 केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of dengue patients in the district has reached 48, with four chikungunya cases.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 9, 2026, dengue patients in Hoshiarpur district have risen to 48, while chikungunya cases total 4. Under the Civil Surgeon’s guidelines, dengue-awareness drives were rolled out across the district, led by District Epidemiologist Dr. Jagdeep Singh. Health teams conducted door-to-door visits in 1,487 households in Hoshiarpur city, finding mosquito larvae in 67 homes and destroying them on the spot; where required, larvicides were sprayed. The exercise aimed to educate residents about dengue, malaria, and other mosquito-borne diseases. A dengue ward with mosquito nets was established for patients at Civil Hospital, SDH, and CHC Dhagger. The campaign involved staff including Ravinder Jassal, Balvir Kaur, Rohit Sharma, Ajay M.P.H.W., nursing students, and others, and will continue with ongoing larval-source reduction.

article.articleHeadline: Viet Nam's Private-Sector TB Bridge Added Thousands of Cases to
article.articleSummary: Vietnam TB program spans 15 provinces with about 40.6 million people and piloted a public-private mix (PPM) bridge 2020–2023 to link 3,154 out-of-network providers to the national TB program. The intervention used active case finding, provider referral incentives, patient support, and near real-time integrated data systems to convert private-sector diagnoses into national notifications. Analyzing 2016–2025 province-quarter data, adjusting for province and calendar-quarter fixed effects and COVID-19 disruptions, the study found an average increase of 316.8 TB notifications per province per quarter (95% CI 23.4–610.2; p=0.034). Nationally, this equates to about 3,206 additional notifications per year (CI 1,658–4,763; p<0.001). Dose–response showed every 100 verbal assessments per 100,000 population linked to a 1.4% rise in notifications (IRR 1.00014; 95% CI 1.00002–1.00025; p=0.018); national models showed a 3.5% increase (IRR 1.00035; p<0.001). Findings support private-sector bridges as scalable, cost-efficient growth in TB case reporting.

article.articleHeadline: Yellow fever: Three deaths confirmed, 15 under investigation in Upper West - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Three yellow fever deaths in Ghana's Upper West Region have been scientifically confirmed, with 15 suspected deaths under investigation as of 9 October 2026. Suspected institutional deaths: Wa East (3), Sissala West (3), Sissala East (3), Nadowli-Kaleo (1); suspected community deaths: Sissala East (4), Wa West (1). Samples tested in Ghana and confirmed by a WHO-accredited lab in Dakar, Senegal, confirmed the three cases. Health authorities activated national and regional emergency operations centres and deployed rapid response teams to strengthen surveillance and community education. A targeted vaccination campaign is being prepared for Wa West, Sissala West, and Sissala East. Nationwide, about 450 suspected yellow fever cases were reported June–September 2026, with 74 in the Upper West and three confirmed there. Residents should seek care for fever, jaundice, or bleeding, avoid self-medication, eliminate standing water, and use mosquito nets and repellents.

article.articleHeadline: Vaarallinen tauti leviää Euroopassa - varoitus lomamatkailijoille
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous disease spreading in Europe - warning to holidaymakers.
article.articleSummary: Autumn holiday travel faces multiple infectious disease threats in Europe, per ECDC and Suomen Rokotepalvelu. Measles outbreaks are seen across Europe, including 40 cases tied to Sweden’s Urkult festival as of 9 September; 28 festival and 12 secondary infections, plus one travel-related case in Finland on a cruise. EU/EEA measles totals for Aug 2025–Jul 2026 are 2,339, with clusters in Bulgaria, Italy, Spain, and France. Outside Europe, outbreaks occur in the United States, Mexico, and Asia (Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines). West Nile virus infections in Europe reached 1,765 by late September, concentrated in Italy, Greece, and Spain; symptoms include fever, headache and myalgia, with rare brain inflammation; higher risk for elderly and immunocompromised. Asia also faces dengue, chikungunya and malaria during the rainy season; Thailand reports 21,620 dengue cases and 31 deaths by end-August. Check travel vaccines and disease status before travel, says Anu Munkki.

article.articleHeadline: La peste como arma biológica: ¿Qué riesgo existe?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague as a Biological Weapon: What Risk Does It Pose?
article.articleSummary: US accuses Russia and others of developing prohibited biological weapons amid an unresolved incident at the Irkutsk plague laboratory. The Irkutsk Institute of Plague Research has long housed virulent strains of Yersinia pestis and anthrax; officially for public health, a US study alleges links to Soviet-era bioweapons programs. Euronews spoke with Dr. Mirko Himmel, who differentiates defensive biodefense research from offensive bioweapons development. Biodefense work, including on plague, is reported to occur in the US, UK, Russia, China and EU states; public records of offensive programs are sparse, though the US suspects China, Russia, North Korea and Iran. Theoretically, plague could be dispersed as bioaerosols inhaled to cause pneumonic plague via planes or explosive devices. The 1975 Biological Weapons Convention lacks a verification mechanism, so no public proof of offensive plague arsenals exists, leaving civil society uncertain.

article.articleHeadline: Ghana Pilots Simple Home-Visit Checklist to Find Hidden Tropical Diseases
article.articleSummary: Ghana piloted a simple home-visit checklist to detect neglected tropical diseases (NTDs). Sixty-four Community Health Officers across Kassena Nankana West (north), Nkwanta South (middle belt) and Ga South (coastal) conducted 1,932 household visits from September to December 2023, generating over 1,100 suspected case observations. Using seven syndromic indicators—blood in urine; skin lesions; visible deformities; eye complications; lymphoedema or limb swelling; suspected hydrocele; and deep skin wounds with undermined edges—mapped to urogenital schistosomiasis, lymphatic filariasis, onchocerciasis, trachoma, yaws, scabies or leprosy morbidity. Skin lesions dominated (1,117 observations). Ga South produced 75% of blood-in-urine reports; Kassena Nankana West contributed 80.8% of lymphoedema and 67.5% of eye conditions; visible deformities concentrated in Ga South; deep wounds clustered in Nkwanta South and Ga South. Uptake of protocols exceeded 85% among trained workers, illustrating frontline surveillance feasibility to inform targeted resource allocation under the WHO 2021–2030 NTD roadmap.

triage.notes: 本記事は顧みられない熱帯病(NTD)の既知流行地域における検診手法（ホームビジットチェックリスト）の有効性評価研究であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生危機の報告ではない。対象疾患（住血吸虫症、リンパ系フィラリア症、オンコセルカ症、トラコーマ、イチゴ腫、疥癬、ハンセン病）は従来から風土病として知られているものであり、トリアージ対象としての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cazul de ciumă din Rusia. Profesor, Oxford: Nu e o boală a trecutului. Trecem prin cicluri de panică şi uitare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's plague case. Oxford professor: It's not a disease of the past. We are going through cycles of panic and forgetfulness.
article.articleSummary: Possible plague case in Russia renews attention to Yersinia pestis and prompts WHO to demand transparent information to determine if pneumonic plague, which transmits via human-to-human droplets, is involved. Two forms: bubonic (flea-borne from rodents; fever, malaise, and swollen lymph nodes) and pneumonic (lung infection; rapid transmission and high fatality without treatment). Without prompt therapy, mortality can reach about 90%. Recent Madagascar-led studies show timely treatment lowers bubonic mortality to about 4%. The bacterium remains in nature: a reservoir across America, Africa, and Eurasia, with over 200 wild rodent species; occasional US cases, including a death in Arizona last year. WHO assesses risk of wide spread as low to very low. Climate change and ecosystem shifts expand vectors; Europe already encounters dengue, chikungunya, West Nile. International data sharing, surveillance, vaccines, and sustained public health collaboration are essential; the Russia incident deserves watchful but calm scrutiny.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト症例について。オックスフォード大学教授：「過去の病気ではない。我々はパニックと忘却のサイクルを繰り返している」
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はロシアでのペスト疑い症例であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のいずれにも該当しない。WHOも拡大リスクを低いと評価しており、監視対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Tiny Vesicles Reveal How Toxoplasma gondii Quietly Rewires Its Host
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasma gondii, a globally widespread single-celled parasite infecting billions, communicates with its host not only through rhoptry, microneme, and dense granule secretion but via extracellular vesicles (EVs) that function as a parallel signaling axis. A Parasites & Vectors review led by Erick Fonseca Balbino and Izadora Volpato Rossi from Brazilian institutions (State University of Londrina; Federal University of Uberlândia; Federal University of Triângulo Mineiro; Fiocruz Carlos Chagas Institute) argues EVs extend the parasite’s secretory toolkit, carrying parasite- and host-derived cargo, including rhoptry/microneme/dense granule proteins, regulatory microRNAs, and bioactive lipids. EVs are produced using conserved eukaryotic machinery (ESCRT, SNARE) in parasite multivesicular bodies, generating vesicles reflecting both parasite and host physiology. Functional themes include infection priming, immune modulation (dampened Th1 signaling and tolerance), and neural reprogramming, contributing to lifelong persistence. Characterization relies on ultracentrifugation, size-exclusion chromatography, nanoparticle tracking, electron microscopy, mass spectrometry, Western blot, and lipidomics.

triage.headline_ja: 微小小胞がトキソプラズマ・ゴンディイの宿主改変メカニズムを明らかに
