article.articleHeadline: WHO says Kenya's Patient Zero might have contracted Ebola in DRC
article.articleSummary: Kenya's first imported Ebola patient may have contracted Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo while seeking treatment for another illness, according to WHO. The investigation notes a one‑month illness‑to‑death interval and suggests infection could have occurred in a health facility or in the community during care, rather than at symptom onset. The Kenyan citizen, who had lived in DRC for seven years, fell ill about a month before traveling by road to Kampala and then by Jambojet flight 8523 to Nairobi, arriving Oct 3. He was isolated at Nairobi Hospital; a sample collected on Oct 5 tested positive for Bundibugyo virus at both the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI, and he died the same day. A safe burial and public‑health measures, including contact tracing linked to the international flight, have been initiated. No specific facility has been named as the infection source; investigators will reconstruct the journey and illness progression.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ケニアの『患者ゼロ』はDRCでエボラに感染した可能性があると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの感染が疑われるエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）症例がケニアへ国際便で輸入され、死亡・接触者追跡が発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の高い該当数から緊急評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源として疑われるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。国際便での移動・接触者追跡が行われており、さらなる続報（感染源施設の特定、二次感染の有無）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Корь вернулась: вспышки опасной болезни фиксируют по всему миру из-за отказа от прививок // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles has returned: outbreaks of a dangerous disease are being recorded worldwide due to vaccine refusal.
article.articleSummary: Measles has returned worldwide due to vaccine refusal, with rubella and pertussis resurging in Russia where 28% abstain from immunization. Anti-vaccine sentiment is higher among youth, blaming vaccines for harm or promoting pharma-conspiracy memes online. By 2025, vaccination rates fell to a ten-year low, notably for measles, hepatitis A and tuberculosis. In the United States, measles cases approach 4,000, a 35-year high, with two-thirds in children or teens; New York has declared a state of emergency as eradication proclaimed in 2000 fades. Pertussis outbreaks reappear, and reports of plague, Legionella, typhus, and typhoid rise. In Bangladesh, the world’s largest measles outbreak has killed nearly 1,000, with about 80% of cases under 18; infants under 9 months are at highest risk due to vaccination gaps. Indonesia (including Bali), Vietnam, and Thailand also rank among top measles transmitters.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が復活：ワクチン拒否により世界中で危険な感染症の流行が記録されている
triage.triage_reason: 複数国（タイ、インドネシア、ベトナム含む）で麻疹が深刻な流行を示し、ワクチン忌避による異常な再興と国際的拡大が確認されるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は世界的な麻疹再興の概況報道であり、米国・ロシア・バングラデシュ等も言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイ・インドネシア（バリ含む）・ベトナムは麻疹伝播の上位国として明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Տարեսկզբից ի վեր Ամերիկայի երկրներում հայտնաբերվել է կարմրուկի շուրջ 55 800 դեպք
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Since the start of the year, about 55,800 measles cases have been detected in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: From Jan 1 to Oct 3, 2026, the Americas reported about 55,792 confirmed measles cases across 17 countries/territories, 4.8 times higher than the same period in 2025. In epidemiological weeks 37–38 (Sept 13–26), 687 new cases were recorded: United States 293; Guatemala 200; Peru 155; Mexico 34; Bolivia 3; Canada and Brazil 1 each. For 2026, Guatemala accounts for the largest burden with 34,355 cases, followed by Mexico 13,595; United States 3,887; Peru 2,553; Canada 1,121, together representing 99.5% of all confirmed cases. The regional death toll stands at 77 this year: Guatemala 50; Mexico 23; United States 2; Peru 1; Bolivia 1. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease transmitted by airborne droplets, primarily affecting children but also adults, with potential complications including otitis, meningitis, and encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 年初からアメリカ大陸諸国で麻疹の症例が約55,800件確認
triage.triage_reason: アメリカ大陸17カ国・地域で麻疹が前年同期比4.8倍に急増し、死者77人を含む大規模発生であるため、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大）を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はアメリカ大陸全体（主にグアテマラ・メキシコ・米国・ペルー）の麻疹流行を扱っており、ブラジルは週37-38に1例報告されたのみで、対象国の中でブラジルの関与は極めて限定的。地域全体としては重大な公衆衛生事象だが、ブラジル単独でのリスクは低い可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Fractional optimal control of hantavirus transmission between rodents and humans
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus transmission between rodents and humans is studied via fractional-order optimal control using Caputo derivatives to capture memory effects in rodent dynamics, environmental contamination, and host recovery. Hantavirus is a serious zoonosis transmitted mainly through inhalation of aerosolized particles from infected rodents; strains include hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome and hantavirus pulmonary syndrome. Human-to-human transmission has been reported in specific outbreaks. Rodents are the primary reservoirs; ecological conditions, climate fluctuations, rodent migration, and habitat changes influence persistence and transmission; Asia and South America show increasing prevalence, with Indonesia hosting infected rodent reservoirs in several provinces. Classical ordinary differential equation models offer qualitative insights, but fractional-order models better capture long-memory effects. Fractional optimal control marries memory-aware dynamics with intervention strategies to minimize costs, integrating rodent reduction, environmental sanitation, and treatment controls. The framework reflects broader applications in epidemic systems, and Caputo-based models have been developed for other diseases, such as foot-and-mouth disease.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスのげっ歯類と人間間の伝播に関する分数最適制御
triage.triage_reason: 記事はハンタウイルスに関する数学モデル研究であり、インドネシアの感染病の実発生イベントではなく理論的研究論文。現在進行形のアウトブレイク報告がなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はNature Scientific Reportsに掲載された学術論文であり、ハンタウイルス伝播の数学的モデリング研究。記事サマリーはインドネシアにおけるげっ歯類の保有状況に言及しているが、具体的な現在進行形のアウトブレイク、患者数、死亡数などの実発生データは記載されていない。理論研究論文であるため、実際の感染症イベント報告とは区別される。疾患としてハンタウイルス感染症が対象であり公衆衛生的関心は存在するが、このシグナルが具体的なリスク評価に値するかは続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uélé: les équipes de riposte encouragées à éradiquer l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uélé: Outbreak response teams urged to eradicate the outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Haut-Uélé, Northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts WHO to press for eradication. At a planning meeting in Isiro on October 9, 2026, WHO incident manager Dr Catherine Smallwood urged coordination teams to intensify actions across the province. The WHO has a sizable response, with staff deployed in all affected health zones and also in zones not yet affected to prepare and detect cases early, working in close partnership with other actors. Smallwood said the response must advance without regret, implementing interventions to overcome transmission and to anticipate spread in Haut-Uélé, which, unlike Ituri and Nord-Kivu, remains the focus for early action. Community engagement is essential, with teams urged to engage residents for better case management. INSP incident manager Dr Styve AUKA attended, underscoring continued WHO support at all levels.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：対応チームに流行根絶を促す - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクがコンゴ民主共和国複数州で継続中であり、WHOが大規模な対応を展開していることから公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: オートウエレ州での新規拡大が懸念されており、イツリ州・北キブ州と合わせ複数州にまたがるエボラ流行が継続中。WHOが積極的に対応支援を行っている。

article.articleHeadline: MP-BA identifica bactéria fecal na água de comunidade quilombola na Chapada Diamantina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia Public Prosecutor's Office identifies fecal bacteria in the water of a quilombola community in Chapada Diamantina.
article.articleSummary: In Bahia, Brazil, the Public Prosecutor’s Office identifies fecal contamination in water from Comunidade Quilombola Queimada Nova, Morro do Chapéu, Chapada Diamantina. Technical reports find total coliforms in cisterns, the well network, and the local desalination system, with Escherichia coli detected in desalinated water, indicating fecal pollution. The regional groundwater shows elevated sulfur and high salinity, worsened by chronic drought, lack of sewage infrastructure, and improper open-dump waste disposal. The MP-BA opened investigations, formally requesting Morro do Chapéu’s municipal authorities to provide maintenance plans for wells and the desalination unit, the schedule for water trucks, sanitation solutions, and waste management. Embasa is asked to assess the feasibility of expanding the water network. Emergency measures include distributing sodium hypochlorite and diarrhea-control actions, health impact assessments, risk mitigation for flood-prone homes, official recognition of the quilombola school, CadÚnico updates, and strengthened food security programs. Signed by Gabriela Gomes Cerqueira Ferreira (Regional Environmental Prosecutor, Jacobina).

triage.headline_ja: バイア州検察、シャパーダ・ジアマンチーナのキロンボーラ・コミュニティの水から糞便性細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一コミュニティの水質汚染に関する行政・環境問題であり、疾病アウトブレイクの報告や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は水質汚染に対する検察の是正措置を報じたもので、感染症の発生やアウトブレイクを示す記述はない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本件は環境・行政問題が主題であり、感染症イベントとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: BKHIT Maluku pantau MTBC pada sapi di Kabupaten Maluku Tengah guna cegah penyakit ternak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BKHIT Maluku monitors Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex in cattle in Central Maluku Regency to prevent livestock diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Maluku's Animal, Fish and Plant Quarantine Agency (BKHIT Maluku) is monitoring the Mycobacterium tuberculosis Complex (MTBC) in cattle in Kobisadar District, Central Maluku Regency, to detect bovine tuberculosis risk and prevent zoonotic transmission to humans. Twenty-five cattle will be tested with the tuberculin skin test, involving intradermal tuberculin injection and a 72-hour observation. MTBC includes pathogens such as Mycobacterium bovis, which can affect cattle and people, impacting livestock health, productivity, and food safety. The activity is part of the 2026 HPHK (Hama dan Penyakit Hewan Karantina) monitoring program to map disease status, incidence, and distribution, guiding quarantine controls and animal-health measures under a One Health approach. Results will inform risk assessment, surveillance planning, and sustaining Maluku’s livestock sector and food security.

triage.headline_ja: BKHITマルクが家畜病予防のため中マルク県の牛における牛結核菌複合体（MTBC）を監視
triage.triage_reason: 牛25頭を対象としたルーチンの検疫モニタリング活動であり、ヒトへの感染事例や公衆衛生上の異常事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は家畜検疫当局による定例的なサーベイランス活動の報告であり、人の症例やアウトブレイクは確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Studi Ungkap Kasus Malaria dan DBD Dipengaruhi Perubahan Iklim, Apa Kaitannya?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study Reveals Malaria and Dengue Fever Cases Are Influenced by Climate Change: What’s the Connection?
article.articleSummary: Monash University researchers report that climate change, via warmer temperatures and altered rainfall, can influence malaria and dengue fever transmission by expanding suitable habitats for Anopheles and Aedes mosquitoes, though effects are non-linear and vary by season and location. The study, published in Science Advances, emphasizes that vector control, urbanization, and housing conditions also shape risk. In Indonesia, malaria cases rose from about 418,000 in 2023 to 706,000 in 2025, while dengue fever affected about 161,937 people in 2025 (57.02 per 100,000). Researchers, including Dr. Toby Cumming and Associate Professor Henry Surendra, collaborated with Indonesia’s Ministry of Health in Kalimantan Timur to identify climate, environmental, and demographic drivers. Prevention strategies call for an integrated approach beyond climate, including vector control and health interventions. The World Mosquito Program’s Wolbachia-infected Aedes releases aim to reduce dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 研究、気候変動がマラリアとデング熱の症例に影響を与えることを明らかに―その関連性とは？
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるマラリア・デング熱症例数の増加傾向を報じる学術研究紹介記事であり、急性の公衆衛生危機ではないが、症例増加の継続性から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動とマラリア・デング熱の関連を論じる学術研究の紹介であり、突発的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ただしインドネシアでの症例数増加（マラリア2023年41.8万→2025年70.6万件）は継続的なベクター媒介感染症の負荷増大を示唆し、注視の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC urges heightened regional preparedness as Ebola cases reach 8,750
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-09, Africa CDC reports Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak across DRC, Uganda, and Kenya has reached 8,750 confirmed cases, 4,208+ deaths (case fatality 48.1%), 2,288 recoveries, and 1,066 in isolation. The crisis is described as the fastest-growing and second-largest on record (week 21), with 4.1× more cases and 3.7× more deaths than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Kenya records a first imported Bundibugyo case: a 40-year-old Kenyan who had lived in the DRC for seven years died in Nairobi after traveling through DRC, Uganda, and Kenya; contact tracing and heightened surveillance are underway. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, malaise, pain, and bleeding, reflecting transmission risk across borders. Beyond DRC, Uganda, and Kenya, ten other high-risk countries are South Sudan, Rwanda, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia. Africa CDC declared a public health emergency of continental security on May 18; WHO PHEIC followed the day before.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱症例が8,750人に達し地域の警戒強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダ・ケニアにまたがるブンディブジョ型エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、症例数・死亡者数ともに過去最大規模に達し、WHO PHEICおよびアフリカCDCの大陸規模緊急事態宣言が出されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ザンビアは記事中で『高リスク国』として言及されているのみで、実際の確定症例報告はないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生国はDRC、ウガンダ、ケニアだが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry declares Yellow Fever outbreak in Upper West Region
article.articleSummary: Yellow Fever outbreak declared in Ghana's Upper West Region after laboratory confirmation of three deaths among suspected cases presenting with fever, jaundice, and bleeding since September 9 in Sissala West and Wa West. Local testing followed by confirmation at a WHO-accredited lab in Dakar, Senegal. The Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh declared the outbreak under International Health Regulations (2005) and Act 851, 2012. National and Regional Public Health Emergency Operations Centres have been activated; Rapid Response Teams deployed for case finding, surveillance, and risk communication. A targeted emergency vaccination campaign is planned for October in affected and at-risk districts including Wa West, Sissala West, and Sissala East. Additional measures include promoting insect repellent use and sleeping under insecticide-treated bed nets during the day, strengthening case management, heightened surveillance, and intensified risk communication. Public urged to seek care for fever, jaundice, bleeding, eliminate stagnant water, and follow official MOH/GHS updates.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アッパーウェスト州で黄熱病の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ・アッパーウェスト州で黄熱病による死亡例が検査確認され、保健省がIHR(2005)に基づき流行を宣言、緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンや対策本部を稼働させるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な対応が取られているため。
triage.notes: セネガル・ダカールは検体確認を行ったWHO認定ラボの所在地であり、発生地域ではないため対象から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Wanaparthy Food Poisoning: Around 25 Students Fall Ill At Girls Hostel
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning sickened around 25 female students at the Girls’ Hostel of the Women's Polytechnic College on the outskirts of Pebbair in Wanaparthy district, Hyderabad. The students reported vomiting, fever and weakness after a night of illness; several were taken to Pebbair Primary Health Centre for examination and treatment, with conditions described as stable. As of 09 Oct 2026, the exact cause remains unestablished and no laboratory confirmation has been reported. Allegations point to consumption of chicken curry as a possible source, though authorities have not confirmed this. Officials visited the hostel to assess safety and student health in the wake of the incident, raising concerns about food safety at the campus hostel. Investigations are ongoing to identify the infection source and determine whether this represents an outbreak or a cluster of foodborne illness.

triage.headline_ja: ワナパルティーの食中毒:女子寮で約25人の学生が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内での食中毒疑い事案であり、原因不明の病原体や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、小規模な局所的事例にとどまる。
triage.notes: 症状は食中毒に典型的（嘔吐・発熱・脱力感）で、患者の容体は安定。特定の病原体や感染症アウトブレイクを示す情報はなく、地域の公衆衛生当局による通常の調査対応で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 4,205 Dead in Outbreak; Trump Admin Broke Federal Law; Viola Davis' Shingles
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Congo reports 8,728 Ebola cases and 4,205 deaths in an outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, per WHO. In the United States, a massive cyclosporiasis outbreak causing diarrhea has eroded public confidence in food safety (Gallup). Taylor Farms will halt iceberg lettuce production in Mexico during CDC’s defined cyclosporiasis season from May through the end of August. Walgreens data show purchases of cold and flu medicines up over 20% from last year. A GAO report says the Trump administration withheld Congress-appropriated AHRQ grant funding; a Commonwealth Fund survey flags Medicare affordability concerns. Actress Viola Davis discusses her bout with shingles. WHO unveils a roadmap to tackle hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and new guidance to reduce reliance on institutionalizing people with mental illness. The United States and Zambia sign a $2.49B health-financing deal after removing specimen-sharing and patient-data clauses.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大で4,205人死亡；トランプ政権が連邦法に違反；ヴィオラ・デイビスの帯状疱疹
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、8,728症例・4,205死亡という甚大な公衆衛生被害が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ（コンゴ）、サイクロスポーラ症（米国・メキシコ）、インフルエンザ（米国）など複数疾病・地域を含む混合ニュースダイジェストだが、公衆衛生上最も重大な事象はコンゴのエボラアウトブレイク。米国・ザンビア間の健康資金協定はエボラ対応支援の文脈と推測されるが、ザンビア国内での疾病発生は記載されていないため verified_locations から除外。米国・メキシコは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : 13 patients guéris en deux jours, dont trois soignants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: 13 patients recovered in two days, including three healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo: Thirteen patients recovered and were discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center at Beni General Referral Hospital between October 7 and 8, 2026. The cohort includes a physician and two nurses who had contracted Ebola. An initial wave of eight patients left the center on October 7, followed by five more on October 8, bringing the two-day total to 13. Among the five on October 8 is Dr Alex, who contracted the virus while treating patients. Dr Jérémie Muhindo, medical director of the hospital, said the health professional had been engaged in the response since the outbreak began and is now cured after care. Two nurses are among the five discharged. Despite these recoveries, vigilance remains essential to prevent new infections and limit spread in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：2日間で13人の患者が回復、うち3人は医療従事者
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて医療従事者を含む感染者が発生しており、重篤な疾患かつヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがあるため、継続的なモニタリングが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は患者の回復という好転的内容だが、医療従事者（医師・看護師）への感染が確認されており、進行中のアウトブレイクであることから引き続き警戒が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương khoanh vùng, khống chế ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết tại phường Hải Bình
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently cordon off and control the dengue fever outbreak in Hai Binh Ward.
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases were confirmed in Liên Hải hamlet, Hai Binh Ward, by the morning of October 9, 2026. The first case began on September 26 and was admitted to Nghi Son General Hospital on October 1 with high fever, headache, and myalgia; laboratory testing confirmed dengue. After a week of treatment, the patient recovered and was discharged. Following the initial detection, the health sector and local authorities implemented epidemiological investigation, environmental sanitation, and vector control, including insecticide spraying. Despite these measures, mosquito and larval indices remained high, necessitating a second insecticide spray on October 9 within a 200-meter radius of the patient’s home. The Nghi Son Center for Health, Hai Binh Health Station, and local authorities intensified community surveillance, surveying households within 200 meters and the Liên Hải hamlet, to identify suspected cases early. Clinics and pharmacies were urged to report suspected dengue cases, with ongoing public health messaging via local broadcasts three times daily.

triage.headline_ja: ハイビン区で発生したデング熱の感染源を緊急に封じ込め、制圧する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム北中部の一地区で小規模なデング熱クラスター（5例）が発生し、当局が対応中だが、現時点で重症例や拡大の明確な証拠はなく、通常の季節性デング対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアで季節性に発生する地方病であり、5例のクラスターは地域的な公衆衛生対応の範囲内。蚊媒介指数が高く防除継続中のため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Students fall ill after dinner at Telangana polytechnic college
article.articleSummary: At least 50 students fell ill after dinner of chicken at Women’s Polytechnic College on the outskirts of Pebberu town, Wanaparth district, Telangana, on October 8. Several were taken to Pebberu Primary Health Centre for tests by the hostel warden’s husband, reportedly without informing parents or authorities. College staff dismissed food poisoning and attributed symptoms to fever; a video shows a student describing fever after dinner. The college claimed a health camp on October 7 diagnosed 22 students with viral fever, though the principal denied knowledge of any such camp. Hospital staff reportedly supported the warden’s account of post-dinner events. Pebberu Municipal Chairperson Srinivas Gou and Congress leaders visited the college to inquire about students’ health amid the incident. No confirmed cause yet; investigation ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: テランガーナ州の工科大学で夕食後に学生らが体調不良
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内での食事後の体調不良事例であり、原因は食中毒またはウイルス性発熱の可能性が高く、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元政治家が見舞いに訪れるなど地域的な関心はあるが、感染症としての国際的な懸念事項には該当せず、食中毒または季節性ウイルス性発熱の可能性が高い単発事例と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Τι είναι η πανώλη και ποιοι κινδυνεύουν
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the plague, and who is at risk?
article.articleSummary: Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is a global concern after a Siberia laboratory worker’s death prompted renewed vigilance. A WHO report (2019–2025) records 3,860 suspected cases worldwide, with six countries reporting confirmed infections; the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar have the highest annual totals. In the EU, no cases are recorded for decades; the US CDC reports about five human cases per year, with the last fatality in 2025. The disease has three forms: bubonic (most common; tender lymph nodes and fever), septicemic (shock and multiorgan failure), and pneumonic (rapid pneumonia, dyspnea, cough, sometimes hemoptysis). Transmission is mainly zoonotic via fleas and handling infected animals; cats can be sources, and pneumonic plague enables human-to-human spread by droplets. Risk groups include residents/visitors to endemic areas, hunters, handlers of dead animals, veterinarians, lab and health-care workers; poor access to care increases risk.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト（黒死病）とは何か、誰がリスクにさらされているのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はシベリアの検査技師死亡を契機としたペストに関する一般的な解説記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。DRC・マダガスカルへの言及は過去のWHO統計に基づく背景情報に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はペストに関する教育的・解説的内容であり、具体的な新規症例やアウトブレイクの発生地点を報告するものではない。発生地域リストにDRC・マダガスカル・米国・ロシアが含まれるが、いずれも過去の統計や発端事例（ロシアの検査技師死亡）の文脈であり、対象国での現在進行中の具体的イベントとは言えないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Gadchiroli Malaria Control | गडचिरोलीत हिवतापावर नियंत्रण; पॉझिटिव्हिटी दर ०.३२ टक्क्यांवर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gadchiroli Malaria Control | Malaria control in Gadchiroli; positivity rate at 0.32 percent.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Gadchiroli district in Maharashtra reports notable malaria control gains. Malaria positivity dropped from 0.49% (Jan–Sep 2025) to 0.32% (Jan–Sep 2026), and cases declined from 6,411 to 3,940. From January to September 2026, 1,219,783 malaria tests were performed: 507,675 blood smear microscopy and 712,108 rapid diagnostic tests. The annual parasite index fell from 6.42 to 4.62. Up to July 2026, six malaria deaths occurred; August–September recorded zero malaria deaths. Vector control included indoor residual spraying in 1,195 villages covering 160,956 households, and 116,372 insecticide-treated nets distributed. In 150 ashram schools, 39,663 students were screened; 371 infected and 566 treated, with total compensation of Rs 283,000 paid to treated students. Gadchiroli ranks first nationwide in NITI Aayog Delta Ranking. Two girls went missing from a Maseli ashram school; investigations ongoing. Citizens are urged to use bed nets, avoid standing water, and seek prompt testing for fever.

triage.headline_ja: Gadchiroli マラリア制御 | ガドチロリ県でマラリアを制御、陽性率0.32%に低下
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例・陽性率はむしろ改善傾向にあり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体によるマラリア対策の成功事例を報告する内容であり、感染症危機シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh dịch hạch từng khiến hàng chục triệu người chết hiện có thực sự nguy hiểm?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Plague That Once Killed Tens of Millions: Is It Really Dangerous Today?
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis) remains a public health concern. In Siberia, a 28-year-old woman who worked at the Irkutsk Institute for Plague Research in Shelekhov died on Oct 2, with Russian officials attributing the death to pneumonia and denying an outbreak risk. Since the 1990s, most human cases have occurred in Africa (Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar), per WHO, while the United States sees about seven cases annually, mostly in rural western states, per CDC. Plague presents as bubonic (most common) with painful lymph node swelling; pneumonic form causes respiratory symptoms and can spread via inhaled droplets; septicemic form involves the bloodstream. Transmission occurs mainly via flea bites from infected rodents or contact with infected body fluids; pneumonic plague can transmit person-to-person through droplets. Early antibiotic treatment is effective; vaccines exist but are not proven for pneumonic plague, recommended only for high-risk workers. Earliest evidence dates ~5,500 years ago near Lake Baikal.

triage.headline_ja: かつて数千万人を死に至らしめたペスト、現在も本当に危険なのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペストに関する一般的な解説記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ロシアでの死亡例も当局が流行リスクを否定しており、対象国（DRC等）への言及も歴史的・疫学的背景説明に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの歴史・病型・ロシアでの1例の死亡（当局は肺炎死と説明し流行否定）を扱う解説記事。DRCやマダガスカルへの言及は1990年代以降の症例分布に関する一般的な疫学背景であり、現在進行中の具体的アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、対象国として確定できる新規イベントはない。

article.articleHeadline: บุรีรัมย์ผวา! เด็ก 5 ขวบสงสัยมือเท้าปากเสียชีวิต อาการทรุดใน 3 วัน กรมควบคุมโรคเตือน 4 สัญญาณอันตราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buriram shaken! 5-year-old dies after suspected hand, foot and mouth disease; condition worsened within 3 days; Department of Disease Control warns of 4 danger signs.
article.articleSummary: Buriram, Thailand — a 5-year-old girl died after suspected hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD); deterioration occurred within three days of onset after returning from school. The Department of Disease Control is investigating, collecting samples for laboratory confirmation and analyzing Enterovirus strains, with emphasis on Enterovirus 71 due to risks of severe complications such as encephalitis and myocarditis. Common circulating HFMD strains Coxsackievirus A6 and A16 are typically milder; Enterovirus 71 accounts for about 5–15% of detections annually and is linked to fatalities. National surveillance reports 81,829 HFMD cases and 1 death (age 2y10m) from Jan 1–Oct 5, 2569 BE (2026), with 7,802 hospitalizations. Highest incidence provinces: Chiang Rai, Chonburi, Bangkok. Preventive measures in schools: strict daily screening, isolate ill children, close classrooms if 2+ cases in a week, thorough cleaning, and rigorous hand hygiene; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: ブリーラム震撼！5歳児が手足口病疑いで死亡、発症から3日で容体急変、疾病管理局が危険な兆候4つを警告
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内で手足口病（HFMD）による小児死亡例が報告され、EV71による重症化（脳炎・心筋炎）の可能性が懸念されており、学校での感染拡大のリスクと社会的関心の高まりが見られるため。
triage.notes: 国内では年間81,829例のHFMD症例・1例の死亡が報告されており、季節性の既知疾患として国内サーベイランス体制下で対応が進められている。EV71株による重症化の可能性が焦点。

article.articleHeadline: В странах Америки выявили почти 55,8 тыс. случаев кори с начала года
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Americas, nearly 55,800 measles cases have been identified since the start of the year.
article.articleSummary: Between Jan 1 and Oct 3, 2026, the Americas reported 55,792 confirmed measles cases, 4.8 times higher than the same period in 2025, per PAHO. In weeks 37–38 (Sept 13–26), the United States accounted for 293 of 687 cases; Guatemala 200; Peru 155; Mexico 34; Bolivia 3; Canada and Brazil 1 each. For 2026, Guatemala leads with 34,355 cases, followed by Mexico 13,595; United States 3,887; Peru 2,553; Canada 1,121, comprising 99.5% of regional cases. There have been 77 deaths region-wide this year: Guatemala 50; Mexico 23; United States 2; Peru 1; Bolivia 1. PAHO notes persistent low-level transmission with sporadic chains that could sustain circulation for more than 12 months. On Oct 6, Russia offered to assist the United States in outbreak response; the U.S. CDC reports 2026 measles activity highest since 1991. Measles is highly contagious and spreads airborne; complications include otitis media, meningitis, and encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 米州で年初から約5万5800件の麻疹症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大)に該当し、PAHOによる地域全体での麻疹急増・死亡77人・ロシアによる米国への支援申し出など社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米州全体（主にグアテマラ・メキシコ・米国・ペルー・カナダ）の麻疹流行であり、対象国の中ではブラジルが週37-38で1例報告されたのみ。ブラジル国内での大規模流行を示す情報はなく、対象国としての重要性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya'da ilk Ebola ölümü sonrası temaslı sayısı 57'ye çıktı, 10 kişi karantinada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, after the first Ebola death, the number of contacts rose to 57, with 10 people in quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reported its first Ebola-related death after the patient died on the night of 5 October. Contacts linked to the case rose to 57, with 10 under quarantine at Nairobi’s National Police Hospital; others are under daily monitoring, and about 17 more contacts have been traced. Health Minister Aden Duale said there is no outbreak, and the confirmed case is a Kenyan who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and traveled to Nairobi via Kampala, Uganda. The patient developed symptoms, was isolated in Nairobi, and tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus at the Kenya National Virology Reference Laboratory and the Kenya Medical Research Institute, receiving supportive care before dying on 5 October. Burial occurred at Lang’ata Cemetery with precautions. Kenya is the fourth country to report Bundibugyo-linked cases after the DRC, Uganda, and France. Over 652,000 travelers screened; 267 samples tested; about 5,000 health workers trained. Transmission is via blood, body fluids, or contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで初のエボラ死亡例、接触者数が57人に増加、10人が隔離中
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による死亡例が確認され、接触者57人・隔離者10人と拡大の兆候があり、複数国にまたがる感染連鎖の可能性があるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRC在住歴がありウガンダ経由でケニアに入国した症例で、今回のイベントの発生国はケニア（対象国リスト外）。DRC・ウガンダ・フランスは過去のブンディブギョ株関連国として言及されているのみで、今回の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Second plague case in Siberia? Russia responds after WHO presses Moscow for answers over 28-year-old researcher's death
article.articleSummary: Darya Shipilova, 28, a laboratory worker at a Siberian anti-plague research institute in Irkutsk, died Oct 2 from pneumonia of unknown origin. Russia rejects claims of a second pneumonic plague case after reports that another employee fell ill; the WHO has asked Moscow for information to clarify the death, the pathogen involved, and reports of a second case. As of Oct 9, 2026, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor says there is no link to pneumonic plague and has completed contact tracing, with nearly 5,000 laboratory tests finding no dangerous pathogens associated with the institute. The agency noted Shipilova’s illness was pneumonia of unknown origin. Disinfection and protective gear were observed near Shipilova’s apartment; some Russian outlets reported a quarantine in Shelekhov, Irkutsk region, drawing unwelcome comparisons to Wuhan, though authorities stress no confirmed outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで第2のペスト症例か？WHOがモスクワに28歳研究者死亡の経緯説明を求め、ロシアが反応
triage.triage_reason: WHOがロシアに説明を求めるなど国際的関心は高いが、ロシア当局は肺ペストとの関連を否定し危険病原体は検出されていないとしており、事実関係が未確定なため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 事件発生地はロシア（イルクーツク州）であり対象国リストに含まれない。武漢（中国）は比較対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア当局はペスト関連を否定し、約5000件の検査で危険な病原体は検出されていないと発表しているが、WHOは追加情報を要請しており、続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra's Chittoor district is bird flu-free, says official; farmers advised to remain vigilant
article.articleSummary: Chittoor district in Andhra Pradesh is declared free from bird flu by Animal Husbandry Joint Director Umamaheswari on 9 October 2026. Preventive measures have been implemented to curb any spread, with check posts alerted to poultry movement from other districts and states. Poultry farmers are advised to remain vigilant and strictly follow biosecurity precautions. Authorities urge the public not to panic or believe rumours about eggs or chicken meat; consumption is safe after thorough cooking with due precautions. People should promptly inform local veterinary officers if they observe abnormal changes or deaths in poultry to enable swift containment. For prevention and control guidance, residents may contact local veterinarians. No active outbreak is reported in Chittoor district at this time.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州チットゥール県、鳥インフルエンザ清浄化を宣言、当局が農家に警戒継続を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザが既に終息し清浄化宣言がなされており、現時点で活動中のアウトブレイクは報告されていないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の鳥インフルエンザ終息後の清浄化宣言と予防的注意喚起であり、ヒト感染や新規発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bombay HC seeks stray dog census data, flags gaps in rabies vaccination
article.articleSummary: Bombay High Court in Maharashtra sought a statewide stray dog census plus totals on sterilisation and vaccination to assess rabies-control measures and dog-bite risk. Hearing a suo motu matter linked to a May Supreme Court directive, the court pressed for population figures to gauge the adequacy of sterilisation and vaccination drives. Amicus Desai highlighted data gaps, noting that without reliable stray-population estimates it is hard to judge program effectiveness. Official data list 150,594 dogs sterilised within Urban Local Bodies over the past six months; the figure should be weighed against population estimates. Rabies-prevention gaps include 128 of 831 government hospitals lacking anti-rabies vaccines and 381 lacking rabies immunoglobulin; no dedicated dog-bite helpline was reported. In urban facilities, 19,694 dogs were found; 1,479 (7.5%) moved to shelters; rural-relocation data is Not Applicable. State reported 13,382 sterilisation procedures in September 2026; next hearing is November 2 for updated census and compliance data.

triage.headline_ja: ボンベイ高等裁判所、野良犬の個体数調査データを要求、狂犬病ワクチン接種の不備を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 個別の狂犬病症例急増や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、州の野良犬管理・ワクチン接種体制に関する行政・司法手続きの記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病ワクチン・免疫グロブリン不足や野良犬管理の課題は継続的な公衆衛生リスクを示唆するが、本記事自体は裁判所手続きの報道であり、新規感染事例や急性のアウトブレイクを扱っていない。

article.articleHeadline: 检出致病菌！佛山一餐饮企业引发食源性聚集事件，已立案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pathogenic Bacteria Detected! A Foshan Catering Company Triggers a Foodborne Illness Cluster; A Case Has Been Filed.
article.articleSummary: Pathogenic bacteria were detected in samples linked to a foodborne illness cluster traced to Foshan Huakai Palace Banquet Catering Management Co., Ltd. in Chancheng District, Foshan City. On Oct 9, 2026, the Chancheng District Market Supervision Administration announced investigations after diners reported illness following meals at the company. On-site inspections revealed improper food-handling practices; authorities ordered immediate corrective actions. The bureau commissioned professional laboratories to test ingredients and leftover foods, while the disease control department conducted environmental and personnel sampling. Preliminary findings indicate a foodborne disease cluster with pathogenic bacteria detected in some collected samples. A case has been filed against the catering company. Investigations continue; authorities will act in accordance with law, strengthen food safety risk screening, and safeguard public health.

triage.headline_ja: 病原菌検出！仏山市の飲食企業が食中毒集団発生を引き起こし、立件済み
triage.triage_reason: 単一の飲食店での食中毒事案であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常性は認められず、局所的な食品安全問題として当局が対応中である。
triage.notes: 単一飲食店における食中毒クラスターで、地方の市場監督管理局が調査・是正措置を実施済み。ヒト-ヒト感染性や国際的拡大リスクはない通常の食品安全事案。

article.articleHeadline: Tay chân miệng gia tăng, cảnh báo những dấu hiệu chuyển nặng dễ bị bỏ sót
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease is on the rise: warning signs of progression that are easy to miss.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth disease is rising in Hanoi, Vietnam, with 5,727 cases reported from January 2026 through October 2, 2026, across 126 wards/communes; no deaths recorded. Most cases involve children under 5, especially under 3, many in daycare/preschool settings. The disease is caused by enteroviruses, notably Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71 (EV71); EV71 can cause severe neurological, respiratory, and cardiovascular complications. Transmission occurs via contact with nasal/mouth secretions, stool, or contaminated objects and surfaces. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, irritability, and poor appetite; after 1–2 days, vesicular rashes appear on hands, feet, knees, buttocks, and oral ulcers, often painful to eat. Some cases show subtle signs; severity is not always linked to skin lesions. Three warning signs for progression: prolonged high fever (>39°C) lasting over 2 days, unusual startle reflexes, and tremor or unsteady movement. Seek prompt medical evaluation if these signs are observed.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が増加、見逃しやすい重症化の兆候に注意
triage.triage_reason: ハノイで手足口病（EV71含む）の症例が季節的に増加しているが、死亡例はなく、ベトナムでは毎年発生する風土病的な疾患であるため、現時点では経過観察が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 手足口病はベトナムで季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、EV71は重症化のリスク因子として知られるが、本記事では死亡例なし・症状の多くが軽症とされている。今後の重症例増加や死亡報告の有無を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Πανώλη: Μεταδίδεται από άνθρωπο σε άνθρωπο;
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague: Is it transmitted from person to person?
article.articleSummary: Death of a laboratory worker in Siberia raises vigilance for plague, caused by Yersinia pestis. A September 2026 WHO report covering 2019–2025 notes about 3,860 suspected cases globally, with six countries reporting confirmed cases; most annual cases occur in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar. In the European Union, no cases have been recorded for decades; the United States reports about five human cases per year, last fatality in 2025 in western states. Plague is an acute, potentially fatal bacterial infection linked to small mammals and fleas. Three forms: bubonic (most common; painful buboes, fever), septicemic, pneumonic (rapid pneumonia; high transmission risk via respiratory droplets). Transmission is primarily animal-to-human via fleas or handling infected animals; pneumonic form can spread human-to-human with close, prolonged contact. Risk groups include travelers to endemic areas, hunters, veterinarians, lab and healthcare workers; emphasize rapid diagnosis, isolation, and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：ヒトからヒトへ感染するのか？
triage.triage_reason: ロシア（シベリア）での研究所職員死亡を契機とした一般啓発的な記事であり、対象国における具体的な新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。DRC・マダガスカルは過去の統計的背景情報として言及されているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はシベリア（ロシア）での研究所職員の死亡とペストの一般的な解説であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCやマダガスカルは過去5年間の症例統計の文脈で言及されているのみで、具体的な現行アウトブレイクの発生地ではない。ロシア・米国は対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: ಸಾಂಕ್ರಾಮಿಕ ರೋಗಗಳ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಿನ ಕ್ರಮ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stringent measures to control infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-09, in Madikeri, District Collector S. J. Someshankar chaired the District Surveillance Committee and outlined measures to curb infectious diseases in Kodagu, including dengue, malaria, vector-borne illnesses, dog-bite (rabies) cases, biomedical waste management, hospital infection control, tobacco control, HIV prevention, and HPV vaccination progress. District Health Officer Dr. Satish Kumar said 2,502 febrile samples were tested, with 42 dengue cases confirmed; monsoon activities include house-to-house surveys, larval source reduction, and public awareness. Dog-bite cases up to Sept 2026 total 999; ensure timely anti-rabies vaccination and immunoglobulin supply. The meeting reviewed sanitation, waste disposal, and adherence to national health service standards. Under the National Tobacco Control Programme, 64 raids yielded Rs 109,700 in fines. HPV vaccination as of Aug 6: 70.79% of 5,256 targets (3,735 vaccinated); Somwarpet taluk leads at 74.88%. Kodagu aims to become a Safe+ district by year-end 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症対策の徹底強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の行政会議報告であり、デング熱42例・犬咬傷999件など既存の疾病管理活動の進捗報告にとどまり、異常な増加や国際的懸念は確認されない。
triage.notes: 地方行政による定例サーベイランス委員会の活動報告記事であり、デング熱・狂犬病・HIV等は既存の管理プログラム下で対応されている。新規または異常な発生の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus respiratórios voltam a crescer no Brasil, alerta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory viruses are rising again in Brazil, Fiocruz warns.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Fiocruz warns rising respiratory viruses with SRAG hospitalizations increasing, especially among children and adolescents. Weekly SRAG cases due to COVID-19 remain low, but rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, and SARS-CoV-2 show growing SRAG activity nationwide, while severe RSV and influenza B cases decline. Influenza A hospitalizations stay stable at low levels. The InfoGripe bulletin notes a mild rebound in SRAG admissions among ages 2-14; other age groups stabilize. States at elevated to high risk: Alagoas, Roraima, Sergipe; metapneumovirus linked to growth in Alagoas and Sergipe, while data in Roraima are inconclusive. Five states (Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina) are alert/risk without long-term growth. Capitals Aracaju, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, São Luís, Vitória show SRAG activity at concerning levels. Preventive measures emphasize updated vaccines (COVID-19; RSV vaccination for pregnant people), along with hygiene, ventilation, and seeking care for severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで呼吸器系ウイルスが再び増加、フィオクルスが警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器ウイルス（RSV、メタニューモウイルス、COVID-19等）によるSRAG入院の増加が一部州で見られるが、重症度や国際的拡大のエビデンスは乏しく、通常の季節的サーベイランス情報の範囲内である。
triage.notes: Fiocruz/InfoGripeによる国内サーベイランス速報であり、複数の既知季節性呼吸器病原体（RSV、ヒトメタニューモウイルス、COVID-19、インフルエンザ）の動向報告。特定州（アラゴアス、ロライマ、セルジッピ）で中等度〜高リスクとされるが、全国的な重症化や異常事態の明確な記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Após 241 casos suspeitos de sarna, município de MG suspende aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After 241 suspected cases of scabies, a municipality in Minas Gerais suspends classes.
article.articleSummary: 241 suspected human scabies cases in Lagoa Santa, Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, Minas Gerais, led to suspension of municipal classes on Oct 8–9 as a preventive measure; 50 new suspected cases were reported Oct 6–7. The first case, identified Sept 18 in a municipal school student; Sept 30, one school suspended after 20 students showed symptoms. Health teams inspected schools with parental consent; confirmed cases referred to health units. The suspension is preventive, not outbreak-control. Parents should monitor for intense itching and red skin patches and seek care, following treatment. Classes to resume Oct 19. Scabies is caused by a mite and spreads via direct contact and shared items. Minas Gerais Health Secretariat notes seven outbreaks in 2026 in the state, including Lagoa Santa, Alfenas, Andradas, Campo Gerais, Lavras, Itapecerica, Joaquim Felício, and Coronel Xavier Chaves.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の疑い241件、ミナスジェライス州の自治体で授業を停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性は低く国際的拡大リスクも限定的だが、学校休校など地域的対応が取られており、同州内で複数の集団発生が報告されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症化や国際伝播のリスクが低い皮膚疾患だが、学校を介した集団発生が州内で複数確認されており地域保健当局が対応中。続報で感染拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Le CDC Afrique appelle à renforcer la préparation régionale alors que le nombre de cas d'Ebola atteint 8.750
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC calls for strengthening regional preparedness as the number of Ebola cases reaches 8,750.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa reaches 8,750 confirmed cases, largely in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 4,208 deaths and a case-fatality rate of 48.1%. By October 9, 2026, 2,288 patients had recovered and 1,066 were in isolation. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo strain and Africa CDC calls for heightened regional preparedness and solidarity as the second largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Uganda and Kenya report cases beyond the DRC, with ten other African countries at high risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo (Congo-Brazzaville), Burundi, and Somalia. Wessam Mankoula urged strengthened readiness during a press briefing. On May 18, Africa CDC described the outbreak as a health-security emergency for the continent, a day after WHO labeled it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例数が8,750人に達し、アフリカCDCが地域的な備えの強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率48.1%、史上2番目に大きく最速で拡大している流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでも症例報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ザンビアは『高リスク国』として言及されているのみで実際の発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 孩子出现咳嗽、发烧症状，别硬扛！警惕呼吸道合胞病毒感染丨健康科代表
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When your child develops a cough and fever, don’t tough it out! Be vigilant for respiratory syncytial virus infection | Health Science Column
article.articleSummary: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection in children is highlighted as a common autumn–winter threat in China, with infants under 6 months at highest risk for severe disease, particularly those who are preterm or have congenital heart disease, chronic lung disease, or immune deficiencies. Early RSV symptoms resemble a cold—nasal congestion, runny nose, mild fever, and reduced appetite—but after about two days cough can worsen with wheeze and increased work of breathing; very young infants may not have fever and may present with poor feeding or irritability. Hospitalization is advised for rapid or labored breathing, significant feeding reduction, decreased urine output, or lethargy; for infants under 3 months with fever, urgent care is recommended. Home care includes ensuring ventilation and appropriate humidity, small frequent feeds to prevent dehydration, avoiding tremella soup and Chuanbei powder, avoiding dairy and cold foods, nasal suction, and not using antibiotics. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, ventilation, masking when someone is ill, limiting exposure of high-risk infants, and physician-guided immunoprophylaxis. Originates from Chengdu-based pediatric specialists in Sichuan, China.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもに咳や発熱の症状が出たら無理をさせないで！呼吸器合胞体ウイルス感染症に注意丨健康科学コラム
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSV感染症に関する一般向け健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性RSV感染症についての一般的な医学啓発コンテンツであり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Biakato : 12 jeunes interpellés pour entrave aux activités de la riposte (Administrateur militaire adjoint de Mambasa) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Biakato: 12 youths arrested for hindering outbreak response activities (Deputy Military Administrator of Mambasa) - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 9 October 2026, in Biakato, Mandima health zone, Mambasa territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, twelve young men were arrested for opposing Ebola outbreak response efforts. The incident occurred amid a surge in Ebola virus disease cases as authorities were providing medical assistance to patients. Col. Maxime Tshishimbi, deputy military administrator for Mambasa, said the youths threatened and pelted response teams and will face judicial proceedings. He stressed that hindering outbreak response obstructs lifesaving measures in a health crisis and called on Mandima residents to cooperate with health teams. The commander warned that authorities will restore state authority with exemplary actions and that those who obstruct response will face legal action and security intervention. The report highlights ongoing outbreak management needs in the Biakato area within Ituri's Mandima zone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 ビアカト：対応活動妨害で若者12人逮捕（マンバサ軍事副行政官）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の症例急増が報告されており、対応活動への妨害も発生していることから、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある既知の既存アウトブレイクに関する続報としてフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応活動への妨害行為（逮捕）が主題だが、背景として症例急増（surge in Ebola virus disease cases）が言及されており、既存アウトブレイクの悪化・対応困難化を示す重要な続報と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo busca aprimorar estratégias de controle do maruim, mosquito transmissor da febre Oropouche
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study aims to improve control strategies for the maruim mosquito, the vector of Oropouche fever.
article.articleSummary: Maruim mosquito (Culicoides paraensis) vector studied to curb Oropouche fever in Três Forquilhas, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The state health secretariat expanded monitoring and launched a nine-week field study alternating mosquito collection and insecticide application to test chemical-control strategies, using a mobile unit donated by Fiergs and supported by Sesi-RS. The aim is to block transmission in residential areas and banana cultivation. In Rio Grande do Sul there are no local Oropouche transmissions; since 2024 two imported cases. Nationally, Oropouche activity is increasing in the Southeast (Espírito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais) and has appeared in Santa Catarina and Paraná. Transmission involves sylvatic cycles with wildlife and urban cycles in humans. Symptoms resemble dengue; diagnosis requires clinical, epidemiological, and laboratory confirmation; no specific treatment. The study also seeks to identify species, activity patterns, and early circulation signals of Oropouche virus (Orov) and other arboviruses, and to improve surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: マルイン蚊（オロプーシェ熱媒介蚊）の制御戦略向上を目指す研究
triage.triage_reason: オロプーシェ熱はブラジル南東部で活動が増加しているものの、本記事はベクター対策研究に関する内容で、リオグランデドスル州では現地感染なし（輸入症例2件のみ）であり、緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は研究・監視活動が主題であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。南東部（Espírito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais）でのオロプーシェ活動増加は言及されているが詳細な症例数等は不明。続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow fever outbreak is under control - Health Minister
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreak in Ghana is under control, with 450 suspected cases reported across 16 regions, including 88 in the Upper West Region. Of Upper West suspects, 3 cases have been laboratory-confirmed by the Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research. Cases are in Wa West (27), Sissala West (23), Sissala East (21), Efiama Msua Busa (7), Nadowli-Kaleo (1), Wa East (1), Wa West Municipal (1), and 7 additional in Funsi. Deaths are under investigation and cannot be attributed to yellow fever without lab confirmation. Government is expanding vaccination beyond routine childhood immunisation to cover people aged nine months to 60 years in affected areas; 187,000 more doses have been requested, with vaccination campaigns starting in the Upper West Region. Transmission is via infected mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, headache, body pains, abdominal discomfort; severe cases may bleed. Public urged to use repellents, wear long sleeves and nets, protect themselves during the day, and follow official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病の流行は制御下にある - 保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: ガーナで黄熱病の疑い例450人（16地域に拡大、うち88人がアッパーウェスト地域）が報告され、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 死亡例は検査確認待ちで黄熱病との因果関係は未確定。ワクチン追加18.7万回分を要請し接種対象を拡大中。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Josh teams launched in Cuddalore to intensify TB awareness and prevention
article.articleSummary: On 9 October 2026, Cuddalore district launched the Josh (Joint Squad for Health) teams under the Tuberculosis-Free India campaign at the Cuddalore Collectorate to boost tuberculosis prevention, awareness and community participation. District Collector Sibi Adhithya Senthil Kumar announced district- and block-level coordination committees to expand TB elimination activities. Each block-level team will include a nodal officer, a coordinator, five MY Bharat volunteers, and five National Cadet Corps volunteers. The squads will carry TB awareness messages, support prevention efforts, and encourage public involvement in control measures. Nucleic acid amplification tests (NAAT) are being used to diagnose TB, and outreach teams are visiting villages to conduct X-ray examinations for symptomatic individuals. This work is part of the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme toward eliminating TB and creating a TB-free India by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: クダロールにてTB啓発・予防強化のためJoshチームが発足
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムの一環としての啓発活動の発表であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 国家結核撲滅プログラムの一環である通常の行政的・啓発的取り組みであり、流行や異常発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Município do Acre registra apenas um caso de dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The municipality of Acre records only one dengue case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Santa Rosa do Purus, Acre, has recorded only one dengue case in 2026 to date. The Municipal Health Secretariat attributes this low figure to preventive work by health teams aimed at containing Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector. Efforts include guiding residents on prevention, conducting home visits, and applying products to containers to curb mosquito breeding, in line with surveillance strategies. The program emphasizes eliminating standing-water receptacles and reinforcing health-protective habits among residents. Located in the Amazon Rainforest, climatic conditions can favor mosquitoes, yet dengue cases remain scarce this year. Officials reiterate the importance of community participation and sustained preventive measures at homes to keep dengue under control in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州の自治体、2026年のデング熱症例はわずか1件
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数が低く抑えられている好事例の報道であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング症例数が少ないことを予防活動の成果として報告するポジティブな内容であり、シグナルとしての懸念はない。

article.articleHeadline: 俄鼠疫情況不明 學者呼籲先切斷對這兩國飛航 防堵疫情擴散
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's rodent-borne outbreak status is unclear; scholars urge suspending air travel to these two countries to prevent the outbreak from spreading.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, Russia reports an unclear pneumonic plague outbreak; public health officials urge swift action to prevent international spread. Drawing on COVID-19 lessons, Brookings senior fellow argues Western nations should not trust statements from authoritarian regimes and should proactively suspend air travel to outbreak regions. The immediate focus targets tourist destinations heavily frequented by Russian travelers: Turkey and Thailand. 2025 estimates indicate nearly 7 million Russian tourists to Turkey and about 2 million to Thailand, making these two countries the most likely sources if pneumonic plague spreads abroad. Other destinations cited include Italy, South Korea, Japan, Germany, the United States, Singapore, Cyprus, Finland, and Vietnam, but with less emphasis. The article stresses halting flights to Turkey and Thailand to curb cross-border dissemination, rather than waiting for full confirmation of cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの鼠疫（ペスト）流行状況不明、学者がトルコとタイへの航空便停止を呼びかけ　感染拡大防止を
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの肺ペスト発生状況が「不明」とされ、記事自体が学者の提言（予防的な渡航制限の呼びかけ）であり、公式な症例確認や詳細な疫学情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアにおける肺ペスト発生（詳細不明）であり、タイ・ベトナムは観光客経由での感染拡大の『潜在的リスク先』として言及されているに過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、対象国での確定例情報が出た場合は改めて評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Wetang'ula urges border residents to remain alert as Kenya confirms Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BEVD) imported case confirmed in Kenya: a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive on Oct 6, 2026, after arriving in Nairobi from Uganda on Oct 3 and later died. This marked Kenya’s first imported BEVD case; authorities say there is no outbreak. The World Health Organization backed public health responses in Kenya and Uganda, including contact tracing. Kenya intensified screening at Malaba and at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, with temporary isolation centers at Malaba and Kocholia and Alupe undergoing renovation. Bungoma and other border counties were urged to remain vigilant, with truck drivers prioritized in screening due to cross-border movements. Public advised to avoid close contact with sick individuals, practice hand hygiene, and seek medical care if exposed or symptomatic; toll-free line 719 provides guidance. The case highlights cross-border transmission risk and ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ウェタングラ氏、ケニアでエボラ死亡例確認を受け国境地域住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初の輸入エボラ(ブンディブギョ)症例で死亡者が発生し、国境地域での越境感染リスクが指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本イベントはケニアでの輸入エボラ症例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。DRC・ウガンダは渡航経路・出身地としての言及であり、発生国としての主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 35 आदिवासी बच्चों की मौत के बाद एमपी के ज़िले के कुछ हिस्सों को महामारी प्रभावित क्षेत्र घोषित करने की मांग, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने मांगा जवाब
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Demand to declare some parts of Madhya Pradesh's districts as epidemic-affected areas after the deaths of 35 tribal children; Supreme Court has sought a response.
article.articleSummary: Measles and rubella outbreak amid severe malnutrition has spurred a Public Interest Litigation in the Supreme Court of India seeking to declare Birsa and Bahar blocks in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, as epidemic-affected under the Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897. The plea — Ajab Lal Lilhare v. Union of India — cites over 35 deaths among Baiga and other PVTG children, attributed to measles-rubella and acute malnutrition. It alleges administrative negligence, inadequate health facilities, and failure to vaccinate on time, demanding compensation for affected families, safe drinking water, nutritious food, and rapid welfare scheme implementation. The Supreme Court bench of Chief Justice Suryakant and Justices Joymaly Bagchi and V. Mohana has issued notices to the Centre, state government, NHRC, and others. Authorities reportedly faced written warnings in January 2026, yet delays persisted in monitoring and response."

triage.headline_ja: 35人の先住民族の子供が死亡した後、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州の一部地区を疫病流行地域に指定するよう求める訴え、最高裁が答弁を要求
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の流行と深刻な栄養失調により先住部族(PVTG)の子供35人以上が死亡し、最高裁が中央・州政府等に通知を発するなど社会的・司法的関心が高い重大事案であるため。
triage.notes: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州バラガート県の先住部族居住区（ビルサ・バハールブロック）における麻疹・風疹流行と重度栄養失調が原因。予防接種の遅延や行政の不作為が指摘され、最高裁が中央政府・州政府・国家人権委員会に通知を発している。

article.articleHeadline: Maul- und Klauenseuche in Sibirien: Wladimir Putin ruft den Notstand aus - Virus breitet sich aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease in Siberia: Vladimir Putin declares a state of emergency - the virus is spreading.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Siberia faces a widening outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) spreading from China and Mongolia into Russia, prompting Vladimir Putin to declare a state of emergency in parts of the region. The Transbaikal governor, Alexander Osipow, ordered broad emergency measures to prevent cross-border transmission, including vaccination of border-area livestock and strict grazing restrictions; Russia’s border with China and Mongolia is effectively tightened. Official case counts and laboratory confirmation are not detailed in the report, but the crisis follows prior large-scale culling in Nowosibirsk (about 4,500 cattle) and earlier in Irkutsk, with authorities attributing incidents to different diseases and farmers alleging cover-ups. The situation is shadowed by accusations of political opacity, including the death of 28-year-old researcher Daria Shipilova in Irkutsk, described by officials as unknown pneumonia, fueling calls for greater transparency to the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで口蹄疫拡大：プーチン大統領が非常事態を宣言 - ウイルスが拡散中
triage.triage_reason: 中国・モンゴルからロシアへ越境拡大した口蹄疫によりプーチン大統領が非常事態を宣言し、国境封鎖・家畜移動制限など渡航貿易制限が実施されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限）を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。原因不明肺炎による研究者死亡や隠蔽疑惑も社会的関心を高めている。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫自体は動物疾患でありヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は限定的だが、国境を越えた拡大・非常事態宣言・貿易制限という点でIHR基準を満たす。また記事内で言及される研究者の原因不明肺炎による死亡は口蹄疫との因果関係が不明であり、別途注視が必要。中国・モンゴルでの発生地点の詳細は記事中に明示されていないため、ロシア（対象国外）が主な発生地として記述されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Akademisi ungakap Cara Menular Influenza A dan Gejala yang Bisa Berujung Pneumonia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Academics Reveal How Influenza A Is Transmitted and the Symptoms That Could Lead to Pneumonia
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia and across Southeast Asia, according to Ministry of Health surveillance through early September 2026, though totals remain at a medium level with seasonal fluctuations. Influenza A is caused by the influenza type A virus and can occur year-round. Common symptoms include fever, chills, sore throat, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, cough, and nasal congestion; incubation is about 1–4 days, fever lasts roughly 3–4 days, while other respiratory symptoms may persist longer. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, talking, or breathing at close range, and via contaminated hands touching the face. Individuals under five years, the elderly, pregnant women, and patients with chronic conditions (diabetes, heart disease, lung disease, or immunosuppression) are at higher risk of severe disease and pneumonia. Citizens are urged to stay vigilant despite the ongoing medium-intensity pattern.

triage.headline_ja: 学者がインフルエンザAの感染経路と肺炎につながりうる症状を解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの一般的な解説記事であり、中等度レベルの季節変動の範囲内とされ、異常性や重大な公衆衛生インパクトを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発・教育目的の一般情報提供記事であり、保健省のサーベイランスでも中等度レベルと報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's Ebola scare reveals continental vulnerability
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Ebola scare reveals continental vulnerability: A Kenyan man infected with Ebola crossed from the Democratic Republic of the Congo through Uganda by public transport, then flew from Entebbe to Nairobi, passed airport screening, and reached Nairobi Hospital before his infection was recognised. He died 58 hours after landing. His journey is a warning about the way Africa manages its borders—and about the threats that its border systems are designed to detect. The report focuses on a missed diagnosis and the broader implications for border surveillance across Africa. No details on laboratory confirmation or symptom profile are provided. The case underscores the need for robust entry-point surveillance to prevent imported Ebola cases and quicker recognition of infections.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ熱騒動が浮き彫りにした大陸全体の脆弱性
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染者が国境を越えてケニアまで到達し発見が遅れた事例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染者はDRCからウガンダを経由しケニアに入国しており、国境監視体制の不備が指摘されている。発生地域としてウガンダ・ケニアも挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Wetang'ula warns Bungoma residents over Ebola threat across Uganda border
article.articleSummary: Kenya heightened Ebola surveillance after confirming its first imported case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease, tracing the patient from the Democratic Republic of Congo through Uganda to Nairobi; the patient died on Oct 5 after hospitalization and transfer to an isolation facility. Bungoma County, near the Uganda border, saw officials urge residents to observe precautionary measures as border screening was intensified at Busia and Malaba beginning Oct 6. Health Director-General Patrick Amoth emphasized rigorous screening of travellers from the region to enable early detection. Aden Duale noted the patient’s travel route via DRC and Uganda before arriving in Nairobi. The public was urged to provide truthful information during screening to aid early identification and care. Uganda had reported Ebola in May and was later declared free; border vigilance remains critical.

triage.headline_ja: ウェタングラ氏、ウガンダ国境付近のブンゴマ住民にエボラの脅威を警告
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初の輸入エボラ（スーダン型/ブンディブギョ型）症例が確認され死亡、DRC発・ウガンダ経由の国際的な感染拡大と国境検疫強化が確認されたため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源とされるDRCのみを verified_locations に計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Symptoms, Transmission and What You Need to Know to Stay Safe
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) due to Bundibugyo virus is active in eastern DRC (Ituri), with the outbreak since May 2026 and more than 8,400 cases by early October; fatality about 50%. Uganda's May outbreak produced 20 cases and two deaths and has resolved. Kenya reported one imported case linked to the regional outbreak; the patient died after arriving in Nairobi on Oct 3-5, with contacts quarantined. Vaccines for Bundibugyo virus are unproven; Uganda is testing a candidate. Uganda's ~10% fatality rate contrasts with ~50% in DRC, possibly from better supportive care and undercounting in DRC. Transmission is via direct contact with body fluids, contaminated clothing, unsterilized equipment, or handling wildlife. Incubation 4-10 days; symptoms progress from malaria-like fever to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, then bleeding, shock and organ failure. To stay safe, avoid flagged areas, call health providers by phone, and quarantine if exposure is suspected, with hospital notification.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：症状、感染経路、安全を守るために知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）で8,400人超・致死率約50%のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクが継続中で、ウガンダへの波及とケニアへの越境輸入例（死亡例）も確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアも記事内で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生地はDRCイトゥリ州。ワクチン未承認で致死率地域差（DRC約50% vs ウガンダ約10%）が報告されている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria da Saúde de SP alerta para prevenção de dengue e chikungunya em período de chuva e calor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo State Health Department warns about dengue and chikungunya prevention during the rainy and hot season
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State Health Department (SES-SP) urged residents to eliminate standing water inside and outside homes to curb Aedes aegypti breeding during the rainy, hot season. Forecasts predict rain, humidity and high temperatures across the state, with a weekend on Monday Oct 12. Greater São Paulo will be hot with afternoon showers; other regions exceed 30°C. As of 2026, the state reports 60,965 dengue cases and 43 deaths. After rain, items can collect water and become mosquito breeding sites: plant pots, gutters, tires, bottles and water tanks. Keep tanks sealed; fill plant saucers with sand or wash weekly; store bottles mouth-down; discard tires and debris; keep drains clear with bleach or screens; maintain pools weekly with chlorine and cover when unused. Dengue starts with fever above 38°C and sudden onset for 2–7 days, plus headache, joint pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, and rash. Seek health care if suspected; do not self-medicate.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州保健局、雨季・高温期のデング熱とチクングニア熱予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで季節性に流行する風土病であり、本記事は例年通りの予防啓発キャンペーンであって異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はサンパウロ州保健局による雨季前の定例的なデング熱・チクングニア熱予防啓発であり、新規の異常発生を示すものではない。累積60,965症例・43死亡は2026年通年の報告値であり、急増や異常な流行パターンを示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed cases of Ebola in DRC reach 8,750 - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches 8,750 confirmed cases and 4,208 deaths (case fatality rate 48.1%), with 2,288 recoveries and 1,066 currently in isolation. Kenya reports an imported Bundibugyo Ebola case after travel through DRC and Uganda; Africa CDC urges vigilance, not bans, and emphasizes regional solidarity. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing and second-largest on record; by week 21 it has 4.1 times more cases and 3.7 times more deaths than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. In addition to DRC, Uganda and Kenya face cross-border risk, with 10 other countries designated high-risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia. Africa CDC declared a public health emergency of continental security on May 18, one day after WHO declared a PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ確定症例数が8,750人に到達 - アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は致死率48.1%、史上2番目の規模で急拡大しており、ケニアへの越境感染例も確認され、WHO及びアフリカCDCがPHEICを宣言している重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行拡大とケニアへの越境感染例を主題とするが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。ザンビアは高リスク国として言及されているが、現時点で確定症例の報告はない。南スーダン、ルワンダ、中央アフリカ共和国、タンザニア、エチオピア、アンゴラ、コンゴ共和国、ブルンジ、ソマリアも高リスク国とされるが対象国リスト外または確定症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : l'Église anglicane appelle les fidèles à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: The Anglican Church Calls on the Faithful to.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, DRC — In Beni territory's Watalinga chiefdom, the Anglican Church reaffirms its commitment in the fight against Ebola virus disease (EVD). At an 8 October annual assembly, Archbishop Georges Titre Ande urged worshippers to respect preventive measures prescribed by health authorities to curb transmission and protect communities. He stressed that acknowledging Ebola's existence is essential, and that the disease can be avoided by following recommended practices. The archbishop highlighted church-led awareness and training campaigns and the establishment of care facilities as part of the response, while warning against denial or trivialization that could increase risk. He called on congregants to cooperate with health authorities and adhere to prevention measures to contribute to epidemic control.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブのエボラ出血熱：聖公会が信者に予防措置の遵守を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でのエボラ出血熱流行継続を示す記事であり、疾患の重篤性と異常性からIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は聖公会による予防啓発活動に関する報告であり、新規症例数や感染拡大の具体的データは含まれていない。続報での感染状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : début de la vaccination contre Ebola à Isiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: Start of Ebola vaccination in Isiro.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, Isiro, capital of Haut-Uélé province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, began preventive Ebola vaccination for frontline responders. On 8 October 2026, Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu oversaw the launch at the Mayogo space, joined by Vice-Governor Christophe Dara Matata and health partners. The vaccination is voluntary and targets health workers, epidemiological surveillance teams, laboratorians, vaccination teams, and teams handling dignified and safe burials—those most exposed to Ebola. The operation is part of the national Ebola preparedness and response strategy, coordinated by the Ministry of Public Health, the Expanded Immunization Programme (PEV), and the Public Health Emergency Operations Center (COUSP) with partners. Leaders were urged to counter misinformation and direct the public to official information sources, emphasizing transparency, scientific data, and solidarity to protect Haut-Uélé and the DRC. Vaccination complements, not replaces, measures like PPE, hand hygiene, early case detection, and safety protocols.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州：イジロでエボラワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で国家的エボラ対応戦略の一環として予防的ワクチン接種が開始されており、エボラは重篤かつ国際的拡大リスクの高い疾患であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はイジロでの予防的ワクチン接種開始を報じているが、具体的な感染者数や発生規模については言及がなく、国全体のエボラ対応戦略の一環として実施されている点に留意。続報でDRC国内の実際の症例数・拡大状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Low Platelet Count In Dengue? 7 Foods And Care Tips To Support Platelet Recovery Naturally
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 695 dengue cases in 2026; the first week of October saw 98 new cases. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. Common symptoms include headache, retro-orbital pain, and muscle or joint pain. Platelet counts can fall during dengue and may not require transfusion; regular blood tests and clinical monitoring guide treatment. Hydration is essential; fluids such as coconut water, ORS, and lemon water help, and fresh juices (papaya, pomegranate, kiwi) may aid fluids and nutrients but do not cure dengue. Papaya leaf juice is sometimes recommended, but evidence is limited and it should not replace medical care. There is no specific antiviral; treatment is supportive and based on symptoms. Avoid self-medication; avoid aspirin and ibuprofen unless advised. Seek urgent medical evaluation for warning signs, especially around defervescence, as dengue can progress to severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱による血小板減少？血小板回復を自然にサポートする7つの食品とケアのコツ
triage.triage_reason: デリーのデング熱症例報告を背景とした健康情報・食事アドバイス記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規異常事態や緊急性を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Approved vaccine for Yellow Fever to be rolled out in Upper West next week-GHS
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreak in Ghana's Upper West Region is being tackled with a vaccination drive in Sissala East, Sissala West and Wa West next week after vaccine approval. Seven districts in the region have reported cases, with laboratory confirmation of three cases, all of which resulted in deaths, prompting escalation. Samples have been sent to Dakar for laboratory analysis; if positive, authorities would declare an outbreak in the Upper West. The Ghana Health Service and Ministry of Health coordinate with WHO to contain spread. The vaccination campaign aims to protect residents and complement other measures. Public urged to seek care for fever, headache, muscle pain, jaundice, or unusual bleeding. Preventive actions include eliminating stagnant water, sleeping under insecticide-treated nets, and using repellents. Officials emphasize reliance on official information and community engagement in containment.

triage.headline_ja: アッパーウェスト州で来週、黄熱病承認ワクチンの接種が開始へ―ガーナ保健サービス
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ・アッパーウェスト州で黄熱病の検査確定例3例が全て死亡に至り、7県で症例報告、WHOと連携したワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されるなど、重大性と拡大リスクが高いシグナルと判断される。
triage.notes: 検体はセネガル・ダカールの検査機関に送付され分析中であり、発生地域リストにセネガルが含まれるが、記事の主題である黄熱病の発生自体はガーナ国内に限られるためセネガルはverified_locationsから除外した。確定例3例の致死率100%は重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Trichy corpn levies Rs24,000 penalties on 8 houses for dengue source
article.articleSummary: Trichy corporation began penalizing dengue breeding grounds by fining eight houses in zone II Rs 24,000 after inspections found containers with dengue larvae. A 400-strong team of domestic breeding checkers (DBCs) will conduct daily doorstep screening across all five zones, inspecting homes, gated communities, commercial properties, and under-construction sites. Corporation commissioner N Ponmani inspected wards 35 (Senthaneerpuram) and 49 (Sangiliyandapuram), confirming eight houses with fresh water containers harboring larvae. Fines on these eight residences total Rs 24,000. The authorities had previously targeted construction sites; with intermittent rains, penalties will extend to residential properties. DBCs are to sensitize residents on dengue prevention, including removing standing water from flowerpots, plastic containers, and open tanks. Sanitary supervisors and inspectors will randomly check properties, and hospital-reported daily fever cases are guiding the intensified drive in coming days.

triage.headline_ja: トリチー市当局、デング熱発生源の家屋8軒に2万4千ルピーの罰金を科す
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱予防・蚊発生源対策に関するルーティン記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症化、国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体の日常的な蚊媒介対策・罰金措置に関する記事で、デング熱の異常発生や大規模流行を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sanitarios del Área Norte de Málaga ayudan a reforzar la detección del ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers from Málaga's Northern Area help bolster Ebola detection in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Healthcare workers from Málaga’s Northern Area of the Andalusian Health Service (SAS), together with Médicos del Mundo, are reinforcing Ebola detection and outbreak response in Katana, Kivu Sur, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The mission operates in two health zones and centers on triage at 14 facilities, aiming to detect and isolate suspected Ebola cases early, guided by a fever-focused algorithm and enhanced infection prevention training. The team produced a ten-point decálogo of basic infection prevention and control actions for triage. The operation also addresses a cholera outbreak in Katana, with 20 potable-water chlorination points. Lugendo health center experienced water shortages for rehydration salts, prompting emergency supply and plans to expand storage and harvest rainwater. Measles vaccination campaigns have reduced weekly incidence; malaria remains a major fever cause. Coordination with local authorities, NGOs, and the referral hospital continues.

triage.headline_ja: マラガ北部地域の医療従事者がコンゴでのエボラ検知強化を支援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ・コレラ同時流行への対応活動であり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」が該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・マラガの医療支援チームによるコンゴ（カタナ、キブ・スド）でのエボラ検知・コレラ対応支援活動を報じたもの。既知の進行中アウトブレイクへの支援活動であり、新規の異常事態というより継続的な公衆衛生対応の一環と見られる。スペイン（Málaga, Andalusia）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。
