article.articleHeadline: Peste e armi biologiche, sospetti sui laboratori russi: cosa sappiamo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague and Biological Weapons, Suspicions About Russian Laboratories: What Do We Know
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, concerns about plague and biological weapons focus on Russian laboratories. An Irkutsk plague research institute reportedly amassed highly virulent strains of plague, anthrax, and other pathogens for decades. Officially these labs protect public health, but a US study cited by the New York Post links plague-lab activities to Soviet-era weapons programs. Euronews interviewed Mirko Himmel of the University of Hamburg, who distinguishes defensive biodefense from prohibited offensive bioweapons research. He notes biodefense work exists in many nations, including the United States, United Kingdom, Russia, China, and EU states, while detailed public evidence of offensive programs is lacking. Suspicions extend to the US, China, Russia, North Korea, and Iran. Theoretical weaponization could disseminate plague via bioaerosols to trigger pneumonic plague. The 1975 Biological Weapons Convention lacks a verification mechanism, leaving the public unsure about the true scope of plague-related research.

triage.headline_ja: ペストと生物兵器、ロシアの研究所への疑惑:私たちが知っていること
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、生物兵器研究・バイオセキュリティに関する地政学的・政策的議論の記事であり、対象国における実際の疾病発生は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のペスト発生事例ではなく、ロシア等の研究所における生物兵器疑惑に関する考察記事。中国は疑惑対象国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生事例ではないため参考情報として記載。対象国での実発生なしのためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: What's known about plague institute lab worker's death in Russia?
article.articleSummary: Death of Darya Shipilova, 28, a lab worker at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia, on Oct 2 prompted quarantine of 200 contacts; 5,000 samples were tested and no dangerous pathogens found. Russia has not confirmed plague as the cause, saying she died of pneumonia with undetermined origin; she was vaccinated and no microorganisms linked to her work were found in her or contacts. WHO has pressed Russia for details on laboratory tests and pathogens evaluated; Maria Van Kerkhove questioned how the pneumonia arose if not plague. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, transmits via fleas or respiratory droplets and can be fatal without treatment but is curable with antibiotics. It is endemic in Siberia; human cases have been in the DRC and Madagascar. International reaction includes WHO and the US seeking more information and border precautions by Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Uzbekistan. The institute was founded in 1934 to control plague.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト研究所研究員の死亡について判明していること
triage.triage_reason: ペスト研究所職員の原因不明死亡に対しWHOが追加情報を求め、近隣国が国境対策を講じるなど国際的関心と潜在的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Gurugram dengue tally rises to 70 with 2 fresh cases, Haryana tally crosses 500
article.articleSummary: Two new dengue cases in Gurugram lift the district's dengue tally to 70, surpassing 64 cases recorded in all of 2025. Haryana state reports 503 dengue cases by October 4, up from 318 on September 14 (≈58% rise in 20 days). Gurugram previously had the state's highest tally with 65; updated district bulletin now lists 70, five more than earlier this week; statewide total not provided in Friday bulletin. A total of 13,797 samples have been tested in Gurugram to date, with 137 tested on Friday; no dengue-related deaths confirmed in the district this year. Rapid fever survey teams covered 16,642 houses on Friday, bringing annual coverage to 1.524 million homes; 7,935 notices under Section 214 for mosquito-control have been issued. Dengue is linked to mosquito breeding after the monsoon; residents advised to prevent water accumulation in coolers, pots, rooftop containers, and other areas. Gurugram reported five malaria cases so far this year; no new malaria on Friday.

triage.headline_ja: グルガオンのデング熱累計70人に増加、ハリヤナ州は500人超え
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱の通常の流行報告であり、死亡例なし・医療体制も機能しているが、症例数の急増（20日で58%増）がみられるため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: ALFENAS TEM 322 CASOS DE SARNA HUMANA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alfenas has 322 cases of human scabies
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks in Southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, as of 2026-10-09: Alfenas reports 322 cases after four new infections over the weekend; Campos Gerais records 14 cases (10 children and four municipal school employees); Andradas has 39 suspected cases. The disease spreads mainly through prolonged direct skin contact; sharing clothing, towels, and bed linens can also propagate transmission. Dogs and cats do not transmit human scabies. Symptoms include intense itching, especially at night, and small skin lesions. Patients with symptoms were removed from schools, and educational facilities were cleaned; classes continue normally. Early diagnosis and treatment help control transmission and prevent new cases. Residents with suspected symptoms should seek evaluation at health units to receive appropriate treatment and curb further spread in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アルフェナスでヒト疥癬322例確認
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で管理可能な皮膚疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒトヒト直接接触やリネン共有で伝播する軽症疾患で、学校での清掃・隔離対応により管理可能とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Peste: doença medieval ainda causa até 3 mil casos todos os anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague: A Medieval Disease Still Causes Up to 3,000 Cases Every Year.
article.articleSummary: Up to 3,000 plague cases occur annually worldwide, according to the Robert Koch Institute, with pneumonic plague capable of killing within 48 hours after symptom onset. The disease presents in three forms: bubonic (painful lymph node swelling, flea-borne), septicemic (bloodstream infection), and pneumonic (lungs, transmissible between people via droplets or aerosols). Today, plague circulates mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and Madagascar (250–500 infections per year in Madagascar); occasional cases also occur in the western United States. The medieval pandemic (1347–1353) killed about 25 million in Europe. Rapid laboratory confirmation and antibiotics save lives; delays in resource-limited settings can be fatal. The last European cases were in Corsica, 1945. An Oregon resident bitten by a sick cat was misdiagnosed with cat scratch disease before plague was identified and treated in the ICU. A global pandemic remains considered unlikely, given transmission dynamics and available therapies.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト：中世の病気は今も年間最大3000件の症例を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、ペストに関する一般的な医学解説・歴史的背景記事であるため、トリアージ対象となる新規シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの歴史・疫学に関する一般解説記事であり、DRC、ウガンダ、マダガスカルでの継続的な流行状況や米国・フランス(コルシカ)での過去の散発例に言及しているが、新規の緊急事態や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。対象国の中ではDRCのみが現在の流行地域として言及されているため、保守的にverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Malária: entenda os riscos, sintomas e a importância do diagnóstico precoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: understand the risks, symptoms, and the importance of early diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium and transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, remains a persistent public health challenge in Brazil, including Amazon regions. Incubation around 8–14 days after a female Anopheles bite. Classic symptoms: high fever with cycles, severe chills, sweating, muscle aches, and persistent headache; later nausea, vomiting, fatigue. Diagnosis relies mainly on thick blood smear microscopy to detect parasite and identify species; Brazil's public health system (SUS) provides free, rapid diagnosis and treatment. Treatment uses antimalarials such as chloroquine and primaquine, with dosage tailored to patient and severity; adherence is essential to prevent relapse and serious complications like severe anemia, renal failure, or neurological issues. Prevention focuses on vector avoidance: repellents, window screens, clothing, and environmental control, especially at dusk and at night when Anopheles are active. The article highlights risks and emphasizes early diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア:リスク、症状、早期診断の重要性を理解する

article.articleHeadline: Peste suspectée en Sibérie : pourquoi la maladie n'a-t-elle jamais disparu ? - Amphisciences
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Plague in Siberia: Why Has the Disease Never Disappeared? - Amphisciences.
article.articleSummary: Siberia harbors persistent natural foci of plague, with the Irkutsk region and the Altai Mountains as long‑standing reservoirs. The gray marmot (Marmota baibacina) colonies host fleas that carry Yersinia pestis, maintaining enzootic cycles independent of humans; documented human cases occurred in the Kosh-Agatch district in the mid‑2010s. Fleas enter winter dormancy in early October, reducing immediate spillover risk, though laboratory accidents remain possible. Pneumonic plague is treatable with antibiotics; regimens include streptomycin, gentamicin, and fluoroquinolones, with doxycycline added for bubonic form; typical treatment lasts 10–14 days. Bubonic plague mortality falls from about 66% without antibiotics to 13% with. Close-contact prophylaxis lasts seven days; around Chelekhov hospital roughly 200 people were under surveillance. A 392-strain study across 17 countries found no resistance to eight antibiotics; Madagascar reported rare MDR strains in the 1990s. Russia maintains anti-plague institutes in Irkutsk and the Altai for surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: Side, Turkey: Five-star hotel plagued by mass infections
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, the five-star Bosphorus Sorgun hotel in Side, Turkey, faces a mass outbreak of intestinal infections, with dozens of tourists—many from Russia—reporting vomiting and diarrhea. Guests cite poor sanitary conditions, including low-quality water and hygiene lapses (staff at a beach bar rinsing glasses with water instead of washing). The outbreak involves guests from multiple countries; similar incidents were reported at the same hotel in August and September this year. No laboratory-confirmed pathogen or case count is provided. The report also notes other traveler health concerns, such as a Russian tourist from Lyubertsy hospitalized after dengue fever diagnosed in Vietnam, believed mosquito-bite–transmitted during sleep.

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa mostra que mosquito da dengue deposita ovos a mais de 10m do solo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research shows that the dengue mosquito lays eggs more than 10 meters above the ground.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers show Aedes albopictus, a dengue, Zika, chikungunya and yellow fever vector, can lay eggs more than 10 meters above ground, implying someone living on upper floors can be exposed to primary and secondary vectors indoors. In Manaus, Amazonas, a six-floor tower was used with 30 traps across levels; eggs deposited on all levels, with the highest concentrations near ground up to about 4 meters; eggs were found up to 10.8 meters. The study, a collaboration among INPA, FMT-HVD, UFMA, UFPR, and UEL, ran 10 weeks in two seasons (dry and wet) of 2015; over 35,000 eggs were collected. Researchers note this reveals gaps in current control measures that focus on ground-level and yard breeding sites, urging surveillance to include upper floors in urban residential buildings to mitigate dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. Future work assesses how mosquitoes reach higher floors and climate-seasonality effects.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 【Censored】Russia suspected pneumonic plague outbreak sparks fear among Chinese public | plague deaths | Siberia, Russia | World Health Organization
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 9, 2026, Russia reports a suspected pneumonic plague case in Siberia near the Chinese border. A female employee in her 20s at the Irkutsk Oblast Anti-Plague Research Institute developed severe pneumonia and died; authorities suggest a live-bacteria sample incident may have occurred, but the exact cause is not yet confirmed. About 200 contacts are under medical observation with isolation measures. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor labels the case as pneumonia of unknown etiology and a highly dangerous infection, with no pathogen detected thus far. On Oct 6, a second suspected pneumonic plague death was reported, prompting WHO to demand clarification of the first case. Cross-border anxiety rises in China, which recently hosted a Aug 24–27 Sino-Russian cross-border infectious-disease drill in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang. Public health officials emphasize that plague is treatable with antibiotics and containment is feasible, though transparency remains urgently needed.

article.articleSummary: Basil recall after E. coli finding: Sweet basil from Thailand has been pulled from sale in Norway after Escherichia coli was detected in the product. Approximately 40 kilograms of the batch were sold to grocery stores and restaurants nationwide by Asian Food Import. The basil was packaged in 80-gram units. E. coli, a group of gut bacteria that can cause illness, poses particular risk if the herb is eaten without heat treatment. Consumers are advised to discard the package or return it to the store for a refund or replacement. The recall involves imported basil intended for raw or lightly heated use; Mattilsynet notes the risk and coordinates the action.

article.articleHeadline: Cat Litter and Pregnancy: Toxoplasma Parasite Found in Over 40 Percent of
article.articleSummary: In eastern Ghana's Volta Region, a cross-sectional study at Ho Teaching Hospital found that 42.5% of 201 pregnant women at their first antenatal visit tested positive for Toxoplasma gondii antibodies (85/201). Among positives, 96.5% were IgG-only (dormant tissue cysts) and 3.5% had IgG and IgM (possible recent or reactivated infection). Blood samples were screened for T. gondii–IgG/IgM by rapid test; participants were enrolled Feb 24–Apr 7, 2025. Regression identified parity as a key risk: primiparous (OR 3.93, 95% CI 1.42–10.91) and multiparous (OR 3.85, 95% CI 1.50–9.87) vs nulliparous. Most exposures are prior immunity, reducing fetal transmission risk, yet more than half remain susceptible to primary infection during pregnancy. T. gondii is transmitted via cat feces–derived oocysts, undercooked meat, or contaminated food, water, or soil; findings raise discussion on routine antenatal screening in Ghana.

article.articleHeadline: San Lazaro Hospital reports 174 cases of influenza-like illness
article.articleSummary: Manila's San Lazaro Hospital reports 174 influenza-like illness (ILI) cases from Jan 1 to Oct 6, with ILI defined by fever, cough, sore throat, colds, body aches, headaches. The Philippines recorded 99,037 ILI cases nationwide this year, and the most affected age group is 5–14 years. Health officials stress vaccination against flu and basic preventive measures—drinking safe water, properly cooked food, handwashing, avoiding floodwater, and preventing mosquito bites—especially during the rainy season. Patients are advised to stay home when unwell and seek medical care if symptoms worsen. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report. The article focuses on ILI trends in Manila and nationwide, amid rainy-season conditions; no outbreaks beyond annual seasonality are specified.

article.articleHeadline: Học sinh dương tính sốt xuất huyết, y tế Nghệ An phun hóa chất khoanh vùng ngay trong đêm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Student tests positive for Dengue fever; Nghệ An health authorities spray chemicals to cordon off the area overnight.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever confirmed in Nghệ An Province, Vietnam: On Oct 2, a 13-year-old middle school student in Ben Thủy, Trường Vinh Ward, Nghệ An, developed fatigue and fever. By Oct 6, laboratory testing confirmed dengue infection. The patient was transferred to Vinh City General Hospital for isolation and treatment; health status is currently stable and under close monitoring. In response, Ben Thủy Health Station and authorities conducted large-scale mosquito spraying on Oct 7, covering a 200-meter radius around the patient’s residence, alongside vector-control and environmental sanitation efforts. Public health officials urged residents to eliminate mosquito breeding sites, destroy larval habitats, seal water containers, and maintain hygiene. Seek prompt medical care for symptoms such as sudden high fever, headache, or body aches. The article notes a dengue outbreak in Nghệ An in September 2026, with 59 cases in the Quỳnh Anh commune by Sept 4, many in Quỳnh Bảng village, prompting area-wide control and spraying.

The case prompted World Health Organization to request clarification of the exact cause; Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor labels it pneumonia of unknown etiology and a highly dangerous infection, with no high-risk pathogen detected to date. On Oct 6, a second suspected pneumonic plague-related death was reported, though Russia denies this and says no dangerous pathogens were found. The event has triggered cross-border anxiety in China, given proximity to Heilongjiang, and recalls joint cross-border drill Aug 24-27 in Fuyuan, across the border; no direct link established.

article.articleHeadline: Adultos com dengue chegam a UTIs da rede pública em estado mais grave que os da rede privada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adults with dengue admitted to public health system ICUs in a more severe condition than those in the private health system.
article.articleSummary: Adults with dengue admitted to Brazil’s public health system ICUs are in more severe condition than those in private hospitals, per a Journal of Critical Care study (2015–2024). Public-system patients had 20% intubation on day one in ICU vs 4% in private facilities. Researchers from Einstein Hospital Israelita and IDOR link greater severity to delays in reaching intensive care. Data from the Brazilian ICU Registry and Datasus show overall ICU hospital mortality at 8.2%; public hospitals recorded 3,682 admissions and 889 deaths, while private hospitals had 28,334 admissions and 1,704 deaths. Public patients were younger (median age 50 vs 54) yet more often required vasopressors on day one (22.4% vs 5.3%), with vasopressor-related mortality at 54.6%. Dengue is transmitted by female Aedes aegypti; LIRAa indicates substantial risk. A 2025 Anvisa single-dose Butantan dengue vaccine (12–59 years) is suspended due to safety concerns.

triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルにおけるデング熱患者の公的・私的医療機関間の重症度格差に関する後ろ向き研究結果の報告であり、新規または異常な感染症発生イベントを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Où sont passés les milliards d'euros promis pour lutter contre l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where have the billions of euros promised to fight the Ebola outbreak in the DRC gone?
article.articleSummary: France has pledged 7 million euros in additional aid to fight the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The commitment was announced by Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot on 6 October at a National humanitarian conference in Paris, signaling that France will reinforce its support. The article's title questions where billions promised to combat the DRC outbreak have gone, but the excerpt reports only this funding increase without providing outbreak metrics such as case counts, deaths, or infection sources. As of 9 October 2026, the announcement adds to ongoing international relief efforts and aims to strengthen operational capacity and humanitarian response in the Ebola-affected regions of the DRC. No laboratory confirmation details or imported/exported case information are included in the supplied text.

triage.notes: 記事本文は資金援助の経緯に焦点が当てられており、具体的な症例数・死亡者数などの疫学データは提供されていない。アウトブレイク自体は既知の継続中の事案であり、新規性は低いが、エボラの重篤性と国際的な資金・支援動向から継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PBH pede que população denuncie focos do mosquito da dengue em Belo Horizonte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PBH asks the public to report dengue mosquito breeding sites in Belo Horizonte.
article.articleSummary: PBH (Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte) asks residents to report suspected Aedes aegypti breeding sites to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. From January to September 2026, the city logged about 1,200 reports; in 2025 more than 1,700 inspection requests were recorded. Reports are free and can be submitted anonymously via phone 156, the BHSIM app, or the PBH Services Portal. Agentes de Combate às Endemias and Agentes Sanitários inspect reported properties and surrounding areas, carrying out eliminations of breeding sites per regional Zoonoses guidance. Commonly flagged sites include abandoned properties, unfinished works, and poorly maintained pools. If a breeding site is found, a deadline is set; a follow-up that confirms continued risk may trigger actions by sanitary or urban oversight. Community participation is encouraged year-round to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Domestic checks, about 10 minutes weekly, cover plants, water tanks, tires, pet bowls, gutters, unused containers, trash, yards, drains, and appliance trays.

article.articleHeadline: Vigia de Nazaré confirma quatro casos de doença de Chagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vigia de Nazaré confirms four cases of Chagas disease.
article.articleSummary: Four cases of Chagas disease were confirmed in Vigia de Nazaré, Pará, Brazil, prompting intensified prevention and surveillance at local açaí-selling points. The alert, disclosed Oct 6, 2026, aims to curb oral transmission from contaminated foods like açaí. A meeting with local açaí beaters is scheduled for Oct 9, 2026 to align processing with Sanitary Surveillance standards and ensure product safety. After notification by Instituto Evandro Chagas, the Pará state health department (Sespa) deployed technicians and mobilized staff to support outbreak control and ensure medicines for affected individuals. Sespa will train health professionals, provide preventive guidance to the population, and coordinate with Vigia’s municipal health department to draft a specific local plan. Prevention emphasizes buying from regulated establishments, checking food hygiene, and maintaining clean, insect-free environments. Transmission routes include insect feces and contaminated foods; diagnosis via specific tests; treatment available through SUS.

article.articleHeadline: Unproven 'cures' pushed online amid plague concerns
article.articleSummary: Plague concerns in Irkutsk region, Russia: a woman employed at a plague research institute reportedly died from plague; the regional governor said tracing found no health issues among contacts. North American social media pitches unproven plague remedies and $300 kits claiming to prevent ER visits, often including doxycycline and ivermectin. The Wellness Company, led by Peter McCullough, saw search spikes; Rogan O'Handley highlighted doxycycline to followers. Experts caution against self-treatment: antibiotics should not be taken without exposure, and doxycycline can disrupt the gut microbiome and foster resistance. Kits’ claimed contents are not evidence-based for plague treatment or prevention, and outbreaks remain controllable with standard antibiotics. The report frames broader misinformation during crises, referencing hantavirus on a cruise ship and the 2026 Ebola outbreak in the DRC as contexts that grifters exploit.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト懸念の中、根拠のない「治療法」がネットで拡散
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼はペストに関する誤情報・未承認治療キットの販売であり、実際の発生国（ロシア）は対象国リスト外、DRCのエボラ流行は背景的言及に留まるため、現時点では具体的なアウトブレイク評価には情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・イルクーツク州でのペスト死亡例を契機とした誤情報・偽治療キット販売を扱う内容。DRCのエボラ流行やクルーズ船でのハンタウイルスは文脈的引用に過ぎず、対象国での主要な発生報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。続報でDRCエボラ関連の詳細情報が出れば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais se prepara para risco de nova epidemia de dengue em 2027, alerta Secretaria de Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais prepares for the risk of a new dengue epidemic in 2027, Health Secretariat warns.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil (Belo Horizonte), is preparing for a potential dengue epidemic in 2027, according to the state Health Secretariat (SES-MG). Health Secretary Fábio Baccheretti notes arboviral cycles run about three years; the last major outbreak occurred in 2024, with over 1.6 million cases and more than 1,000 deaths. As of early October, SES-MG reports 63,647 probable dengue cases, 49 confirmed deaths, and 17 under laboratory investigation. Although transmission has temporarily declined, high temperatures, heavy rainfall, and El Niño are conducive to Aedes aegypti proliferation. The government’s plan focuses on three fronts: household mobilization, vector control, and community engagement. About 80% of mosquito breeding sites are inside homes. Residents are urged to perform a weekly ten-minute inspection of yards and interiors, remove standing water, seal water tanks, and keep gutters clean ahead of the upcoming rains.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、2027年のデング熱流行リスクに備える 保健局が警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は既知の地域流行病で、2027年の将来予測に関する予防的な注意喚起記事であり、現時点で異常な急増や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、過去の大規模流行歴があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2027年の将来的流行リスクに関する予防的警告であり、2024年の大規模流行（160万例以上、1000人以上死亡）を参照。現在の症例数（63,647例、49死亡）は増加傾向ではなく一時的減少と記載されており、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Lutte contre le paludisme - Le plaidoyer d'Impact Santé Afrique et de la COPEMA-RDC obtient l'engagement du ministre de la santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Combating malaria - Advocacy by Impact Santé Afrique and COPEMA-RDC secures the Minister of Health's commitment.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains a major public health burden, with about 26 million cases and nearly 30,000 deaths in 2025 per the PNLP annual report. Advocacy by Impact Santé Afrique (ISA), COPEMA-RDC, CS4ME, and civil society secured a commitment from Health Minister Samuel Kamba Mulamba to personally monitor PNLP funding and prevent budget cuts. On October 2, 2026, a delegation led by MP Dieudonné Mposhi Kibambi pressed three concrete asks: unlock PNLP operating funds in Q3 2026; ensure PNLP needs are included in the 2027 Finance Law; and strengthen domestic resource mobilization as external funding declines.Internally, the FPS and mandatory health insurance are mobilized to cover simple malaria cases, supported by MoUs with the U.S. government and the Global Fund to bolster response. Civil society will monitor implementation and budget votes to turn commitments into on-ground action in health centers across the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：マラリア対策 - Impact Santé AfriqueとCOPEMA-RDCの提言が保健大臣の約束を取り付ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるマラリアは既知の風土病であり、本記事は資金確保に向けた政策アドボカシー活動を報じるものであって、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は年次マラリア負荷報告（2025年、約2600万症例・約3万人死亡）と資金アドボカシーに関する政策ニュースであり、突発的な感染拡大事象ではないため見送り判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Here's where plague strikes most as Russia rejects outbreak scare
article.articleSummary: Russian authorities say Darya Shipilova's death is not linked to her work at the Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia, and there have been no additional plague cases; Russia maintains the threat level has stabilized. Globally, plague cases remain concentrated in Africa: the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 1,893 confirmed cases from 2019–2024; Madagascar had 1,482 suspected cases and 693 confirmed; Kenya had 375 suspected and 22 confirmed. In the United States, 25 plague cases were reported during 2019–2024, including one pneumonic plague case. The CDC in October published a July 2025 pneumonic plague death in Coconino County, Arizona, where a young man exposed to two sick domestic cats died about eight hours after hospital admission; 46 people were exposed, none became ill thereafter. Officials will continue monitoring outbreaks and seek more information from Russia about Shipilova's death.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアが流行の懸念を否定する中、ペストが最も多く発生している地域はどこか
triage.triage_reason: 主題はロシアでの肺ペスト死亡例とアリゾナでの事例であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCへの言及は2019-2024年の過去統計データであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを示すものではないため対象国での実発生とは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（研究所関係者の死亡、感染拡大なしとロシア当局が主張）と米国アリゾナ州（2025年7月の肺ペスト死亡例）を中心に、世界のペスト発生状況（DRC、マダガスカル、ケニアの過去統計）を紹介する概説記事。対象国での現在進行中の発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo do RS inicia testes com inseticidas para controlar o mosquito transmissor da febre oropouche
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government of Rio Grande do Sul begins testing insecticides to control the mosquito that transmits Oropouche fever.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-09, Rio Grande do Sul’s State Health Secretariat began a nine-week study to control the maruim mosquito, the vector of Oropouche fever, in Três Forquilhas on the Litoral Norte. Since 2024 the state has confirmed two imported Oropouche cases, with no local transmission. Maruim has been identified in Dom Pedro de Alcântara, Itati, Maquiné, Mampituba, Terra de Areia, and Três Forquilhas. Coordinated by the Centro Estadual de Vigilância em Saúde (CEVS), the project includes the Ministry of Health, Fiocruz, Embrapa, the State Agriculture Secretariat, and the Três Forquilhas municipality. It will test insecticide applications and monitor populations to gauge efficacy, identify species, activity peaks, and habitats, and assess possible circulation of Oropouche and other arboviruses in residential and banana-growing areas. Oropouche fever is viral and transmitted by maruim bites; symptoms resemble dengue; diagnosis requires lab tests; no specific treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州政府、オロプーシュ熱を媒介する蚊を制御するための殺虫剤試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でオロプーシュ熱の輸入症例が確認されているが地域内伝播はなく、本記事は予防的な媒介蚊対策研究であり現時点で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な蚊媒介対策プロジェクトの開始を報じるもので、現時点で局地的なオロプーシュ熱の感染拡大は確認されていない。今後の研究結果・感染動向を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Kenya: WHO Yachunguza Uwezekano wa Mgonjwa wa Kwanza Kuambukizwa DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola; Kenya and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) are referenced in the article title, with the WHO reportedly examining the possibility that the first Ebola patient was infected in the DRC. The body provides no epidemiological specifics—no case counts, deaths, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, transmission details, outbreak timeline, or infection source. Publication date is 2026-10-09, but no additional timing information is given. There is no mention of imported or exported cases, nor of ongoing outbreaks or regional status beyond the headline reference to Kenya. The available content appears to be channel branding rather than a detailed public-health report, offering no quantitative data or clinical findings to guide decision-making. In summary, the piece signals a WHO inquiry about the outbreak source (DRC) with Kenya as the contextual reference, without substantive details.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ケニア：WHOがDRCでの感染可能性がある最初の患者について調査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は本質的に重篤・異常な感染症であり、WHOがDRCでの感染可能性を調査しているとの報道は、情報が乏しくても即時のフルリスク評価対象とすべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの疑い患者がDRCで感染した可能性をWHOが調査中との内容だが、症例数・死亡者数・検査確認等の具体的疫学情報は一切記載されていない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。続報による確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridade sanitária alerta para dois focos de doença em aves e coelhos em Ponta Delgada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities warn of two disease outbreaks among birds and rabbits in Ponta Delgada.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease in birds (pigeons and doves) and Rabbit Hemorrhagic Disease (RHD) outbreaks are reported in the municipality of Ponta Delgada, São Miguel, Azores. About 40–50 fatalities per day; Newcastle has persisted for weeks with increasing wildlife deaths. RHD was detected roughly 1–2 weeks ago and is spreading in Capelas, Santo António, Livramento, and areas Fajã de Cima and Fajã de Baixa, with notable impact on the urban rabbit population in Ponta Delgada’s Urban Park. No human infection risk; transmission occurs within species. Correct response includes promptly burying carcasses and contacting the parish or Municipal Health Authority for guidance. Domestic rabbit and bird owners are urged to adopt preventive measures and consider vaccination. The origin of RHD is not yet identified; the disease recurs cyclically in São Miguel over the past two decades due to high density.

triage.headline_ja: ポンタ・デルガダで鳥類とウサギの2つの疾病発生についてポルトガル保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: 動物(野鳥・ウサギ)のみの疾患で人への感染リスクはなく、対象国(ポルトガル・アゾレス諸島は非対象)にも該当しないため、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 発生地域はポルトガル領アゾレス諸島(São Miguel島)であり、対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル・中国(マカオ)の地名も発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリー上では言及がなく誤付与と判断。人への感染リスクもないと明記されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Чем опасен грипп "Дарвин", который распространяется в этом сезоне
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How dangerous is the "Darwin" influenza that is spreading this season?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, the 2026–2027 influenza season is expected to see circulation of the updated A(H3N2) Darwin variant, A/Darwin/1454/2025. This Hong Kong flu lineage strain has undergone antigenic drift, accumulating mutations that markedly changed its antigenic profile from previous seasons. The strain is highly contagious and associated with a severe clinical course; during the 2025–2026 peak, A(H3N2) accounted for about 80% of influenza cases. It carries a substantial risk of severe complications, with high-risk groups particularly affected. Infections with A/Darwin–derived influenza typically begin with a sudden onset of symptoms. The article emphasizes the substantial pathogenic potential of this lineage and the possibility of ongoing outbreaks through the current season.

triage.headline_ja: 今シーズン流行しているインフルエンザ「ダーウィン株」の危険性とは
triage.triage_reason: A(H3N2)ダーウィン変異株による季節性インフルエンザの一般的な解説記事であり、対象国（中国等）での具体的な発生状況・症例数は記載がなく情報不足のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア語メディアによる季節性インフルエンザ(A/H3N2 Darwin株)の一般的解説で、具体的な発生国（香港・中国・オーストラリア等）における感染者数や公衆衛生対応の詳細は記載されていない。発生地域として付与された香港・中国・オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれる中国のみだが、記事本文からは中国国内での具体的発生事実が確認できないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 加纳上西部省暴发黄热病疫情 3例确诊病例死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow fever outbreak in Ghana's Upper West Region; 3 confirmed cases have died.
article.articleSummary: Ghana's Ministry of Health on October 8 declared a Yellow fever outbreak in the Upper West Region, with 3 confirmed cases and all three deaths, and about 450 suspected cases reported from June to September. The government activated the National and Regional Health Emergency Operations Centers and deployed a National Rapid Response Team to affected communities for case finding, surveillance, and risk communication. An emergency vaccination campaign is planned this month in the affected areas. Yellow fever is caused by the yellow fever virus and transmitted by mosquitoes; symptoms include high fever, headache, jaundice, and bleeding, and severe cases can be fatal. There is no specific antiviral therapy; vaccination remains the most effective preventive measure. The announcement emphasizes rapid response and vaccination as key steps to control the outbreak in Ghana.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ上西部州で黄熱病が発生、確定症例3例全員死亡
triage.triage_reason: 確定例の致死率100%で公衆衛生上深刻かつ疑い例450人と規模が大きく、ワクチンキャンペーンなど国際支援が示唆されるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 確定例3例全員死亡、疑い例約450例（6月〜9月）。緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを今月実施予定。蚊媒介感染症でヒト-ヒト感染ではないが、流行地域拡大のリスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina reforça vacinação contra o sarampo após registro de casos no Brasil em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina strengthens measles vaccination after reports of cases in Brazil in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 5, 2026, Brazil reported 52 measles cases, including 41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, and 1 in Rio de Janeiro. Teresina's Municipal Health Foundation (FMS) is strengthening measles vaccination to prevent reintroduction in a country with no endemic transmission. The outbreak unfolds amid widespread measles circulation in the Americas, with the United States, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, and Canada affected; in the United States, over 90% of cases are linked to unvaccinated or vaccination-unknown individuals. Teresina last reported a measles case in 2019. Measles is highly contagious, transmitted via respiratory droplets; there is no specific treatment beyond supportive care. An infected person can transmit to up to 90% of non-immune contacts; the virus can remain viable in air and on surfaces after departure of the case. Vaccination and surveillance are crucial to protect populations.

triage.headline_ja: テレジナ市、2026年ブラジルでの麻疹症例報告を受けワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の地域排除を達成しているブラジルで新規症例52例（複数州）が確認され、米州全体で流行が拡大している異常事態であり、国際的拡大リスクも認められるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジルは麻疹の地域排除(elimination)状態にあったため、複数州（サンパウロ、アマゾナス、リオデジャネイロ）での症例確認は異常事態。米州全体（米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダ）で流行が広がっている点も国際的拡大の懸念材料だが、これら他国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dżuma jako broń biologiczna. Jednostka 731, Ningbo i oblężenie Kaffy | HISTORIA.org.pl
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague as a Biological Weapon. Unit 731, Ningbo, and the Siege of Kaffa | HISTORIA.org.pl
article.articleSummary: On October 27, 1940, Japanese aircraft dropped fleas infected with Yersinia pestis over Ningbo, Zhejiang, China, triggering a plague outbreak; the first death occurred on October 30. By November 2 authorities sealed the outbreak area, and on November 3 plague was confirmed. The attack aimed to provoke epidemics and fear, leveraging advanced knowledge of transmission. It was part of Shirō Ishii’s Unit 731 bioweapons program, tied to a broader network including 1644 in Nanjing and Unit 100 in Changchun. In Ningbo, isolation teams, decontamination, and burials were organized; seven households reported no survivors. Unit 731 conducted deadly experiments on prisoners—deliberately infecting them with plague, cholera, and anthrax, sometimes via vivisection. Some estimates suggest up to 600 prisoners were killed annually at a single facility during such experiments.

triage.headline_ja: 生物兵器としてのペスト。731部隊、寧波、カッファ包囲戦 | HISTORIA.org.pl
triage.triage_reason: 1940年の歴史的出来事（日本軍731部隊による寧波へのペスト攻撃）を扱う歴史記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は1940年の歴史的事件（日本軍731部隊によるペスト生物兵器攻撃）を扱う歴史解説記事であり、現在の公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため対象国には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies casts a shadow on Gir's pride
article.articleSummary: Rabies-linked lion deaths in Gujarat's Greater Gir landscape total two in four months—one confirmed in June and another reported in October 2026. The latest case involves a lioness that attacked five people in Amreli and died within 20 hours of rescue; the five victims received anti-rabies vaccination after initial care at a primary health centre lacking vaccines, then at a private hospital, and are under observation. Gujarat government has issued directives to aggressively implement the Gujarat Rabies Control Regulations, 2023, to address gaps in dog-bite data and surveillance, aiming for Zero human rabies deaths by 2030. Lab confirmation for the latest death is awaited; officials say some lion deaths are not tested for rabies. Feral dogs in Amreli, Junagadh, Gir-Somnath, Bhavnagar total about 100,000, with 84,460 wild ungulates outside protected forests; transmission routes include dogs, jackals, and mongooses, plus babesiosis risk from cattle ticks. Calls for transparent testing protocols and strengthened post-exposure treatment and broader surveillance beyond protected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病がギルの誇り（アジアライオン）に影を落とす
triage.triage_reason: 絶滅危惧種のアジアライオンにおける狂犬病死亡と、人間5人への曝露・医療体制（ワクチン不足）の課題が明らかになっており、WPRO基準を複数満たし社会的・行政的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 絶滅危惧種アジアライオンでの狂犬病感染は希少種保全上重要な事象。人間への直接的大規模感染は確認されていないが、野犬・ジャッカル・マングースを介した感染環、医療施設でのワクチン不足、サーベイランス体制のギャップが指摘されており、動物由来感染症対策として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária: carne de frango e ovos são seguros para consumo?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: Are chicken meat and eggs safe for consumption?
article.articleSummary:
Avian influenza outbreak confirmed in backyard poultry in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Officials in Selbach, Alto Jacuí, reported the index case on October 5; laboratory testing at LFDA-SP confirmed the virus. Despite the detection, authorities say consuming chicken meat and eggs remains safe when properly cooked, and the OMS advises avoiding raw or undercooked products in affected regions. The principal human risk is direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments.

Containment measures: by October 7, inspectors surveyed 70 properties within a 3-km radius and one commercial farm within 10 km that was not housing birds at the time; no new suspicions were found within 3 km, and the focus is considered closed but surveillance continues. Producers and farm workers are urged not to handle suspect animals and to report promptly to the official veterinary service. Key warning signs include sudden mortality, respiratory or neurological changes.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：鶏肉と卵は食べても安全か？
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部の裏庭養鶏での鳥インフルエンザ発生は既に封じ込められ、人への感染例もなく、食品安全性についての注意喚起記事であるため、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 人への感染例は報告されておらず、発生地域の監視は継続中だが発生地点（フォーカス）は封鎖済みとされている。記事は主に食品安全に関する消費者向け情報。

article.articleHeadline: 87 jawans hospitalised with dengue in 10 days in Gandhinagar; one dies
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, a dengue outbreak among security personnel deployed for the Statue of Unity parade in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, involves 87 jawans admitted to Gandhinagar Civil Hospital over 10 days, from BSF, CRPF and ITBP. One jawan has died; postmortem results will determine the exact cause. Of the 87 admissions, 50 have recovered and been discharged, while 37 remain under treatment and observation. The affected personnel had arrived in Gujarat from Odisha, Jharkhand, Delhi, West Bengal and Chhattisgarh to participate in the event. Dengue is the diagnosed infection, with ongoing monitoring by the state health department as hospital authorities continue to treat the affected personnel."

triage.headline_ja: ガンディナガルで10日間に87人の兵士がデング熱で入院、1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 特定イベント（統一の像パレード）に参加した治安部隊員87人が短期間でデング熱により入院し1人死亡しており、クラスター発生として異常性と重症度の観点からフルリスク評価が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで流行性疾患であり、本件はグジャラート州ガンディナガルでの特定イベント参加者間の局所的クラスターと考えられる。死因は検視結果待ちであり、重症度の確定情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Conceição do Mato Dentro intensifica combate à dengue com visitas domiciliares e ações educativas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Conceição do Mato Dentro steps up the fight against dengue with home visits and educational campaigns.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention intensified in Conceição do Mato Dentro, Minas Gerais, Brazil, over the last 15 days with door-to-door visits and elimination of mosquito breeding sites. Led by Endemic Disease Control Agents (ACE) in coordination with the Municipal Health Secretariat and the Health Surveillance Department, activities cover residences, UBSs, CEMO, UPA, and schools, with daily fieldwork to remove larval habitats and educate residents on preventing standing water. Educational campaigns accompany home visits to boost community participation in source reduction. ACEs also joined a Regional Arbovirus Seminar by the Minas Gerais State Health Department to update practices. Residents are urged to keep yards clean, remove unused containers, check gutters and drains, and regularly inspect water tanks. Cooperation during visits is essential as preventive efforts continue daily under local health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンセイサン・ド・マト・デントロ市、家庭訪問と啓発活動でデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱予防活動・啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な発生や重症例の急増等の情報はなく、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の一地方自治体における通常のデング熱予防活動（家庭訪問、啓発キャンペーン）を報じるもので、感染拡大や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Possible norovirus in raspberry pastries sold at nine Montreal-area bakeries
article.articleSummary: Norovirus contamination risk tied to Alasko-brand frozen raspberries from China triggered a Canadian Food Inspection Agency recall and a MAPAQ warning about raspberry pastries sold at Boulangerie Ange in Montreal-area suburbs. Affected products are raspberry tart, raspberry tartlet, and, at some locations, raspberry Danish, sold individually between Sept. 8–11 at nine Boulangerie Ange sites (some packaged with a Boulangerie Ange label); pastries may also have been sold online or through community groups. The ministry notes a few illness cases have been reported to MAPAQ linked to the recalled raspberries. Symptoms of norovirus include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea and abdominal cramps, typically starting 24–48 hours after exposure. Consumers are advised not to eat these pastries and to seek medical care if symptoms develop. MAPAQ is reviewing other Quebec retailers; more recalls could follow. For questions: smsaia@mapaq.gouv.qc.ca.

triage.headline_ja: モントリオール近郊の9つのパン屋で販売されたラズベリーペストリーにノロウイルス混入の可能性
triage.triage_reason: カナダ（モントリオール）での食品リコール事案であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国は冷凍ラズベリーの原産地として言及されているのみで、実際のイベント発生国ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChinaが含まれるが、これは冷凍ラズベリーの原産地情報であり、実際の感染・流通イベントはカナダ（ケベック州モントリオール）で発生している。カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Analysis: Ghana's yellow fever numbers reveal a gap between vaccination and protection
article.articleSummary: Ghana recorded about 450 suspected yellow fever cases from June–September 2026, including 74 in the Upper West Region and three laboratory-confirmed infections. The data highlight the gap between suspected and confirmed cases, and between vaccination and verified immunity, as no national breakdown of confirmed/negative/pending results has been released. Yellow fever is mosquito-borne; vaccination is the key protection. Past data show 235 Ghanaian cases reported 2021–2025, but 450 suspected in 2026 are not directly comparable due to differing case definitions. Upper West has prior outbreak history; Wa East (2021) involved 57 suspected, 12 confirmed and four deaths, with vaccination in the district rising from 25% to 95% after mass campaigns. National routine vaccination estimates: 94% (2021), 95% (2022), 88% (2023), 91% (2025). The International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis (ICVP) records vaccination but does not guarantee protection; gaps arise if certificates are falsified or lost, though one-dose vaccination is generally lifelong.

triage.headline_ja: 分析:ガーナの黄熱病数値が明らかにするワクチン接種と防御力のギャップ
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例450件・確定例3件のみで重症度や死亡の報告がなく、ワクチン接種率データの分析記事であるため緊急性は低いが、ベクター媒介感染症として継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年6-9月の疑い例450件(確定3件)とワクチン接種率のギャップに関する分析記事。過去のWa East地区での2021年アウトブレイク(57疑い例、12確定、4死亡)と比較しているが、2026年分のデータでは重症度・死亡情報が明示されていない。国全体の確定/陰性/保留の内訳データも未公開であり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil reforça combate ao sarampo diante do aumento de casos nas Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil steps up the fight against measles amid rising cases across the Americas
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks prompt Brazil to intensify surveillance and vaccination as cases rise in the United States and across the Americas. As of October 5, 2026, Brazil reported 52 imported measles cases: 41 in São Paulo, 10 in Amazonas, and 1 in Rio de Janeiro. Authorities warn against new introductions due to international travel. Measures include intensified epidemiological surveillance, investigation of suspected cases, contact tracing, and post-detection ring vaccination to limit transmission. Health teams reinforce guidance on symptoms and urge seeking care for suspicious cases. Measles is a highly contagious viral infection transmitted mainly by the air and respiratory droplets, with fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a characteristic red rash; severe complications include pneumonia and encephalitis. Vaccination remains the primary prevention; ensure up-to-date immunization and obtain doses at the SUS. Brazil regained measles-endemic circulation-free status in November 2024 (OPAS), but vigilance and high vaccination coverage are essential to prevent sustained transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アメリカ大陸で麻疹症例増加を受け対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除ステータスを有するブラジルで輸入症例が52例確認され、国際的な人の移動による再導入リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を2項目満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（サンパウロ、アマゾナス、リオデジャネイロ）の輸入麻疹症例に関する報道であり、カナリア諸島・スペイン・米国は参照地域として言及されているのみで対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases surge in Pune as Oct heat boost mosquito breeding
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever surges in Pune, India, as October heat and lingering humidity boost Aedes breeding. Since January, Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) records over 1,700 suspected dengue cases and 90 confirmed across the city; by Oct 8, 96 suspected and 25 confirmed in October. Chikungunya totals stand at 26. Hospitals report rising dengue admissions, with longer recovery and complications such as serositis, dengue hepatitis, dengue shock syndrome, and low platelets, including in children. Experts attribute the uptick to post-monsoon heat, humidity and standing water sustaining transmission, though heat alone is not the cause. Emphasis on early testing and vigilance: monitor fever, hydration, and platelet/hematocrit levels; seek medical care rather than self-medicating. Preventive measures urged: eliminate stagnant water, use repellents, wear covered clothing, and employ nets or screens.

triage.headline_ja: プネーでデング熱急増、10月の暑さが蚊の繁殖を助長
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加であり、インドで毎年見られる流行パターンの範囲内だが、重症化例や患者数増加が報告されており経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はインドで毎年季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域の公衆衛生当局による対応で管理可能と考えられるが、重症例（デング性肝炎、ショック症候群等）の報告があるため継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lagoa Santa registra 178 casos de sarna humana e mantém suspensão das aulas - Cidades - Aqui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoa Santa records 178 cases of human scabies and maintains the suspension of classes - Cities - Here.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks in Lagoa Santa, within the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reached 178 confirmed cases with 75 under investigation (253 total notifications) as of Oct 8. In the last 24 hours, 12 new cases were recorded. Municipal schools remain closed on Oct 9 as a precaution amid rising cases. All notified individuals were referred to the municipal health network for evaluation and treatment guidance. Families are advised to watch for intense itching and skin lesions, seek professional assessment if suspected, and reinforce hygiene by laundering clothes, towels, and bedding while avoiding close contact with possibly infected persons. The school suspension is precautionary and not a routine control measure; transmission is not halted by school closure alone. Minas Gerais reports seven outbreaks in 2026, including Lagoa Santa and outbreaks in Andradas, Itapecerica, Lavras, Joaquim Felício, Coronel Xavier Chaves, and Alfenas. Scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei and spread mainly through prolonged direct contact or shared items; diagnosis is by a health professional; it is not on the national/state-notifiable list, and two linked cases trigger SES-MG notification.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタで疥癬178例確認、休校措置を継続
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低い疾患だが、学校休校など地域対応が継続しており、ミナスジェライス州内で複数の集団発生が報告されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は国際的に重大な公衆衛生リスクとはみなされないが、ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州内で複数の自治体にまたがる集団発生があり、地域の学校閉鎖措置が続いているため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: " Nous voulons rentrer chez nous " : en RDC, l'autre urgence derrière Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We want to go home": in the DRC, the other emergency behind Ebola
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak now spans seven provinces and 64 health zones, with 8,665 confirmed cases and 4,178 deaths (case fatality 48.2%), 2,259 recoveries and 890 patients hospitalized or in quarantine. In the shadow of the response, the humanitarian crisis worsens: about 12 million people in affected provinces need aid, of whom roughly 8 million have needs directly linked to Ebola. More than 6.1 million displaced; 26 million facing food insecurity; malnutrition affects over 4 million children under five. Disrupted health services and violence hinder care; 343 aid workers targeted, eight killed this year. UN OCHA warns against fragmenting the response and calls for sustained access, protection, and unity of Ebola control and emergency relief. The aid plan totals $2.13 billion to reach 10.7 million people, with about $1 billion still unfunded. Residents like Maman Miriamou in Oicha, North Kivu, long to return home and farm again.

triage.headline_ja: 「私たちは家に帰りたい」：コンゴ民主共和国、エボラの陰に隠れたもう一つの緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC7州64保健地区に拡大し、感染者8,665人・死者4,178人（致死率48.2%）に達する大規模アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が明確なため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の大規模エボラアウトブレイクの継続報道であり、国連OCHAが人道支援資金不足（約10億ドル）と対応の分断リスクを警告している。感染拡大7州・暴力による医療活動妨害・援助従事者への攻撃（343件、死者8人）も報告されており、継続的な注視と既存のRRA更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak update - October 7, 2026
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 7, 2026, the DRC reports 59 new EVD cases across Ituri (29), North Kivu (26), and Haut-Uele (4), including 26 community deaths. ETC deaths total 11: Ituri 4, North Kivu 4, Tshopo 1, Haut-Uele 2, lifting period deaths to 37. Recoveries: 23 (Ituri 15, North Kivu 8). Cumulative: 8,787 cases, 4,242 deaths (CFR 48.3%). Ituri remains epicenter with 74.5% of cumulative cases and 49.2% of last 24-hour new cases. 64 of 167 health zones (38.3%) across seven provinces affected. UNICEF notes nearly 2,000 children have lost or been separated from parents since the start of the 17th outbreak; as of Sept 29, 2,076 pediatric cases and 1,162 deaths. Children account for >25% of cases and about one-third of deaths; under-five fatality is seven in ten, with many dying before care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク最新情報 - 2026年10月7日
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大を続け、累計8,787症例・死亡4,242人（CFR 48.3%）、7州64保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: UNICEFが小児への深刻な影響（症例の25%以上、死亡の約1/3、5歳未満致死率7割）を報告しており、人道的観点からも注視が必要。国際的拡大・渡航制限の有無については記事内に明示情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: diversos municípios brasileiros entram em alerta; veja como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: several Brazilian municipalities are on alert; see how to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: Despite a near 70% drop in dengue cases in Brazil in 2026, 49.2% of municipalities are at alert or risk for Aedes aegypti infestation. The LIRAa rapid survey (May–August 2026) shows 42.3% of breeding sites in small containers (plant dishes, pots, bottles), 26.1% in water-storage tanks, and 23% in tires, debris. Regional patterns: North concentrates on tires and discarded materials; Northeast focuses on water deposits; Southeast, South, and Central-West on domestic containers. As of September 26, 2026, about 470.5k probable dengue cases, down from 1.5 million in the same period 2025. Chikungunya cases fell to 67,902; Zika to 2,141. El Niño could raise transmission by altering rainfall and temperatures; projected dengue in 2027 around 1.7 million (InfoDengue/Fiocruz). Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, sealing water tanks, careful plant management, and cleaning gutters.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ブラジルの複数の自治体が警戒態勢に；予防方法を確認
triage.triage_reason: 2026年はデング熱症例数が前年比で大幅減少しており、既知の季節性流行への注意喚起記事であり、新規性・異常性は低い。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年比で減少傾向にあり、記事は予防啓発が主目的。El Niñoによる2027年の増加予測はあるが現時点でのシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la RD del Congo supera 8.700 casos y 4.200 muertos - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 8,700 cases and 4,200 deaths - teleSUR.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths (case fatality rate 48.2%), according to the WHO. Between Sept 25 and Oct 6, 775 new infections and 379 deaths were reported. Transmission remains high nationwide, with expansion to Alimbongo in North Kivu and a total of 64 health zones across seven eastern provinces; Ituri remains heavily affected. High mortality and many deaths outside hospitals reflect delays in detection and access to care. The outbreak began May 15, 2026, in both DRC and Uganda; Uganda’s emergency ended July 28, with WHO confirmation on Aug 25. On Oct 6 Kenya reported its first Ebola case in a traveler from Congo, who died. MSF calls North Kivu transmission 'out of control' as health capacity is stretched. The Bundibugyo strain spreads rapidly and could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak in scale and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、感染者8,700人・死者4,200人を超える - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.2%の大規模エボラ流行がDRCで継続拡大し、ケニアへの越境例も発生するなど国際的拡大リスクが明白であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例にも言及があるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。MSFが北キブでの感染拡大を「制御不能」と表現しており、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る規模になる可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Estado alerta para prevenção da raiva e reforça cuidados com cães, gatos e morcegos | Tribuna de Petrópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State on alert for rabies prevention and reinforces precautions for dogs, cats, and bats | Tribuna de Petrópolis
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Rio de Janeiro state after August confirmation of a rabies case in a dog living in an urban area of the city of Rio de Janeiro, with history of bat exposure. In Petrópolis, authorities urge keeping dogs and cats vaccinated and avoiding contact with bats and wildlife; do not touch unknown animals. If a sick or dead bat is found, isolate it, cover with a bucket, cardboard box, or clean, dry cloth, and contact Environmental Surveillance. People should report animals showing signs such as abrupt behavior change, heavy salivation, lack of motor coordination, or progressive paralysis. If there is human exposure, wash the area with water and soap and seek urgent care, preferably at UPA Cascatinha. Vaccination is the main prevention; Petrópolis has carried out four vaccination campaigns this year, vaccinating 23,026 dogs and cats (72.4% coverage). Rabies is a deadly viral disease transmitted via saliva, nearly 100% fatal after symptoms. Environmental Surveillance unit: Rua Dr. Sá Earp, 433, Morin; phones: (24) 2231-0841 / 2291-1594 / 2291-1797.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、狂犬病予防を警戒—犬・猫・コウモリへの注意を強化
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ市内の都市部で犬1頭の狂犬病感染（コウモリ曝露歴あり）が確認され予防キャンペーンが実施されているが、人への感染例は報告されておらず、緊急性の高い公衆衛生上の危機とは言えない。
triage.notes: 都市部の犬における狂犬病感染（コウモリ由来の可能性）が確認され、地方自治体が予防ワクチン接種キャンペーンと注意喚起を実施中。人への感染報告はなく、国際的拡大やWHO通知相当の事案ではないが、野生動物由来の都市部スピルオーバーとして継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Accidentes, fugas de virus y brechas de bioseguridad: el peligro que duerme oculto en probetas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Accidents, virus leaks, and biosafety breaches: the danger that lies dormant in test tubes.
article.articleSummary: Possible pneumonic plague case in Russia triggers alarms as of 2026-10-09; Moscow says the crisis is over, but the World Health Organization requests more testing. One death; 200 people in quarantine; journalists who exposed the leak fled Russia; sources say the outbreak came from a broken test tube. Historically, lab leaks include: 2004 Beijing University incident where two Chinese PhD students were infected, 11 people contaminated, and a mother died; 2007 UK foot-and-mouth disease escaped into wastewater, eight farms affected and thousands of animals culled; late 1970s Soviet bioweapons facility released anthrax spores, causing 66 deaths and hundreds of animal deaths; Janet Parker smallpox death in Birmingham leading to tighter UK lab-placement rules; 1955 US polio vaccine disaster infected about 40,000 children, with 260 paralysis and 10 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 事故、ウイルス漏洩、バイオセキュリティの不備：試験管の中に潜む危険
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアでの肺ペスト疑い事例を発端とした過去のラボ漏洩事故（北京大学2004年、英国口蹄疫2007年、ソ連炭疽菌、天然痘、ポリオワクチン事故）を振り返る歴史的レビュー記事であり、対象国リストにおける現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 主題はロシアでの肺ペスト疑い事例だが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれない。中国（北京大学）の言及は2004年の過去の歴史的事例であり、現在進行中のイベントではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: País registra tendência de alta de casos de síndrome respiratória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country reports an upward trend in cases of respiratory syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Fiocruz InfoGripe reports a national rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI), driven by RSV, rhinovirus, and metapneumovirus, with COVID-19–related SARI remaining at low levels. Vaccination of priority groups against COVID-19 is urged, and pregnant women should also receive RSV vaccination. The data show increasing hospitalizations among children and adolescents aged 2–14. Alagoas, Roraima, and Sergipe are in alert/risk for rising pediatric cases; Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina have high incidence without a clear growth trend. Capitals Aracaju, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, São Luís, and Vitória report higher SARI activity. Since January 2026, more than 161,000 SARI cases have been notified nationwide, with RSV and rhinovirus predominating; metapneumovirus cases rise in the South, Southeast, and Northeast, including Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Espírito Santo. SARI mainly affects children under two; deaths occur more in those 65+.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、呼吸器症候群症例の増加傾向を報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のRSV・ライノウイルス・メタニューモウイルスによるSARI増加であり、COVID-19関連は低水準。小児・高齢者の入院増加は見られるが、通常の季節性流行パターンの範囲内であり、新興感染症としての異常性は低い。
triage.notes: Fiocruz InfoGripeによる定期的な呼吸器疾患サーベイランス報告であり、ブラジル国内の季節性流行として位置づけられる。複数州・都市で入院増加が見られるが、新興感染症としての異常性・国際拡大リスクは確認されない。続報（COVID-19動向や死亡率の変化等）を注視する価値はある。

article.articleHeadline: Travel-related dengue fever case reported on Oʻahu
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-09, Hawaiʻi Department of Health reports a new travel-related dengue fever case on Oʻahu, bringing Hawaii’s 2026 total to eight; all cases involve travel to Pacific Island countries/territories and show no link to prior Hawaiʻi cases. The infected individual acquired the virus while traveling in a dengue-endemic region. Health teams are conducting inspections and mosquito-control in the area; the risk of local transmission is low. Recent heavy rain highlights the need to eliminate standing water to reduce breeding. Dengue is a year-round risk in tropical/subtropical areas, including Central/South America (Brazil, Mexico), parts of Asia (Philippines), Africa, the Caribbean (Puerto Rico), and Pacific islands (American Samoa, FSM, Marshall Islands, Palau). Travelers should review country-specific guidance 4–6 weeks before travel, use EPA-registered repellents, wear protective clothing, and stay in screened or air-conditioned accommodations. Return travelers should prevent bites for 3 weeks and seek evaluation within 2 weeks if symptoms (fever, nausea, vomiting, rash, body aches) develop; report suspected cases at 808-586-4586.

triage.headline_ja: オアフ島で渡航関連のデング熱症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: ハワイにおける渡航関連の散発例で、現地伝播リスクは低いと報告されており、対象国における新規・異常な感染拡大は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はハワイ（米国）での渡航関連デング熱症例に関するもので、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル、フィリピン等）は流行地域の一般的な例示として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tecpar concede Selo de Inovação à plataforma que monitora dengue, chikungunya e zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tecpar grants the Seal of Innovation to the platform that monitors dengue, chikungunya, and Zika.
article.articleSummary: Tecpar, the Institute of Technology of Paraná, awarded the Selo de Inovação to EDL Brasil for the Plataforma Digital Integrada de Inteligência Territorial para Vigilância de Arboviroses, a system for dengue, chikungunya and Zika surveillance. The platform unites a field mobile app, a web portal, interactive dashboards, georeferencing, logistics, maintenance, routes, and epidemiological data in an offline-first environment to support public and private sector operations. Validated with municipal health secretaries and Tecpar’s campus, it currently monitors more than 1,500 georeferenced points nationwide, including seven active points at the Tecpar Campus CIC, with 23 more planned before summer—the peak period for vector reproduction. Linked to Estações Disseminadoras de Larvicida (EDLs) — smart traps that autodisseminate larvicide to hard-to-reach breeding sites—the platform tracks device locations and field activities, turning records into actionable data for decision-makers to improve disease control and resource use.

triage.headline_ja: Tecpar、デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱を監視するプラットフォームに「イノベーション・シール」を授与
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、ブラジルの技術機関が監視プラットフォームに技術革新賞を授与したという内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱等の症例発生自体ではなく、監視技術プラットフォームへの表彰に関するもの。疾患の発生地域（Paraná州）への言及はあるが、具体的な症例数・流行状況の記載はないため対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde em Pauta estreia com episódio sobre prevenção do sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health on the Agenda debuts with an episode on measles prevention.
article.articleSummary: Measles-focused episode of Saúde em Pauta, aired Oct 8, 2026, features Dr. Ana Carolina Martins clarifying transmission, early symptoms, and differentiation from other infections, with emphasis on pediatric presentation. It covers vulnerable groups, complication risks, and guidance for suspected infection. Vaccination is central; explains who should receive doses and steps if vaccination history is uncertain or exposure occurred. Dr. Martins—medical degree from São Leopoldo Mandic (2023), pediatric residency at USP (2025), coordinator of Pediatrics at Hospital Brasil, Mauá—discusses her clinical background. The new health segment on Diário's DGABCTV aims to inform the public through expert conversations; full episode available via link.

triage.headline_ja: 「健康アジェンダ」が麻疹予防をテーマに初回放送
triage.triage_reason: 実際の麻疹アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、医療情報番組での予防啓発コンテンツであるため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Prevalence, characteristics, and clinical course of mpox-related ophthalmic disease (MBOTE-EYE): a prospective cohort study in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: MBOTE-EYE is a prospective cohort study conducted in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, examining mpox-related ophthalmic disease. It aims to determine the prevalence of ophthalmic involvement among mpox cases, describe clinical characteristics and progression, and monitor outcomes over time. The multicenter cohort collects demographic and clinical data, infection timing, and treatment, with potential laboratory confirmation as reported. By tracking onset to resolution or deterioration, the study provides insights into symptoms such as conjunctival involvement and visual sequelae, informing clinical management of mpox patients. The research brings together institutions across Bukavu, Kinshasa, Goma, and international partners in Belgium, the United States, Canada, France, South Africa, Japan, and beyond, contributing to public health surveillance and response in the DRC as of publication date 2026-10-09.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox関連眼疾患(MBOTE-EYE)の有病率、特徴、臨床経過：コンゴ民主共和国南キヴ州における前向きコホート研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既知のMpoxアウトブレイクに関する臨床研究（前向きコホート研究）の紹介であり、新規の感染症イベントや異常な公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術研究（臨床コホート研究）の紹介であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。研究拠点としてベルギー・米国・カナダ・フランス・南アフリカ・日本等が挙げられているが、これらは国際協力機関であり発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil bate recorde histórico nas exportações de frango com 1,51 milhão de toneladas em 3 meses, supera trimestre anterior e consolida recuperação após restrições por gripe aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil posts a historic record in chicken exports of 1.51 million tonnes in three months, surpassing the previous quarter and consolidating the recovery after avian influenza restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian chicken exports reached 1.51 million tonnes in Q3 2026 (July–September), the highest quarterly volume on record in the Secex series (since 1997), up 2.2% from Q2. September alone exported 500.3 thousand tonnes, the fourth-highest monthly total in 2026. Year-over-year comparisons show September up 3.7%. The quarterly performance underscores a recovery after export restrictions tied to an avian influenza case at a commercial farm in Montenegro, Rio Grande do Sul, in May 2025. Analysts from Cepea note the annual comparison must consider that context, but the Q3 record indicates the rebound of Brazil’s chicken shipments to international markets. The report, published Oct 9, 2026, relies on Secex data via Compre Rural; it reports volumes but not revenue, destinations, or prices.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、3カ月で151万トンの鶏肉輸出で過去最高記録を達成、前四半期を上回り鳥インフルエンザ規制後の回復を定着
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2025年5月の鳥インフルエンザ関連輸出規制からの回復を伝える経済・貿易統計記事であり、現在進行中の新規感染拡大や公衆衛生上の懸念は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年5月に発生した鳥インフルエンザ事例による輸出規制からの貿易回復を扱う経済記事であり、現時点での新規感染事例は報告されていない。過去事例であるためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo confirmado: médica orienta pacientes sobre vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles confirmed: doctor advises patients on vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 October 2026, two confirmed measles cases were reported in Rio Branco, Acre, Brazil—an 11-month-old child and a 30-year-old woman. Rheumatologist Talita de Oliveira Ribeiro warned on social media that the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine uses live attenuated viruses and may be contraindicated for patients with significant immunosuppression, including those on biologics, JAK inhibitors, or certain immunosuppressants. Confirmed diagnoses do not necessarily indicate local transmission. The alert emphasizes that immunosuppressed individuals should have vaccination evaluated by their treating physician. SBIm recommends two MMR doses starting at 12 months, with at least one month between doses; the standard pediatric schedule is 12 and 15 months. For those 60+, vaccination should consider susceptibility and epidemiological risk. Measles is airborne, causing fever, red rash, cough, and coryza, and can progress to pneumonia or encephalitis. Rio Branco’s vaccination coverage is reported above 98%; there is no mass vaccination yet, but authorities are monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹確認：医師がワクチン接種について患者に助言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州で麻疹確定例2件が報告されたが、地域の感染ではなく、ワクチン接種率も98%超と高く大規模感染拡大の兆候はないため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 確定例は2件のみで、地域内伝播は確認されていない。ワクチン接種率が高く、当局は監視を継続している段階。免疫抑制患者への接種に関する注意喚起が主な内容。

article.articleHeadline: വിട്ടുമാറാതെ മലമ്പനി; രോഗവാഹകരിലേറെയും അതിഥിത്തൊഴിലാളികൾ, കൂടുതൽ ഇടുക്കിയിലെ തോട്ടംമേഖലയിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Relentless malaria; more among disease carriers and migrant workers in Idukki's plantation belt.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a challenge in Kerala, with rising transmission among migrant workers in Idukki's plantation belt, despite local control efforts. In 2026, 983 people have been confirmed with malaria and seven deaths, six of which were migrant workers. Most cases cluster among migrant laborers in Idukki, including workers from Jharkhand, Odisha, and Bihar, with hundreds affected. In Ernakulam district, Perumbavoor and Kakkanad report a second concentration, largely linked to workers from Odisha, Bengal, and Bihar. Return of migrants during election periods coincides with higher case counts this year. Malaria is transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes that bite at night. Symptoms include high fever, chills, headache, and weakness; fever with shivering warrants blood testing. Prevention focuses on avoiding bites (bed nets, repellents) and eliminating standing water in ponds, irrigation channels, pits, wells, and water-filled tires.

triage.headline_ja: 収まらないマラリア；感染者の多くは出稼ぎ労働者、イドゥッキのプランテーション地帯で拡大
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州で出稼ぎ労働者を中心にマラリア感染と死亡例が継続的に報告されているが、地域的な流行であり国際的拡大リスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: ケララ州イドゥッキ県・エルナクラム県の出稼ぎ労働者（ジャールカンド、オディシャ、西ベンガル、ビハール出身）間でマラリア感染が集中。2026年に983人確認、死亡7人（うち6人が出稼ぎ労働者）。地域的な公衆衛生問題であり、国際的な懸念事項ではない。
