article.articleHeadline: 食安中心指令停售 馬莎兩款進口預先包裝食品疑受沙門氏菌污染 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Food Safety orders a halt to the sale of two imported Marks & Spencer prepackaged foods suspected of Salmonella contamination
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety ordered a halt to sale of two Marks & Spencer imported prepackaged foods suspected of Salmonella contamination, following notices from UK and Ireland authorities. The affected products are Marks & Spencer Vegan Nut Quinoa Salad with Middle Eastern Sesame Sauce (285g) and Pistachio and Parmesan Cheese Pesto (115g), both from the United Kingdom. Potential Salmonella-contaminated batches have best-before dates: the salad 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-11; the pesto 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-13. Importer ALF Retail Hong Kong Limited has stopped selling, pulled the products, and initiated a recall. The Centre learned of the recall via the Food Incident Monitoring System. Inquiries can be made to the importer hotline 8 0093 1457 during office hours. The public is advised not to consume affected batches; industry should halt distribution.

triage.headline_ja: 食安中心、マークス&スペンサーの輸入済み包装済み食品2品のサルモネラ菌汚染疑いで販売停止を指示
triage.triage_reason: 英国・アイルランド発の食品リコールに伴う香港での予防的措置であり、ヒトの感染例報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは確認されない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はサルモネラ症であり、Bluedot付与の腸チフス・パラチフスとは一致しない。香港は輸入食品の販売停止を発令した場所であり、発生源は英国・アイルランドだが対象国リストに含まれないため、香港（China扱い）のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: 肺鼠疫燒到中國？ 東北三省瘋傳囤糧備藥 封城警訊 | 中俄邊境疫情 | 俄羅斯鼠疫研究所 | 東北三省囤糧
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has pneumonic plague reached China? Northeast three provinces panic-buy food and medicines; lockdown warning | Sino-Russian border outbreak | Russian Institute of Plague Research | Northeast three provinces hoard food
article.articleSummary: Rumors of pneumonic plague in Russia have triggered panic in Northeast China, with authorities reporting no confirmed outbreak. A cross-border infectious disease drill was held in August 2026 between China and Russia. A Russian plague research institute technician, a 28-year-old woman, was hospitalized with severe pneumonia on Sept 29 and died on Oct 2; authorities say the death cause is not confirmed and tests did not reveal a high-risk pathogen linked to her work. About 200 close contacts were quarantined and monitored. In the three northeastern Chinese provinces along the border, residents reportedly stockpile food, masks, gloves, and sanitizers, while social media posts warn of possible lockdowns. US virologist Lin Xiaoxu cautions that transparency about the death remains unclear. No evidence yet confirms a pneumonic plague outbreak or its source; investigations ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 肺ペストが中国に飛び火？ 東北三省で食料・医薬品の買いだめが拡大、封鎖懸念の噂 | 中露国境の感染症 | ロシア・ペスト研究所 | 東北三省の備蓄
triage.triage_reason: ロシア国境付近での原因不明死亡例を発端に中国東北部で肺ペストの噂が拡大し、買いだめ等の社会的関心が急激に高まっているため、確認作業を含めたフルリスク評価への移行が望ましい。
triage.notes: ロシア人研究所職員の死亡原因は未確定で、肺ペストのアウトブレイクは公式には確認されていない。中国当局も発生を否定しているが、SNSやデマにより東北三省で買いだめ・封鎖懸念が拡大しており、社会的関心の高さから続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 俄疑爆肺鼠疫 触发中国民众封城恐怖记忆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's suspected pneumonic plague outbreak triggers Chinese people's terrifying memory of lockdowns.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-09, in Russia’s Siberian region, a laboratory worker died; officials initially cited unknown cause, later describing it as pneumonia of unknown origin, fueling speculation of pneumonic plague. The news crossed into China, triggering public anxiety, especially in the Northeast provinces, with chatter about city lockdowns and stockpiling antibiotics such as doxycycline on social media. Mainland commentators say fears echo Covid memories and distrust of government transparency, while some compare the pattern to Wuhan outbreak narratives around high-containment labs and possible accidents. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis and spread by droplets, is the deadliest form; WHO notes mortality up to 30–100% if untreated. The CDC says doxycycline and ciprofloxacin are treatment or post-exposure options, but warns against self-medication. No reliable reports confirm stockpiling, price hikes, or confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで疑われる肺ペスト発生、中国民衆に都市封鎖の恐怖の記憶を呼び起こす
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの検査室職員1名の死亡が肺ペストの疑いとして報道されているが、公式確認はなく、中国は反応・パニックの文脈でのみ言及されている。対象国での実際の発生事例ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はロシア（対象国リスト外）。中国は社会的反応（パニック、買いだめの噂）の文脈でのみ登場し、感染症の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。確定症例や公式発表はなく、未確認情報に基づく記事である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana declares yellow fever outbreak as 3 die from infections - MyDailyNewsOnline
article.articleSummary: Ghana declares yellow fever outbreak in the Upper West Region, with three deaths among confirmed cases. Samples collected from Wa West and Sissala West districts tested positive for yellow fever. The Ministry of Health states that national and regional emergency operations centers have been activated, and rapid response teams deployed for case finding, surveillance, and risk communication in affected communities. Emergency vaccination campaigns are being prepared in Wa West, Sissala West, and Sissala East districts this month. Yellow fever is a mosquito-borne viral infection; mosquitoes bite mostly during the day. Reported symptoms include fever, yellowing of the skin and eyes, dark urine, abdominal pain with vomiting, and bleeding from the mouth, nose, eyes, or stomach. This summary reflects information as of 2026-10-09. Keywords: outbreak, vaccination, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナが黄熱病の流行を宣言、感染により3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ保健省が黄熱病の流行を公式に宣言し、死亡例が複数確認されたため、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）およびWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）が複数該当する。
triage.notes: ガーナ北西部（Upper West Region）のWa West、Sissala West、Sissala East各郡で黄熱病確定例が報告され、死亡例3例を含む。緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンが準備されており、国家・地域レベルの緊急対応センターが稼働中。蚊媒介性ウイルス感染症であり、地域内での拡大リスクに留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya's first Ebola case: Questions remain after man travelled across three nations undetected
article.articleSummary: Kenya's first confirmed Ebola case was a 40-year-old Kenyan businessman diagnosed with Bundibugyo Ebola on arrival at Nairobi Hospital; he died on 5 October. Investigations reconstruct a six-week travels across three nations, highlighting missed detection opportunities. He spent late August–September in DR Congo's Bas-Uélé, visiting Buta, Aketi and Likati, where an Ebola case was recorded in Buta in August, though the source remains unclear. He flew to Kisangani on 20 September for over 10 days of care, then on 1 October to Beni and Kasindi (North Kivu, a region with 1,755 infections and >1,000 deaths). He crossed into Uganda, then reached Nairobi on 3 October; Ugandan airport screening reported no fever. Lab tests confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola in Nairobi; he died two days later. Kenya identified 66 potential contacts; WHO warns numbers may rise as tracing continues. DR Congo’s ongoing outbreak has >4,000 deaths this year; Kenya has screened about 652,000 travellers and trained nearly 5,000 healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ症例：3カ国を未検知のまま移動した男性を巡る疑問
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラ流行に関連し、感染者が検疫をすり抜けて複数国を移動しケニアで死亡した事例であり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の重大性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染源となったDRCの流行拡大が主題であるため含めた。国境を越えた未検知の感染者移動は国際保健規則上の重大事案であり、WHOによる接触者調査継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Heat Erodes Wolbachia Shield Against Dengue in Mosquitoes, Study Finds
article.articleSummary: Vietnamese laboratory study shows elevated rearing temperature weakens Wolbachia (wMel)-mediated protection against dengue virus (DENV) in Aedes aegypti. Using blood from thirteen dengue patients at Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases to feed wMel-infected mosquitoes, researchers compared cohorts raised at 28±4°C and 31±4°C. At 31°C, infectious saliva appeared more frequently, signaling greater potential for human transmission; nevertheless, the Wolbachia block was not abolished, as wMel-infected mosquitoes remained less likely than wild-type to produce infectious saliva. Heat reduced Wolbachia densities in ovaries, midgut, and salivary glands, plausibly explaining reduced blocking. Dengue serotypes DENV-1 and DENV-4 replicated more at higher temperatures in wMel mosquitoes. Dissemination to head/thorax and viral load in those tissues predicted breakthrough infections, whereas Wolbachia density did not. Implications: wMel deployments remain valuable but efficacy margins narrow during hot conditions linked to urban heat islands and climate change in dengue-endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: 高温がウォルバキアによるデング熱防御効果を低下させる、蚊を用いた研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生報告ではなく、ラボでの基礎研究（温度とWolbachia効果の関係）に関する科学記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要するシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナム・ホーチミン市の研究室で行われた実験研究の報告であり、実際のデング熱アウトブレイクや症例急増を報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象の感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Primo' do Aedes aegypti consegue pôr ovos a mais de 10 metros do solo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aedes aegypti's 'cousin' can lay eggs more than 10 meters above the ground.
article.articleSummary: Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil — Aedes albopictus, a relative of Aedes aegypti, can lay eggs up to 10.8 meters above ground, a three- to four-story height, per a study in EntomoBrasilis. Researchers from INPA, the Heitor Vieira Dourado Tropical Medicine Foundation, and Brazilian universities installed 30 traps on a six-story tower in Manaus and collected over 35,000 eggs across ten weeks. Eggs were most abundant near ground level, but elevated floors also contained eggs. Humidity influenced egg numbers during the dry season (about 34% of the observed variation); in the rainy season, humidity, temperature, and rainfall showed no significant relationship. The species can transmit dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever; however, Brazil has no confirmed natural dengue transmission attributed to this species yet. The findings highlight the need to monitor upper floors and indoor water containers, and to explore how these mosquitoes reach higher levels or may sustain virus transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ネッタイシマカの「いとこ」、地上10メートル以上の高さでも産卵可能
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の生態に関する学術研究報告であり、実際の感染症発生や症例報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はヒトスジシマカ（Aedes albopictus）の産卵高度に関する昆虫学的研究結果の報告であり、ブラジルにおける実際のデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱・黄熱の発生事例ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、感染症イベントそのものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Sugar Bait Traps Fail to Curb Malaria in Landmark Three-Country Trial
article.articleSummary: Malaria control using attractive targeted sugar baits (ATSB) with Westham Sarabi v1.2 failed to reduce malaria in three large Phase III trials conducted in Kenya, Mali, and Zambia. The bait stations used 0.11% dinotefuran and were mounted two per house on exterior walls. Across nearly 7,000 child-years, and 6,981 person-years for clinical malaria incidence, the study found no statistically significant differences between intervention and control for clinical malaria, Plasmodium falciparum infection prevalence, or four entomological measures (parity, mosquito abundance, landing rate, sporozoite positivity) in Anopheles. A post-hoc analysis revealed a dose-response: each additional 10 bait stations per hectare correlated with a 19% reduction in clinical malaria incidence (IRR 0.81; 95% CI 0.74-0.89; p<0.001), but only when baits were in good condition. Implication: deployment density and bait maintenance may determine efficacy; thresholds remain undetermined. Methodological lessons for future cluster trials.

triage.headline_ja: 砂糖餌トラップ、画期的な3カ国試験でマラリア抑制に失敗
triage.triage_reason: マラリア対策介入（ATSB）の臨床試験結果に関する研究報告であり、新規の異常な感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は介入試験（砂糖餌トラップ）の有効性評価に関する研究報告であり、マラリアの異常発生や公衆衛生危機を報じるものではない。マリ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外、ザンビアのみ対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Syphilis Bacteria Found in Spinal Fluid Across All Disease Stages
article.articleSummary: In a Shanghai, China-based study published in BMC Infectious Diseases, Treponema pallidum DNA was detected in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) of HIV-negative adults across all syphilis stages, including early primary/secondary, latent, and symptomatic neurosyphilis. The Tongji University-affiliated Shanghai Skin Disease Hospital enrolled 155 untreated patients (47 primary/secondary, 70 latent, 38 neurosyphilis). CSF and blood plasma were analyzed by nested PCR targeting polA and Tpp47. Detection in CSF occurred in 17.0% of primary/secondary, 17.1% latent, and 28.9% neurosyphilis (P=0.284). Roughly one in six early/latent cases, and nearly one in three symptomatic cases, carried CSF DNA; importantly, 14.6% with normal TPPA/RPR and normal CSF still harbored bacterial DNA. CSF–plasma agreement was poor (kappa 0.1). Findings imply CNS invasion can occur early and silently, challenging reliance on standard CSF markers.

triage.headline_ja: 梅毒菌、すべての病期において脊髄液中に検出される
triage.triage_reason: 単一研究機関による学術研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は梅毒の病態生理に関する学術研究であり、感染症アウトブレイクイベントではないため対象国の発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: وفاة باحثة روسية تثير مخاوف دولية من احتمال تفشي الطاعون الرئوي | ليبيا أوبزيرفر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a Russian researcher raises international concerns over the potential outbreak of pneumonic plague | Libya Observer
article.articleSummary: Darya Shibelova, a 28-year-old Russian researcher at an Irkutsk plague-control institute in Siberia, died in a Shelikhov-area hospital after acute pneumonia. A laboratory incident reportedly shattered a test tube, prompting concern about possible exposure to pneumonic plague, though no confirmed link has been established. Media reports suggested up to about 200 people could have been exposed; Russian authorities said no dangerous pathogens were found among contacts and monitoring has ended. Authorities also denied an online document about plague containment; the cause of death remains unconfirmed as investigations focus on pneumonia. International responses: the United States requests more information and transparency; China and Mongolia monitor developments; WHO says there are no confirmed plague cases in Irkutsk, notes an ongoing epidemiological investigation, and seeks details on the pneumonia and a second potential case. Pneumonic plague is highly transmissible via respiratory droplets and requires early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人研究者の死亡、肺ペスト流行の可能性をめぐり国際的懸念が高まる｜リビア・オブザーバー
triage.triage_reason: シベリア・イルクーツクのペスト研究施設で実験管理事故が発生し、研究者が急性肺炎で死亡。WHOや米国・中国・モンゴルが注視するなど国際的関心が高く、肺ペストの可能性が完全には否定されていないためフルRRAでの評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Low Sodium and High Neutrophils Mark Severe COVID-19 in Children, Study
article.articleSummary: In a retrospective Chinese study of 519 children hospitalized with symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection (Dec 2022–Dec 2025), 345 (66.4%) were infants or toddlers. Disease severity split: 37.0% mild (192), 43.7% moderate (227), 19.3% severe/critical (100); all patients recovered. Compared BA.5-dominant period with post-BA.5 period, severe/critical disease, supplemental oxygen use, length of stay, and complications were significantly higher during BA.5 era. Neurological symptoms were more frequent in the BA.5 period, while viral co-detection was lower. Multivariable analysis initially flagged neurological symptoms, BA.5 period, and young age as risk factors for severe/critical disease, but sensitivity analyses using Firth penalized regression showed Definitional circularity and unstable age/period effects. Only hyponatremia (low sodium) and elevated neutrophil count remained robust predictors across analyses, suggesting two simple laboratory measures may reliably signal impending severity in pediatric COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 低ナトリウム血症と好中球増多が小児の重症COVID-19の指標に、研究で判明

article.articleHeadline: Flu-like illnesses rise across Kashmir, doctors urge precautions
article.articleSummary: Influenza has an early start in Kashmir this year, with a surge across age groups and areas around Srinagar as winter approaches. Respiratory infections are increasing, and influenza can lead to complications requiring hospitalisation in high‑risk groups. Pulmonologist Prof. Naveed Nazir Shah notes the surge began earlier this year, with September activity rather than November as typical; secondary infections and pneumonia are being observed. Seek medical help if symptoms persist beyond a week, or if breathlessness or high fever occurs. High‑risk individuals—diabetes, lung disease, or immunocompromised—should receive the trivalent influenza vaccine this season; children under five are also advised to vaccinate. SKIMS issued a public health advisory urging influenza and pneumonia vaccination, hand hygiene, and avoidance of unnecessary antibiotics. Autumn/winter conditions favour viral spread and can worsen asthma, COPD, and cardiovascular ailments. Most people recover in about a week, but lab confirmation is needed to prove influenza.

triage.headline_ja: カシミール全域でインフルエンザ様疾患が増加、医師らが注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行が例年より早く始まっている点は注目されるが、重篤な集団発生や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、通常の季節性公衆衛生情報の範囲内。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの早期発生で地域医療機関（SKIMS）がワクチン接種を呼びかけているが、重症度や死亡者数などの具体的データは記事に含まれず不明。

article.articleHeadline: 孩子被动物咬伤要不要打狂犬病疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Should a child bitten by an animal receive the rabies vaccine?
article.articleSummary: Rabies is a deadly zoonosis; once symptoms appear, mortality is nearly 100%. High-risk animals include dogs and cats (including strays), wild carnivores, and especially bats; any bat exposure is treated as high risk. Most other animals—birds, aquatic animals, reptiles, amphibians, and especially rodents and rabbits—pose negligible risk. China’s 2023 Rabies Exposure Prevention guidelines classify exposures I–III: I—contact or licking with intact skin; II—minor bite/scratch; III—deep bite, mucosal or open-wound exposure, or bat contact. I requires cleansing; II requires wound care plus vaccine; III requires wound care, rabies vaccine, and rabies immunoglobulin. Special cases: bat contact always III; head/face/neck injuries upgrade to III. Domestic cats/dogs vaccinated and indoors may be observed instead of immediate vaccination. Pre-exposure vaccination is advised for high-risk workers and travelers. Early vaccination is crucial; incubation is usually 1–3 months. Beijing Children’s Hospital Rabies Vaccination Clinic stresses rapid wound cleaning and integrated vaccination and tetanus services.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもが動物に噛まれた場合、狂犬病ワクチンを接種すべきか

triage.notes: 本記事は北京児童病院による狂犬病曝露後の対応（暴露分類・ワクチン接種基準等）に関する一般的な啓発・解説記事であり、具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Russian Lab Death Sparks Intense Plague Panic in China
article.articleSummary: 28-year-old Darya Shipilova died in early October at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute, Russia, amid unusual circumstances tied to a high-security plague facility. Russian officials deny a lab leak; they attribute the death to an unknown viral pneumonia, while unverified reports allege she accidentally broke a live pneumonic plague tube. About 200 people she had contact with were placed under medical observation; a Shelekhov district hospital was briefly locked down and later cleared after negative tests. The World Health Organization has urged Russia to provide transparent data to assess global risk. Pneumonic plague is highly contagious by air and presents with high fever, weakness, and rapid pneumonia; untreated cases are usually fatal within days. In China, panic has spurred antibiotic purchases along several northern border towns; authorities warn against self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所での死亡事例が中国でペスト恐慌を引き起こす

triage.notes: 実際の感染事例はロシア（イルクーツク）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。中国での反応は抗生物質購入などのパニックのみで、疾病発生自体は確認されていないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: الإيبولا يوسع دائرة القلق فى أفريقيا.. إصابة وافدة فى كينيا وتسارع التفشى بالكونغو وقيود التنقل تهدد وصول المساعدات.. يونيسف: أكثر من 1900 طفل يواجهون تداعيات فقدان الوالدين ومخاوف من تفاقم الأزمة الإنسانية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola widens the circle of concern in Africa; an imported case in Kenya and the rapid spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and movement restrictions threaten aid delivery; UNICEF: more than 1,900 children face the consequences of losing their parents and fears of a worsening humanitarian crisis - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola case confirmed in Kenya; authorities identified, isolated, and tested the patient. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola transmission is accelerating, with Ituri and North Kivu provinces reporting the vast majority of new infections (over 94%). Movement restrictions on several main roads aim to contain spread but risk limiting humanitarian access and aid delivery. UNICEF reports more than 1,900 children have lost one or both parents or caregivers or become separated since Ebola’s outbreak began in May, heightening protection and psychosocial needs. UN agencies warn that road controls may hinder relief operations, while continuing to back authorities to expand the response. Kenya’s first imported case highlights cross-border transmission risks, and the UN and partners stress the importance of safeguarding aid delivery and ensuring care for affected children through facilities near treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカで懸念を拡大…ケニアで輸入症例、コンゴでの流行加速、移動制限が援助到達を脅かす…ユニセフ：1900人以上の子どもが両親を失う影響に直面し、人道危機悪化への懸念
